note: Machine translation of the website (tools/website/translate_site.py); fix a row's text to improve it.

00004330479bcbe5.source: That copy updates with DDM: a new DDM replaces its files, and the browser uses them from its next start. Keep one copy only: if you add the store's later, remove this one.
00004330479bcbe5.text: 这个副本随 DDM 一起更新：新版本的 DDM 会替换它的文件，浏览器在下次启动时使用它们。只保留一个副本：如果之后添加了商店版本，请删除这一个。

0014a3bf18679290.source: The first time, Windows may ask whether to let DDM communicate on networks: allow it on private networks, or the phone can't reach DDM.
0014a3bf18679290.text: 首次使用时，Windows 可能会询问是否允许 DDM 在网络上通信：请允许其在专用网络上通信，否则手机无法连接 DDM。

0017931594681f79.source: <g1><g2>Portable mode</g2></g1> — run DDM from a folder or a USB stick without installing it.
0017931594681f79.text: <g1><g2>便携模式</g2></g1> — 无需安装即可从文件夹或 U 盘运行 DDM。

0024cb13460f1e1f.source: DDM saves each download's progress as it goes, so a Windows crash, a power cut or closing DDM loses at most the last moments.
0024cb13460f1e1f.text: DDM 会在下载过程中保存每个下载的进度，因此 Windows 崩溃、断电或关闭 DDM 最多只会丢失最后时刻的进度。

0025b509f2663050.source: Runs on most distributions: make it executable (<x1/>) and run it. It updates itself in place (<g2>Help → Check for updates</g2>).
0025b509f2663050.text: 可在大多数发行版上运行：使其可执行（<x1/>）并运行。它会原地更新（<g2>帮助 → 检查更新</g2>）。

003e18571307edf6.source: <g1>Under your speed limits</g1>: the <g2>Speed Limiter</g2>'s, the video's own (its progress window's <g3>Speed Limiter</g3> tab), and the limit for all downloads together. A change applies at once.
003e18571307edf6.text: <g1>在您的速度限制下</g1>：包括<g2>速度限制器</g2>的限制、视频本身的限制（其进度窗口的<g3>速度限制器</g3>选项卡），以及所有下载任务的总限制。任何更改都会立即生效。

0047e3c92be9288c.source: After a few months the list can hold hundreds of downloads. Here are four ways to get to the one you want.
0047e3c92be9288c.text: 几个月后，列表可能会包含数百个下载。这里有四种方法可以找到您想要的下载。

004ce569701a199b.source: On macOS only an administrator can schedule a wake, so the option is greyed. DDM doesn't ask for an administrator's password. An administrator can have the Mac wake every day a minute before the queue starts, for example at 10:59 PM for a queue that starts at 11:00 PM:
004ce569701a199b.text: 在 macOS 上，只有管理员才能安排唤醒，因此该选项是灰色的。DDM 不会要求管理员密码。管理员可以设置 Mac 在队列开始前一分钟每天唤醒，例如，对于晚上 11:00 开始的队列，在晚上 10:59 唤醒：

0051f4b8843f85f5.source: DDM asks the server for the file's name and size, and shows them in <g1>Download File Info</g1>. The window opens at once, even while DDM sits in the notification area: under the file's icon it says <g2>Checking...</g2> while the server answers, and the size takes its place as soon as it does (a download the browser handed over comes with its size, so there is nothing to wait for).
0051f4b8843f85f5.text: DDM 会向服务器询问文件的名称和大小，并显示在<g1>下载文件信息</g1>中。窗口会立即打开，即使 DDM 当时在通知区域中：在服务器回应期间，文件图标下方显示<g2>正在检查...</g2>，一得到回应就换成文件大小（浏览器交来的下载自带大小，所以无需等待）。

006bcd211ae86394.source: These pages explain each part of the program. The tutorials walk through the things people do most, one task each.
006bcd211ae86394.text: 这些页面介绍了程序的各个部分。教程会逐步讲解大家最常做的操作，每个教程介绍一项操作。

0098dc925a6174d6.source: Acts on downloads by id: <x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/> (file kept), <x4/> (file deleted too) or <x5/> (shows the file in its folder, as <g6>Open folder</g6> does). Answers <x7/>; a running download must be paused before it is removed or deleted. Only while the API is on.
0098dc925a6174d6.text: 按 ID 对下载执行操作：<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/>（保留文件）、<x4/>（同时删除文件）或 <x5/>（在文件夹中显示文件，与<g6>打开文件夹</g6>相同）。返回 <x7/>；运行中的下载必须先暂停，才能被移除或删除。仅在 API 开启时有效。

00a7253abb008136.source: Report a problem with a translation →

00c0b83711a9aa44.source: On a Linux system without CA certificates (a minimal install without the <x1/> package), torrents still work: peers, the DHT and <x2/> trackers. An <x3/> tracker can't be checked there, so DDM skips it; install that package to use those too.
00c0b83711a9aa44.text: 在没有 CA 证书的 Linux 系统上（未安装 <x1/> 软件包的最小化安装），种子仍然可以工作：对等节点、DHT 和 <x2/> 跟踪器。无法在此类系统上检查 <x3/> 跟踪器，因此 DDM 会跳过它；安装该软件包即可使用这些功能。

00c4e6015cb2a0d5.source: In <g1>Link grabber</g1>, the volumes of one archive form one package. Each package has its folder, the archives' password, <g2>Extract when done</g2> (ticked by itself when the package holds an archive) and <g3>Delete archives after extracting</g3>. The password is kept in memory only, never written to disk.
00c4e6015cb2a0d5.text: 在<g1>链接抓取器</g1>中，一个压缩包的所有分卷会组成一个包。每个包都有自己的文件夹、压缩包密码、<g2>完成后提取</g2>（当包包含压缩包时会自动勾选）和<g3>提取后删除存档</g3>。密码仅保存在内存中，绝不会写入磁盘。

00deae29052686c9.source: The download list, text boxes and menus
00deae29052686c9.text: 下载列表、文本框和菜单

00dfff13e69e9ac7.text: 一个列表，管理所有下载

00ec64d3ac29c27c.source: Adding downloads — Dannex Download Manager help
00ec64d3ac29c27c.text: 添加下载 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

00ede073a341fb2a.source: <g1>Dannex Download Manager stopped responding</g1>: its window didn't answer for 8 seconds. DDM is still running, frozen. <g2>End and restart DDM</g2> closes the frozen copy and starts a new one. If DDM answers again by itself, the window says so.
00ede073a341fb2a.text: <g1>Dannex Download Manager 停止响应</g1>：窗口连续 8 秒没有响应。DDM 仍在运行，但已冻结。<g2>结束并重启 DDM</g2>会关闭已冻结的程序副本并启动一个新的副本。如果 DDM 自行恢复响应，窗口会显示这一情况。

0101e95bc6b6502c.source: Hold <g1>Ctrl+Alt</g1> while clicking a link to have DDM download it whatever its type, as <g2>Download with DDM</g2> in the right-click menu does: a page, a picture, a file type Options leave to the browser. Neither the page nor the browser does anything else with that click (no tab opens).
0101e95bc6b6502c.text: 点击链接时按住 <g1>Ctrl+Alt</g1>，可让 DDM 下载它，不论其类型，效果与右键菜单中的<g2>使用 DDM 下载</g2>相同：包括网页、图片，以及选项留给浏览器处理的文件类型。这次点击，页面和浏览器都不会再做别的事（不会打开标签页）。

0116b75ba3243932.source: <g1>Depth</g1>: how many links away from the start page it reads pages. 0 reads the start page only; 2 reads the pages it links to, and the pages those link to.
0116b75ba3243932.text: <g1>深度</g1>：从起始页面向外读取多少层链接内的页面。0 只读取起始页面；2 会读取它链接到的页面，以及那些页面所链接到的页面。

0144648fb3f3d061.source: <g1>Tick all</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+A</g2>), <g3>Tick none</g3> (<g4>Ctrl+Shift+A</g4>) and <g5>Invert</g5> (<g6>Ctrl+I</g6>) act on the links shown.
0144648fb3f3d061.text: <g1>全选</g1>（<g2>Ctrl+A</g2>）、<g3>全不选</g3>（<g4>Ctrl+Shift+A</g4>）和<g5>反选</g5>（<g6>Ctrl+I</g6>）作用于显示的链接。

01694d953d6f34a7.source: the API: <x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>; how it runs: <x6/>, <x7/>, <x8/> (the first request), <x9/> (a fresh download to the planner), <x10/>, <x11/>, <x12/> (verification and repair), <x13/> (one connection's work), <x14/>;

017ae946397f5cac.source: DDM downloads BitTorrent files from magnet links and .torrent files. Torrents appear in the same list as other downloads, marked Torrent in the Source…
017ae946397f5cac.text: DDM 可通过磁力链接和 .torrent 文件下载 BitTorrent 文件。种子会与其他下载一起显示在同一列表中，并在“源”列中标记为“种子”…

01a849d31d234662.source: Import your download list from IDM — Dannex Download Manager
01a849d31d234662.text: 从 IDM 导入下载列表 — Dannex Download Manager

01bcaeaab78b066e.source: A page address that points at one video inside a playlist or a mix (for example <x1/>) downloads that one video, never the whole list.
01bcaeaab78b066e.text: 如果页面地址指向播放列表或混音中的某个视频（例如 <x1/>），只会下载该视频，不会下载整个列表。

01c4c1faa63db5e5.source: Add it to the main download queue without starting it.
01c4c1faa63db5e5.text: 将其添加到主下载队列，但不开始下载。

01d01057d15da7cc.source: A server far by its round trip (over 150 ms)
01d01057d15da7cc.text: 往返时间较长（超过 150 毫秒）的服务器

01e8f0b4acca66a4.source: <g1>Start Download</g1> (or <g2>Enter</g2>) — download now. The progress window opens.
01e8f0b4acca66a4.text: <g1>开始下载</g1>（或<g2>Enter</g2>） — 立即下载。进度窗口打开。

01ff3dac53c05f4d.source: The box under the list edits the package of the selected row:
01ff3dac53c05f4d.text: 列表下方的框用于编辑所选行的包：

02134bd4a394a140.source: Torrents and magnet links, in the list you already use.
02134bd4a394a140.text: 种子和磁力链接，就在您已使用的列表中。

0229b9ca87857c4c.source: A scheme changes colours only, on the classic look: every window, button and menu stays where it was. A dark scheme makes DDM dark and a light one light, whatever <g1>View → Always dark</g1> says. The scheme's colours go where they mean the same:
0229b9ca87857c4c.text: 方案只改变经典外观的颜色：所有窗口、按钮和菜单都保持原位。深色方案使 DDM 变暗，浅色方案使 DDM 变亮，无论 <g1>视图 → 始终为深色</g1> 的设置如何。方案的颜色会应用到其含义相同的位置：

023161030ce98143.source: <g1>Size</g1>, once DDM has looked the link up (see below);
023161030ce98143.text: <g1>大小</g1>，DDM 查询到该链接之后显示（见下）；

02371ffa84de243f.source: Yes. Put downloads in a queue and let the Scheduler start it at a set time, stop it at another, and even shut down or put the computer to sleep when the queue is done. See <g1>Download overnight</g1>.
02371ffa84de243f.text: 可以。将下载任务放入队列，让计划程序在设定时间开始，在另一时间停止，甚至在队列完成后关闭或休眠计算机。请参阅<g1>通宵下载</g1>。

0251eaa65cf18141.source: With a debrid account, torrents and magnet links can go to the service instead of to peers, and DDM downloads the files from it over HTTP: see <g1>Torrents through the service</g1>.
0251eaa65cf18141.text: 通过网盘账户，种子和磁力链接可以发送到服务而不是对等节点，DDM 会通过 HTTP 从该服务下载文件：请参阅<g1>通过服务下载种子</g1>。

02575b1206e9ed9c.source: It's a theme already. A <g1>Base16 or Base24 scheme</g1> (<x2/>) or pywal's <x3/>, added the same way, changes DDM's colours and nothing else: the scheme's backgrounds behind the list and the windows, its text kept readable (4.5:1 or more), its blue on the focus, the selection and the progress bar. Once <x4/> has run, <g5>View → Theme</g5> lists <g6>pywal</g6>, read from <x7/> (
02575b1206e9ed9c.text: 它本身就是一个主题。<g1>Base16 或 Base24 配色方案</g1>（<x2/>）或 pywal 的 <x3/>，以相同方式添加，只改变 DDM 的颜色：列表和窗口的背景色、保持可读的文本颜色（4.5:1 或更高）、焦点、选择和进度条的蓝色。一旦 <x4/> 运行，<g5>视图 → 主题</g5> 会列出从 <x7/> 读取的 <g6>pywal</g6>（

026a1b767daa1fa2.source: <g1>File name or part of the name</g1> — on by default.
026a1b767daa1fa2.text: <g1>文件名或名称的一部分</g1> — 默认开启。

02a3ebd04f6ae293.source: Each release lists the <g1>SHA-256</g1> checksum of every file in <x2/>. Check your download against it: see <g3>Download</g3>.
02a3ebd04f6ae293.text: 每个版本都列出了 <x2/> 中每个文件的 <g1>SHA-256</g1> 校验和。请对照它检查您的下载：请参阅<g3>下载</g3>。

02b95a4f44948228.source: <g1>Download only what you have the right to.</g1> You are responsible for what you download and share.
02b95a4f44948228.text: <g1>只下载您有权下载的内容。</g1>您对您下载和分享的内容负责。

02d3f7c49a396162.source: Videos protected with DRM, as most paid streaming services use, can't be downloaded, and DDM doesn't try. Downloading may be against some sites' terms: checking that is up to you.
02d3f7c49a396162.text: 大多数付费流媒体服务使用的 DRM 保护视频无法下载，DDM 也不会尝试。下载可能违反某些网站的服务条款：您需要自行检查。

02e598ee413c0595.source: A checked box's or radio's accent
02e598ee413c0595.text: 选中复选框或单选框的强调色

02ead06d261194ac.source: Point at a video and a small <g1>Download video</g1> button appears at its edge. It opens DDM's <g2>Download video from a page</g2> window with the qualities on offer (see <g3>video downloads</g3>). You can hide it on one video or one site, or turn it off in <g4>Options</g4>.
02ead06d261194ac.text: 指向视频时，其边缘会出现一个小的<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮。它会打开 DDM 的<g2>从页面下载视频</g2>窗口，其中显示了可用的画质（请参阅<g3>视频下载</g3>）。您可以在单个视频或单个网站上隐藏它，或在<g4>选项</g4>中将其关闭。

02f56de89605a75e.source: DDM asks each service well under its request limit: Real-Debrid at most 120 times a minute (it allows 250), AllDebrid 300 (it allows 600), Premiumize 60 (it publishes no limit), TorBox 120 (it allows 300 a minute, and 60 new web downloads an hour). When a service says it's asked too often, DDM waits.
02f56de89605a75e.text: DDM 对每个服务的请求次数远低于其限制：Real-Debrid 每分钟最多 120 次 (它允许 250 次)，AllDebrid 300 次 (它允许 600 次)，Premiumize 60 次 (它未公布限制)，TorBox 120 次 (它允许每分钟 300 次，每小时 60 次新网页下载)。当服务提示请求过于频繁时，DDM 会等待。

02f824962fd84248.source: This cap is shared by every download, however many run at once. It works on its own; you don't need to turn the Speed Limiter on.
02f824962fd84248.text: 无论同时运行多少个下载，此限制都由所有下载共享。它独立工作；您无需开启速度限制器。

031da5c20d1881e4.text: 计划程序能做的所有事情 →

03506d1b88dc282f.source: The area under a speed graph's line, at the line (it fades toward the bottom)
03506d1b88dc282f.text: 速度图线条下方的区域，靠近线条处（向底部渐隐）

03615f08519b4f49.source: <g1>Tasks → Link grabber...</g1> opens the same window empty: paste text with links in it (<g2>Ctrl+V</g2>). See <g3>Link grabber and archives</g3> for the packages, the archive password and extracting archives when they are downloaded.
03615f08519b4f49.text: <g1>任务 → 链接抓取器...</g1>会打开一个空白的同一窗口：粘贴包含链接的文本（<g2>Ctrl+V</g2>）。有关下载包、压缩包密码以及下载完成后解压压缩包的信息，请参阅<g3>链接抓取器和压缩包</g3>。

0364c0cf3df3d7e2.source: Select the download and click <g1>Resume</g1>. Many errors are a server or connection having a bad moment.
0364c0cf3df3d7e2.text: 选择下载任务并点击<g1>恢复</g1>。很多错误只是服务器或连接暂时出了问题。

037e54db1d283569.source: No. DDM has no accounts, no analytics and no telemetry. It connects to the servers you download from and, each time it starts and once a day while it runs, asks GitHub whether a newer version exists (you can turn that off in Help → Check for updates). The browser extension talks only to DDM on your own computer. The details are in the <g1>privacy policy</g1>.
037e54db1d283569.text: 不。DDM 没有账户、分析和遥测功能。它连接到您下载的服务器，并在每次启动时和运行时每天一次向 GitHub 查询是否有新版本（您可以在“帮助”→“检查更新”中关闭此功能）。浏览器扩展程序只与您自己电脑上的 DDM 通信。详细信息请参阅<g1>隐私政策</g1>。

039a3bf8ea2e0dae.source: 10 built-in looks for Dannex Download Manager, each light and dark: Classic, Native, High contrast, Metro, Adwaita, Breeze, Luna, Aero, Aqua, Emerald. Or make your own in a text file.
039a3bf8ea2e0dae.text: Dannex Download Manager 提供了 10 种内置外观，每种都有亮色和暗色模式：经典、原生、高对比度、现代、Adwaita、Breeze、Luna、Aero、Aqua、翡翠。您也可以在文本文件中创建自己的主题。

03b1ad40625d83e8.source: Yes, completely. Dannex Download Manager (DDM) is free and open-source software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. There is no trial period…
03b1ad40625d83e8.text: 是的，完全免费。Dannex Download Manager (DDM) 是在 GNU 通用公共许可证第 3 版下发布的免费开源软件。没有试用期…

03b53593fe38abb0.source: For video pages, DDM downloads yt-dlp (and ffmpeg if you want merged qualities) the first time you need them.
03b53593fe38abb0.text: 对于视频页面，DDM 会在您首次需要时下载 yt-dlp（如需合并画质，还会下载 ffmpeg）。

03c0d4a7540da82c.source: A download's progress window can go there as well, with its Minimize, with <g1>Esc</g1>, or with its <g2>Hide to the notification area</g2> button: a short dash with an arrow down to the corner. The download goes on. (Its close box <g3>×</g3> stops the download instead, as <g4>Cancel</g4> does.)
03c0d4a7540da82c.text: 下载的进度窗口也可以放到那里，方法是使用其“最小化”、按 <g1>Esc</g1>，或使用其<g2>隐藏到通知区域</g2>按钮：一条短横线加一个指向角落的向下箭头。下载继续进行。（其关闭框 <g3>×</g3> 则会停止下载，与<g4>取消</g4>相同。）

040a0a6a2988381d.source: If the site replaced the file with a new version, the parts DDM has don't fit any more. Right-click the download and choose <g1>Redownload</g1> to start again from the beginning. A finished file is only replaced when the new download completes.
040a0a6a2988381d.text: 如果网站用新版本替换了文件，DDM 已下载的部分就不再匹配。右键点击下载并选择<g1>重新下载</g1>以从头开始。只有当新下载完成时，已完成的文件才会被替换。

0410e8d07c304fbe.source: Can my AI assistant use DDM? — Dannex Download Manager
0410e8d07c304fbe.text: 我的 AI 助手可以使用 DDM 吗？— Dannex Download Manager

042f649662bebfc1.source: DDM opens where you left it: the window's place and size, the Categories pane, its open branches and the category or queue you were looking at.
042f649662bebfc1.text: DDM 会在上次关闭时的位置和大小打开窗口，并恢复类别窗格、展开的分支，以及您当时查看的类别或队列。

0483013fd35a5fd8.source: <g1>Options → General → Take downloads from web browsers</g1> is on, and your browser is ticked under <g2>Take downloads from these browsers</g2>.
0483013fd35a5fd8.text: <g1>选项 → 常规 → 接管浏览器的下载</g1>已开启，并且在<g2>接管这些浏览器的下载</g2>下已勾选您的浏览器。

04c59d01af7e5661.source: <g1>Speed limiter</g1><g2>One cap for all of DDM, a limit per file, and full speed when you're away.</g2>
04c59d01af7e5661.text: <g1>速度限制器</g1><g2>为 DDM 设置一个总限速，或为每个文件设置限速，当您离开时可全速下载。</g2>

A magnet link (Add URL, the browser, the clipboard, a drop) or a <x3/> file (Add torrent's <g4>Download Now</g4> or <g5>Later</g5>) then goes to the first account in the list:
04ea3f289327532e.text: 在<g2>选项 → 帐户</g2>中勾选<g1>将种子和磁力链接发送到第一个帐户，而不是发送给对等方</g1>。之后，磁力链接（通过添加 URL、浏览器、剪贴板或拖放添加）或<x3/>文件（通过“添加种子”中的<g4>立即下载</g4>或<g5>稍后</g5>操作）都会发送到列表中的第一个帐户：

04fa97e53d575da9.source: Copy-protected media (DRM: Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay, as Netflix, Spotify and most paid streaming and music services use) can't be saved: no tool may break that protection, and DDM doesn't try. When the page's player decrypts what it plays (it was given the browser's decryption keys, or met encrypted data), the button over that video or on that player's bar says <g1>Protected</g1>; a click says that it can't be saved, and nothing is looked up or sent. The toolbar panel's <g2>Download video</g2> says the same for that tab. A stream whose manifest says it is protected is never sent as the video's stream, and a file read as encrypted is never offered nor listed by <g3>Download all videos and audio</g3>: DDM looks the page up instead (a site may serve the same video unprotected another way), and says so when all of it is protected.
04fa97e53d575da9.text: 受版权保护的媒体（DRM：Widevine、PlayReady、FairPlay，Netflix、Spotify 和大多数付费流媒体与音乐服务都在使用）无法保存：任何工具都不得破解这种保护，DDM 也不会尝试。当页面的播放器解密它播放的内容时（它拿到了浏览器的解密密钥，或遇到了加密数据），该视频上方或该播放器栏上的按钮会显示<g1>受保护</g1>；点击它会提示无法保存，不会查找或发送任何内容。工具栏面板的<g2>下载视频</g2>对该标签页给出同样的提示。清单声明受保护的流绝不会作为视频的流发送，被识别为加密的文件绝不会被提供，也不会列在<g3>下载所有视频和音频</g3>中：DDM 转而查找该页面（网站可能以另一种方式提供同一视频的未受保护版本），并在全部受保护时告知。

05088ac8334b7b90.source: Dannex Download Manager (DDM) is a free download manager for Windows and Linux (and, still experimental, macOS). It is laid out the way Internet Download Manager users expect: a toolbar, categories on the left, one list of downloads and a browser extension that hands downloads to it.
05088ac8334b7b90.text: Dannex Download Manager (DDM) 是一款适用于 Windows 和 Linux（macOS 版本仍在实验中）的免费下载管理器。它的布局与 Internet Download Manager 用户所熟悉的界面一致：一个工具栏、左侧的类别、一个下载列表以及一个将下载任务交给它的浏览器扩展。

05105cdaa992861d.source: <g1>Dannex Download Manager isn't installed</g1>, a <g2>Download Dannex Download Manager</g2> button for your system (Windows setup, macOS .dmg, Linux AppImage, .deb or .rpm) and three short steps
05105cdaa992861d.text: <g1>Dannex Download Manager 未安装</g1>，一个适用于您系统的<g2>下载 Dannex Download Manager</g2>按钮（Windows 安装程序、macOS .dmg、Linux AppImage、.deb 或 .rpm）以及三个简短的步骤

052e65771dfdbc15.source: While the app is not notarized by Apple (the experimental builds are not), Safari lists the extension only with unsigned extensions allowed: <g1>Settings → Advanced</g1> → <g2>Show features for web developers</g2>, then <g3>Settings → Developer</g3> → <g4>Allow unsigned extensions</g4>. Safari forgets that setting each time it quits.
052e65771dfdbc15.text: 由于此应用程序未经 Apple 公证（实验版本未经公证），Safari 仅在允许未签名扩展程序时才列出此扩展程序：<g1>设置 → 高级</g1> → <g2>显示网页开发者功能</g2>，然后<g3>设置 → 开发者</g3> → <g4>允许未签名扩展程序</g4>。Safari 每次退出时都会忘记此设置。

053263e0b7c48cfa.text: 哪些内容会连接到您的计算机

053ee7266a83cbdf.source: <g1>One browser only:</g1> <g2>Options → General → Take downloads from these browsers</g2>. Untick the ones DDM should leave alone.
053ee7266a83cbdf.text: <g1>仅限一个浏览器：</g1><g2>选项 → 常规 → 接管这些浏览器的下载</g2>。取消勾选 DDM 应忽略的浏览器。

05570b2fd86d1903.source: <g1>Your own devices, for the remote control.</g1> Off until you turn it on in <g2>Options → Remote</g2>: then DDM answers, over HTTPS on your local network, only the phones and computers you paired with its code.
05570b2fd86d1903.text: <g1>您的设备，用于远程控制。</g1> 在<g2>选项 → 远程</g2>中开启前，此功能默认关闭：开启后，DDM 仅通过本地网络上的 HTTPS 协议响应您已用其代码配对的手机和电脑。

055ae1fc7cba3fea.source: Use <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1> in DDM: it opens the bug report form on GitHub with your version, system and language filled in. Or <g2>open the form</g2> yourself. Security problems go privately through the <g3>security page</g3>.
055ae1fc7cba3fea.text: 在 DDM 中使用<g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1>：它会打开 GitHub 上的错误报告表，并已填写您的版本、系统和语言信息。或者您也可以<g2>自行打开该表单</g2>。安全问题请通过<g3>安全页面</g3>私下提交。

056973ea0bc40de4.source: Use GitHub's private <g1><g2>Report a vulnerability</g2></g1> form. Only the maintainers can read it. Say what you found, how to reproduce it, and which version you used (<g3>Help → About</g3> shows it). Please don't open a public issue for security problems.
056973ea0bc40de4.text: 请使用 GitHub 的私密<g1><g2>报告漏洞</g2></g1>表单。只有维护者可以查看。请说明您发现的问题、复现方法以及使用的版本（可在<g3>帮助 → 关于</g3>中查看）。请勿公开提交安全问题。

057a7f50e1cb0dc0.source: DDM runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11, and on 64-bit Linux: see <g1>On Linux</g1>. Builds for macOS are new and still experimental: see <g2>On a Mac</g2>.
057a7f50e1cb0dc0.text: DDM 运行于 64 位 Windows 10 和 Windows 11，以及 64 位 Linux：请参阅<g1>在 Linux 上</g1>。macOS 版本是新推出的，仍在实验阶段：请参阅<g2>在 Mac 上</g2>。

0588c7c82fed2d21.source: Which browsers does it work with?

05a0e75094ba72e8.source: <g1>Firefox</g1> asks you once, at the switch, to allow the extension to read the browser's proxy; switching it off takes that permission back. DDM gets the proxy the browser's own request for the file took, including the ones a VPN extension picks for each request.
05a0e75094ba72e8.text: <g1>Firefox</g1>会在您切换时询问一次，以允许扩展读取浏览器的代理；关闭此选项会收回该权限。DDM 会获取浏览器自身请求文件时所用的代理，包括 VPN 扩展为每个请求选择的代理。

05cdb0c8c9d33bd7.source: <g1>Get automatic updates</g1>, once, quietly (also in the right-click menu)
05cdb0c8c9d33bd7.text: <g1>获取自动更新</g1>，仅提示一次，不打扰（右键菜单中也有）

05e4107afbf16316.source: Open it with <g1>Scheduler</g1> on the toolbar or <g2>Downloads → Scheduler</g2>. Right-clicking a queue and choosing <g3>Schedule</g3> or <g4>Edit queue</g4> opens it on that queue.
05e4107afbf16316.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>计划程序</g1>或选择<g2>下载 → 计划程序</g2>即可打开窗口。右键点击某个队列，然后选择<g3>计划</g3>或<g4>编辑队列</g4>，即可打开该队列的设置。

05f7b93b3e8c0f8c.source: A small file (up to 16 MB) starts on one connection. A moment later DDM opens the others, unless that one would finish before another could even start: some servers take a second or more to answer each new connection.
05f7b93b3e8c0f8c.text: 小文件（最大 16 MB）从一个连接开始下载。过一会儿，DDM 才会打开其余连接，除非这一个连接在另一个连接还没来得及开始之前就已完成：有些服务器响应每个新连接都要一秒甚至更久。

05f8c699ee2684d7.source: The website is in 21 languages too, also machine-translated. Its texts are in <x1/>, one row per sentence: fix a row's <x2/> (keep tags like <x3/> and <x4/> as they are, they are the links and icons). <x5/> shows what each language still lacks, and the same tool with <x6/> translates only that.
05f8c699ee2684d7.text: 本网站也提供 21 种语言版本，同样由机器翻译生成。网站文本位于<x1/>中，每行一句：修正每行的<x2/>（保留<x3/>和<x4/>等标签，它们代表链接和图标）。<x5/>会显示各语言还缺少哪些内容；使用同一工具并指定<x6/>时，只会翻译这些内容。

05f8c91edd2041dd.source: Under <g1>Add to queue</g1>, pick <g2>Main download queue</g2>. Leave <g3>Start the queue now</g3> unticked. Click <g4>OK</g4>.
05f8c91edd2041dd.text: 在<g1>添加到队列</g1>下，选择<g2>主下载队列</g2>。不要勾选<g3>立即启动队列</g3>。点击<g4>确定</g4>。

060740273a407a0d.source: Options, Save to: a category's folder
060740273a407a0d.text: 选项 → 保存到：一个类别的文件夹

0660089fb2a14cce.source: DDM tells Windows it draws for each monitor's own scale, so Windows never stretches its windows into blur, and it draws Windows' fonts grid-fitted to whole pixels. If the text still looks blurred, tell us your screen's resolution and Windows' display scale when you <g1>report it</g1>.
0660089fb2a14cce.text: DDM 告诉 Windows 它会根据每个显示器的缩放比例进行绘制，因此 Windows 不会将其窗口拉伸导致模糊，并且它会以网格对齐到完整像素的方式绘制 Windows 字体。如果文字仍然模糊，请在<g1>报告问题</g1>时告知我们您的屏幕分辨率和 Windows 的显示缩放比例。

066088d5e05f695c.source: yt-dlp, gallery-dl and ffmpeg can't be held to an adapter themselves. While one is chosen, DDM gives them a proxy of its own on this computer, with a password only they get, and opens their connections through the adapter as it opens its own. Video formats that can't go through a proxy (RTMP, RTSP, MMS, FTP) are refused rather than sent around it.
066088d5e05f695c.text: yt-dlp、gallery-dl 和 ffmpeg 本身无法绑定到网卡。当选择网卡时，DDM 会在本地计算机上为它们提供一个自己的代理，并使用只有它们才能获得的密码，通过该网卡打开它们的连接，就像打开自己的连接一样。无法通过代理的视频格式（RTMP、RTSP、MMS、FTP）将被拒绝，而不是绕过代理发送。

06868fac33ae5a6d.source: Safari gives an extension's button no right-click menu: the click works the same, and <g1>Safari → Settings → Extensions → Dannex Download Manager → Settings</g1> opens the options page, which says when DDM can't be reached and links to the status page.
06868fac33ae5a6d.text: Safari 不为扩展的按钮提供右键菜单：点击的效果相同，而<g1>Safari → 设置 → 扩展 → Dannex Download Manager → 设置</g1>会打开选项页面，页面会告知何时无法连接 DDM，并链接到状态页面。

068929e04a8d8a6b.source: The progress window shows the download: its speed, the time left, and what each connection is doing.
068929e04a8d8a6b.text: 进度窗口显示下载情况：速度、剩余时间以及每个连接的状态。

0692cbfad04324c6.source: The progress window draws it as it happens: a bar of the whole file with each connection's start and progress, and a table with what every connection is doing right now.
0692cbfad04324c6.text: 进度窗口会实时显示下载情况：一个显示整个文件进度的条形图，其中包含每个连接的起始位置和进度，以及一个显示每个连接当前正在做什么的表格。

06963b667716f236.source: Control your downloads from an AI assistant (MCP server)
06963b667716f236.text: 通过 AI 助手（MCP 服务器）控制下载

06a005846d84ad31.source: Many features: video and MP3 through yt-dlp, torrents, a site grabber, AI models from Hugging Face
06a005846d84ad31.text: 功能丰富：通过 yt-dlp 下载视频和 MP3，支持种子下载，提供网站抓取工具和来自 Hugging Face 的 AI 模型

06b404cfc795c9e9.source: The downloads join the <g1>Main download queue</g1>, ready to start (<g2>Start</g2> starts it too). <g3>Tasks → Import → From an IDM list (.ef2)</g3> reads a list exported from IDM, with each download's referrer and cookies.
06b404cfc795c9e9.text: 这些下载会加入<g1>主下载队列</g1>，随时可以开始（<g2>开始</g2>也可以启动它）。<g3>任务 → 导入 → 从 IDM 列表 (.ef2)</g3>会读取从 IDM 导出的列表，包括每个下载的引用页和 Cookie。

06b5ae2a1fefaa62.source: <g1>Crash reports</g1><g2>A crash or freeze opens a report you read first, then send on GitHub yourself if you want.</g2>
06b5ae2a1fefaa62.text: <g1>崩溃报告</g1><g2>崩溃或冻结时会打开一份报告，您可以先阅读，如果需要，再自行发送到 GitHub。</g2>

06c3086c2bfcb389.source: If you want Internet Download Manager's layout without its price, Dannex Download Manager: free and open source, laid out like IDM, and it imports your IDM list. If you need something else first, such as an Android app or a particular feature, the comparison above shows what each of the others is good at.
06c3086c2bfcb389.text: 如果您想要 Internet Download Manager 的布局但不想付费，请选择 Dannex Download Manager：免费开源，布局与 IDM 相似，并且可以导入您的 IDM 列表。如果您首先需要其他功能，例如安卓应用或特定功能，上面的比较显示了其他每个产品的优点。

06d93a023180f29b.source: <g1>Timing.</g1> End to end: from issuing the command to the finished file under its final name, polled every millisecond on a monotonic clock. DDM renames its finished file into place; IDM creates the final file early and fills it, so for IDM the moment it reaches full size counts. Transfer: the server's first request to its last byte, read on the same clock through a calibration request before each run.
06d93a023180f29b.text: <g1>计时。</g1> 端到端：从发出命令到文件以最终名称完成，在单调时钟上每毫秒轮询一次。DDM 将完成的文件重命名到位；IDM 提前创建最终文件并填充它，因此对于 IDM，达到完整大小的时刻即为完成。传输：服务器的第一个请求到最后一个字节，在每次运行前通过校准请求在同一时钟上读取。

06e245ea1e3d8bbb.source: Its permissions, and why: <g1>downloads</g1> to see and hand over downloads; <g2>cookies</g2> so signed-in downloads work in DDM; <g3>nativeMessaging</g3> to talk to DDM; <g4>contextMenus</g4> for the right-click items; <g5>storage</g5> for its settings; <g6>webRequest</g6> to see forms submitted and video streams loaded (it changes nothing); <g7>declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess</g7> (Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers) to have the files the browser would open (a PDF) downloaded instead, for the types DDM takes; in Firefox, <g8>webRequestBlocking</g8> does that; <g9>scripting</g9> to read a page's links when you ask, and to add the video button to pages already open when the extension is installed; <g10>proxy</g10> to read which proxy the browser uses, so downloads taken from a browser behind a VPN or proxy extension go through it too, only while you have that switched on in its options page (it never changes the browser's proxy; in Firefox it is optional, asked for when you switch it on; Chrome and the other Chromium browsers can't make it optional, and count it under the access to all sites); access to all sites because downloads and videos can come from any site.
06e245ea1e3d8bbb.text: 它的权限及原因：<g1>downloads</g1>用于查看并交出下载；<g2>cookies</g2>使已登录的下载在 DDM 中可用；<g3>nativeMessaging</g3>用于与 DDM 通信；<g4>contextMenus</g4>用于右键菜单项；<g5>storage</g5>用于保存其设置；<g6>webRequest</g6>用于查看提交的表单和加载的视频流（它不会更改任何内容）；<g7>declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess</g7>（Chrome、Edge 和其他 Chromium 浏览器）用于让浏览器本会打开的文件（如 PDF）改为下载，针对 DDM 接管的类型；在 Firefox 中由<g8>webRequestBlocking</g8>实现；<g9>scripting</g9>用于在您请求时读取页面的链接，并在安装扩展时将视频按钮添加到已打开的页面；<g10>proxy</g10>用于读取浏览器使用的代理，使通过 VPN 或代理扩展的浏览器接管的下载也能经过它，仅在您于其选项页中开启该开关时才会使用（它从不更改浏览器的代理；在 Firefox 中它是可选的，开启时才会请求；Chrome 和其他 Chromium 浏览器无法将其设为可选，会将其计入对所有站点的访问权限）；访问所有站点，因为下载和视频可能来自任何站点。

06f1e7a5c9a5fcfc.source: Help → About: the version you have.
06f1e7a5c9a5fcfc.text: 帮助 → 关于：您拥有的版本。

06f2b21b4750b749.text: 如何报告错误或提出功能请求？

074a8c8239dbb3b8.source: <g1>Picked before DDM is done.</g1> A quality picked from the page's list stays marked until DDM's list comes, then downloads by itself. If DDM doesn't offer that quality after all, the menu says so and shows what it does offer.
074a8c8239dbb3b8.text: <g1>在 DDM 完成之前选择。</g1>从页面列表中选择的画质会一直保持标记，直到 DDM 的列表出来，然后自动下载。如果 DDM 最终并不提供该画质，菜单会说明，并显示它提供的内容。

074e15c2678ecadd.source: Sounds: a sound for each event.
074e15c2678ecadd.text: 声音：为每种事件播放声音。

074edb6ecffbee2c.source: You don't need to start DDM first: if it isn't running, it starts by itself. The browser keeps the extension up to date.
074edb6ecffbee2c.text: 无需先启动 DDM：如果它没有运行，会自动启动。扩展由浏览器负责更新。

07587f5f9e42aa6f.source: <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> appears. Make sure it is turned on.
07587f5f9e42aa6f.text: 列表中会出现<g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1>。确保已启用它。

075b6e2400f539ab.source: Click a download link and <g1>Download File Info</g1> opens in DDM instead of the browser's own download bar. DDM gets the address together with the page it came from, your cookies for the site and the browser's User-Agent, so a download that needs you to be signed in still works. The browser's copy is cancelled and taken off its download list.
075b6e2400f539ab.text: 点击下载链接后，DDM 会打开<g1>下载文件信息</g1>窗口，而不是浏览器自带的下载栏。DDM 会获取下载地址、来源页面、您在该网站的 Cookie 以及浏览器的 User-Agent，因此需要登录才能下载的文件也能正常工作。浏览器本身的下载会被取消并从其下载列表中移除。

077f24ba3d4f74b0.source: Very likely: DDM speaks 86 languages, every display language Windows 11 offers, chosen on the first start or any time in <g1>View → Language</g1>. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur are laid out right to left. See <g2>all the languages</g2> and how to help improve yours.
077f24ba3d4f74b0.text: 很有可能：DDM 支持 86 种语言，涵盖 Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，可在首次启动时或随时在<g1>视图 → 语言</g1>中选择。阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语采用从右到左的布局。请参阅<g2>所有语言</g2>以及如何帮助改进您的语言。

0b5a2fe5d385702d.source: <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1> — Minimize hides the main window, and a download's progress window, in the notification area; downloads go on. Off by default, as in IDM: Minimize leaves the window in the taskbar and only the close box hides it in the tray (lists from before 1.0, where it was on by default, have it off once; tick it again if you want it). On, only the window's own Minimize hides it; a click on its taskbar button still minimizes it to the taskbar, as Windows does. Where the tray has no icon, the main window minimizes to the taskbar instead. The close setting above is separate; when it is on, closing hides there too (or minimizes to the taskbar if there is no icon at all). Greyed where no tray shows DDM's icon (some Linux desktops); in a Wayland session the main window stays minimized in the dock, since Wayland can't hide a window.
0b5a2fe5d385702d.text: <g1>最小化到通知区域</g1> — 最小化会将主窗口以及下载的进度窗口隐藏到通知区域；下载继续进行。默认关闭，与 IDM 相同：最小化会将窗口留在任务栏中，只有关闭框才会将其隐藏到托盘（1.0 之前默认开启的列表会将其关闭一次；如需要请再次勾选）。开启时，只有窗口自己的“最小化”会将其隐藏；单击其任务栏按钮仍会将其最小化到任务栏，与 Windows 一样。在托盘没有图标的地方，主窗口会改为最小化到任务栏。上面的关闭设置是独立的；当它开启时，关闭窗口也会隐藏到那里（如果完全没有图标，则最小化到任务栏）。在没有托盘显示 DDM 图标的地方（某些 Linux 桌面）显示为灰色；在 Wayland 会话中，主窗口会保持最小化在程序坞中，因为 Wayland 无法隐藏窗口。

0f0d01c7bf52af00.source: <g1>Start Dannex Download Manager with the computer</g1> — start DDM when you sign in to Windows. It starts in the notification area, its window hidden, with its downloads, queues and Scheduler running; click its icon (or start DDM again) to show the window. On Linux and macOS it starts with your session the same way; where no notification area shows DDM's icon (some Linux desktops), it starts minimized, and the option's tooltip says so. DDM waits for the notification area up to 30 seconds after making its icon, its window hidden, as a desktop's can come up after DDM at sign-in. Off by default. Greyed in a <g2>portable copy</g2>, which writes nothing to the registry.
0f0d01c7bf52af00.text: <g1>随计算机启动 Dannex Download Manager</g1> — 在您登录 Windows 时启动 DDM。它在通知区域启动，窗口隐藏，下载、队列和计划程序照常运行；单击其图标（或再次启动 DDM）即可显示窗口。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，它同样随您的会话启动；在没有通知区域显示 DDM 图标的地方（某些 Linux 桌面），它会以最小化方式启动，选项的提示中会对此说明。DDM 在创建图标并隐藏窗口后，最多等待通知区域 30 秒，因为桌面的通知区域可能在登录时比 DDM 更晚出现。默认关闭。在不向注册表写入任何内容的<g2>便携版</g2>中显示为灰色。

0f215f8302a86388.source: If neither can start, DDM draws with a software renderer (Microsoft's on Windows, Mesa's on Linux), so the window still opens (Remote Desktop, a virtual machine without a graphics driver). It works, but keeps the processor busier.
0f215f8302a86388.text: 如果两者都无法启动，DDM 会使用软件渲染器绘制（Windows 上使用 Microsoft 的软件渲染器，Linux 上使用 Mesa 的软件渲染器），这样窗口仍能打开（例如在远程桌面或没有图形驱动程序的虚拟机中）。这种方式可以正常工作，但会增加处理器负担。

0f962bad8ad412ec.source: <g1>Paired devices only</g1>: every request but pairing needs the token the device got when it paired. A pairing code works once, for ten minutes, with five tries, and tries are slowed down. The settings keep a fingerprint of each token, not the token.
0f962bad8ad412ec.text: <g1>仅限已配对设备</g1>：除了配对之外的每个请求都需要设备在配对时获得的令牌。配对代码只能使用一次，有效期十分钟，有五次尝试机会，并且尝试速度会减慢。设置会保留每个令牌的指纹，而不是令牌本身。

105119676f5865c6.source: As links arrive, DDM asks each server about its file, a few at a time. Each link then shows its real name and size, and whether it is <g1>Online</g1>, <g2>Offline (404)</g2>, <g3>Needs a login</g3> or <g4>Busy, try later</g4>. Offline links come unticked, so you don't queue what isn't there. Links to web pages are hidden by default.
105119676f5865c6.text: 链接到达时，DDM 会一次性向每个服务器询问其文件信息。每个链接随后会显示其真实名称和大小，以及它是<g1>在线</g1>、<g2>离线 (404)</g2>、<g3>需要登录</g3>还是<g4>繁忙，请稍后重试</g4>。离线链接默认不勾选，这样您就不会将不存在的内容加入队列。指向网页的链接默认隐藏。

106b31b5a3b2042f.source: Run Dannex Download Manager on a home server or a NAS (Docker, Unraid, any Linux machine) without a window, and send it downloads from your phone or your browser: the server downloads them into its own folders, such as a network share.

11aeaa1e552ab59b.source: A video yt-dlp downloads by itself (<g1>How a video comes down</g1>) takes a limit only as it starts: when you turn the limiter on or off, change its settings or the video's own limit, DDM stops it and starts it again with the new limit, and it goes on from where it was (the log says "Stopped: the speed limit changed; starting again with it"). Under the limit for all downloads, such videos share it evenly: when another starts, the ones running with more than their share start again with it; when one ends, the others keep theirs. An image gallery's files that gallery-dl downloads itself (<g2>Image galleries</g2>) do the same, gallery-dl skipping the files already saved; those DDM downloads keep to a new limit at once. Other changes (torrents taking more or less of the limit for all downloads, <g3>Only while I'm using the computer</g3>) apply to the next one that starts.
11aeaa1e552ab59b.text: yt-dlp 自行下载的视频（<g1>视频如何下载</g1>）只在启动时采用限制：当您开启或关闭限速、更改其设置或该视频自己的限制时，DDM 会停止它，并用新的限制重新启动，从原来的位置继续（日志会写“已停止：速度限制已更改；正在以新限制重新开始”）。在所有下载的总限制之下，这类视频平均分享该限制：另一个开始时，占用超过其份额的视频会用新份额重新启动；一个结束时，其余的保持原份额。由 gallery-dl 自行下载的图库文件（<g2>图像图库</g2>）也是如此，gallery-dl 会跳过已保存的文件；由 DDM 下载的文件则立即遵守新限制。其他更改（种子占用所有下载限制的多少、<g3>仅在我使用计算机时</g3>）适用于下一个开始的下载。

1277f9ac96d96956.source: Each torrent gets a limit of its own, like any other download, and a remembered limit applies again when it resumes. Under <g1>Limit all downloads together to</g1>, torrents and other downloads share the cap: each side gets at least half, and more when the other side needs less. A torrent can't be held under 16 KBytes/sec, because a lower limit made torrents drop their peers and stall.
1277f9ac96d96956.text: 每个种子下载任务都有自己的速度限制，就像其他下载任务一样，并且记住的限制会在恢复时再次生效。在<g1>将所有下载总计限制为</g1>下，种子下载任务和其他下载任务共享总限速：每方至少获得一半，当另一方需求较少时则获得更多。种子下载任务的速度不能低于 16 千字节/秒，因为更低的限制会导致种子下载任务断开对等连接并停滞。

157d0fc6b0ea2f75.source: No. DDM is an independent program written from scratch in Rust, with no connection to Tonec Inc., the makers of Internet Download Manager (IDM). It contains none of IDM's code or artwork. Its windows are laid out the way IDM users expect, so you can switch without learning anything new — and because DDM is free, there is nothing to crack. Please don't download "cracked" download managers: they are a common way to spread malware.
157d0fc6b0ea2f75.text: 不是。DDM 是一个完全独立的程序，使用 Rust 从头编写，与 Internet Download Manager (IDM) 的开发商 Tonec Inc. 没有任何关系。它不包含 IDM 的任何代码或美术作品。它的窗口布局符合 IDM 用户的习惯，因此您可以无需学习新知识即可切换使用——而且由于 DDM 是免费的，所以无需破解。请不要下载“破解版”下载管理器：它们是传播恶意软件的常见方式。

15d7674516a26804.source: <g1>GitHub, to check for updates.</g1> Each time it starts, and once a day while it stays open, DDM asks GitHub's public API for the latest release of DDM (<x2/>). The request carries DDM's version in its User-Agent and nothing else. Turn the check off in <g3>Help → Check for updates</g3> (<g4>Check for updates at every start</g4>). If you choose <g5>Update now</g5>, DDM downloads the new version's file and its signed checksum list from the same GitHub release. GitHub's own privacy statement applies to these requests.
15d7674516a26804.text: <g1>GitHub，用于检查更新。</g1>每次启动时，以及在DDM保持打开状态下每天一次，DDM会向GitHub的公共API请求DDM的最新版本（<x2/>）。此请求在其User-Agent中携带DDM的版本信息，不包含其他任何内容。您可以在<g3>帮助 → 检查更新</g3>中关闭此检查（<g4>每次启动时检查更新</g4>）。如果您选择<g5>立即更新</g5>，DDM会从同一个GitHub发布中下载新版本的文件及其签名的校验和列表。GitHub自己的隐私声明适用于这些请求。

15e8a888aceb4b0e.source: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, is the main platform. Builds for Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz) and macOS (.dmg) come with every release too; today's are marked experimental. Linux is checked on GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon, in Wayland sessions too, and its packages in clean Ubuntu, Debian and Fedora systems. Still to come there: the Flatpak Firefox isn't checked yet, and screen readers (Orca) don't read DDM's windows yet. macOS stays experimental. See Windows, Mac and Linux and Download.

17526ad1287cb130.source: DDM itself still sends nothing anywhere: the server talks only to the DDM on this computer, over a token-protected local channel. But what the assistant reads, it passes on to its own AI service. When it lists your downloads, their file names, addresses and folders go to that service, under that service's privacy terms. Turn the API off with <x1/>, or remove the server from the assistant, when you don't want that.
17526ad1287cb130.text: DDM 本身不会向任何地方发送任何数据：服务器仅通过受令牌保护的本地通道与此计算机上的 DDM 通信。但助手读取的内容会传递给它自己的 AI 服务。当它列出您的下载任务时，其文件名、地址和文件夹会根据该服务的隐私条款发送到该服务。当您不希望发生这种情况时，请使用 <x1/> 关闭 API，或从助手中删除服务器。

199d6d5b06756e0f.source: DDM contains no adware, spyware, bundled offers or tracking. Its whole source code is public, so anyone can check what it does, and every release is built from that code by GitHub's servers, where the build can be inspected. The helper programs it can fetch for videos are verified before they run: yt-dlp against its developers' signing key, ffmpeg against its published checksums. Download DDM only from <g1>this site</g1> or the project's GitHub releases.
199d6d5b06756e0f.text: DDM 不包含广告软件、间谍软件、捆绑优惠或跟踪。它的全部源代码都是公开的，因此任何人都可以检查它的功能，并且每个版本都是由 GitHub 的服务器从该代码构建的，构建过程可以被检查。它为视频获取的辅助程序在运行前会进行验证：yt-dlp 会对照其开发者的签名密钥进行验证，ffmpeg 会对照其发布的校验和进行验证。请仅从<g1>本网站</g1>或项目的 GitHub 发布页面下载 DDM。

1adaa7c4de6bc9e1.source: Paste the new link into Address, then resume.
1adaa7c4de6bc9e1.text: 将新链接粘贴到“地址”中，然后恢复下载。

1b0b5fa5425d1c30.source: A window larger than the screen at a big interface size scrolls.
1b0b5fa5425d1c30.text: 当界面尺寸较大时，如果窗口超出屏幕，则会出现滚动条。

1b23e1a7cceb67c9.source: <g1>Connections.</g1> Passive mode is used by default. <g2>Options → Proxy / Socks → Use passive mode for FTP</g2> switches it off for servers that only take active connections. FTP connects to the server directly, not through the HTTP proxy.
1b23e1a7cceb67c9.text: <g1>连接。</g1>默认使用被动模式。<g2>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 对 FTP 使用被动模式</g2>可为只接受主动连接的服务器关闭它。FTP 直接连接服务器，不经过 HTTP 代理。

1b3efe7b98d2c2da.source: Jump to the item that starts with it, in a list or a drop-down
1b3efe7b98d2c2da.text: 在列表或下拉列表中，跳转到以该字母开头的项目

1b638519d92c59b7.source: More about queues in <g1>Queues and the Scheduler</g1>.
1b638519d92c59b7.text: 有关队列的更多信息，请参1阅<g1>队列和计划程序</g1>。

1b9bbdc7f554f0b8.source: In Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur the whole window is mirrored: the menus, toolbar and categories run from right to left, as Windows does for these languages. File names, addresses and folder paths keep their own direction inside translated sentences, so they stay readable.
1b9bbdc7f554f0b8.text: 使用阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语时，整个窗口会镜像显示：菜单、工具栏和分类会从右向左排列，就像 Windows 对这些语言的处理方式一样。文件名、地址和文件夹路径在翻译后的句子中仍保持原有的书写方向，以确保可读性。

1bad738cb3cea90f.source: Select or unselect the download with the dotted outline
1bad738cb3cea90f.text: 选择或取消选择带虚线轮廓的下载

1bc760bb0d073838.source: Click a column's title to sort by it; click it again for the other way.
1bc760bb0d073838.text: 单击列标题可按该列排序；再次单击则反向排序。

1bc816518d6f87cb.source: <g1>Save to</g1>: the folder its torrents go to; empty, the Torrents category's folder. <g2>Add them without starting them</g2> adds them as <g3>Download Later</g3> would.
1bc816518d6f87cb.text: <g1>保存到</g1>：种子文件的保存文件夹；留空则使用“种子”类别的文件夹。启用<g2>添加但不启动</g2>时，添加方式与<g3>稍后下载</g3>相同。

1bcf62be8def689c.source: Download File Info with Download Later ringed
1bcf62be8def689c.text: “下载文件信息”中圈出的“稍后下载”

1bdb78f184316d1c.source: <g1>Notification area</g1><g2>Starts with the computer in the notification area, and hides progress windows there while they run.</g2>
1bdb78f184316d1c.text: <g1>通知区域</g1><g2>随电脑启动并在通知区域运行，运行时将进度窗口隐藏在通知区域。</g2>

1be905c8f721541b.source: <g1>Browser integration needs the installer.</g1> The browser finds DDM's helper through the registry, so a portable copy can't take downloads from the browser. Use <g2>Add URL</g2>, the clipboard or the drop target instead (see <g3>Adding downloads</g3>).
1be905c8f721541b.text: <g1>浏览器集成需要安装程序。</g1>浏览器通过注册表查找 DDM 的辅助程序，因此便携版无法从浏览器接收下载。请改用<g2>添加 URL</g2>、剪贴板或拖放区域（请参阅<g3>添加下载</g3>）。

1c0101659f1e2203.source: <g1>Feeds</g1>: the feeds it watches; none ticked, all of them.
1c0101659f1e2203.text: <g1>源</g1>：规则适用的源；如果没有勾选任何源，则适用于所有源。

1c20a2d248e2a80e.source: Run DDM on a home server, NAS, Docker or Unraid — Dannex Download Manager
1c20a2d248e2a80e.text: 在家庭服务器、NAS、Docker 或 Unraid 上运行 DDM — Dannex Download Manager

1c21f2a42d7d73f5.source: Some servers drop the connection when the speed is very low. Avoid a tight limit for servers that can't resume (<g1>Can resume: No</g1>).
1c21f2a42d7d73f5.text: 当速度很低时，有些服务器会断开连接。对于不支持断点续传的服务器（<g1>支持断点续传：否</g1>），请避免设置过严的限制。

1c4670fc540cb86b.source: <g1>Refresh</g1> fetches the selected feed now. <g2>Remove</g2> stops watching it. A feed that can't be read is shown in red, and its line at the bottom says why.
1c4670fc540cb86b.text: <g1>刷新</g1>会立即获取选定的源。<g2>删除</g2>会停止监视该源。无法读取的源会显示为红色，底部一行会说明原因。

1c5547ccab0ff61c.source: <g1>Accent colour</g1>: the colour of focus, the selection, ticked boxes, default buttons and progress. The first one is the theme's own; the others are Blue, Teal, Green, Olive, Gold, Orange, Red, Pink, Purple and Graphite; <g2>Your own</g2> takes any colour as <x3/>. Every colour of the theme's accent family takes the new one, with its own shades for the pointer and a press; text, errors, warnings and success keep theirs, and text on the accent stays readable (DDM makes it darker or lighter when it has to).
1c5547ccab0ff61c.text: <g1>强调色</g1>：焦点、选中项、已勾选的框、默认按钮和进度的颜色。第一个是主题自己的；其他依次是蓝色、青色、绿色、橄榄色、金色、橙色、红色、粉色、紫色和石墨色；<g2>自定义</g2>可采用任何颜色，格式为 <x3/>。主题强调色系的每种颜色都换成新的，指针悬停和按下时有各自的深浅；文字、错误、警告和成功保持原色，强调色上的文字保持可读（需要时 DDM 会把它调深或调浅）。

1c5f1bf427c1cf81.text: 它能续传中断的下载吗？

1c603722e0427f19.source: How do I download a video from YouTube or another site? — Dannex Download Manager
1c603722e0427f19.text: 如何从 YouTube 或其他网站下载视频？— Dannex Download Manager

1c8712bdb568d397.source: Install DDM with the setup and keep <g1>Set up browser integration (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> ticked. This registers the helper. (The portable copy can't do this; see <g2>Portable mode</g2>.) On Linux and macOS DDM registers it itself, each time it starts, for the browsers installed then.
1c8712bdb568d397.text: 使用安装程序安装 DDM，并勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Firefox）</g1>。这会注册辅助程序。（便携版无法执行此操作；请参阅<g2>便携模式</g2>。）在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 每次启动时都会为当时安装的浏览器自行注册。

1c90a99a45e311c8.source: If the service can't get the torrent (no peers, too big, refused), the list says why.
1c90a99a45e311c8.text: 如果服务无法获取种子（没有对等方、文件过大或请求被拒绝），列表会说明原因。

1c9344ff1a57c0ff.source: Quit DDM with <g1>Tasks → Exit</g1> before you unplug the stick, so it saves the list.
1c9344ff1a57c0ff.text: 拔下 U 盘前，请通过<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>退出 DDM，以保存下载列表。

1cafb86bd2c2b2f4.source: <g1>Download File Info</g1> shows the file's name, its size and where it will be saved. The folder depends on the file's type: a ZIP goes to <x2/>, a video to <x3/>, and so on. Change the folder or the category if you like.
1cafb86bd2c2b2f4.text: <g1>下载文件信息</g1>显示文件名、大小以及保存位置。文件夹取决于文件类型：ZIP 文件到<x2/>，视频文件到<x3/>，依此类推。您可以更改文件夹或类别。

1cf59e936ec9e349.source: Whether <g1>7-Zip</g1> was found: 7z and RAR archives need it.
1cf59e936ec9e349.text: 是否找到 <g1>7-Zip</g1>：7z 和 RAR 存档需要使用它。

1d28151c4fc4f2b7.source: The download's log (hover over it in the list) says what happened: <g1>Extracted 12 files to …</g1>, or why not, for example <g2>Couldn't extract movie.7z.001: volume 3 of it is missing</g2>. An encrypted archive without its password opens the <g3>Archive password</g3> window. Type the password and click <g4>Extract</g4>, or <g5>Cancel</g5> to leave the archive as it is.
1d28151c4fc4f2b7.text: 下载日志（将鼠标悬停在列表中的下载上即可查看）会说明提取结果：<g1>已提取 12 个文件到…</g1>；如果提取失败，也会说明原因，例如 <g2>无法提取 movie.7z.001：缺少第 3 卷</g2>。如果加密存档没有密码，会打开“<g3>存档密码</g3>”窗口。输入密码并点击“<g4>提取</g4>”，或点击“<g5>取消</g5>”以保留存档。

1d3619526676820b.source: <g1>The servers you download from.</g1> To download a file, DDM connects to the server that holds it and sends what any browser would: the request, and the cookies, referrer and browser identification the extension passed along, so downloads that need you to be signed in keep working. Those servers see your IP address, as they would if your browser downloaded the file.
1d3619526676820b.text: <g1>您下载文件的服务器。</g1>为了下载文件，DDM 会连接到存储文件的服务器，并发送任何浏览器都会发送的内容：请求，以及扩展程序传递的 cookie、referrer 和浏览器标识，以便需要登录的下载能够继续工作。这些服务器会看到您的 IP 地址，就像您的浏览器下载文件时一样。

1d4ee2f96c724f0f.source: A torrent: what it sends to peers, while it runs.
1d4ee2f96c724f0f.text: 一个种子：运行时发送给对等点的数据。

1d6ccabe01271561.source: The progress window: speed, time left and each connection's share of the file
1d6ccabe01271561.text: 进度窗口：速度、剩余时间以及每个连接的文件份额

1d7e3a269b980fb6.source: one module per page (<x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/>, <x7/>, <x8/>, <x9/>, <x10/>, <x11/>, <x12/>), <x13/> (the windows over it), <x14/> (the pages' own controls)

1d8e72be31ef720b.source: <g1>Adwaita</g1>: GNOME's look: round corners, flat grey buttons, a rounded focus ring, GNOME's check boxes, a header bar with the title in bold and round buttons (on Windows, where DDM draws it), and GNOME's Adwaita icons, in colour for files and categories, one colour in the toolbar.
1d8e72be31ef720b.text: <g1>Adwaita</g1>：GNOME 的外观：圆角、扁平的灰色按钮、圆形的焦点环、GNOME 的复选框、带有粗体标题和圆形按钮的标题栏（在 Windows 上，由 DDM 绘制），以及 GNOME 的 Adwaita 图标，文件和类别为彩色，工具栏为单色。

1da156143837aec9.source: Click <g1>Add Torrent</g1> on the toolbar to choose a <x2/> file. Or click the arrow next to it and choose <g3>Open torrent file...</g3> or <g4>Add magnet link...</g4> (also under <g5>Tasks</g5>).
1da156143837aec9.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>添加 Torrent</g1>来选择一个 <x2/> 文件。或者点击旁边的箭头，选择<g3>打开 torrent 文件...</g3>或<g4>添加磁力链接...</g4>（也在<g5>任务</g5>下）。

1daf9eb7819e64c4.source: Use Help → Report a problem in DDM: it opens the bug report form on GitHub with your version, system and language filled in. Or open the form yourself. Security problems go privately through the security page.
1daf9eb7819e64c4.text: 在 DDM 中选择“帮助”→“报告问题”，即可在 GitHub 上打开错误报告表单，其中已填入您的版本、系统和语言。您也可以自行打开表单。安全问题请通过安全页面私下报告。

1dc7d4ba0d377867.text: 遵循浏览器的 VPN 扩展

1dea3a17c28944ca.text: 已选择另一个 DDM（<g1>将下载发送到</g1>）

1dfb7acf11d64257.source: 1 Follow the system's dark mode; 2 Always dark keeps DDM dark.
1dfb7acf11d64257.text: 1 跟随系统深色模式；2 始终为深色会让 DDM 保持深色。

1e137c87addef252.source: The torrent engine is written in Rust, which rules out many memory bugs, and DDM checks every piece against the torrent's fingerprint, so a peer can't slip in altered data. DDM keeps the engine up to date with the fixes its authors publish.
1e137c87addef252.text: 种子引擎使用 Rust 编写，可避免许多内存错误。DDM 还会根据种子的指纹检查每个数据块，因此对等方无法混入被篡改的数据。DDM 会及时更新种子引擎，以应用其作者发布的修复。

1e4608d466e2df9a.source: <g1>When done</g1> — shows where the file will be saved. Untick <g2>Show the Download complete window</g2> to skip the <g3>Download complete</g3> box for this file only.
1e4608d466e2df9a.text: <g1>完成后</g1> — 显示文件将保存的位置。取消勾选<g2>显示“下载完成”窗口</g2>，可仅对此文件跳过<g3>下载完成</g3>框。

1e4861cc4f32a384.source: <g1>Every text the user sees goes through <x2/></g1> (<x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/>); after adding one, run <x7/>. Data inside a sentence (a file name, an address, a size) goes in through <x8/> or <x9/>, so it reads right in right-to-left languages.
1e4861cc4f32a384.text: <g1>用户看到的所有文本都必须通过<x2/></g1>（<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>、<x6/>）；添加文本后，运行<x7/>。句子中的数据（文件名、地址、大小）应通过<x8/>或<x9/>传入，以便在从右到左的语言中正确显示。

1e5f6407bbf006fa.source: Switching is easy. Bring your downloads with you.
1e5f6407bbf006fa.text: 轻松切换。带上您的下载。

1e6d70e217a00841.source: <g1>View → Toolbar</g1> chooses how the toolbar looks, at once: <g2>Large buttons</g2> (the default) or <g3>Small buttons</g3>, a lower toolbar with smaller icons and each label beside its icon. Untick <g4>Show text labels</g4> for icons only: hold the pointer over a button to see its name. <g5>Line style</g5> (the default) draws the buttons' icons as thin coloured lines, <g6>3D style</g6> as glossy, shaded pictures, and <g7>The theme's own icons</g7> as a theme with icons of its own draws them (Metro, Adwaita, Breeze, Luna, Aero, Aqua: theirs by default). Each theme keeps the style chosen for it (<g8>The theme picker</g8>); High contrast keeps its one-colour icons. <g9>Customize...</g9> chooses which buttons the toolbar shows (tick them) and their order (<g10>Move up</g10>, <g11>Move down</g11>); <g12>Reset</g12> shows every button again in its first order.
1e6d70e217a00841.text: <g1>视图 → 工具栏</g1>可立即改变工具栏的外观：<g2>大按钮</g2>（默认）或<g3>小按钮</g3>（更矮的工具栏，图标更小，每个标签位于其图标旁边）。取消勾选<g4>显示文本标签</g4>则只显示图标：把指针停在按钮上可查看它的名称。<g5>线条样式</g5>（默认）把按钮图标画成细的彩色线条，<g6>3D 样式</g6>画成带光泽、有阴影的图片，<g7>主题自带的图标</g7>则按带有自己图标的主题所画的样子显示（现代、Adwaita、Breeze、Luna、Aero、Aqua：默认使用各自的图标）。每个主题保留为它选择的样式（<g8>主题选择器</g8>）；高对比度保留它的单色图标。<g9>自定义...</g9>选择工具栏显示哪些按钮（勾选它们）及其顺序（<g10>上移</g10>、<g11>下移</g11>）；<g12>重置</g12>会按最初的顺序再次显示所有按钮。

1e9513157826302d.source: Debrid service accounts — Dannex Download Manager help
1e9513157826302d.text: 网盘服务帐户 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

1ea06b5a33c6c50f.source: <g1>Cancel</g1> (<g2>Esc</g2>) closes the window and adds nothing.
1ea06b5a33c6c50f.text: <g1>取消</g1>（<g2>Esc</g2>）关闭窗口，不添加任何内容。

1ef5c74257887c0c.source: A download manager can fill your whole connection. The Speed Limiter caps DDM so that browsing, video calls and games stay smooth, and can give it full speed again while you're away from the computer.
1ef5c74257887c0c.text: 下载管理器可能会占用您全部的网络连接。速度限制器可以限制 DDM 的速度，让您在浏览网页、视频通话和玩游戏时保持流畅。当您不在电脑旁时，它还可以让 DDM 恢复全速下载。

1f696e508865eda4.source: <g1>Episodes</g1> reads <x2/> or <x3/> in a title. <x4/> is season 1, episode 2; <x5/> is episodes 5 to 8; <x6/> is everything from season 2 on. A rule takes each episode once: when a second release of an episode it already added turns up, it is skipped.
1f696e508865eda4.text: <g1>剧集</g1>会读取标题中的<x2/>或<x3/>。<x4/>是第 1 季第 2 集；<x5/>是第 5 到 8 集；<x6/>是第 2 季及之后的所有内容。一个规则每集只取一次：当它已经添加的剧集的第二个版本出现时，它会被跳过。

1f6d9db77baccf7e.source: Click <g1>Download Now</g1>, or <g2>Later</g2> to add it to the list without starting.
1f6d9db77baccf7e.text: 点击<g1>立即下载</g1>，或点击<g2>稍后</g2>将其添加到列表而不开始下载。

1f70af26cbe00250.source: : the user that owns those folders (DDM runs as no particular user).
1f70af26cbe00250.text: ：拥有这些文件夹的用户（DDM 不以特定用户身份运行）。

1f73edb3d8f37ba8.source: Some limits, plainly: the portable copy can't connect to a browser, since it writes nothing outside its folder.
1f73edb3d8f37ba8.text: 一些限制，请注意：便携版无法连接到浏览器，因为它不会在其文件夹之外写入任何内容。

1f97ee3107818c42.source: Speed Limiter and connections in detail →
1f97ee3107818c42.text: 速度限制器和连接详情 →

1f98be990d8acb5c.source: A torrent's progress window on its Pieces tab: a square for each piece, filled once it's here.
1f98be990d8acb5c.text: 种子的下载进度窗口，位于“分块”选项卡：每个分块对应一个方块，下载到本地后方块会填满。

1faf210450b3be53.source: Right-click a link, a video, a sound or a picture and choose <g1>Download with DDM</g1>. DDM downloads it whatever its type: you asked for it, so the file types list and the excluded sites don't apply here (they only decide which downloads DDM takes over by itself). A video that plays as a stream goes to the <g2>Download video</g2> window with the stream its player loaded (HLS or DASH), as the <g3>button over videos</g3> sends it, with your cookies for the stream's server and the page as the referrer.
1faf210450b3be53.text: 右键点击链接、视频、音频或图片，然后选择<g1>使用 DDM 下载</g1>。无论文件类型是什么，DDM 都会下载您指定的内容：由于这是您主动选择的操作，文件类型列表和排除网站设置在这里不适用（它们只决定 DDM 自动接管哪些下载）。如果视频以流媒体形式播放，就会连同播放器加载的流（HLS 或 DASH）一起发送到“<g2>下载视频</g2>”窗口，方式与点击<g3>视频上方的按钮</g3>相同，并会附带该流媒体服务器所需的 Cookie 和作为引荐来源的页面。

20266a1e7f69fd15.source: The toolbar, categories and download list, where you expect them.
20266a1e7f69fd15.text: 工具栏、类别和下载列表，都在您期望的位置。

205082935db97950.source: It works with assistants that support MCP, the Model Context Protocol: Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and others.
205082935db97950.text: 它适用于支持 MCP（模型上下文协议）的助手：Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code 等。

205fdb98f94e95c5.source: <g1>Pause all downloads</g1> stops every running download and queue; <g2>Resume all downloads</g2> starts those again.
205fdb98f94e95c5.text: <g1>暂停所有下载</g1>会停止每个正在运行的下载和队列；<g2>恢复所有下载</g2>会再次启动它们。

2075535ccce685a4.source: <g1>Options → Connection → DNS</g1> picks who turns names into addresses for downloads, FTP, DDM's own downloads and the update check: the system's (the default), Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, AdGuard, NextDNS with your configuration ID, or your own. It is asked over HTTPS (the default) or TLS, so nobody on the way sees or changes the names you look up, or plainly over TCP. <g2>Test</g2> shows how long it takes to answer.
2075535ccce685a4.text: <g1>选项 → 连接 → DNS</g1> 用于选择谁将下载、FTP、DDM 自身的下载和更新检查的名称解析为地址：系统默认、Cloudflare、Google、Quad9、AdGuard、带有您的配置 ID 的 NextDNS，或您自己的 DNS。解析请求通过 HTTPS（默认）或 TLS 发送，因此途中的任何人都无法看到或更改您查询的名称，也可以直接通过 TCP 发送。<g2>测试</g2> 显示响应所需的时间。

20802419a2c5daee.source: — implicit FTPS, port 990 unless the address gives another.
20802419a2c5daee.text: — 隐式 FTPS，默认使用端口 990，地址另有指定时除外。

20a97913c89bc8d2.source: The main window in the Metro theme

20b4186e11d56460.source: DDM's setup registers the helper where Helium looks for it, on Windows, Linux and macOS. On Linux and macOS DDM also offers the extension to Helium, through Helium's own services, so with them allowed it arrives by itself at Helium's next start (on macOS Helium asks first: <g1>New extension added</g1> in its menu, where you turn it on). The Linux packages (.deb, .rpm) leave that to the window below, writing nothing in your home folder. On Windows Helium can't be offered the extension this way: DDM's <g2>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g2> window opens the store's page in Helium when Helium was installed with its setup; Helium from its zip isn't found there, so open the store's page in it yourself. Helium presents itself as Google Chrome, on purpose, so in <g3>Options → General → Take downloads from these browsers</g3> it is <g4>Google Chrome</g4>.
20b4186e11d56460.text: DDM 的安装程序会在 Helium 查找的位置注册帮助程序，Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上都是如此。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 还会通过 Helium 自己的服务向 Helium 提供扩展，所以在这些服务被允许时，它会在 Helium 下次启动时自动到达（macOS 上 Helium 会先询问：菜单中的<g1>已添加新扩展</g1>，在那里启用它）。Linux 安装包（.deb、.rpm）把这件事留给下面的窗口，不会在您的主文件夹里写入任何内容。在 Windows 上无法用这种方式向 Helium 提供扩展：如果 Helium 是用它的安装程序安装的，DDM 的<g2>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>窗口会在 Helium 中打开商店页面；用 zip 安装的 Helium 在那里找不到，请自行在其中打开商店页面。Helium 有意把自己标识为 Google Chrome，所以在<g3>选项 → 常规 → 接管这些浏览器的下载</g3>中，它显示为<g4>Google Chrome</g4>。

20bfe390ea3f70e6.source: Can I use it without installing it?
20bfe390ea3f70e6.text: 我可以不安装就使用它吗？

20c9e241a7ef67ce.source: Find a download in a long list →

20e287595c1be7dd.source: Pick a network adapter, usually your VPN's, and every connection DDM opens goes through it. If the VPN drops, nothing slips out through your normal connection: downloads stop, and start again when it's back.
20e287595c1be7dd.text: 选择一个网卡，通常是您的 VPN 网卡，DDM 的所有连接都将通过它。如果 VPN 断开，您的正常连接不会泄露任何信息：下载会停止，并在 VPN 恢复后重新开始。

20e8ae667f877f6c.source: Download speed limiter — Dannex Download Manager
20e8ae667f877f6c.text: 下载速度限制器 — Dannex Download Manager

21338dfddf72777e.source: The remote control (#141): the HTTPS server a paired phone or computer on the local network uses (its page, pairing codes, device tokens, the self-signed certificate); every request becomes an automation API command the app answers
21338dfddf72777e.text: 远程控制 (#141)：本地网络上已配对的手机或电脑使用的 HTTPS 服务器（其页面、配对码、设备令牌、自签名证书）；每个请求都成为应用响应的自动化 API 命令

214a5490cbec850d.source: <g1>Look links up when they arrive (name, size, online)</g1> — Link grabber asks each server about its file (on by default).
214a5490cbec850d.text: <g1>链接到达时查找（名称、大小、在线）</g1> — 链接抓取器会向每台服务器查询文件信息（默认开启）。

214b90b13f41cfae.source: Your debrid account, with every connection DDM has.
214b90b13f41cfae.text: 您的网盘账户，DDM 的所有连接都可用。

214f865d28ca98ae.source: DDM's torrents don't use <g1>encryption</g1> (sometimes called "protocol encryption"). That kind of encryption only hides the traffic from simple filters. It never hides who you are, so DDM doesn't claim to offer it. Some peers that require it won't connect.
214f865d28ca98ae.text: DDM 的种子不使用<g1>加密</g1>（有时称为“协议加密”）。这种加密只能让简单的过滤器无法识别流量，但不会隐藏您的身份，因此 DDM 不会声称提供这种加密。部分要求使用这种加密的对等方将无法连接。

215c6b99b6fe2b74.source: DDM downloads videos from their web pages: YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitch, TikTok, X, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, SoundCloud and well over a thousand other sites. <g1>yt-dlp</g1>, an open-source program whose community keeps it working as sites change, finds the video on the page; DDM's own downloader then brings it in, the way it downloads any file.
215c6b99b6fe2b74.text: DDM 可以从 YouTube、Vimeo、Dailymotion、Twitch、TikTok、X、Instagram、Facebook、Reddit、SoundCloud 以及其他一千多个网站下载视频。开源程序 <g1>yt-dlp</g1> 的社区会持续更新，以适应网站的变化，它负责在网页上找到视频；然后 DDM 自带的下载器会像下载任何文件一样将其下载。

2160f23236202cad.source: TikTok, X and internet radio join them, and music players get a button of their own.
2160f23236202cad.text: TikTok、X 和网络电台也能用，音乐播放器还有自己的按钮。

216167f68e5e8b95.source: A <x1/> file's web address works too: paste it into <g2>Add URL</g2> or <g3>Torrent</g3>, or let the browser hand the download over. DDM fetches the file, with the browser's cookies when the browser sent it, and <g4>Add torrent</g4> shows what it holds. The browser hands <x5/> downloads over because <x6/> is in <g7>Options → File types</g7>. It's there by default; a list you had before this version keeps what it had, so add <x8/> to it yourself. <g9>Download with DDM</g9> on a link always hands it over. A command line with <x10/> (silent) saves the <x11/> file itself, like any file. DDM fetches at most 10 MB: anything bigger isn't a <x12/> file.
216167f68e5e8b95.text: 一个 <x1/> 文件的网址也适用：将其粘贴到<g2>添加 URL</g2>或<g3>种子</g3>中，或者让浏览器将下载任务交给 DDM。DDM 会获取该文件，如果浏览器发送了它，则会带上浏览器的 cookie，<g4>添加种子</g4>会显示其中包含的内容。浏览器会将 <x5/> 下载任务交给 DDM，因为 <x6/> 位于<g7>选项 → 文件类型</g7>中。它默认就在那里；如果您在此版本之前有一个列表，它会保留原有的内容，因此请自行添加 <x8/>。<g9>使用 DDM 下载</g9>链接总是会将其交给 DDM。带有 <x10/>（静默）的命令行会像任何文件一样保存 <x11/> 文件本身。DDM 最多获取 10 MB：任何更大的文件都不是 <x12/> 文件。

21690a7873e90985.source: <g1>For Chromium browsers, by hand <x2/></g1><g3>Unzip, then Load unpacked on the browser's extensions page, with Developer mode on.</g3>
21690a7873e90985.text: <g1>适用于 Chromium 内核浏览器，手动安装 <x2/></g1><g3>解压后，在浏览器的扩展页面打开开发者模式，选择“加载已解压的扩展程序”。</g3>

2171be975f40efe2.source: <g1>Moving from IDM</g1><g2>Your IDM list comes over in one file, each download with its address, referrer and cookies.</g2>
2171be975f40efe2.text: <g1>从 IDM 迁移</g1><g2>您的 IDM 列表可导入为一个文件，每个下载任务都包含其地址、引用页和 Cookie。</g2>

219b4865ef43eb2a.source: not to use it to overload, attack or get around the limits of servers you don't own.
219b4865ef43eb2a.text: 不使用它来超载、攻击或绕过您不拥有的服务器的限制。

219d3a9eddb4a1de.source: It downloads like any other file, in its own row and window.
219d3a9eddb4a1de.text: 它会像其他文件一样下载，在列表中占据一行，并有自己的窗口。

21a175fe80775c21.source: <g1>Can resume</g1> — <g2>Yes</g2> if the server lets DDM continue the download later, <g3>No</g3> if it doesn't.
21a175fe80775c21.text: <g1>支持断点续传</g1> — 如果服务器允许 DDM 稍后继续下载，则为<g2>是</g2>，否则为<g3>否</g3>。

21aa032bde745310.source: A download's first request (<x1/>) follows redirects and the pages that lead on to a file by themselves (a waiting page's refresh). Sites whose links aren't the file's address have a module in <x2/> (Google Drive: <x3/>): it turns the link into the file's address, reads the site's own pages (a confirmation form, an error page) and names its refusals (<x4/>), with pure functions tested without a network. The lab server plays such a site on its real host names for the end-to-end tests (<x5/>).
21aa032bde745310.text: 下载的第一个请求 (<x1/>) 会跟踪重定向以及那些自行导向文件的页面（例如等待页面的刷新）。如果网站的链接不是文件地址，<x2/> 中会有一个模块（例如 Google Drive: <x3/>）：它将链接转换为文件地址，读取网站自己的页面（例如确认表单、错误页面），并指出其拒绝原因 (<x4/>)，所有这些都通过无需网络即可测试的纯函数实现。实验室服务器会在其真实主机名上模拟此类网站，以进行端到端测试 (<x5/>)。

21b4ad12f925276a.source: Delete the <x1/> folder (or make it read-only) and the same copy behaves like the plain zip: it keeps its data in <x2/>.
21b4ad12f925276a.text: 删除 <x1/> 文件夹（或将其设为只读）后，同一副本的运行方式就与普通 ZIP 文件相同：数据会保存在 <x2/> 中。

21c5e248abf66173.source: Speed, measured: Dannex Download Manager against IDM
21c5e248abf66173.text: 速度实测：Dannex Download Manager 对比 IDM

21e0a24c92fe95eb.source: Hover over the line for the server's address and how the time was measured.
21e0a24c92fe95eb.text: 将鼠标悬停在该行上，可查看服务器地址以及时间测量方式。

21e40310e3442a92.source: Add URL on Linux, with its address box
21e40310e3442a92.text: Linux 上的“添加 URL”窗口，带有其地址框

21ee3eebf468850e.source: A drop-down's or spin box's arrow
21ee3eebf468850e.text: 下拉框或微调框的箭头

21f9763149fa42df.source: Browser integration needs one more step in each browser: adding the extension. In Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi it comes from the Chrome Web Store: DDM's <g1>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g1> window opens its page, where <g2>Add to Chrome</g2> installs it, and the browser keeps it up to date. Firefox takes it as a file from DDM's <x3/> folder until addons.mozilla.org lists it (on its way). <g4>Browser integration</g4> shows how.
21f9763149fa42df.text: 浏览器集成还需要在每个浏览器中再做一步：添加扩展。Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 从 Chrome 网上应用店获取：DDM 的<g1>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g1>窗口会打开它的页面，点击<g2>添加至 Chrome</g2>即可安装，之后由浏览器负责更新。在 addons.mozilla.org 上架之前（正在进行中），Firefox 使用 DDM 的 <x3/> 文件夹中的文件。<g4>浏览器集成</g4>介绍了具体做法。

22042069dec095ac.source: <g1>Your IDM list</g1><g2>Brought over in one step, addresses and all</g2>
22042069dec095ac.text: <g1>您的 IDM 列表</g1><g2>一步导入，地址一并带过来</g2>

2210ea7b021f5fbb.source: <g1>Add to queue</g1> chooses the queue they join, and <g2>Start the queue now</g2> whether it starts. The queue downloads as many at once as it allows.
2210ea7b021f5fbb.text: <g1>添加到队列</g1>选择它们加入的队列，<g2>立即启动队列</g2>决定是否启动。队列按其允许的数量同时下载。

221a3db374fdb74c.source: into a folder named after the archive when it holds several things at its top (or always, or never: <g1>Options → Archives</g1>),
221a3db374fdb74c.text: 如果存档顶层包含多个项目，则提取到以存档命名的文件夹中（也可设置为始终或从不创建文件夹：<g1>选项 → 存档</g1>），

224d3d1a59c09782.source: <g1>Link grabber</g1> gathers many links at once, sorts them into packages, and lets you tick the ones to download. DDM can then extract the archives it downloaded (zip, 7z, rar and more), by itself or when you ask.
224d3d1a59c09782.text: <g1>链接抓取器</g1>可一次收集多个链接，将它们整理成分组，并让您勾选要下载的链接。DDM 随后可以自动提取下载的存档（zip、7z、rar 等），也可以等您选择后再提取。

225937cd2337f950.source: <g1><g2>Debrid service accounts</g2></g1> — Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize and TorBox: file-host links through your own account.
225937cd2337f950.text: <g1><g2>网盘服务帐户</g2></g1> — Real-Debrid、AllDebrid、Premiumize 和 TorBox：通过您自己的帐户下载文件托管链接。

225fcf1e3a947289.source: <g1>Your IP address.</g1> Everyone sharing the same torrent sees it, as do its trackers and the DHT (the network peers use to find each other). That's how BitTorrent works, and no setting in DDM changes it. To hide your address, use a VPN on your whole computer.
225fcf1e3a947289.text: <g1>您的 IP 地址。</g1>所有共享同一种子的人，以及该种子的跟踪器和 DHT（对等方用来相互查找的网络），都能看到您的 IP 地址。这就是 BitTorrent 的工作方式，DDM 中的任何设置都无法改变这一点。要隐藏您的地址，请在整台计算机上使用 VPN。

22954adcadefc7ba.source: Click a download link in the browser: Download File Info opens in DDM.
22954adcadefc7ba.text: 在浏览器中点击下载链接：DDM 中会打开“下载文件信息”窗口。

22b1c6afc644a89a.source: Small and quick to set up, with a browser extension that catches video and audio
22b1c6afc644a89a.text: 体积小巧，安装快捷，提供可捕获视频和音频的浏览器扩展

22b6f7c73ab799c1.source: The first time, the phone's browser warns about the certificate. That is expected: DDM made it on your computer, and no public authority knows it. <g1>Options → Remote</g1> shows its fingerprint to compare. Add the page to the phone's home screen to keep it one tap away.
22b6f7c73ab799c1.text: 首次使用时，手机浏览器会警告证书问题。这是预期的：DDM 在您的电脑上生成了它，并且没有公共机构知道它。<g1>选项 → 远程</g1>显示其指纹以供比较。将页面添加到手机主屏幕，以便一键访问。

22fc4bad0d36c5fa.source: Every connection at once. Picked up where it stopped.
22fc4bad0d36c5fa.text: 同时建立多个连接。从中断处继续。

230325217f1c4b94.source: shows the address to open and, while no device is paired, a pairing code with a QR code:
230325217f1c4b94.text: 显示要打开的地址，并且在没有设备配对时，显示一个带有二维码的配对码：

23167d991f18b2e8.source: What each version changed, newest first. Follow along with the <g1>news feed</g1>, or watch the project on GitHub.
23167d991f18b2e8.text: 每个版本改了什么，最新的在前。可通过<g1>新闻订阅</g1>关注，或在 GitHub 上关注本项目。

2319136e89725d94.source: <g1>How it asks:</g1> gallery-dl and DDM's downloader ask sites as DDM (with the User-Agent the browser handed over, if any), and name the gallery's site as the page the pictures come from, as a browser does. Wikimedia's servers refuse tools that ask without a name. What gallery-dl downloads itself, it downloads one file a second at most. It uses no configuration file of yours.
2319136e89725d94.text: <g1>请求方式：</g1>gallery-dl 和 DDM 的下载器以 DDM 的名义向站点发出请求（如果浏览器提供了 User-Agent，则使用它），并像浏览器一样，把图库所在的站点作为图片来源页面。Wikimedia 的服务器会拒绝不报名称的工具。gallery-dl 自己下载的内容，每秒最多一个文件。它不使用您的任何配置文件。

231de63d91e89c9f.source: When it finishes, <g1>Download complete</g1> appears. Click <g2>Open</g2> to open the file, or <g3>Open folder</g3> to see it in Explorer.
231de63d91e89c9f.text: 下载完成后，出现<g1>下载完成</g1>。点击<g2>打开</g2>以打开文件，或点击<g3>打开文件夹</g3>以在资源管理器中查看。

23201f5f65d0831b.source: <g1>Linux, the first start is slow:</g1> DDM looks up the system's fonts for every script once, all together, while it starts (fontconfig); a first start on a busy computer can take a few seconds more. Install your distribution's Noto fonts if some scripts or symbols show as boxes.
23201f5f65d0831b.text: <g1>Linux，首次启动缓慢：</g1>DDM 在启动时会一次性查找系统所有脚本的字体（fontconfig）；在繁忙的电脑上首次启动可能需要多几秒钟。如果某些脚本或符号显示为方框，请安装您的发行版的 Noto 字体。

233fe4a013bde8ca.source: The pane on the left has four branches:

234499c99245461c.source: <g1>The sound alone</g1>: <g2>Audio only MP3</g2> at its best variable bitrate or at 320, 256, 192 or 128 kbps, <g3>Audio only OPUS</g3>, and <g4>Audio only FLAC</g4>, with an honest note that FLAC can't add quality the site's sound doesn't have.
234499c99245461c.text: <g1>纯音频</g1>：<g2>纯音频 MP3</g2>（最佳可变比特率或 320、256、192 或 128 kbps），<g3>纯音频 OPUS</g3>和<g4>纯音频 FLAC</g4>，并诚实地指出 FLAC 无法提升网站音频本身不具备的音质。

23454d17d297f033.text: 已在 DDM 的选项中关闭

23659927233459c8.source: On Linux this needs a tray, which most desktops have (KDE Plasma, Xfce, Cinnamon, Ubuntu's GNOME or GNOME with the AppIndicator extension, waybar's tray). On a desktop without one (some tiling window managers), closing the window quits DDM, since there would be nowhere to bring it back from.
23659927233459c8.text: 在 Linux 上，这需要一个托盘，大多数桌面环境都具备（KDE Plasma、Xfce、Cinnamon、Ubuntu 的 GNOME 或带有 AppIndicator 扩展的 GNOME、waybar 的托盘）。在没有托盘的桌面环境（某些平铺式窗口管理器）中，关闭窗口会退出 DDM，因为无法将其恢复。

2365e47d5b9e0466.text: 帐户：您的网盘服务帐户。

237ab225250a7fd4.source: Choose <g1>Tasks → Show drop target</g1>. A small night-blue square with DDM's comet appears in the main window's lower-right corner and stays on top of other windows.
237ab225250a7fd4.text: 选择<g1>任务 → 显示拖放目标</g1>。主窗口右下角会出现一个带有 DDM 彗星图标的深蓝色小方块，并保持在其他窗口之上。

237eb18bcebddae5.source: On <g1>File Name</g1>, <g2>Description</g2> and the other columns, type a word.
237eb18bcebddae5.text: 在 <g1>文件名</g1>、<g2>描述</g2> 等列中输入一个词。

2395e97255fa81a4.source: The gallery gets one row in the list. Its size grows as the pictures arrive, and its progress window says how many of the gallery's files are done ("12 of 40 files"). The log says how many were saved. Each picture is marked as downloaded from the internet, as any download is.
2395e97255fa81a4.text: 图库在列表中占一行。其大小随图片到达而增长，进度窗口会显示图库中已完成多少个文件（“40 个文件中的 12 个”）。日志会说明保存了多少个。与任何下载一样，每张图片都会标记为来自互联网。

23b71c92ff3856c0.source: DDM opens where you left it, with the same branches open and the same category shown. <g1>View → Hide categories</g1> gives the list the whole window.
23b71c92ff3856c0.text: DDM 会在您上次离开时的状态打开，保持相同的分支打开并显示相同的类别。<g1>视图 → 隐藏类别</g1>可让列表占据整个窗口。

24b6fe3b0b54eee0.source: The windows are drawn with OpenGL (eframe's glow) or with the system's own graphics API through eframe's wgpu, with that one backend only: Direct3D 12 on Windows (the default there), Vulkan on Linux, Metal on macOS (choices there; OpenGL stays their default until real graphics cards have tried them, #206). View → Draw with picks one, from the next start. One code path does it on every system (<x1/>): when the chosen one can't start, the other one is tried, so the windows always open. A watched start with the system's API leaves a marker until its first frame is drawn: a start that ends before it (a crash inside the driver), one whose first frame doesn't come within 10 seconds (DDM then starts again with OpenGL), or a graphics card lost twice in 10 minutes is remembered with its reason, which the menu shows.
24b6fe3b0b54eee0.text: 窗口使用 OpenGL（eframe 的 glow）或通过 eframe 的 wgpu 使用系统自己的图形 API 绘制，仅使用该后端：Windows 上的 Direct3D 12（默认），Linux 上的 Vulkan，macOS 上的 Metal（这些是选项；OpenGL 仍是它们的默认，直到真正的显卡尝试过它们，#206）。“视图”→“绘制方式”选择一个，从下次启动开始生效。一个代码路径在每个系统上都这样做 (<x1/>)：当选择的无法启动时，会尝试另一个，因此窗口总是能打开。使用系统 API 的受监控启动会在绘制第一帧之前留下标记：如果启动在此之前结束（驱动程序内部崩溃），或者第一帧在 10 秒内未出现（DDM 随后会使用 OpenGL 重新启动），或者显卡在 10 分钟内丢失两次，则会记住其原因，并在菜单中显示。

2508774439912aac.source: No, unless you want it to. While a torrent downloads it trades pieces with other people, as every torrent client does. When it finishes, it stops, like any other download. Turn on Keep sharing torrents after they finish in Options if you'd like to give back.

251b2409fae5818c.source: When the browser can't hand a download to DDM, it keeps the download itself, so nothing is lost. The extension's toolbar button then turns grey with a red <g1>!</g1>. Click it: the extension's status page opens, says in a sentence or two what's wrong and the one thing to do, and turns into <g2>Dannex Download Manager is installed</g2> by itself once DDM answers (it asks again every two seconds while it is open). Its <g3>Help</g3> link brings you to the matching section below. You can open it any time: right-click the toolbar button → <g4>Help</g4>.
251b2409fae5818c.text: 当浏览器无法将下载交给 DDM 时，它会自己保留该下载，因此不会丢失任何内容。此时扩展的工具栏按钮会变为带红色<g1>!</g1>的灰色。单击它：扩展的状态页会打开，用一两句话说明出了什么问题以及该做的一件事，并在 DDM 响应后自动变为<g2>Dannex Download Manager 已安装</g2>（页面打开期间，它每两秒再询问一次）。其<g3>帮助</g3>链接会带您转到下方对应的部分。您可以随时打开它：右键单击工具栏按钮 → <g4>帮助</g4>。

2725cf19e6ced1be.source: Video pages and image galleries: yt-dlp, gallery-dl and the ffmpeg yt-dlp starts can't be held to an adapter themselves, so while one is chosen DDM gives them a proxy of its own on this computer (<x1/>, with a password only they get). DDM opens their connections through the adapter, as it opens its own, and looks the names up with the DNS you chose. When the adapter disconnects, their connections close and the downloads stop with the others. Video formats that can't go through a proxy (RTMP, RTSP, MMS, FTP) are refused rather than sent around it.
2725cf19e6ced1be.text: 视频页面和图片库：yt-dlp、gallery-dl 以及 yt-dlp 启动的 ffmpeg 本身无法绑定到适配器，因此选择适配器后，DDM 会在此计算机上为它们提供自己的代理（<x1/>，只有它们知道密码）。DDM 会像处理自己的连接一样，通过该适配器为它们建立连接，并使用您选择的 DNS 查询域名。适配器断开连接时，它们的连接会关闭，下载也会和其他下载一起停止。无法通过代理传输的视频格式（RTMP、RTSP、MMS、FTP）会被拒绝，而不会绕过代理发送。

276fcec559dad0de.source: <g1>Use passive mode for FTP</g1> — on by default: for FTP downloads DDM opens the data connections itself (passive mode), which works through routers and firewalls. Turn it off only for a server that needs active mode (the server connects back to you). FTP never goes through the proxy above. See <g2>FTP and FTPS</g2>.
276fcec559dad0de.text: <g1>对 FTP 使用被动模式</g1> — 默认开启：对于 FTP 下载，DDM 会自己打开数据连接（被动模式），这样可以穿过路由器和防火墙。仅对需要主动模式的服务器（服务器反过来连接您）才将其关闭。FTP 从不经过上面的代理。请参阅 <g2>FTP 和 FTPS</g2>。

286f78069efed389.source: <g1>Open with...</g1> (here and in <g2>Download complete</g2>) shows the system's own choice of apps: Windows' <g3>Open with</g3> window, whose <g4>Always</g4> (or <g5>Always use this app</g5>) makes that app the one <g6>Open</g6> uses from then on; on Linux the desktop's <g7>Open With</g7> chooser; on macOS the list of applications. <g8>Open folder</g8> opens the file's folder with the file selected.

2879329fef4fb0e5.text: 添加下载，含地址框、登录服务器和确定

297e899a201c87a6.text: <g1>服务器</g1> — 服务器的位置：其国家/地区旗帜和名称，以及往返所需时间。请参阅<g2>服务器位置</g2>。当浏览器将下载文件及其名称和大小移交给DDM时，此项会留空，因为DDM无需询问服务器。

29cc0459c192b39d.source: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, is the main platform. Builds for Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz) and macOS (.dmg) come with every release too; today's are marked experimental. Linux is checked on GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon, in Wayland sessions too, and its packages in clean Ubuntu, Debian and Fedora systems. Still to come there: the Flatpak Firefox isn't checked yet, and screen readers (Orca) don't read DDM's windows yet. macOS stays experimental. See <g1>Windows, Mac and Linux</g1> and <g2>Download</g2>.
29cc0459c192b39d.text: Windows 10 和 11（64 位）是主要平台。每次发布也会提供 Linux（AppImage、.deb、.rpm 和 .tar.gz）和 macOS（.dmg）版本；目前这些版本标注为实验性。Linux 已在 GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon 上测试过，包括 Wayland 会话，其安装包也已在全新的 Ubuntu、Debian 和 Fedora 系统中测试过。尚待完成的有：Flatpak 版 Firefox 还未测试，屏幕阅读器 (Orca) 还不能朗读 DDM 的窗口。macOS 版仍为实验性。请参阅 <g1>Windows、Mac 和 Linux</g1>和<g2>下载</g2>。

The setup speaks the same languages, and the browser extension speaks your browser's.

2a88270c5adb5b5c.source: When none of this helps, the browser keeps the download, so nothing is lost. The extension's toolbar button turns grey with a red <g1>!</g1>, and a click on it opens its status page, which says why it couldn't reach DDM and what to do; see <g2>The browser and DDM aren't connected</g2>.
2a88270c5adb5b5c.text: 如果以上都无济于事，浏览器会保留该下载，因此不会丢失任何内容。扩展的工具栏按钮会变为带红色<g1>!</g1>的灰色，单击它会打开其状态页，其中说明它为何无法连接 DDM 以及该怎么做；请参阅<g2>浏览器与 DDM 未连接</g2>。

2b022cf4d9a97412.text: 没有密码的加密压缩包会打开<g1>压缩包密码</g1>窗口。将鼠标悬停在列表中的下载任务上，可以查看发生了什么：提取了多少文件、提取到哪里，或者为什么没有提取。
