2b15744382efafb3.text: 关于 Dannex Download Manager 的解答：它是否免费、是否安全、与 IDM 的比较、浏览器、视频、种子、速度、Mac 和 Linux 等。

2b3813b1923fc5e3.source: The list covers every display language of Windows 11, including both Chinese scripts, Spanish for Spain and Mexico, French for France and Canada, Portuguese for Portugal and Brazil, and Serbian in Cyrillic and Latin. The <g1>languages page</g1> lists them all.
2b3813b1923fc5e3.text: 此列表涵盖 Windows 11 的所有显示语言，包括两种中文脚本、西班牙语（西班牙和墨西哥）、法语（法国和加拿大）、葡萄牙语（葡萄牙和巴西），以及西里尔字母和拉丁字母的塞尔维亚语。<g1>语言页面</g1>列出了所有这些语言。

2b4348ab9abbefc7.source: <g1>Take these file types from the browsers</g1> — the file types the browser hands over (and the clipboard picks up). Separate them by spaces; <x2/> matches any characters, as in <x3/>. <g4>Default</g4> puts the original list back. The list starts with the usual archives, programs and installers (Windows, macOS and Linux ones: DMG, PKG, DEB, RPM, APPIMAGE, MSIX), music and videos, PDF and Office files, AI models and datasets (GGUF, SAFETENSORS, CKPT, PT, ONNX, PARQUET), 3D and CAD files (GLB, FBX, OBJ, STL, BLEND, STEP), design and camera RAW files, ebooks, disk images and split archives. Pages, scripts, plain text and web images are left out on purpose, so saving a picture or a page stays with the browser; add any type you need, or put a single <x5/> in the box to take every file that has an extension. A list you never changed gains the types a new version adds; one you edited stays as it is.
2b4348ab9abbefc7.text: <g1>接管浏览器中的这些文件类型</g1> — 浏览器交出的文件类型（也包括剪贴板识别的类型）。用空格分隔；<x2/> 可匹配任意字符，如 <x3/>。<g4>默认</g4>会恢复原始列表。列表一开始包含常见的压缩包、程序和安装包（Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的：DMG、PKG、DEB、RPM、APPIMAGE、MSIX）、音乐和视频、PDF 和 Office 文件、AI 模型和数据集（GGUF、SAFETENSORS、CKPT、PT、ONNX、PARQUET）、3D 和 CAD 文件（GLB、FBX、OBJ、STL、BLEND、STEP）、设计文件和相机 RAW 文件、电子书、磁盘映像和分卷压缩包。网页、脚本、纯文本和网页图片被有意排除在外，因此保存图片或页面仍由浏览器处理；可添加您需要的任何类型，或在框中只放一个 <x5/>，以接管所有带扩展名的文件。从未更改过的列表会获得新版本新增的类型；您编辑过的列表则保持原样。

2b529a26cf5efd79.source: <g1>Uninstalling</g1> on Windows with <g2>remove the download list and settings</g2> removes DDM's entries from Credential Manager too. Elsewhere, or to remove them yourself: <x3/> (only DDM's own entries).
2b529a26cf5efd79.text: 在 Windows 上<g1>卸载</g1>时，如果选择<g2>删除下载列表和设置</g2>，也会从凭据管理器中删除 DDM 的条目。在其他地方，或者要自行删除它们：<x3/>（仅限 DDM 自己的条目）。

2b59fa980f99642c.source: <g1>Queues</g1> — each queue; select one to see only its downloads.
2b59fa980f99642c.text: <g1>队列</g1> — 显示各个队列；选择一个队列即可只查看其中的下载。

2b69d9420536434a.source: It opens the download's address in the browser the download came from, or in your default browser when DDM doesn't know which one it was (a link you added in DDM yourself) or doesn't find it (on Linux, a Flatpak or Snap browser). Answer the site's check there if it asks for one. When the browser starts the download, its extension offers it to DDM as usual, and DDM leaves it to the browser: the browser keeps it, and the extension's status page (right-click its toolbar button → <g1>Help</g1>) says why. DDM does this once for that address (or the one its redirects led to), within 10 minutes of your click; after that, the link's downloads come to DDM again. DDM's log notes each one.
2b69d9420536434a.text: 它会在下载来源的浏览器中打开该下载的地址；当 DDM 不知道是哪个浏览器（您自己在 DDM 中添加的链接）或找不到它（在 Linux 上，Flatpak 或 Snap 版浏览器）时，则在您的默认浏览器中打开。如果站点要求验证，请在那里完成。当浏览器开始下载时，其扩展会照常将其提交给 DDM，而 DDM 会把它留给浏览器：浏览器保留它，扩展的状态页（右键单击其工具栏按钮 → <g1>帮助</g1>）会说明原因。DDM 只对该地址（或其重定向到的地址）这样做一次，且在您单击后的 10 分钟内；之后，该链接的下载又会交给 DDM。DDM 的日志会记录每一次。

2b7807a59c407729.source: Right-click any text box for <g1>Undo</g1>, <g2>Cut</g2>, <g3>Copy</g3>, <g4>Paste</g4>, <g5>Delete</g5> and <g6>Select all</g6>. A read-only value (an address, a path, a version) copies with <g7>Ctrl+C</g7> or its right-click menu.
2b7807a59c407729.text: 右键点击任何文本框可进行<g1>撤消</g1>、<g2>剪切</g2>、<g3>复制</g3>、<g4>粘贴</g4>、<g5>删除</g5>和<g6>全选</g6>。只读值（地址、路径、版本）可通过<g7>Ctrl+C</g7>或右键菜单复制。

2ba8419d04c975e2.source: The Mac gets two smaller downloads, one for Apple Silicon and one for Intel, instead of one universal <x1/> of 80 MB. The AppImage can update through AppImageLauncher, Gear Lever and AppImageUpdate, which fetch only the parts that changed. Linux can draw with Vulkan and macOS with Metal, from <g2>View → Draw with</g2>, while OpenGL stays the default there. In a Wayland session, DDM runs through XWayland so its menus open where you click.
2ba8419d04c975e2.text: Mac 现在提供两个较小的下载包，一个适用于 Apple 芯片，一个适用于 Intel，而不再是 80 MB 的通用 <x1/>。AppImage 可通过 AppImageLauncher、Gear Lever 和 AppImageUpdate 更新，它们只获取更改过的部分。Linux 可以使用 Vulkan 绘制，macOS 可以使用 Metal 绘制，设置位于<g2>视图 → 绘制方式</g2>，而 OpenGL 仍是这两个系统上的默认方式。在 Wayland 会话中，DDM 通过 XWayland 运行，因此菜单会在您点击的位置打开。

2d61641ccf46b994.source: A torrent's <g1>web seeds</g1> (web servers that have its files) follow the same rule: DDM asks only <x2/> and <x3/> servers on the internet, never one on your computer or your local network, nor one a server redirects it to there. 2f1dc927e3199151.source: The sign-in is kept in the system's keychain: Windows Credential Manager, the keyring on Linux, the macOS keychain. Without an unlocked one, it stays in DDM's own settings, and <g1>Options → Accounts</g1> says where it is. DDM sends a service only the links you download through it, with your token. The direct link is never shown or copied, since the services forbid sharing it, and the token is never written to DDM's log, crash reports or the command line's output. DDM asks each service well under its request limit.
2f1dc927e3199151.text: 登录信息保存在系统的密钥链中：Windows 凭据管理器、Linux 上的密钥环、macOS 密钥链。如果没有解锁的密钥链，它会保存在 DDM 自己的设置中，<g1>选项 → 账户</g1>会显示其位置。DDM 只会向服务发送您通过它下载的链接以及您的令牌。直链绝不会显示或复制，因为服务禁止共享它，并且令牌绝不会写入 DDM 的日志、崩溃报告或命令行输出。DDM 向每个服务发出的请求远低于其请求限制。

30cb30fc1c2290f2.source: By default DDM downloads the pieces that the fewest peers have first, as BitTorrent programs usually do. That way a piece only one peer has is fetched before that peer leaves, and DDM can pass it on to others sooner. On DDM's test swarms it finished just as fast as downloading in order, and it was the only order that finished when a scarce piece's only holder left.
30cb30fc1c2290f2.text: 默认情况下，DDM 会像其他 BitTorrent 程序一样，优先下载拥有者最少的分块。这样，只有一个对等方拥有的分块就能在该对等方离开前下载完成，DDM 也能更早将它传给其他对等方。在 DDM 的测试群中，这种方式的完成速度与按顺序下载一样快；当稀有分块的唯一持有者离开时，也只有这种方式能完成下载。

338f47d658562dae.source: If DDM is already running, the setup asks it to save and close first. To update, use <g1>Help → Check for updates → Update now</g1>, or run the setup of the new version; your list and settings stay.
338f47d658562dae.text: 如果 DDM 正在运行，安装程序会先要求它保存并关闭。要更新，请使用<g1>帮助 → 检查更新 → 立即更新</g1>，或运行新版本的安装程序；您的列表和设置将保留。

338fb72d9f10d647.source: Open Windows Settings → Apps, find Dannex Download Manager and choose Uninstall. The uninstaller asks whether to delete your download list and settings as…
338fb72d9f10d647.text: 打开 Windows 设置 → 应用，找到 Dannex Download Manager 并选择“卸载”。卸载程序会询问是否同时删除您的下载列表和设置…

33a764abc459826a.source: <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1> opens GitHub's bug report form in your browser with DDM's version, your system and its version, how DDM was installed and your language filled in. Nothing is sent until you choose to submit it on GitHub, where it becomes public; read it before you post.
33a764abc459826a.text: <g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1>会在您的浏览器中打开 GitHub 的错误报告表单，其中已填写 DDM 的版本、您的系统及其版本、DDM 的安装方式以及您的语言。在您选择在 GitHub 上提交之前，不会发送任何内容，提交后内容将公开；请在发布前阅读。

33a7d786853dbe7d.source: <g1>Remote control</g1><g2>Paste a link on your phone and the computer downloads it. Watch and pause from anywhere at home.</g2>
33a7d786853dbe7d.text: <g1>远程控制</g1><g2>在手机上粘贴链接，电脑即可下载。在家中任何地方查看和暂停下载。</g2>

33af7ad4953498d9.source: With <g1>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g1> ticked (it is, unless you turned it off), when you copy a link to a file type in <g2>Options → File types</g2> (ZIP, EXE, MP4, PDF and many more), <g3>Download File Info</g3> opens with it filled in, ready for <g4>Start Download</g4>. A copied magnet link opens <g5>Add torrent</g5> (while <x6/> is in the list). Links to other pages are left alone. With <g7>Options → Downloads → Show Download File Info first</g7> off, the download starts at once instead. Only links copied while DDM runs are taken, never one that was already there.
33af7ad4953498d9.text: 勾选<g1>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g1>后（除非您关闭，否则默认勾选），当您复制指向<g2>选项 → 文件类型</g2>中某种文件类型（ZIP、EXE、MP4、PDF 等）的链接时，<g3>下载文件信息</g3>会打开并已填好，随时可以<g4>开始下载</g4>。复制的磁力链接会打开<g5>添加种子</g5>（只要列表中有 <x6/>）。指向其他页面的链接不会处理。若关闭<g7>选项 → 下载 → 先显示“下载文件信息”</g7>，则会直接开始下载。只处理 DDM 运行期间复制的链接，之前已有的链接不会被处理。

33c87ad90bc3c2e4.source: When there is one, <g1>Update now</g1> downloads it, checks it, puts it in place and restarts DDM; your list, settings and downloads stay as they are:
33c87ad90bc3c2e4.text: 当有新版本时，<g1>立即更新</g1>会下载、检查、安装并重新启动 DDM；你的列表、设置和下载保持不变：

33cb6035f72e6370.source: Choose the subtitles; tick Put them into the video to keep them inside the file.
33cb6035f72e6370.text: 选择字幕；勾选“将它们放入视频”，即可将字幕保存到视频文件中。

33e74c2131bce5b0.text: 种子下载公平共享限速

33e932958a661bfe.source: <g1>Category</g1> — choose a category to see and change its settings below.
33e932958a661bfe.text: <g1>类别</g1> — 选择一个类别以查看和更改其下方的设置。

340464f741db2a7b.source: Import your download list from IDM
340464f741db2a7b.text: 从 IDM 导入下载列表

343c248df702cea5.source: DDM can start with your computer and wait in the notification area, its window closed and its downloads running. A download's progress window can go there too, with one click.
343c248df702cea5.text: DDM 可以随电脑启动，并在通知区域等待，窗口关闭，下载仍在进行。下载进度窗口也可以一键隐藏到通知区域。

344900eeb785a84a.source: As each page and style sheet finishes downloading, DDM changes its links to lead to the saved copies: links to other pages, pictures (<x1/> and pictures loaded late too), style sheets, scripts, fonts and the addresses in CSS. A link to something that wasn't saved (a page beyond the depth, another site) is made a full address, so it still opens on the site. Nothing else in the page changes. Grabbing more of the site later and downloading the new files updates the pages already saved.
344900eeb785a84a.text: 每个页面和样式表下载完成后，DDM 会修改其链接，使其指向已保存的副本：指向其他页面、图片（<x1/>，也包括稍后加载的图片）、样式表、脚本、字体以及 CSS 中地址的链接。指向未保存内容（超出深度的页面、其他站点）的链接会变为完整地址，因此仍能在网站上打开。页面中的其他内容不会改变。以后抓取该站点的更多内容并下载新文件，会更新已保存的页面。

346cc7daf1d04291.source: <g1>Search links</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+F</g2>) shows the links whose name, text or address contain what you type. <g3>Esc</g3> empties it.
346cc7daf1d04291.text: <g1>搜索链接</g1>（<g2>Ctrl+F</g2>）会显示名称、文字或地址中包含您输入内容的链接。<g3>Esc</g3> 清空它。

347505ab63956d2f.source: On Windows, DDM binds the adapter's own address, and Windows then sends those packets only through that adapter. Linux binds the device itself (Linux 5.7 or newer), and macOS binds the interface. An address of a kind the adapter doesn't have, such as IPv6 on a VPN that has only IPv4, is refused, not sent around it.
347505ab63956d2f.text: 在 Windows 上，DDM 绑定网卡自身的地址，然后 Windows 只通过该网卡发送这些数据包。Linux 绑定设备本身（Linux 5.7 或更高版本），macOS 绑定接口。网卡不具备的地址类型，例如只有 IPv4 的 VPN 上的 IPv6，将被拒绝，而不是绕过它发送。

347561bddd3264b9.source: With <g1>First and last pieces first</g1> (on by default), each file's last pieces come early too. Most video files keep their index at the end, and a player reads it before anything plays.
347561bddd3264b9.text: 启用<g1>先下载首尾分块</g1>（默认开启）后，每个文件末尾的分块也会提前下载。大多数视频文件将索引保存在末尾，而播放器会先读取索引，再开始播放。

3477bbfd4c6c4344.source: A caption button under the pointer (a tint over the bar)
3477bbfd4c6c4344.text: 指针下的标题按钮（标题栏上的着色）

34ae5dce5829db86.source: With <g1>Use the browser's proxy for the downloads it hands over</g1> (on by default), a download DDM takes from the browser goes through the proxy the browser used for it: a VPN or proxy extension's, the browser's own manual proxy, or its auto-config script. Content limited to the VPN's country keeps working. In Firefox, switch on <g2>Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension</g2> in the extension's options page. Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi can't hand the proxy over yet: set the same proxy in DDM there. A proxy that needs the VPN extension's own login can't be shared, and the download says so rather than going without it.
34ae5dce5829db86.text: 启用<g1>对浏览器交给 DDM 的下载使用浏览器的代理</g1>（默认开启）后，DDM 从浏览器接管的下载会经过浏览器当时使用的代理：VPN 或代理扩展的代理、浏览器自己的手动代理，或其自动配置脚本。仅限 VPN 所在国家的内容仍可正常访问。在 Firefox 中，请在扩展的选项页中开启<g2>通过此浏览器的代理或 VPN 扩展发送下载</g2>。Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 目前还无法交出代理：请在这些浏览器的 DDM 中设置相同的代理。需要 VPN 扩展自己的登录信息的代理无法共享，此时下载会明确提示，而不是不经代理直接下载。

34b13dc91c758e03.source: DDM doesn't need to be running first: the browser starts it. If DDM can't be reached at all, the download stays with the browser, so nothing is lost.
34b13dc91c758e03.text: DDM 无需预先运行：浏览器会启动它。如果 DDM 完全无法访问，下载将保留在浏览器中，因此不会丢失任何内容。

34b285389a79f6ba.source: Dannex Download Manager's link grabber collects a page's links, sorts them into packages, checks which are online and extracts the archives they bring.
34b285389a79f6ba.text: Dannex Download Manager 的链接抓取器可以收集页面上的链接，将其分类打包，检查哪些在线，并提取它们带来的压缩包。

34c6faf87239c685.source: Install DDM with the setup and keep <g1>Set up browser integration</g1> ticked. In Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, add the extension from the Chrome Web Store: DDM's <g2>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g2> window opens its page, where <g3>Add to Chrome</g3> installs it, and the browser keeps it up to date. Firefox installs only add-ons Mozilla has signed, so until Dannex's is on addons.mozilla.org it takes the file <x4/> in Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR, or until Firefox closes in any Firefox. The <g5>tutorial</g5> walks through each.
34c6faf87239c685.text: 用安装程序安装 DDM，并保持勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成</g1>。在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 中，从 Chrome 网上应用店添加扩展：DDM 的<g2>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>窗口会打开扩展页面，点击<g3>添加至 Chrome</g3>即可安装，之后由浏览器负责更新。Firefox 只安装经 Mozilla 签名的附加组件，所以在 Dannex 的扩展登上 addons.mozilla.org 之前，需要在 Firefox Developer Edition、Nightly 或 ESR 中安装文件 <x4/>，或者在任何 Firefox 中安装，直到 Firefox 关闭为止。<g5>教程</g5>会逐一带您操作。

34dea13f606a3c2f.source: <g1>Restore the built-in categories</g1> — brings the built-in categories back as they came, after you renamed, retyped or deleted them.
34dea13f606a3c2f.text: <g1>恢复内置类别</g1> — 在您重命名、更改文件类型或删除内置类别后，将其恢复到初始状态。

34ee8ac31c366dc9.source: Some file hosts count a look-up as a download: turn the look-ups off in <g1>Options → Archives</g1>.
34ee8ac31c366dc9.text: 一些文件主机将查找计为下载：请在<g1>选项 → 压缩包</g1>中关闭查找功能。

3513f93cb0fa7d72.source: <g1>Far</g1> (red): over 150 ms, usually another continent. A far server is often slower, and more connections help it most.
3513f93cb0fa7d72.text: <g1>远</g1>（红色）：超过 150 毫秒，通常是另一个大陆。远距离服务器通常较慢，增加连接数帮助最大。

3514fb404711d6ec.source: Connections to this computer itself (<x1/>) aren't bound. A proxy on this computer carries the downloads, and where it sends them is up to it.
3514fb404711d6ec.text: 连接到这台计算机本身的连接（<x1/>）不会绑定到适配器。代理在这台计算机上转发下载，下载发送到哪里由代理决定。

3545af38d7005869.source: A page whose video the window can't find: play the video in your browser, then use the extension's button over it, or right-click the video → <g1>Download with DDM</g1>: either sends the stream the page loaded (<g2>Videos a page plays</g2>).
3545af38d7005869.text: 窗口找不到视频的页面：请在浏览器中播放该视频，然后使用扩展在其上的按钮，或右键单击视频 → <g1>使用 DDM 下载</g1>：两者都会发送页面加载的流（<g2>页面播放的视频</g2>）。

35694583fe0f1379.source: In the same window, tick <g1>Limit all downloads together to</g1> and set the speed. This caps DDM as a whole, however many files are downloading, torrents included. When torrents and other downloads run at the same time, each side gets at least half of the speed, and more when the other side needs less: a torrent going slowly leaves the rest to the other downloads, and the other way round. It applies whenever it is ticked, whether the per-file limiter is on or off.
35694583fe0f1379.text: 在同一窗口中，勾选<g1>将所有下载总计限制为</g1>并设置速度。无论有多少个文件正在下载，这都会限制 DDM 的总速度，包括种子。当种子和其他下载同时运行时，双方至少各自获得一半的速度；如果一方需要的速度较少，另一方就能获得更多：种子速度较慢时，剩余速度会分配给其他下载，反之亦然。只要勾选此选项，无论是否启用单个文件的限速器，限制都会生效。

3577998027a0f5af.text: 高对比度主题下的主窗口

359e57bd1bf0613c.text: 主窗口的工具栏和类别采用 Breeze 主题

35f38319f67fe41e.source: Give it a folder for its settings and one for the downloads, where each category gets its own folder. Mount a network share there and the files land straight on it. On Unraid, a template maps the folders and runs DDM as <x1/>, as Unraid's shares expect.
35f38319f67fe41e.text: 为其设置一个文件夹用于保存配置，一个文件夹用于保存下载，每个分类都有自己的子文件夹。在此处挂载网络共享，文件将直接保存到其中。在 Unraid 上，模板会映射文件夹并以 <x1/> 方式运行 DDM，以符合 Unraid 共享的预期。

3601696fdb20bd10.source: <g1>Several at a time</g1>: as many as <g2>Options → Connection</g2> gives a file (8 by default). While many files are left, each comes over one connection; the last few share them. The progress window's connections table shows the files under way.
3601696fdb20bd10.text: <g1>同时下载多个</g1>：数量由<g2>选项 → 连接</g2>给每个文件的连接数决定（默认 8）。剩余文件很多时，每个文件使用一条连接；最后几个文件共享这些连接。进度窗口的连接表会显示正在下载的文件。

3618a633ab0466f9.text: AI 助手（MCP）— Dannex Download Manager 帮助

363b317c47e6d6ad.text: 开始或恢复已停止、排队中或失败的下载。

365316b6e2379778.text: 未完成的文件被删除时

36716c47e12ccaff.source: <g1>Download now</g1> (<g2>Enter</g2>) adds the ticked links to the <g3>Main download queue</g3> and starts the queue. It downloads as many files at once as the queue allows.
36716c47e12ccaff.text: <g1>立即下载</g1>（<g2>Enter</g2>）会把勾选的链接添加到<g3>主下载队列</g3>并启动队列。它会按队列允许的数量同时下载多个文件。

3688ea6bb5b2fe83.source: Right-click the list's blank space for <g1>Add new download</g1>, <g2>Select all</g2>, <g3>Arrange files</g3>, <g4>Clear all filters</g4> and <g5>Delete All Completed</g5>.
3688ea6bb5b2fe83.text: 右键点击列表空白处，可选择<g1>添加新下载</g1>、<g2>全选</g2>、<g3>整理文件</g3>、<g4>清除所有筛选器</g4>或<g5>删除所有已完成</g5>。

36a1df60e5ee30b9.source: <g1><x2/></g1> — what <g3>View → Theme</g3> lists; the file's name when there is none.
36a1df60e5ee30b9.text: <g1><x2/></g1> — <g3>视图 → 主题</g3>中列出的名称；如果没有，则为文件名。

36a3a5e9867592e0.source: <g1>Delete Completed</g1> on the toolbar (or <g2>Downloads → Delete All Completed</g2>) removes every finished download from the list, with the same question.
36a3a5e9867592e0.text: 工具栏上的<g1>删除已完成</g1>（或<g2>下载 → 删除所有已完成</g2>）会从列表中移除所有已完成的下载，并弹出相同的询问。

36fa729abf3d65b0.source: Regional: dates and times as the system writes them, or your own way.
36fa729abf3d65b0.text: 区域：日期和时间按系统格式或自定义格式显示。

371a8fd9723baed3.source: <g1>Under your speed limits</g1>: one limit holds for the whole gallery, however many files come at once. It is the gallery's own, set in its progress window's <g2>Speed Limiter</g2> tab, or else the <g3>Speed Limiter</g3>'s limit for one file. The limit for all downloads together counts the gallery too. A change applies at once.
371a8fd9723baed3.text: <g1>遵守您的速度限制</g1>：不论同时下载多少个文件，整个图库只受一个限制。这就是图库自己的限制，在其进度窗口的<g2>速度限制器</g2>选项卡中设置；如果没有，则是<g3>速度限制器</g3>中针对单个文件的限制。所有下载合计的限制也会计入该图库。更改会立即生效。

3724a83fa3a38087.source: <g1>Download Later</g1> — add it to a queue without starting. See below.
3724a83fa3a38087.text: <g1>稍后下载</g1> — 将其添加到队列而不开始。请参阅下文。

3731ebb25637b8d0.source: The page then says <g1>On</g1> and shows the address to open, such as <x2/>.
3731ebb25637b8d0.text: 页面将显示<g1>开启</g1>并显示要打开的地址，例如<x2/>。

37343da37ab419b1.source: <g1>Options → Accounts → Add...</g1> takes <g2>Real-Debrid</g2>, <g3>AllDebrid</g3> and <g4>Premiumize</g4>. Real-Debrid and AllDebrid sign in with a code you confirm in the browser, or with your API token; Premiumize with its API key. DDM shows the account's name and whether it is premium. With several accounts, a link goes through the first one whose service supports its host.
37343da37ab419b1.text: <g1>选项 → 账户 → 添加...</g1>支持<g2>Real-Debrid</g2>、<g3>AllDebrid</g3>和<g4>Premiumize</g4>。Real-Debrid 和 AllDebrid 通过您在浏览器中确认的代码或您的 API 令牌登录；Premiumize 通过其 API 密钥登录。DDM 会显示账户名称以及是否为高级账户。如果有多个账户，链接会通过第一个支持其主机服务的账户下载。

3737a9d9f2dab4e2.source: Paste it, get a plain answer
3737a9d9f2dab4e2.text: 粘贴校验和，获得明确结果

374c7ca1306e3af5.source: Numbers your language's way, and buttons that fit
374c7ca1306e3af5.text: 符合您语言习惯的数字和自适应按钮

376a47aa5154da76.text: 在不同计算机之间移动

377e66565e98c8df.source: Add it from the <g1>Chrome Web Store</g1>: <g2>Add to Chrome</g2> installs it, and the browser keeps it up to date. DDM's <g3>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g3> window opens that page in each browser it finds (<g4>Add the extension</g4> beside the browser). In Edge, first click <g5>Allow extensions from other stores</g5>; there the button is <g6>Get</g6>. Chrome may also offer it by itself at its next start (<g7>New extension added</g7>): turn it on there.
377e66565e98c8df.text: 从 <g1>Chrome 网上应用店</g1>添加：<g2>添加至 Chrome</g2>即可安装，之后由浏览器负责更新。DDM 的<g3>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g3>窗口会在它找到的每个浏览器中打开该页面（浏览器旁边的<g4>添加扩展</g4>）。在 Edge 中，请先点击<g5>允许来自其他商店的扩展</g5>；那里的按钮是<g6>获取</g6>。Chrome 也可能在下次启动时自行提示（<g7>已添加新扩展</g7>）：在那里把它启用即可。

37bb2ad3933da467.source: Each running download has its own progress window. It opens when you start or resume the download. To open it again, right-click the download and choose <g1>Show progress</g1>, or choose it in <g2>Downloads in progress</g2> in the tray icon's menu. (With <g3>On Double click → Open</g3>, a double-click on an unfinished download opens it too.)
37bb2ad3933da467.text: 每个正在运行的下载都有自己的进度窗口。它在您开始或恢复下载时打开。要再次打开它，请右键单击下载并选择<g1>显示进度</g1>，或在托盘图标菜单的<g2>正在进行的下载</g2>中选择它。（启用<g3>双击时 → 打开</g3>后，双击未完成的下载也会打开它。）

37c74a0e1edd492c.source: <g1>Unfinished</g1> — downloads that aren't complete yet, by category.
37c74a0e1edd492c.text: <g1>未完成</g1> — 尚未完成的下载，按类别显示。

37d5de28b8d397b2.source: A user's systemd timer can't wake the computer, and <x1/> needs root, so without this setting DDM can't wake the computer. DDM never asks for an administrator's password.
37d5de28b8d397b2.text: 用户的 systemd 计时器无法唤醒电脑，并且<x1/>需要 root 权限，因此没有此设置，DDM 无法唤醒电脑。DDM 从不要求管理员密码。

37fadf1ff98a0172.source: Schedule: when the queue is done

380655a5943a3527.source: <g1>Open</g1>: its window, on its grab under way, else on the files it found (or its settings, when it hasn't run yet).
380655a5943a3527.text: <g1>打开</g1>：其窗口，正在进行抓取时显示该抓取，否则显示它找到的文件（尚未运行时显示其设置）。

381467a798639085.source: Sites change often, and a newer yt-dlp usually fixes it. DDM looks for a newer yt-dlp once a session, the first time you open the video window or the <g1>Download video</g1> button's menu. To get the newest one now: quit DDM (<g2>Tasks → Exit</g2>), delete the <x3/> folder in DDM's data folder (<x4/>, or the <x5/> folder of a portable copy) and start DDM: it downloads the newest yt-dlp by itself.
381467a798639085.text: 网站经常变动，更新的 yt-dlp 通常能修好它。DDM 每次会话检查一次 yt-dlp 的新版本，即第一次打开视频窗口或<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮的菜单时。要立即获取最新版：退出 DDM（<g2>任务 → 退出</g2>），删除 DDM 数据文件夹中的 <x3/> 文件夹（<x4/>，或便携版的 <x5/> 文件夹），再启动 DDM：它会自行下载最新的 yt-dlp。

383d0f0e07729602.source: When the address is already in the list

38415738ef9a9124.source: <g1><x2/></g1> — the theme yours starts from: <x3/> (the default when it's left out), a built-in theme's id (<x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/>, <x7/>, <x8/>, <x9/>, <x10/>), or another theme file in the same folder, by its file name without <x11/>. A file that inherits another can be inherited in turn; a theme can't inherit itself.
38415738ef9a9124.text: <g1><x2/></g1> — 您的主题的起始主题：<x3/>（如果省略则为默认值）、内置主题的 ID（<x4/>、<x5/>、<x6/>、<x7/>、<x8/>、<x9/>、<x10/>），或同一文件夹中的另一个主题文件，按其不带<x11/>的文件名。一个继承了另一个主题的文件可以反过来被继承；一个主题不能继承自身。

384d07fc73bc91b6.source: <g1>Swap the extension</g1><g2>Add DDM's extension to your browser (<g3>how</g3>) and turn IDM's off, so only one of them takes your downloads.</g2>
384d07fc73bc91b6.text: <g1>更换扩展</g1><g2>把 DDM 的扩展添加到浏览器（<g3>方法</g3>），并关闭 IDM 的扩展，这样只有其中一个接管您的下载。</g2>

387103bb1d031203.source: Tick <g1>Let phones and computers on the local network control DDM</g1>.
387103bb1d031203.text: 勾选<g1>允许本地网络上的手机和电脑控制 DDM</g1>。

38c2835e2c5124e2.source: <g1>Files</g1> — each file, its size and how much of it is done. Files you unticked show <g2>Skipped</g2>. Tick or untick a file's box to change what is downloaded, even while the torrent runs. At least one file stays ticked. If you untick everything still missing, the torrent finishes. If a finished torrent that isn't running gets a file back, it waits as stopped until you resume it, so nothing downloads unseen.
38c2835e2c5124e2.text: <g1>文件</g1> — 每个文件、其大小以及完成的进度。未勾选的文件显示<g2>已跳过</g2>。勾选或取消勾选文件的框以更改下载内容，即使种子正在运行。至少有一个文件保持勾选状态。如果您取消勾选所有仍缺失的文件，则种子完成。如果一个已完成但未运行的种子重新获得一个文件，它会保持停止状态，直到您恢复它，这样就不会在不知情的情况下下载任何内容。

38c6cf4c985550ff.source: Tasks → Download video from a page...
38c6cf4c985550ff.text: 任务 → 从页面下载视频...

38db876264011df2.source: DDM then downloads its files from the service over HTTP, as any download, into the <g1>Torrents</g1> folder. A torrent of several files gets a folder of its own there.
38db876264011df2.text: 然后，DDM 会通过 HTTP 从服务下载种子文件，并将其保存到<g1>种子</g1>文件夹中。包含多个文件的种子会在该文件夹中单独存放在一个子文件夹内。

3900fb0b6d466cf6.source: Where IDM is ahead, the line says so.
3900fb0b6d466cf6.text: IDM 领先的地方，会在该行注明。

39029dbbc20ae107.source: <g1><g2>Crash reports</g2></g1> — what the crash report window shows when DDM closes unexpectedly or stops responding, what a report contains, and how to send it.
39029dbbc20ae107.text: <g1><g2>崩溃报告</g2></g1> — DDM 意外关闭或停止响应时，崩溃报告窗口会显示什么、报告包含哪些内容，以及如何发送报告。

390c182359b77e73.source: <g1>At once from the page.</g1> On YouTube the player itself lists the video's formats, and on other sites the HLS or DASH stream the player loaded lists its qualities. The menu shows them straight away, the way DDM will list them: each resolution with its size, then the sound. A thin line moving along the menu's top edge means DDM is still checking. When DDM's own look-up comes, its list takes the place of the page's, row for row: sizes are corrected and any quality the page didn't name is added, while the row under the pointer stays where it is. The page's sizes are written as estimates (<g2>~128.4 MB</g2>) until then; DDM's are those of the very formats it will download (on YouTube, its AV1 or VP9 picture and its Opus sound, not the largest file of each height), with <g3>~</g3> only where the site gives no exact size (a stream sized from its bitrate, a conversion to MP3, Opus or FLAC). If the page says nothing DDM can use (a live stream, a protected video, a site that names no qualities), the menu says <g4>Looking up the qualities...</g4> and shows DDM's list when it comes, as before.
390c182359b77e73.text: <g1>直接来自页面。</g1>在 YouTube 上，播放器自己会列出视频的格式；在其他网站上，播放器加载的 HLS 或 DASH 流会列出它的画质。菜单立即显示它们，与 DDM 将要列出的方式一样：每种分辨率带有它的大小，然后是声音。菜单顶部边缘有一条细线在移动，表示 DDM 仍在检查。DDM 自己的查找结果出来后，它的列表会逐行取代页面的列表：大小会被修正，页面没有列出的画质会被补上，而指针下的那一行保持原位。在此之前，页面给出的大小写成估计值（<g2>~128.4 MB</g2>）；DDM 给出的则是它将要下载的那些格式的大小（在 YouTube 上是它的 AV1 或 VP9 画面和 Opus 声音，而不是每种高度中最大的文件），只有网站没有给出确切大小时才带有<g3>~</g3>（按比特率估算大小的流，或转换成 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC）。如果页面没有给出 DDM 能用的任何内容（直播流、受保护的视频、没有列出画质的网站），菜单会显示<g4>正在查找画质...</g4>，并在 DDM 的列表出来时显示它，与以前一样。

391a6b0e422e6b00.source: Through your VPN, or not at all.
391a6b0e422e6b00.text: 通过您的 VPN，否则不下载。

392a4c3d29401ba8.source: To see it again, right-click the tray icon and choose it under <g1>Downloads in progress</g1>, which lists every running download. Double-clicking the download in the list brings its window back too.
392a4c3d29401ba8.text: 要再次查看，请右键点击托盘图标，然后在<g1>正在进行的下载</g1>下选择它，其中列出了所有正在运行的下载。双击列表中的下载也会将其窗口带回。

39495ae504c37d96.source: The tick or dot on the checked accent
39495ae504c37d96.text: 选中强调色上的勾或点

3963daf96fa144e5.source: <g1>Choose columns:</g1> right-click any column title and tick the ones you want, or choose <g2>Columns...</g2> for a window with every column, <g3>Move up</g3>, <g4>Move down</g4> and <g5>Reset</g5> (also <g6>View → Choose columns...</g6>). The others keep their widths and close up; File Name always shows.
3963daf96fa144e5.text: <g1>选择列：</g1>右键单击任意列标题并勾选所需的列，或选择<g2>列...</g2>打开包含所有列的窗口，其中有<g3>上移</g3>、<g4>下移</g4>和<g5>重置</g5>（也可使用<g6>视图 → 选择列...</g6>）。其他列保持其宽度并向中间靠拢；文件名列始终显示。

3985471191b1778f.text: <g1>macOS Apple Silicon</g1><g2>.dmg · 适用于 M1 及更高版本 · 实验性</g2>

39aff8ad52210f97.text: Dannex Download Manager 是一款通用工具。本页面简要说明了它的用途。

39d844d210bbac8c.text: AppImage · 适用于任何发行版，x86-64

39e1cb161bac67b9.source: Start a finished gallery again with <g1>Resume</g1> and DDM fetches only the pictures that aren't in its folder yet. The ones you already have are skipped, so following an artist or an album costs nothing but the new pictures.
39e1cb161bac67b9.text: 使用<g1>恢复</g1>再次启动已完成的图库下载，DDM 将只获取其文件夹中尚未存在的图片。您已有的图片将被跳过，因此关注某个艺术家或相册只需下载新图片，无需额外费用。

39f0061bac128459.source: <g1>Options → Archives</g1> says whether 7-Zip was found. Without it, a 7z or RAR archive isn't extracted, and the <g2>7-Zip needed</g2> window says so, with a <g3>Get 7-Zip</g3> button.
39f0061bac128459.text: <g1>选项 → 存档</g1> 会显示是否找到了 7-Zip。如果没有找到，7z 或 RAR 存档将不会被解压，并且 <g2>需要 7-Zip</g2> 窗口会提示，并带有一个<g3>获取 7-Zip</g3> 按钮。

3a14e0e8b14737d7.text: 选择<g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 开启</g1>。

3a2c1373b01431e8.source: <g1>Each theme's own choices</g1> (<x2/>). The settings keep, by theme id, the accent colour and the toolbar's icons chosen for it, taken back when it is picked again. The accent is laid over the theme as it is made active (<x3/>, so a pywal or Native theme followed again keeps it): every role of the accent's hue family (OKLCh, within about 34°) takes the new hue and colourfulness, strong ones its lightness too; semantic roles (errors, warnings, success) stay; the accent, links and text on accent fills are then kept readable (<x4/>). View → Font → Compact / Comfortable rows (<x5/>) add room to the download list's and Link grabber's rows.
3a2c1373b01431e8.text: <g1>每个主题自己的选择</g1>（<x2/>）。设置按主题 ID 保存为它所选的强调色和工具栏图标，再次选用该主题时恢复。强调色在主题被激活时叠加到主题上（<x3/>，所以再次跟随的 pywal 或原生主题仍保留它）：与强调色同一色相族（OKLCh，约 34° 以内）的每个角色都采用新的色相和鲜艳度，较强的角色连明度也采用；语义角色（错误、警告、成功）保持不变；随后强调色、链接以及强调色填充上的文字会被调整到保持可读（<x4/>）。视图 → 字体 → 紧凑 / 舒适的行（<x5/>）为下载列表和链接抓取器的行增加空间。

3a3e576a5758de0d.source: When the browser keeps a download, the extension's status page (right-click its toolbar button → <g1>Help</g1>) says which of these left it there, with the file's name, and DDM's log has a line for each one (<x2/> in <g3>DDM's data folder</g3>).
3a3e576a5758de0d.text: 当浏览器保留某个下载时，扩展的状态页（右键单击其工具栏按钮 → <g1>帮助</g1>）会说明是上述哪一项让它留在那里，并附上文件名，而 DDM 的日志中每项都有一行记录（位于<g3>DDM 的数据文件夹</g3>中的 <x2/>）。

3a4df5add1831960.source: When every segment is done, the part file is checked against the expected size and renamed into place; the file's date can follow the server's.
3a4df5add1831960.text: 当所有分段完成后，部分文件会根据预期大小进行检查并重命名到位；文件的日期可以跟随服务器的日期。

3a4e70f36d8c2ab6.source: Rules look only at articles that are new since the feed was last fetched, and a feed's first fetch only lists what is there. Adding a feed or a rule never downloads its whole history. <g1>Matches ... articles now</g1> shows which articles the rule would take, so you can check it and download those by hand.
3a4e70f36d8c2ab6.text: 规则只查看自上次获取订阅源以来新增的文章，并且订阅源的首次获取只列出已有的内容。添加订阅源或规则绝不会下载其全部历史记录。<g1>当前匹配...篇文章</g1>显示规则将获取哪些文章，因此您可以检查它并手动下载这些文章。

3a67923adc7f1f4d.source: Find file: a name to look for, with where to look
3a67923adc7f1f4d.text: 查找文件：要查找的名称，以及查找位置

3a89223ba0beb8b5.text: 崩溃报告 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

3aa4e1f7d67e8111.source: The question before removing downloads — tick <g1>Options → General → Confirm before deleting downloads</g1>. While it is off, <g2>Remove</g2> does what you last answered: with or without the files.
3aa4e1f7d67e8111.text: 移除下载前的提问 — 勾选<g1>选项 → 常规 → 删除下载前确认</g1>。当它关闭时，<g2>删除</g2>会按您上次的回答执行：连同文件或不连同文件。

3aa9cd577459669e.source: A free IDM alternative that feels familiar
3aa9cd577459669e.text: 一款感觉熟悉的免费 IDM 替代品

3ab9cf2572517ea7.source: Not sure yet? Show it in an <g1>issue</g1> first. <g2>CONTRIBUTING.md</g2> explains how pull requests work here.
3ab9cf2572517ea7.text: 还没有把握？请先在 <g1>issue</g1> 中展示。<g2>CONTRIBUTING.md</g2> 说明了这里的拉取请求如何运作。

3aca386992ad550b.source: Move between the download list and the Categories tree
3aca386992ad550b.text: 在下载列表和“类别”树之间移动

3acc7a2e246ab6e3.source: Check four things: the extension is installed and turned on; <g1>Options → General → Take downloads from web browsers</g1> is on and your browser is ticked; the file's type is in <g2>Options → File types</g2>; and the site isn't in the list of sites DDM leaves alone. Right-click a link and choose <g3>Download with DDM</g3> to send any file whatever its type. More in <g4>Troubleshooting</g4>.
3acc7a2e246ab6e3.text: 请检查四件事：扩展已安装并已开启；<g1>选项 → 常规 → 接管浏览器的下载</g1>已开启，且已勾选您的浏览器；该文件的类型在<g2>选项 → 文件类型</g2>中；该站点不在 DDM 忽略的站点列表中。右键单击链接并选择<g3>使用 DDM 下载</g3>，可发送任何文件，无论其类型。更多内容请见<g4>故障排除</g4>。

3ae62309609ddf49.source: The desktop app (<x1/>, egui): list, categories, queues, scheduler, dialogs, tray, settings
3ae62309609ddf49.text: 桌面应用（<x1/>，egui）：列表、类别、队列、调度器、对话框、托盘、设置

3ae6cb6575c23b95.source: <g1>Show the Download complete window</g1> — show <g2>Download complete</g2> when a file finishes. A download's progress window has the same box for that file alone (<g3>When done</g3>): ticked or unticked there, it counts for that file whatever this one says. <g4>Don't show this again</g4> in <g5>Download complete</g5> unticks this one. Tick it here to have the box back.
3ae6cb6575c23b95.text: <g1>显示“下载完成”窗口</g1> — 文件完成时显示<g2>下载完成</g2>。下载的进度窗口中有仅针对该文件的同名复选框（<g3>完成后</g3>）：无论在那里勾选与否，都以它为准，不管此处如何设置。<g5>下载完成</g5>中的<g4>不再显示此消息</g4>会取消勾选此项。在此处勾选可恢复该提示框。

3aeb6a6267d41e6e.source: A checksum is a short code worked out from a file's contents, published so you can tell that the copy you downloaded is the right one. Right-click a download in the list, choose <g1>Verify checksum...</g1> and paste the code from the site. DDM answers <g2>The file matches</g2> or <g3>The file does NOT match</g3>. Nothing to install, and no command to type.
3aeb6a6267d41e6e.text: 校验和是根据文件内容计算出的一段简短代码，发布它的目的是让您能够判断下载的文件是否正确。在下载列表中右键点击一个下载任务，选择<g1>验证校验和...</g1>，然后粘贴网站上的代码。DDM 会回答<g2>文件匹配</g2>或<g3>文件不匹配</g3>。无需安装任何东西，也无需输入命令。

3aff68cc63b2823a.source: <g1>Must contain</g1>: words the title must hold, all of them, in any order. <x2/> takes either, and <x3/> and <x4/> are wildcards.
3aff68cc63b2823a.text: <g1>必须包含</g1>：标题中必须包含的词语，所有词语，顺序不限。<x2/>表示两者之一，<x3/>和<x4/>是通配符。

3b0230cdd699218a.source: Allow <x1/> (in DDM's folder) in your antivirus or anti-malware program.
3b0230cdd699218a.text: 在杀毒软件或反恶意软件程序中允许 <x1/>（位于 DDM 文件夹中）。

3b16e77cc07e2e0a.text: DDM 自己的外观和默认设置：IDM 用户熟悉的布局，带有 Windows 11 的控件。

3c0c31138b27d1b4.source: A torrent stopped by one of these says so in its event log, and isn't shared again when DDM starts. Raise or turn off the limit to share it again. - <g1>Limit uploading for all torrents to</g1> — off by default. Caps what all your torrents together send to other peers, while they download and while they share. A torrent's own upload limit, in its progress window, applies on top of it. - <g2>Open magnet links and .torrent files with Dannex Download Manager</g2> — Windows then opens magnet links in your browser and <x3/> files in Explorer with DDM. This is for your Windows account only; a program you chose in Windows' <g4>Open with</g4> stays first. The setup can turn it on for you.
3c0c31138b27d1b4.text: 因上述任一原因停止共享的种子会在事件日志中注明，且 DDM 下次启动时不会再次共享。提高或关闭限制即可再次共享。 - <g1>将所有 torrent 的上传限制为</g1> — 默认关闭。限制所有 torrent 在下载和共享期间向其他节点上传的总速度。种子进度窗口中设置的单个种子上传限速也会生效。 - <g2>使用 Dannex Download Manager 打开磁力链接和 .torrent 文件</g2> — 设置后，Windows 会使用 DDM 在浏览器中打开磁力链接，并在资源管理器中打开 <x3/> 文件。此设置仅适用于您的 Windows 账户；您在 Windows 的<g4>打开方式</g4>中选择的程序仍优先使用。安装程序可以为您启用此功能。

3c6ad623b5f5dc77.source: DDM starts its torrent engine the first time a torrent needs it. With <g1>Stop the torrent engine when no torrent is running</g1> on (the default), it stops again a minute after no torrent is running or sharing. While it runs, other peers can connect to DDM, and DDM asks your router to forward its port (UPnP). Windows may ask whether to allow DDM through the firewall: allow it on private networks only.
3c6ad623b5f5dc77.text: 种子首次需要种子引擎时，DDM 会启动它。默认情况下，<g1>没有种子运行时停止种子引擎</g1>处于开启状态；没有种子运行或共享 1 分钟后，种子引擎就会停止。种子引擎运行时，其他对等方可以连接到 DDM，DDM 也会要求路由器转发其端口 (UPnP)。Windows 可能会询问是否允许 DDM 通过防火墙：仅允许其在专用网络上通过。

3c6b487078dbdaaa.source: <g1><x2/></g1> — single colour roles (such as <x3/>, <x4/> or <x5/>) on both sides; <g6><x7/></g6> and <g8><x9/></g8> on one side only. A colour is <x10/>, or <x11/> with transparency. The roles a file sets win over its seeds.
3c6b487078dbdaaa.text: <g1><x2/></g1> — 两侧的单一颜色角色（例如<x3/>、<x4/>或<x5/>）；<g6><x7/></g6>和<g8><x9/></g8>仅在一侧。颜色是<x10/>，或带有透明度的<x11/>。文件设置的角色优先于其种子。

A package can't remove those: it never touches home folders. Without DDM they lead nowhere, so the extension says it can't reach DDM. To remove them as well, run this as each user who used DDM, <g2>before</g2> uninstalling:
3dcd0da451b1205b.text: DDM 在您的主文件夹中保留的内容会像任何软件包一样保留：您的列表和设置（<x1/>）、AppImage 和 tar.gz 的浏览器文件，以及那些只从此处读取它们的浏览器（Opera、Helium、Thorium 和 Firefox 的分支：Zen、LibreWolf、Floorp、Waterfox）。软件包无法移除这些文件：它从不触及主文件夹。没有 DDM，它们将无处可去，因此扩展会显示无法连接 DDM。要一并移除它们，请在卸载<g2>之前</g2>，以每个使用过 DDM 的用户身份运行以下命令：

3de66564d88116c7.source: How fast Dannex Download Manager is, by the clock: against IDM 6.42 (5.4× faster on 1 GiB, 106× on small files) and the new engine against the version before it. Every run, the raw data and the method.
3de66564d88116c7.text: Dannex Download Manager 到底有多快，用秒表说话：对比 IDM 6.42（1 GiB 文件快 5.4 倍，小文件快 106 倍），以及新引擎对比它之前的版本。每一次运行、原始数据和测试方法都在这里。

3dfd74b1990e5a43.source: The torrent engine is written in Rust, and every piece is checked against the torrent's fingerprint, so a peer can't slip in altered data.

3fb5d477ceacf22f.text: DDM 的支持是根据每个服务的公开文档构建的，尚未通过真实的付费账户确认。如果您的账户出现问题，请在 GitHub 上提交问题，切勿在其中粘贴您的令牌或密钥。

3fd2d9b9a2e2d4f7.source: Queue big files during the day and let DDM download them at night, when nobody needs the connection. It can turn the computer off when it is done.
3fd2d9b9a2e2d4f7.text: 白天将大文件加入队列，让 DDM 在晚上（没人需要网络连接时）下载。完成后，它还可以关闭计算机。

3fffdf3df5ac8800.source: To stop in the morning whatever is left, tick <g1>Stop at</g1> and set a time, for example 7:00:00 AM.
3fffdf3df5ac8800.text: 若要在早晨停止所有剩余的下载，请勾选<g1>停止于</g1>并设置时间，例如早上 7:00:00。

402fd2cf6aa900d5.source: An editable drop-down's arrow zone pressed or open
402fd2cf6aa900d5.text: 可编辑下拉框箭头区域被按下或打开时

4043f232dfbdf98e.source: DDM checks the account and shows its name and whether it is premium. <g1>OK</g1> keeps it.
4043f232dfbdf98e.text: DDM 会检查帐户，并显示帐户名称及是否为高级帐户。点击<g1>确定</g1>即可保存。

40633c27b9a902b5.source: The main window in Arabic: the menus, toolbar and categories run from right to left.
40633c27b9a902b5.text: 阿拉伯语主窗口：菜单、工具栏和类别均从右到左排列。

406376ea6db241ce.source: Did you click <g1>Apply</g1> after setting the time?
406376ea6db241ce.text: 设置时间后，是否点击了<g1>应用</g1>？

4065d823f7a0f8c0.source: Every download and the total speed: <x1/>. <x2/> is <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/> or <x7/>; <x8/> is <x9/> while unknown; <x10/> (why it failed) is there only for a download in <x11/>; <x12/> is a category's <x13/>; <x14/> is the free space where downloads go (<x15/> when unknown). Only while the API is on.
4065d823f7a0f8c0.text: 每个下载和总速度：<x1/>。<x2/> 是 <x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>、<x6/> 或 <x7/>；<x8/> 在未知时是 <x9/>；<x10/>（失败原因）仅在下载处于 <x11/> 状态时存在；<x12/> 是类别的 <x13/>；<x14/> 是下载存储的可用空间（未知时为 <x15/>）。仅在 API 开启时可用。

406b2e903a2cd3fd.source: <g1>The last download couldn't go to Dannex Download Manager</g1>, and <g2>Try again</g2>
406b2e903a2cd3fd.text: <g1>上次的下载无法发送到 Dannex Download Manager</g1>，以及<g2>重试</g2>

4071345a6d246c9b.source: As links arrive, DDM asks each server about its file, as IDM's <g1>Download all links</g1> does: sixteen links at a time, and at most six from any one site, so a page of thousands is looked up quickly without flooding a server. <g2>Looking up sizes: 120 of 340</g2> under the list shows how far it has got. Each link then shows its real name and size, and a status:
4071345a6d246c9b.text: 链接到来时，DDM 会像 IDM 的<g1>下载所有链接</g1>那样，向每个服务器询问它的文件：每次十六个链接，同一站点最多六个，所以有数千个链接的页面也能很快查完，而不会冲击服务器。列表下方的<g2>正在查询大小：120 / 340</g2>显示进度。之后每个链接会显示它的真实名称和大小，以及一个状态：

4087eca64b1e9c7f.text: 更多内容请参阅<g1>连接和速度</g1>。

40a1f31ae2a6c453.source: Crash and freeze reports you read before you send — Dannex Download Manager
40a1f31ae2a6c453.text: 发送前可阅读的崩溃和冻结报告 — Dannex Download Manager

40a26ac3ae7dcbbc.source: If the link has expired (common for links from sites you sign in to, or links with a time limit in them), get a new one: right-click → <g1>Refresh download address</g1>. See <g2>Resume a broken download</g2>.
40a26ac3ae7dcbbc.text: 如果链接已过期（登录后才能访问的网站链接或带有时限的链接常会过期），请获取新链接：右键点击 → <g1>刷新下载地址</g1>。另请参阅<g2>恢复中断的下载</g2>。

40ae9f6f34dade5c.text: 选择<g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 设置...</g1>。

40b300c66a605f82.source: In the Scheduler's time and date boxes, <g1>Up</g1> / <g2>Down</g2> and the number keys change the selected part, and <g3>Left</g3> / <g4>Right</g4> move between parts. In the calendar, the arrows move a day or a week, <g5>Page Up</g5> / <g6>Page Down</g6> a month, and <g7>Enter</g7> picks the day.
40b300c66a605f82.text: 在计划程序的日期和时间框中，<g1>向上</g1> / <g2>向下</g2>键和数字键可更改选定部分，<g3>向左</g3> / <g4>向右</g4>键可在各部分之间移动。在日历中，箭头键可移动一天或一周，<g5>Page Up</g5> / <g6>Page Down</g6>键可移动一个月，<g7>Enter</g7>键可选择日期。

40b46adc61bd2f95.source: Tick Also delete the file from disk only if you want the file gone too.
40b46adc61bd2f95.text: 仅当您也想删除文件时，才勾选同时从磁盘中删除文件。

40b67e7837545823.source: Download a gallery's pictures (a Wikimedia Commons category, a Flickr album, ...) into a folder named after it inside <x1/>: gallery-dl lists them, DDM's downloader brings them in, <x2/> at once (8 by default, as <x3/>'s connections); <x4/> takes at most that many, the first the site lists. Started again, it fetches only the new ones. <x5/> sends its connections, and gallery-dl's, through one network adapter, as for <x6/>.
40b67e7837545823.text: 把图库的图片（Wikimedia Commons 分类、Flickr 相册等）下载到 <x1/> 内以图库命名的文件夹中：gallery-dl 列出它们，DDM 的下载器把它们取回，同时下载 <x2/>（默认 8，与 <x3/> 的连接数相同）；<x4/> 最多取这么多，即站点列出的前几个。再次启动时，只获取新增的图片。<x5/> 通过同一个网络适配器发送它的连接和 gallery-dl 的连接，与 <x6/> 相同。

40c721d28a572fcf.source: The bar at the top shows the total speed and the free space where your downloads go.
40c721d28a572fcf.text: 顶部栏显示总速度和下载目标位置的可用空间。

40cf609cd66a0051.source: On Windows, DDM must be installed with the setup, with <g1>Set up browser integration (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> ticked. It is ticked by default. If you're not sure, run the setup again. A portable copy can't do this. On Linux and macOS, start DDM once: it sets browser integration up itself.
40cf609cd66a0051.text: 在 Windows 上，DDM 必须通过安装程序安装，并勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Firefox）</g1>。此选项默认勾选。如果您不确定，请再次运行安装程序。便携版无法执行此操作。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，启动 DDM 一次即可：它会自动设置浏览器集成。

40d582d636a59fc5.source: <g1>Start Dannex Download Manager with the computer</g1> in <g2>Options → General</g2> is greyed: starting with Windows needs the registry.
40d582d636a59fc5.text: <g2>选项 → 常规</g2>中的<g1>随计算机启动 Dannex Download Manager</g1>显示为灰色：随 Windows 启动需要注册表。

40dc8191b16ed145.source: Eight per download by default, and up to 32 if you choose in Options → Connection, or 128 after ticking Allow more than 32 connections there. DDM uses fewer…
40dc8191b16ed145.text: 默认情况下，每个下载使用八个连接。如果您在选项 → 连接中选择，最多可达32个；勾选允许超过32个连接后，可达128个。当服务器允许的连接数较少时，DDM会使用较少的连接…

40fe836f1ec8f4d4.source: Eight per download by default, and up to 32 if you choose in Options → Connection, or 128 after ticking Allow more than 32 connections there. DDM uses fewer when a server allows fewer, and only one when a server can't send parts of a file at all.
40fe836f1ec8f4d4.text: 默认情况下，每个下载使用八个连接。如果您在选项 → 连接中选择，最多可达32个；勾选允许超过32个连接后，可达128个。当服务器允许的连接数较少时，DDM会使用较少的连接；当服务器完全无法发送文件分段时，DDM只使用一个连接。

412118ea0605f457.source: Many sites publish a checksum next to the download. Right-click the download, choose <g1>Verify checksum...</g1> and paste it. DDM reads MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and CRC32. A finished file is checked at once; an unfinished one is checked when its download ends. DDM then says <g2>The file matches</g2> or <g3>The file does NOT match</g3>.
412118ea0605f457.text: 许多网站会在下载链接旁提供校验和。右键单击下载，选择<g1>验证校验和...</g1>，然后粘贴校验和。DDM 支持 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 和 CRC32。已完成的文件会立即进行校验；未完成的文件会在下载结束后进行校验。随后，DDM 会显示<g2>文件匹配</g2>或<g3>文件不匹配</g3>。

412f3b0d34ccb320.source: Choose <g1>Tasks → Add batch download</g1> and write the address with one asterisk where the files differ: <x2/>. Under <g3>Fill the * with</g3>, choose <g4>Numbers</g4> or <g5>Letters</g5>, then <g6>From</g6> and <g7>To</g7>. For numbers, <g8>Digits</g8> sets the number of digits: with 3, the files are <x9/>, <x10/> and so on.
412f3b0d34ccb320.text: 选择<g1>任务 → 添加批量下载</g1>，并在文件不同的位置写一个星号：<x2/>。在<g3>* 替换为</g3>下，选择<g4>数字</g4>或<g5>字母</g5>，然后设置<g6>从</g6>和<g7>到</g7>。对于数字，<g8>位数</g8>用于设置数字的位数：设为 3 时，文件为 <x9/>、<x10/>，依此类推。

41333ec069d15e15.source: A magnet link takes a long time
41333ec069d15e15.text: 磁力链接需要很长时间

415f7ef389135eab.source: In Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur the whole window is mirrored, the way Windows does it for these languages. File names, addresses and folder paths keep their own direction inside translated sentences, so they stay readable. DDM uses the system's own fonts for every script.
415f7ef389135eab.text: 在阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语中，整个窗口会像 Windows 对这些语言的处理方式一样进行镜像显示。文件名、地址和文件夹路径在翻译后的句子中会保持其自身方向，以确保可读性。DDM 为每种文字都使用系统自带的字体。

4160d55635d3e362.source: Freeze reports that tell the kind of freeze
4160d55635d3e362.text: 显示冻结类型的冻结报告

4171c591cc5de164.source: A menu's and a popup's frame
4171c591cc5de164.text: 菜单和弹出窗口的边框

418a57e1f6e0ae58.source: Yes: ftp://, and FTP over TLS both ways (ftpes:// and ftps://), with several connections at once, resume, and logins from the address or from Sites Logins.…
418a57e1f6e0ae58.text: 是：ftp://，以及双向的 FTP over TLS（ftpes:// 和 ftps://），支持同时进行多个连接、续传，并可从地址或“站点登录”中获取登录信息。

41afeb3d132bc8d0.source: <g1>Density</g1>: <g2>Compact</g2> rows (the theme's own) or <g3>Comfortable</g3> ones, taller with more air around their text, in the download list and Link grabber. Also in <g4>View → Font</g4>.
41afeb3d132bc8d0.text: <g1>密度</g1>：<g2>紧凑</g2>的行（主题自己的）或<g3>舒适</g3>的行（更高，文字周围留白更多），应用于下载列表和链接抓取器。也可在<g4>视图 → 字体</g4>中设置。

41b21e6f6cf70f57.source: <g1>Drag on blank space</g1> to draw a box around downloads.

41d58fdb5c4f98df.source: A row with a <x1/> line above it was translated by machine. When you have checked it (and corrected it if needed), delete that <x2/> line. From then on the row is yours: machine translation never replaces it, and a check on every pull request makes sure no change drops it or marks it machine again.
41d58fdb5c4f98df.text: 上方有 <x1/> 线的行是由机器翻译的。当您检查并（如果需要）更正后，请删除该 <x2/> 线。从那时起，该行就属于您了：机器翻译绝不会替换它，并且每次拉取请求都会进行检查，以确保不会有任何更改将其删除或再次标记为机器翻译。

41e44a8bcf27e42b.source: In IDM, export your list as an <x1/> file (its <g2>Tasks → Export</g2> menu). In DDM, choose <g3>Tasks → Import → From an IDM list (.ef2)</g3> and pick that file. Each download comes over with its address, the page it came from (its referrer) and its cookies. The downloads join the <g4>Main download queue</g4>, ready to start.
41e44a8bcf27e42b.text: 在 IDM 中，将列表导出为 <x1/> 文件（其<g2>任务 → 导出</g2>菜单）。在 DDM 中，选择<g3>任务 → 导入 → 从 IDM 列表 (.ef2)</g3>并选取该文件。每个下载都会连同其地址、来源页面（即引用页）和 Cookie 一起导入。这些下载会加入<g4>主下载队列</g4>，随时可以开始。

41ea9434ca6c6552.source: Median startup (command to first request), transfer and finish of each program, per test.
41ea9434ca6c6552.text: 每个程序的启动（从命令到第一个请求）、传输和完成的中位时间，按测试列出。

41eaa021513bb2bc.source: One cap for all of DDM

420ddd33b4ea0c12.source: The extension is newer than DDM
420ddd33b4ea0c12.text: 扩展程序版本比 DDM 新

420fd4269607a080.source: Pick a quality, then Download Now.
420fd4269607a080.text: 选择画质，然后点击“立即下载”。

423221c9c3857d3c.text: 语言 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

424085db320c36a7.source: If Direct3D, Vulkan or Metal can't start on your computer (no driver for it, some virtual machines), or its first window doesn't show within 10 seconds of its own (the time DDM spends loading your list and its icons doesn't count, however slow the computer is just after it starts), DDM draws with OpenGL, and <g1>View → Draw with</g1> says so and why. Choosing it again tries it again at the next start.
424085db320c36a7.text: 如果您的电脑无法启动 Direct3D、Vulkan 或 Metal（缺少驱动程序，或在某些虚拟机中），或者 DDM 启动后 10 秒内（不计入 DDM 加载列表和图标的时间，即使电脑启动后运行缓慢）其首个窗口没有显示，DDM 将使用 OpenGL 绘制，并且<g1>视图 → 绘制方式</g1>会显示此信息及原因。再次选择它会在下次启动时再次尝试。

425dd08233bf3ff3.source: On Linux and macOS, DDM finds yt-dlp, ffmpeg and gallery-dl on your <x1/> and in the usual package-manager folders, including Homebrew's. A program you selected yourself takes priority, followed by DDM's own installed copy. The system copy is used when neither is present, and your package manager keeps it up to date: DDM never downloads over it on its own. If your distribution's yt-dlp is old, <g2>Use DDM's own copy</g2> in Helpers downloads DDM's, which keeps itself current and is used from then on.
425dd08233bf3ff3.text: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 会在您的 <x1/> 以及包括 Homebrew 在内的常用包管理器文件夹中查找 yt-dlp、ffmpeg 和 gallery-dl。您自己选择的程序优先，其次是 DDM 自己安装的副本。当两者都不存在时，将使用系统副本，并且您的包管理器会使其保持最新：DDM 绝不会自行覆盖它。如果您的发行版中的 yt-dlp 过旧，请在“帮助程序”中勾选<g2>使用 DDM 自带的副本</g2>，DDM 将下载并使用自己的副本，该副本会自行保持最新。

427026ed4d9e0ca8.source: Links the download list has already go into <g1>Already in the list</g1>.
427026ed4d9e0ca8.text: 下载列表中已有的链接会进入<g1>已在列表中</g1>。

427cc05e98da7048.source: <g1>Extract when done</g1>: ticked by itself when the package holds an archive.
427cc05e98da7048.text: <g1>完成后提取</g1>：分组中包含存档时，此项会自动勾选。

429af5aabcba70df.source: 50 MiB, server allows 2 connections, 2 MB/s each
429af5aabcba70df.text: 50 MiB，服务器允许 2 个连接，每个 2 MB/秒

42b14e12bdf12e29.source: <g1>DDM asks to create a folder:</g1> the folder doesn't exist yet. Click <g2>Yes</g2>.
42b14e12bdf12e29.text: <g1>DDM 要求创建文件夹：</g1>该文件夹尚不存在。点击<g2>是</g2>。

42c7eeed9c7e6c6b.source: It stores its own settings (paused or not, DDM's file types and excluded sites, its connection status, the name and site of the last download it left to the browser so its status page can say why, where you dragged the video button on each of the last 200 sites; nothing from private windows) in the browser's extension storage, on your computer.
42c7eeed9c7e6c6b.text: 它会将自己的设置（是否暂停、DDM 的文件类型和排除的站点、其连接状态、它留给浏览器的上一个下载的名称和站点，以便其状态页说明原因、您在最近 200 个站点中每个站点上拖动视频按钮的位置；不包含来自隐私窗口的任何内容）存储在您计算机上浏览器的扩展存储中。

42c9af850b22a734.source: The other way works too: <g1>Tasks → Export → As a text file</g1> writes one address per line, and <g2>As an IDM list (.ef2)</g2> writes an <x3/> list.
42c9af850b22a734.text: 反过来也行：<g1>任务 → 导出 → 文本文件</g1>每行写入一个地址，<g2>IDM 列表 (.ef2)</g2>则写入 <x3/> 列表。

42d22490266e1c29.source: The pictures go into a folder of their own, named after the gallery. Want only a few? Type a number in <g1>Files at most</g1> to take the first ones the site lists, on most sites the newest.
42d22490266e1c29.text: 图片将保存到以图库命名的独立文件夹中。如果只想下载部分图片，可在<g1>最多文件数</g1>中输入数字，以下载网站列出的前几张图片（在大多数网站上为最新图片）。

42fcdc57b1d01537.source: A code works once, for ten minutes, and not after five wrong tries: click <g1>New code</g1> for another. To keep the page one tap away, add it to the phone's home screen (the browser's menu: <g2>Add to Home screen</g2>).
42fcdc57b1d01537.text: 一个代码只能使用一次，有效期十分钟，并且在五次错误尝试后失效：点击<g1>新代码</g1>获取另一个。要让页面触手可及，请将其添加到手机主屏幕（浏览器菜单：<g2>添加到主屏幕</g2>）。

42fd429771459bdb.source: A playlist: every video ticked, one quality for all.
42fd429771459bdb.text: 播放列表：所有视频均已勾选，画质统一。

4322a9c35e172e53.source: Its title and glyphs while the window isn't the active one, and a greyed button's
4322a9c35e172e53.text: 窗口非活动时，其标题和字形，以及置灰按钮的标题和字形

432cbb1ffee89925.source: <g1>Your downloads are yours to answer for.</g1> Respect copyright and the terms of the sites you download from. With torrents, remember that a torrent client also shares what it downloads.
432cbb1ffee89925.text: <g1>您的下载由您负责。</g1> 请尊重版权和您下载网站的条款。对于种子文件，请记住种子客户端也会分享它下载的内容。

434c8bef47698656.source: Download a file — Dannex Download Manager help
434c8bef47698656.text: 下载文件 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

436bac2c4f3d3f4c.source: <g1>Downloads → Start queue</g1> and <g2>Downloads → Stop queue</g2> list them too.
436bac2c4f3d3f4c.text: <g1>下载 → 启动队列</g1>和<g2>下载 → 停止队列</g2>也会列出所有队列。

438125f38e23c858.source: The Download File Info window: the file starts while you choose where it goes.
438125f38e23c858.text: “下载文件信息”窗口：您选择保存位置时，文件已经开始下载。

4383e99ab4106d08.source: One click, about a minute to install. No ads, no sign-up, nothing bundled.
4383e99ab4106d08.text: 点一下，约一分钟装好。没有广告，无需注册，不捆绑任何软件。

43a47efd749a00a7.source: dannex.kavangi.co.ke is a static site. Two companies take part in showing it to you:
43a47efd749a00a7.text: dannex.kavangi.co.ke 是静态网站。有两家公司参与向您展示本站：

43b468d3bb0d57bb.source: Sites Logins: a user name and password per site.
43b468d3bb0d57bb.text: 站点登录：每个站点的用户名和密码。

The extension's options page holds only <g4>Send downloads to Dannex Download Manager</g4> (the same switch as the click) and, under <g5>More</g5>, the two things only the extension can do: <g6>Download through this browser's VPN or proxy</g6> (see below) and <g7>Send downloads to</g7>: this computer, or Dannex Download Manager on another computer. When DDM can't be reached, it says so there, with <g8>See what to do</g8> for the status page.
44726c1758ab10cf.text: Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 会在该菜单中添加自己的<g1>选项</g1>项；在 Firefox 中则是<g2>管理扩展</g2> → <g3>选项</g3>。扩展的选项页只有<g4>将下载发送到 Dannex Download Manager</g4>（与单击相同的开关），以及在<g5>更多</g5>下的两项只有扩展才能做的事：<g6>通过此浏览器的 VPN 或代理下载</g6>（见下文）和<g7>将下载发送到</g7>：此计算机，或另一台计算机上的 Dannex Download Manager。当无法连接 DDM 时，会在那里说明，并提供<g8>查看处理方法</g8>以转到状态页。

44970b9b25afe28d.source: These are the checks CI runs; each works on a clean clone:
44970b9b25afe28d.text: 以下是 CI 执行的检查；每项检查都在干净的克隆版本上运行：

44ad450a0c786f11.source: <g1>Pause between requests</g1> and <g2>Requests at once</g2>: how gently it reads the site. The defaults (half a second, two at once) are polite to small sites. Each page is read once, however many pages link to it.
44ad450a0c786f11.text: <g1>请求间隔</g1>和<g2>同时请求数</g2>：读取站点的温和程度。默认值（半秒，同时两个）对小型站点比较友好。无论有多少页面链接到某个页面，每个页面只读取一次。

44c881667b5a140f.source: The pane on the left has four branches. <g1>All Downloads</g1> holds everything, <g2>Unfinished</g2> what isn't complete yet and <g3>Finished</g3> what is, each by category. <g4>Queues</g4> lists each queue. The top branches show how many downloads they hold, and right-click → <g5>Browse</g5> opens a category's folder.
44c881667b5a140f.text: 左侧窗格有四个分支。<g1>所有下载</g1>包含所有文件，<g2>未完成</g2>显示尚未完成的文件，<g3>已完成</g3>显示已完成的文件，每个都按类别分类。<g4>队列</g4>列出每个下载队列。顶部显示的分支会显示其包含的下载数量，右键点击 → <g5>浏览</g5>可打开类别的文件夹。

44ec437de74fb4b6.source: Get the video tools (yt-dlp, and ffmpeg on Windows) that are missing from DDM's data folder, checked as always, and close: no window, and nothing handed to a running DDM. It prints its progress, one line at a time (<x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>), and ends with exit code 0 once nothing is missing. The setup runs it after copying the files; DDM itself gets missing tools in the background anyway.
44ec437de74fb4b6.text: 获取 DDM 数据文件夹中缺少的视频工具（yt-dlp，Windows 上还有 ffmpeg），照常校验，然后退出：不显示窗口，也不会把任何内容交给正在运行的 DDM。它逐行打印进度（<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/>），在没有任何缺失后以退出码 0 结束。安装程序在复制文件之后运行它；DDM 本身也会在后台获取缺少的工具。

4586afd483f44a6f.source: Don't open it to the internet through your router. To reach it while you're away, use a VPN to your home network, such as WireGuard or Tailscale; with Tailscale, choose its address under <g1>Listen on</g1>. The first time, Windows may ask whether DDM may use the network: allow it on private networks, or the phone can't reach DDM.
4586afd483f44a6f.text: 不要通过路由器将其暴露到互联网。要在您外出时访问它，请使用 VPN 连接到您的家庭网络，例如 WireGuard 或 Tailscale；使用 Tailscale 时，请在<g1>监听</g1>下选择其地址。首次使用时，Windows 可能会询问 DDM 是否可以使用网络：允许它在私有网络上使用，否则手机将无法访问 DDM。

459b25f877a94aab.source: A greyed label in the progress window
459b25f877a94aab.text: 进度窗口中置灰的标签

45c30bcf47cac1d8.source: <g1>The file the page played, first.</g1> When the video's player loaded the video's own file (TikTok's player does, and so does any page playing an MP4 or WebM), the menu lists that file first, as soon as it opens, worded like any other quality (its picture's height, its type and size: <g2>1024p MP4</g2>). Pick it and DDM downloads that very file, as it downloads a link: <g3>Download File Info</g3> opens, then DDM's own downloader brings it in over several connections. It goes with your browser's cookies for the file's server, the page as the referrer and your browser's User-Agent, as the player fetched it, and nothing is looked up, so it works even when the site turns yt-dlp away (TikTok does, to an address that asked it often). It is named after the video's title once DDM's look-up has found it, else after the page. A file the player was fed in pieces is offered only once its first bytes show that it is that player's video: the same length and picture size. In a feed, where two videos of the same length may play side by side, neither is offered then, and the menu waits for DDM's look-up as before.
45c30bcf47cac1d8.text: <g1>页面播放过的文件，排在最前。</g1>当视频的播放器加载了视频自己的文件时（TikTok 的播放器就是如此，任何播放 MP4 或 WebM 的页面也是），菜单一打开就把该文件排在第一位，措辞与其他画质一样（它的画面高度、类型和大小：<g2>1024p MP4</g2>）。选择它，DDM 就下载这个文件本身，就像下载一个链接一样：<g3>下载文件信息</g3>会打开，然后由 DDM 自己的下载器通过多个连接把它取回。它会带上您的浏览器针对该文件的服务器的 Cookie、作为来源页的页面以及您的浏览器的 User-Agent，与播放器获取它时一样，并且不进行任何查找，所以即使网站拒绝 yt-dlp（TikTok 对频繁请求的地址就会这样），它也能用。DDM 的查找找到视频标题后，它就以标题命名，否则以页面命名。播放器被分块喂入的文件，只有当它的最初几个字节表明它就是该播放器的视频（长度和画面尺寸相同）时才会提供。在信息流中，两个长度相同的视频可能并排播放，此时两者都不提供，菜单像以前一样等待 DDM 的查找结果。

45ce55f4ec4843d8.source: <g1>Start now</g1> and <g2>Stop</g2> run or halt the selected queue straight away.
45ce55f4ec4843d8.text: <g1>立即开始</g1>和<g2>停止</g2>会立即启动或停止所选队列。

45e8a3a166043112.source: <g1>Symbols.</g1> Release builds keep line tables (<x2/>), but no download includes the debug info. CI turns it into <x3/> (<x4/>, using Mozilla's <x5/>), published beside the release's other files. The report window fetches the zip for its own version when a stack shows bare addresses.
45e8a3a166043112.text: <g1>符号。</g1> 发布版本保留行号表（<x2/>），但下载文件不包含调试信息。CI 会将其转换为 <x3/>（<x4/>，使用 Mozilla 的 <x5/>），并与发布版本的其他文件一同发布。当堆栈中只有裸地址时，报告窗口会获取对应版本的 zip 文件。

460a4a4a7f6d305e.source: DDM keeps Internet Download Manager's compact sizes. On a large or high-resolution screen, choose <g1>View → Interface size</g1> (110 %, 115 %, 120 %, 125 %, 150 %, 175 % or 200 %), or press <g2>Ctrl +</g2> and <g3>Ctrl −</g3> in any DDM window, as in a browser; <g4>Ctrl 0</g4> goes back to 100 %. Every window follows at once, and DDM starts at that size next time. It comes on top of Windows' own display scale (<g5>Settings → System → Display → Scale</g5>).
460a4a4a7f6d305e.text: DDM 保持了 Internet Download Manager 的紧凑尺寸。在大屏幕或高分辨率屏幕上，选择<g1>视图 → 界面大小</g1>（110%、115%、120%、125%、150%、175% 或 200%），或者在任何 DDM 窗口中按下 <g2>Ctrl +</g2> 和 <g3>Ctrl -</g3>，就像在浏览器中一样；<g4>Ctrl 0</g4> 可恢复到 100%。所有窗口会立即随之调整，DDM 下次启动时也会使用该尺寸。这会叠加在 Windows 自身的显示缩放（<g5>设置 → 系统 → 显示 → 缩放</g5>）之上。

460c28c064c58629.source: To remove it, open the same window and untick <g1>Limit all downloads together to</g1>.
460c28c064c58629.text: 要取消限制，请打开同一窗口并取消勾选<g1>将所有下载总计限制为</g1>。

46128337a14f5fa7.source: <g1>Something is blocking Dannex Download Manager</g1>: security software; or install it again, with the download
46128337a14f5fa7.text: <g1>有程序正在阻止 Dannex Download Manager</g1>：安全软件所致；或重新安装它，并附有下载

461ab20a8f7b69d5.text: 如果需要，可超过 32 个连接

462b4ea88323a117.source: Bug reports, ideas, translation fixes and pull requests are all welcome. Everything happens in the open on <g1>GitHub</g1>.
462b4ea88323a117.text: 欢迎提交错误报告、想法、翻译修正和拉取请求。所有活动都在<g1>GitHub</g1>上公开进行。

463b3165a5cdb89b.source: <g1>When Drive won't give a file.</g1> Drive limits how often a file can be downloaded: after many downloads in a day it answers "too many users have viewed or downloaded this file recently". DDM shows Drive's own words and writes nothing. Try again later (it can take up to a day), or sign in to Google in your browser and download from there, which often gets past the limit. DDM doesn't try to get around it. A file whose owner turned off downloading, or that your account can't open, gets <g2>no access</g2>.
463b3165a5cdb89b.text: <g1>当云端硬盘无法提供文件时。</g1>云端硬盘限制了文件的下载频率：一天内多次下载后，它会回复“最近有太多用户查看或下载此文件”。DDM 会显示云端硬盘自己的提示，不作任何修改。请稍后再试（可能需要一天时间），或者在浏览器中登录 Google 并从那里下载，这通常可以绕过限制。DDM 不会尝试绕过此限制。如果文件的所有者禁用了下载，或者您的帐户无法打开该文件，则会显示<g2>无权访问</g2>。

465d49f53d5a3c17.source: Tick <g1>Only while I'm using the computer</g1> and the cap applies only while you use the mouse or keyboard. After a minute without input, DDM goes back to full speed.
465d49f53d5a3c17.text: 勾选<g1>仅在我使用计算机时</g1>，此限制仅在您使用鼠标或键盘时生效。在一分钟没有输入后，DDM 将恢复全速下载。

466898c9b0e4598e.source: Add a download from your phone, or from another computer at home, and watch it run on the computer where DDM is: paste a link or a magnet link, send a <x1/> file, see the list with its progress, and pause, start or remove downloads. Your phone opens a small page that DDM itself serves; nothing is installed on the phone, and no outside service is involved.
466898c9b0e4598e.text: 从手机或家中另一台电脑添加下载，并在运行 DDM 的电脑上查看其运行情况：粘贴链接或磁力链接，发送 <x1/> 文件，查看包含进度、暂停、开始或删除下载的列表。您的手机会打开 DDM 自身提供的小页面；手机上无需安装任何东西，也不涉及任何外部服务。

46864a8854c68892.text: 文件、视频、音乐和种子，从浏览器接管，通过多个连接同时下载。免费，没有广告，没有试用期，无需注册。

46ac1f2e09bce7b0.source: When something breaks, you see why.
46ac1f2e09bce7b0.text: 问题发生时，您会知道原因。

46d2fe03f43a68d3.source: It stays out of the way: it shows while you point at a video (or the player has the keyboard's focus; <g1>Tab</g1> then moves to the button), fades when the pointer rests, and leaves out small videos and short muted loops (animated pictures, backgrounds). A video that starts playing with at least half of it in view (a feed's video playing by itself, a page's own player) gets it too, half transparent, until you point at it; it goes once that video stops or leaves the view, and the next one playing takes it. The video you point at keeps it. In fullscreen it follows the video when the player allows it. On copy-protected media (DRM) it says <g2>Protected</g2>, and its click says that it can't be saved.
46d2fe03f43a68d3.text: 它不碍事：当您指向视频（或播放器获得键盘焦点；然后按 <g1>Tab</g1> 可移到该按钮）时显示，指针停住时淡出，并略过小视频和短小的静音循环（动图、背景）。至少有一半在视野内就开始播放的视频（信息流中自动播放的视频、页面自己的播放器）也会显示它，半透明，直到您指向它；该视频停止播放或离开视野后它就消失，由下一个正在播放的视频接手。您指向的视频始终保留它。全屏时，只要播放器允许，它会跟随视频。在受版权保护的媒体（DRM）上它显示<g2>受保护</g2>，点击会提示无法保存。

46e38301466c0baa.source: Going the other way is just as easy: <g1>Tasks → Export → As a text file</g1> saves one address per line, and <g2>As an IDM list (.ef2)</g2> writes an <x3/> file.
46e38301466c0baa.text: 反向操作同样简单：<g1>任务 → 导出 → 文本文件</g1>会每行保存一个地址，<g2>IDM 列表 (.ef2)</g2>则写入 <x3/> 文件。

476a78eca0326f04.text: 保留列表、设置、证书和已配对设备。

479315841001935e.text: <g1><x2/></g1>，一个独立的命令行工具：无需打开应用程序，即可在终端中下载文件、视频和种子，并显示进度。

4c0b75cb39374b7b.source: Download a file with up to 8 connections (<x1/>, 1 to 128), showing progress. <x2/> pauses it; <x3/> continues. <x4/> checks the finished file: hex MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 or CRC32, optionally named (<x5/>). <x6/> picks the DNS: <x7/> (the default); a service and how to ask it, <x8/>, <x9/>, <x10/>, <x11/>, <x12/>; DNS servers' addresses, <x13/>; or a DNS-over-HTTPS address. It never falls back to the system's DNS. <x14/> sends every connection through one network adapter, by its name (<x15/>, <x16/>) or one of its addresses; when it isn't connected, nothing is sent and the download fails. A link from a file host that one of your debrid accounts (<g17>Options → Accounts</g17>) supports goes through that account, as in the app, and <x18/> says <x19/>; <x20/> downloads the address itself (<g21>Debrid service accounts</g21>).
4c0b75cb39374b7b.text: 下载文件，最多使用 8 个连接（<x1/>，范围为 1 到 128），并显示进度。<x2/> 暂停下载；<x3/> 继续下载。<x4/> 检查已下载完成的文件：以十六进制格式显示 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 或 CRC32 校验和，也可以指定名称（<x5/>）。<x6/> 选择 DNS：<x7/>（默认）；选择服务及其查询方式，<x8/>、<x9/>、<x10/>、<x11/>、<x12/>；指定 DNS 服务器地址，<x13/>；或指定 DNS-over-HTTPS 地址。它不会回退到系统 DNS。<x14/> 通过一个网络适配器发送所有连接，可指定适配器名称（<x15/>、<x16/>）或其地址之一；如果适配器未连接，则不会发送任何内容，下载也会失败。文件托管网站的链接如果受网盘服务帐户（<g17>选项 → 帐户</g17>）支持，就会像在应用程序中一样通过该帐户处理；<x18/> 表示 <x19/>；<x20/> 则直接下载该网址（<g21>网盘服务帐户</g21>）。

4c648e133b142af3.source: Music sites, podcast pages and radio stations play their sound from a player you can't point at: hidden behind controls of the page's own, often a bar along the bottom of the window (YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Boomplay, a radio's player). When such a sound starts playing (or the tab starts making sound and its page loaded something to offer), a <g1>Download audio</g1> button stands on that bar, at its end, half transparent while the sound plays; over a podcast's own player box when the page has one, else at the window's bottom corner. It acts like the button over a video: its menu lists the file the page plays first (an MP3, a radio station's broadcast), as a quality like the others, then DDM's own lookup of the track, and opens on its <g2>Audio</g2> tab (on YouTube Music too, whose songs DDM looks up with yt-dlp). The file is named after what the page's player tells the system it plays (the title and artist your media keys and lock screen show), else the station's or the page's name. The ✕ hides it for that track; unticking <g3>Over sound players</g3> in the button's settings (<g4>Options → General → DDM's download button over videos in browsers → Edit...</g4>) turns it off with the button over sound players.
4c648e133b142af3.text: 音乐网站、播客页面和电台通过一个您无法直接指向的播放器播放声音：它藏在页面自己的控件后面，常常是窗口底部的一条栏（YouTube Music、SoundCloud、Boomplay、电台的播放器）。当这样的声音开始播放时（或标签页开始发声而页面加载了可供下载的内容），栏的末端会出现一个<g1>下载音频</g1>按钮，声音播放期间半透明；页面有播客自己的播放器框时，它位于该框上方，否则位于窗口的底角。它的行为与视频上方的按钮一样：菜单先列出页面最先播放的文件（一个 MP3、电台的广播流），作为一个画质选项，然后是 DDM 自己查找到的曲目，并在它的<g2>音频</g2>选项卡中打开（YouTube Music 也一样，其歌曲由 DDM 用 yt-dlp 查找）。文件以页面播放器告诉系统它正在播放的内容命名（您的媒体键和锁屏显示的标题和艺人），否则以电台或页面的名称命名。✕ 会在该曲目上隐藏它；在按钮的设置中取消勾选<g3>在音频播放器上</g3>（<g4>选项 → 常规 → 浏览器中视频上的 DDM 下载按钮 → 编辑...</g4>）会同时关闭音频播放器上的按钮。
