4c7ed07ca86321d9.text: 统计信息中的一个条：某一天，或某个站点或某类文件的占比

4c8652ab742797b6.source: Some servers report a new date for the same file every time. Tick <g1>Options → Downloads → Resume even if the file's date on the server changed</g1>.
4c8652ab742797b6.text: 有些服务器每次都为同一文件报告新日期。请勾选<g1>选项 → 下载 → 即使服务器上的文件日期已更改，也继续下载</g1>。

4c9e560c0ba0c3aa.source: Options on its Connection page: connections per download, the network adapter and per-server exceptions
4c9e560c0ba0c3aa.text: “选项”的“连接”页面：每个下载的连接数、网络适配器和每个服务器的例外。

4ca9a35f67c86648.source: Find a download in a long list — Dannex Download Manager help
4ca9a35f67c86648.text: 在长列表中查找下载 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

4ceca71bcfd7f0a8.source: Double-click the torrent in the list to open its progress window. Besides the usual status, a torrent's window has five tabs:
4ceca71bcfd7f0a8.text: 双击列表中的种子以打开其进度窗口。除了常规状态外，种子的窗口有五个选项卡：

4cf950c979a3dcf8.source: Each connection is a connection of its own to the server, also with servers that speak HTTP/2 (GitHub's and Google's, for two), which could otherwise carry all of them over one.
4cf950c979a3dcf8.text: 每个连接都是到服务器的独立连接，即使服务器使用 HTTP/2（例如 GitHub 和 Google 的服务器；否则它们本可以用一个连接承载所有请求）。

4d0868248400f576.source: <g1>No video this can download on that page</g1> means yt-dlp found nothing on the page. Check that the address is the video's own page.
4d0868248400f576.text: <g1>此页面上没有可下载的视频</g1>表示 yt-dlp 未在该页面找到视频。请确认地址是视频本身的页面。

4d13242235854bbc.source: The main window's toolbar and categories in the High contrast theme
4d13242235854bbc.text: 主窗口的工具栏和类别采用高对比度主题

4d398edd535e24d9.source: The <g1>Speed Limiter</g1> tab of a torrent's window has, besides its download limit, <g2>Limit uploading</g2> to a speed of your choice. That limit is kept with the torrent: it applies again whenever the torrent runs or shares. A torrent can't be held under 16 KBytes/sec either way.
4d398edd535e24d9.text: torrent 窗口的<g1>速度限制器</g1>选项卡除了下载限制外，还有<g2>限制上传</g2>到您选择的速度。该限制会随 torrent 保存：每当 torrent 运行或分享时，该限制都会再次生效。无论如何，torrent 的上传速度不能低于 16 千字节/秒。

4d4775d381449e33.source: View → Theme changes how the whole window looks in one click, and everything stays where it was. Each built-in look has a light and a dark side, and your own theme is one small text file.
4d4775d381449e33.text: 视图 → 主题可一键改变整个窗口的外观，所有内容仍在原处。每种内置外观都有浅色和深色两面，您自己的主题只是一个小文本文件。

4d7daf5f5a647783.source: Double-click the download to open its progress window.
4d7daf5f5a647783.text: 双击下载任务，打开其进度窗口。

4d895f12e00559ae.source: Can it download from Netflix or other paid streaming services?
4d895f12e00559ae.text: 它能从 Netflix 或其他付费流媒体服务下载吗？

4dad09a9ad62a54a.source: Many sites hand out links that only work for a while, or only while you are signed in. Resuming then fails, because the old address no longer answers.
4dad09a9ad62a54a.text: 许多网站提供的链接只在一段时间内有效，或者只在您登录时有效。此时恢复会失败，因为旧地址不再响应。

4ded0822f265967f.source: Paste the new link into <g1>Address</g1> in <g2>File Properties</g2> and click <g3>OK</g3>.
4ded0822f265967f.text: 将新链接粘贴到<g2>文件属性</g2>中的<g1>地址</g1>，然后点击<g3>确定</g3>。

4e1b5974d69225f9.source: Moving from Internet Download Manager? Export your list there and import it in DDM. Every download comes over with its address, referrer and cookies, into a window laid out the way you know.
4e1b5974d69225f9.text: 要从 Internet Download Manager 切换过来吗？在 IDM 中导出您的列表，然后导入到 DDM。每个下载任务都会带着地址、来源和 Cookie，导入到您熟悉的界面中。

4e1e4f1611aaf6ce.source: Free for Windows, Linux and Mac. No ads, no trial.
4e1e4f1611aaf6ce.text: Windows、Linux 和 Mac 均免费。没有广告，没有试用期。

4e2bd23c85992b54.source: The box on each of those buttons ticks every link of that kind (the search's, if you typed one), or unticks them when they all are. Half-filled, some are ticked.
4e2bd23c85992b54.text: 这些按钮上的框会勾选该类型的每个链接（如果输入了搜索内容，则是搜索结果中的），全部已勾选时则取消勾选。半选状态表示其中一部分已勾选。

4e2c245c44f6b6ff.source: The files go next to the archive, into a folder named after it when it holds several things (or always, or never: you choose in Options). A file that is already there is kept, and the new one is numbered: <x1/>.
4e2c245c44f6b6ff.text: 文件会解压到压缩包旁边，如果压缩包包含多个文件，则会解压到一个以压缩包命名的文件夹中（您可以在选项中选择总是、从不或仅在多文件时创建文件夹）。如果目标位置已有同名文件，则会保留原有文件，新文件会进行编号：<x1/>。

4e3e7d596fa947ef.source: Check <g1>Save to</g1> (the Video category's folder by default) and <g2>File name</g2>, which comes from the video's title.
4e3e7d596fa947ef.text: 检查<g1>保存到</g1>（默认为视频类别的文件夹）和<g2>文件名</g2>。文件名取自视频标题。

4e4d590e10d29607.text: 欢迎使用脚本。支持 IDM 命令行参数。

4e9230d3c87e173e.source: A silent connection reconnects after 3 s instead of waiting 12 (aria2c took 61 s)
4e9230d3c87e173e.text: 无响应的连接 3 秒后重连，而不是等 12 秒（aria2c 用了 61 秒）

4e9ff23471ef2f2a.source: A <x1/> and a Compose file come with DDM's source. For now you build the image yourself; a published image comes later. The first build is long, up to an hour on a small server, and the image is small, about 175 MB, with no desktop libraries.
4e9ff23471ef2f2a.text: DDM 的源代码中包含一个 <x1/> 和一个 Compose 文件。目前您需要自行构建镜像；已发布的镜像将在稍后提供。首次构建时间较长，在小型服务器上可能长达一小时，但镜像很小，大约 175 MB，不包含桌面库。

4ed0aaa5f83f33db.text: macOS <g1>11 及更高版本 · 实验性</g1>

4f07dda13d242d23.source: Options on its Connection page: connections per download, per-server exceptions, Download limits and the DNS list
4f07dda13d242d23.text: 其“连接”页面上的选项：每个下载的连接数、每个服务器的例外、下载限制和 DNS 列表

4f342424b8dab68f.source: Every display language Windows 11 offers, chosen by flag on the first start or any time in View → Language. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur are laid out right to left.
4f342424b8dab68f.text: 支持 Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，首次启动时可通过旗帜选择，或随时在视图 → 语言中更改。阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语采用从右到左的布局。

4f5159770275b6af.source: <g1>When done, open this file</g1> — for example a sound, a script or a program. <g2>...</g2> picks the file.
4f5159770275b6af.text: <g1>完成后打开此文件</g1> — 例如声音、脚本或程序。<g2>...</g2>用于选择该文件。

4f5ab4808403e058.source: Turn the running app's automation API on or off.
4f5ab4808403e058.text: 开启或关闭运行中的应用的自动化 API。

4fa28fbd41a68f6d.source: A key DDM doesn't know, or a value it can't read, is skipped and written to DDM's log (the <x1/> folder beside the themes folder), so a file made for a newer DDM still loads. A file that isn't valid TOML or JSON doesn't load, and the log says why. A file named like a built-in theme (<x2/>) is passed over: give yours a name of its own.
4fa28fbd41a68f6d.text: DDM 不知道的键，或无法读取的值，将被跳过并写入 DDM 的日志（主题文件夹旁边的<x1/>文件夹），因此为较新 DDM 制作的文件仍然可以加载。无效的 TOML 或 JSON 文件无法加载，日志会说明原因。与内置主题同名的文件（<x2/>）将被跳过：请给您的文件一个自己的名称。

4fa6254f56afb416.source: Closing the main window doesn't quit DDM. It hides in the notification area, and downloads, queues and schedules carry on. To make closing quit (a portable copy's folder can then be deleted), untick <g1>Options → General → Keep running when closing the window</g1>. If there is no icon for DDM at all — not in the notification area, nor behind the ^ hidden icons — the window minimizes to the taskbar instead, so downloads continue and there is a way back. An icon behind ^ can be clicked to bring the window back, and starting DDM again always does.
4fa6254f56afb416.text: 关闭主窗口不会退出 DDM。它会隐藏在通知区域，下载、队列和计划会继续运行。要使关闭窗口即退出（之后便可删除便携版副本的文件夹），请取消勾选<g1>选项 → 常规 → 关闭窗口时保持运行</g1>。如果通知区域或“^ 隐藏图标”后面都没有 DDM 图标，则窗口会最小化到任务栏，这样下载仍会继续，并且可以找回窗口。点击“^”后面的图标可以恢复窗口，再次启动 DDM 也能恢复。

4fa91a22adfd3dee.source: Does it download torrents? — Dannex Download Manager
4fa91a22adfd3dee.text: DDM 能下载种子文件吗？ — Dannex Download Manager

4faa7018e737c223.source: <g1>Categories</g1> (left). Choose what the list shows: <g2>All Downloads</g2>, <g3>Unfinished</g3>, <g4>Finished</g4> and <g5>Queues</g5>, each with its categories. Drag the gap between the pane and the list to make it wider.
4faa7018e737c223.text: <g1>类别</g1>（左侧）。选择列表显示的内容：<g2>所有下载</g2>、<g3>未完成</g3>、<g4>已完成</g4>和<g5>队列</g5>，每个项目下还有相应的类别。拖动窗格与列表之间的分隔线可加宽窗格。

4fb7cfbf3e8ef4a2.source: Run in the notification area: start hidden, hide progress windows
4fb7cfbf3e8ef4a2.text: 在通知区域运行：隐藏启动，隐藏进度窗口

4fbf90cc572fcc58.source: The window that offers the browser extension on Linux: Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox, each with Add the extension
4fbf90cc572fcc58.text: 在 Linux 上提供浏览器扩展的窗口：Google Chrome 和 Mozilla Firefox，每个都有“添加扩展”按钮

4fc6cec11b2f6d8b.source: <g1>Chrome Web Store</g1><g2>For Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, kept up to date by the browser. Edge first asks to allow extensions from other stores.</g2>
4fc6cec11b2f6d8b.text: <g1>Chrome 网上应用店</g1><g2>适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi，由浏览器保持更新。Edge 会先询问是否允许来自其他商店的扩展。</g2>

4fefa1c9a9258b09.source: Download manager for Windows, with macOS and Linux builds
4fefa1c9a9258b09.text: 适用于 Windows 的下载管理器，也支持 macOS 和 Linux 构建

4ff559ceebc8c2c2.source: Can I limit the download speed? — Dannex Download Manager
4ff559ceebc8c2c2.text: 我可以限制下载速度吗？— Dannex Download Manager

4ff5f9e98df3234a.source: In Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi or Helium
4ff5f9e98df3234a.text: 在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 或 Helium 中

4ffb28494afc5681.source: With the list selected, type the first letters of a name to jump straight to it.
4ffb28494afc5681.text: 选中列表后，输入名称的首字母即可直接跳转到该项。

500f97298bacea57.source: The same answer carries Options → General's keys (<x1/>: what page.js holds a click by, to leave a link to the browser or force it to the app) and the right-click items to show (<x2/>: background.js makes its menu anew when they change); the answer to whether the video button may show carries Download panels' settings (<x3/>: over videos or sound players, the least length, the first corner). Their names and defaults are <x4/>'s, read from the settings the app saves. The extension asks again when the browser's window gets the focus back (a few seconds after it last asked), when a page starts (15 s), and at a download (a minute).
500f97298bacea57.text: 同一次回答还带有选项 → 常规中的按键（<x1/>：page.js 据此判断是否拦截点击，把链接留给浏览器或强制交给应用）和要显示的右键菜单项（<x2/>：这些项更改时，background.js 会重新生成菜单）；是否可以显示视频按钮的回答则带有下载面板的设置（<x3/>：在视频或音频播放器上、最短时长、起始角落）。它们的名称和默认值来自 <x4/>，取自应用保存的设置。扩展会在浏览器窗口重新获得焦点时（距上次询问几秒后）、页面开始加载时（15 秒）以及下载时（一分钟）再次询问。

502a32945d3f28fd.source: Point at a column title and a funnel shows at its right: click it to filter the list by that column. From the keyboard, or on a narrow column, right-click the title and choose <g1>Filter "…"...</g1>.
502a32945d3f28fd.text: 将鼠标指向列标题，其右侧会显示一个漏斗：单击它即可按该列筛选列表。使用键盘，或在较窄的列上，请右键单击标题并选择<g1>筛选“…”...</g1>。

50344e9c00abc1e4.source: <g1>Add to queue</g1> adds the ticked links to the <g2>Main download queue</g2>, as the import always did, and <g3>Start</g3> starts the queue as well. An <x4/> file still brings each download's referrer and cookies. See <g5>Link grabber and archives</g5>.
50344e9c00abc1e4.text: <g1>添加到队列</g1>会将已勾选的链接添加到<g2>主下载队列</g2>，就像以前的导入功能一样，而<g3>开始</g3>也会同时启动队列。<x4/> 文件仍然会带上每个下载任务的来源和 Cookie。请参阅<g5>链接抓取器和压缩包</g5>。

505a599d74a09b57.source: The gallery gets one row in your download list. Its size grows as the pictures arrive, and its log says how many were saved.
505a599d74a09b57.text: 该图库将在您的下载列表中占据一行。其大小会随着图片的到来而增长，日志会显示已保存的图片数量。

50627566ef670c57.text: 来自 HTTP/2 服务器的 8 MiB

506410068bc3e290.source: DDM is installed and reached, but its own settings leave this download to the browser. The extension's status page (right-click its toolbar button → <g1>Help</g1>) names the file and which setting it was. Check, in DDM:
506410068bc3e290.text: DDM 已安装且可连接，但其自身设置将此下载留给了浏览器。扩展的状态页（右键单击其工具栏按钮 → <g1>帮助</g1>）会指出文件名以及是哪项设置。请在 DDM 中检查：

5066f7b336cce1f7.source: The app, the extension and the website collect no personal data from anyone, children included.
5066f7b336cce1f7.text: 应用程序、扩展程序和网站不会收集任何人的个人数据，包括儿童。

5069ed5778c3addc.source: <g1>Extract archives when their download completes</g1> (off by default) — every archive downloaded, as soon as it (or a split archive's last volume) is in. A Link grabber package has its own <g2>Extract when done</g2>.
5069ed5778c3addc.text: <g1>下载完成后提取存档</g1>（默认关闭）— 每个存档下载完成后立即提取；分卷存档则在最后一个卷下载完成后提取。链接抓取器的每个包都可以单独设置<g2>完成后提取</g2>。

50a8864f971c1689.source: Right-click → <g1>Add category</g1> makes one for what you collect, say <g2>Books</g2> for <x3/>: a name, the file types separated by spaces (<x4/> allowed) and a folder. Change it later with <g5>Properties</g5>, or remove it with <g6>Delete</g6>. The files stay where they are.
50a8864f971c1689.text: 右键点击 → <g1>添加类别</g1>可为您收集的文件创建类别，例如为<x3/>创建<g2>图书</g2>类别：输入名称、用空格分隔的文件类型（允许<x4/>）以及一个文件夹。之后可以使用<g5>属性</g5>更改，或使用<g6>删除</g6>移除。文件会保留在原位置。

50b1b826b2c5891a.source: Run DDM without a window on a home server or a NAS, and send it downloads from your phone or your browser. The files land in the server's own folders, such as a network share.
50b1b826b2c5891a.text: 在家庭服务器或 NAS 上无窗口运行 DDM，并通过手机或浏览器向其发送下载任务。文件将直接保存到服务器的文件夹中，例如网络共享。

50cb386f15dff5dd.source: then signs out and in again. The setting stays after a restart. The computer has one wake alarm: if another program has set it, DDM leaves it alone and says so.
50cb386f15dff5dd.text: 然后注销并重新登录。重启后设置仍然有效。电脑只有一个唤醒闹钟：如果其他程序已设置，DDM 会保留它并提示。

50ddf68448e9275b.source: <g1>Only pages under the start address's folder</g1>: part of a site. From <x2/>, only the pages in <x3/> and below it are explored, not the rest of the site. The pictures and files those pages use are collected wherever they are.
50ddf68448e9275b.text: <g1>仅限起始地址所在文件夹下的页面</g1>：网站的一部分。从 <x2/> 开始，仅探索 <x3/> 及其下的页面，而不探索网站的其余部分。这些页面使用的图片和文件无论在哪里都会被收集。

50e9066f0da554b8.source: The Speed Limiter keeps DDM from using all of your connection.
50e9066f0da554b8.text: 速度限制器可防止 DDM 占用全部网络带宽。

50ea8d40b4e8e738.source: No, unless you want it to. While a torrent downloads it trades pieces with other people, as every torrent client does. When it finishes, it stops, like any other download. Turn on <g1>Keep sharing torrents after they finish</g1> in Options if you'd like to give back.
50ea8d40b4e8e738.text: 不会，除非您希望它这样做。当种子下载时，它会像所有种子客户端一样与其他用户交换分片。下载完成后，它会像其他下载一样停止。如果您想继续分享，可以在“选项”中开启<g1>下载完成后继续共享种子</g1>。

50f84dc9b1b44c26.source: <g1>Options → Remote</g1> lists the paired devices, when each was paired and when it was last seen. Select one and click <g2>Remove</g2>: it is refused from its next request on, at once (no need for <g3>OK</g3>). On the phone, the page's <g4>⋮ → Forget this device</g4> does the same from that side.
50f84dc9b1b44c26.text: <g1>选项 → 远程</g1>列出了已配对的设备，以及每个设备的配对时间和上次看到的时间。选择一个并点击<g2>删除</g2>：它会立即被拒绝从下一次请求开始（无需点击<g3>确定</g3>）。在手机上，页面的<g4>⋮ → 忘记此设备</g4>会从该侧执行相同的操作。

511729ecf9bdc1e4.source: Corner radius of a glossy push button (Luna, Aero; Aqua's are round at the ends)
511729ecf9bdc1e4.text: 光泽按钮的圆角半径 (Luna, Aero；Aqua 的两端是圆的)

512f824da85ef410.source: Point each category's folder at the stick.
512f824da85ef410.text: 将每个类别的文件夹指向U盘。

5137278f15d2d067.source: It does not hold your download addresses or file names, and your user name shows as <x1/> in folder paths. If an error message quotes something you typed, that text is in it, which is why you read it first.
5137278f15d2d067.text: 它不包含您的下载地址或文件名，并且您的用户名在文件夹路径中显示为<x1/>。如果错误消息引用了您输入的内容，则该文本会包含在内，这就是您需要先阅读它的原因。

5143892c1fb73010.source: explains the key terms (download, queue, category, connection, resume…). Translate each one the same way everywhere, the way Windows says it in your language. <x1/> is each language's style guide: how it writes commands, questions and labels, and the terms reviewers settled.

Downloads that end together make one notification. It has no sound, and waits while the system's focus assist or Do not disturb is on. On Windows it comes from the tray icon; on Linux and macOS from the desktop's notifications.
5574839067aa0a86.text: <g1>下载完成时通知</g1>会在某个下载完成、但它的<g2>下载完成</g2>窗口没有打开时（队列中的、链接抓取器中的，或该窗口被关闭时），显示一条安静的小通知。同时结束的下载只产生一条通知。它没有声音，并在系统的专注助手或勿扰模式开启时等待。在 Windows 上它来自托盘图标；在 Linux 和 macOS 上来自桌面通知。

557accf0aacea5ac.source: Link grabber listing the links of a page in packages, with their names, sizes and whether they are online
557accf0aacea5ac.text: 链接抓取器列出页面中的链接包，包括它们的名称、大小以及是否在线

55941e6d91b9a45c.source: What a copy can't do: run what needs the site (searches, forms, logins), or show what a page's scripts would have fetched. Some browsers refuse scripts written as modules (<x1/>) from the disk.
55941e6d91b9a45c.text: 副本无法做到的事：运行需要网站的功能（搜索、表单、登录），或显示页面脚本本会获取的内容。有些浏览器会拒绝从磁盘加载以模块形式编写的脚本（<x1/>）。

559f1edb4136e9ae.source: End to end: command to finished file
559f1edb4136e9ae.text: 端到端：从发出命令到文件下载完成

55bb7652c732e417.source: The browser and DDM aren't connected
55bb7652c732e417.text: 浏览器和 DDM 未连接

55df82a395f7d69e.source: PDFs, music and videos the browser would open itself, and downloads from forms, go to DDM too. Hold <g1>Alt</g1> while clicking to let the browser have one.
55df82a395f7d69e.text: 浏览器会自行打开的 PDF、音乐和视频，以及来自表单的下载，也会发送到 DDM。在点击时按住<g1>Alt</g1>键，可让浏览器自行处理。

55ea9ba59e0259e8.source: <g1>No breaking of copy protection.</g1> DDM doesn't remove or get around DRM, and isn't meant to. Protected content stays protected.
55ea9ba59e0259e8.text: <g1>不破解版权保护。</g1> DDM 不会移除或绕过 DRM，也无意如此。受保护的内容仍然受保护。

55ecea9df3d3ed23.source: Paste the address of a playlist (<x1/>) or a channel's videos (<x2/>) and click <g3>Look up</g3>. Instead of one video's qualities, the window lists the list's videos, each with its length.
55ecea9df3d3ed23.text: 粘贴播放列表 (<x1/>) 或频道视频 (<x2/>) 的地址，然后点击 <g3>查找</g3>。窗口不会显示单个视频的画质选项，而会列出播放列表中的视频及其时长。

55ed1ee9aa561a5a.source: Made something others would like? Open a <g1>pull request on GitHub</g1> that adds it to <g2><x3/></g2>, with:
55ed1ee9aa561a5a.text: 制作了其他人可能会喜欢的主题？在 <g1>GitHub 上提交拉取请求</g1>，将其添加到 <g2><x3/></g2>，并附带：

55fc68b1cae6ed7f.source: <g1>pywal itself:</g1> once <x2/> has run, <g3>View → Theme</g3> lists <g4>pywal</g4>, read straight from where pywal writes its colours: <x5/> (on Windows <x6/>, where winwal and pywal write it; <x7/> or <x8/> when you set them). Pick it and DDM follows your wallpaper: each time <x9/> writes new colours, DDM takes them within two seconds. It looks only at the file's date and size, every two seconds, and only while pywal is the theme. A copy added with <g10>Add a theme file…</g10> keeps the colours it had.
55fc68b1cae6ed7f.text: <g1>pywal 本身：</g1> 一旦 <x2/> 运行，<g3>视图 → 主题</g3> 会列出 <g4>pywal</g4>，直接从 pywal 写入颜色的位置读取：<x5/>（在 Windows 上是 <x6/>，winwal 和 pywal 写入此处；如果您设置了 <x7/> 或 <x8/>，则为这些位置）。选择它，DDM 就会跟随您的壁纸：每次 <x9/> 写入新颜色时，DDM 都会在两秒内获取。它每两秒只查看文件日期和大小，并且仅在 pywal 是主题时。通过 <g10>添加主题文件…</g10> 添加的副本会保留其原有的颜色。

564813465e6f19c2.source: <g1>Right-click the page → Download all videos and audio with DDM</g1> opens, in Link grabber, the page's players and links to such files, and the files its players played without naming them.
564813465e6f19c2.text: <g1>右键单击页面 → 使用 DDM 下载所有视频和音频</g1>会在链接抓取器中打开页面上的播放器和指向此类文件的链接，以及其播放器未标明名称而播放过的文件。

5662a2d0e8ae7225.source: <g1>Dates and times</g1> in the list (<g2>Last Try Date</g2>, <g3>Added</g3>), the Scheduler and Statistics are written the way the interface language writes them, as numbers are: German <x4/> and <x5/>, Arabic <x6/> (Unicode CLDR's conventions). When your system's region is in that same language, its own formats win (on Windows <g7>Settings → Time & language → Language & region → Regional format</g7>). In English they follow the system's region, and the list keeps IDM's own date text (<x8/>), on the system's 12- or 24-hour clock (<x9/>). Your own date order, clock and first day of the week in <g10>Options → Regional</g10> win over both.
5662a2d0e8ae7225.text: 列表中的<g1>日期和时间</g1>（<g2>上次尝试日期</g2>、<g3>已添加</g3>）、计划程序和统计信息，按界面语言的写法书写，数字也一样：德语 <x4/> 和 <x5/>，阿拉伯语 <x6/>（Unicode CLDR 的约定）。当您系统的区域使用同一种语言时，以其自己的格式为准（在 Windows 上为<g7>设置 → 时间和语言 → 语言和区域 → 区域格式</g7>）。英语则遵循系统区域，列表保留 IDM 自己的日期文字（<x8/>），按系统的 12 或 24 小时制（<x9/>）。您在<g10>选项 → 区域</g10>中自己设置的日期顺序、时钟和每周第一天，优先于以上两者。

566b1720d3f6ccac.source: DDM isn't installed, or browser integration isn't set up
566b1720d3f6ccac.text: DDM 未安装，或浏览器集成未设置

5672aa47684fc0f8.source: Lines starting with <x1/> are notes for translators: where the text appears and what it means.
5672aa47684fc0f8.text: 以<x1/>开头的行是给译者的注释，说明文本出现的位置及其含义。

567f61dda0920579.text: 灰色未选中复选框的边框

5680c010be7aa6b1.source: If your antivirus quarantined DDM, restore it and add an exception for its folder. If it flags something other than the setup or DDM's own programs, or a copy from anywhere else, don't run it, and please <g1>tell us</g1>.
5680c010be7aa6b1.text: 如果您的杀毒软件隔离了 DDM，请恢复它并为其文件夹添加例外。如果它标记了安装程序或 DDM 自身程序以外的内容，或者来自其他来源的副本，请不要运行它，并<g1>告知我们</g1>。

56a440bc7aa24cf3.source: Your language, from the first window.
56a440bc7aa24cf3.text: 从第一个窗口开始，就是您的语言。

56c991946fe8d471.source: To continue a stopped download, select it and click <g1>Resume</g1> on the toolbar (or <g2>File → Download Now</g2>).
56c991946fe8d471.text: 要继续已停止的下载，请选择该下载，然后点击工具栏上的<g1>恢复</g1>（或选择<g2>文件 → 立即下载</g2>）。

56cc0ee76be4673e.source: You can add your own queues in the Scheduler, or with <g1>Create new queue</g1> in a download's right-click menu.
56cc0ee76be4673e.text: 您可以在“计划程序”中添加自己的队列，或者通过下载右键菜单中的<g1>创建新队列</g1>来添加。

56d8787819039809.source: <g1>Ready before you click.</g1> When the pointer reaches the button, or rests for a moment over the video on that video's own page (a YouTube watch page, for example, never a feed or YouTube Shorts), DDM starts looking the video up already, so its list is often ready when the menu opens. One look-up at a time. It starts only while DDM isn't looking up another video, and stops when you leave the page. In a private window nothing is looked up before you click.
56d8787819039809.text: <g1>在您单击之前就绪。</g1>当指针移到按钮上，或在该视频自己的页面（例如 YouTube 观看页，绝不是动态消息或 YouTube Shorts）上的视频上停留片刻时，DDM 就会开始查找该视频，因此菜单打开时其列表通常已经就绪。一次只查找一个。它仅在 DDM 没有在查找另一个视频时才开始，并在您离开页面时停止。在隐私窗口中，在您单击之前不会查找任何内容。

56e24f6222e629f5.source: is the theme yours starts from: <x1/> (the default), <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/>, <x7/>, <x8/>, <x9/>, or another theme file in the same folder.

56f407c985b086ad.source: Adds a download, as the command line's <x1/> do (<x2/> is <x3/>); <x4/>. <x5/> (a key from the list's <x6/>) puts it in that category's folder instead of the one its type picks; <x7/> (a queue's name) is the queue it waits in with <x8/>. Also with the API off, like the command line.
56f407c985b086ad.text: 添加下载，如同命令行中的 <x1/>（<x2/> 是 <x3/>）；<x4/>。<x5/>（列表中的 <x6/> 键）将其放入该类别的文件夹，而不是其类型选择的文件夹；<x7/>（队列名称）是它与 <x8/> 一起等待的队列。在 API 关闭时也可用，如同命令行。

5704b78ea54419dd.source: Click <g1>Add URL</g1> and paste the gallery's address, for example <x2/>.
5704b78ea54419dd.text: 点击<g1>添加 URL</g1> 并粘贴图库地址，例如 <x2/>。

571e5a5e3923ac85.source: When a download comes from a form you submitted, it passes <g1>the form's data</g1> too, so DDM can submit it again. It notes the data of forms you submit (in memory, used for two minutes at most, never stored) only for that.
571e5a5e3923ac85.text: 当下载来自您提交的表单时，它也会传递<g1>表单数据</g1>，以便 DDM 可以再次提交。它只为此目的记录您提交的表单数据（在内存中，最多使用两分钟，从不存储）。

57271fd14fc7d6ce.source: The main window on Windows 11: the toolbar, the categories on the left and the download list on the right
57271fd14fc7d6ce.text: Windows 11 上的主窗口：工具栏、左侧的类别和右侧的下载列表

572eaa88b689dd90.source: Wait for the list. It shows each resolution with its size, best first, then the sound alone: - <g1>Audio only, original</g1>: the site's own file, not converted (M4A, or WebM with Opus inside, as the site serves it). The best sound there is, in the smallest file. - <g2>Audio only MP3</g2> at its best variable bitrate (VBR) and at 320, 256, 192 and 128 kbps, for players that only take MP3. - <g3>Audio only OPUS</g3>: an <x4/> file. When the site's sound is Opus already (YouTube's usually is), it's only moved into that file, not converted, so nothing is lost. - <g5>Audio only FLAC</g5>: a lossless <x6/> file, for a library or a program that wants FLAC. It can't add quality: the site's sound is already compressed with losses, and FLAC keeps it exactly as it came, in a file several times bigger. The window says so when you choose it.
572eaa88b689dd90.text: 等待列表加载。列表会按画质从高到低显示各分辨率和对应的文件大小，之后列出纯音频选项：- <g1>仅音频，原始</g1>：网站提供的原始文件，不经过转换（网站提供的是 M4A，或包含 Opus 音频的 WebM）。这是音质最好的选项，文件也最小。- <g2>仅音频 MP3</g2>：提供最佳可变比特率（VBR），以及 320、256、192 和 128 kbps，适用于只支持 MP3 的播放器。- <g3>仅音频 OPUS</g3>：一个 <x4/> 文件。如果网站提供的音频已经是 Opus（YouTube 通常如此），只需将它封装到该文件中，无需转换，因此不会损失音质。- <g5>仅音频 FLAC</g5>：无损 <x6/> 文件，适用于音乐库或需要 FLAC 的程序。它无法提升音质：网站提供的音频已经过有损压缩，FLAC 会原样保留音频，但文件会大几倍。选择此选项时，窗口会显示这一点。

5730437f2b40d7c8.source: You can also <g1>open the form yourself</g1>; it asks for the same details.
5730437f2b40d7c8.text: 你也可以<g1>自行打开表单</g1>；它会要求相同的详细信息。

5745722d36271493.source: The log records what DDM does, so a report can show what led to a problem. To log more detail, start DDM with the environment variable <x1/>.
5745722d36271493.text: 日志会记录 DDM 的操作，因此报告可以显示问题的起因。要记录更详细的信息，请使用环境变量<x1/>启动 DDM。

575ae202ce45ffc4.source: Files named photo001.jpg to photo150.jpg don't need 150 clicks. Write the address once with an asterisk where the number changes, and DDM queues every file. A list of links in a text file goes in just as easily.
575ae202ce45ffc4.text: 名为 photo001.jpg 到 photo150.jpg 的文件不需要点击 150 次。只需将地址中的数字变化部分用星号代替，DDM 就会将所有文件加入队列。文本文件中的链接列表也能同样轻松地导入。

57a2e56d39e0a778.source: <g1>Needs a login</g1>: the server wants a user name and password, or the page's cookies.
57a2e56d39e0a778.text: <g1>需要登录</g1>：服务器需要用户名和密码，或需要页面的 Cookie。

57cb779850f770f1.source: <g1>86 languages</g1><g2>Every one Windows 11 offers, right to left too</g2>
57cb779850f770f1.text: <g1>86 种语言</g1><g2>Windows 11 提供的每一种，包括从右到左书写的语言</g2>

57d8abd136298ad0.source: Windows 10/11 and Linux; macOS to try
57d8abd136298ad0.text: Windows 10/11 和 Linux；macOS 可试用

57f7a41f3d7829f5.source: A video or a gallery takes a limit of its own the same way. For a torrent, the limit is that torrent's alone; the others keep theirs. A torrent can't be held under 16 KBytes/sec: a lower limit gives it 16.
57f7a41f3d7829f5.text: 视频或图片库同样有自己的限制。对于种子文件，限制仅适用于该种子文件；其他文件保持其各自的限制。种子文件的速度不能低于 16 千字节/秒：如果设置了更低的限制，它将自动调整为 16 千字节/秒。

5807d89f8c08086c.source: <g1>Then move the archives to the Recycle Bin</g1> (off by default; the Trash on macOS and Linux) — after a successful extraction only. This is also the default of a new package's <g2>Delete archives after extracting</g2>.
5807d89f8c08086c.text: <g1>然后将存档移至回收站</g1>（默认关闭；在 macOS 和 Linux 上移至废纸篓）— 仅在成功提取后移动。这也是新建包的<g2>提取后删除存档</g2>选项的默认设置。

5825a9c27ba24869.source: <g1><g2>Keyboard shortcuts</g2></g1> — every key the main window answers, and screen readers.
5825a9c27ba24869.text: <g1><g2>键盘快捷方式</g2></g1> — 主窗口响应的每个按键，以及屏幕阅读器。

584cc45dc137daf3.text: 一个星号，一个完整系列

5874f2f7da09955e.source: No trial that runs out, no paid edition, no licence key. The code is open for anyone to read, and every download is built from it in public.
5874f2f7da09955e.text: 没有会过期的试用，没有付费版，没有许可证密钥。代码公开，任何人都可以阅读，每个下载都是用它公开构建的。

587c035cfef7393d.source: Download complete: Open the file, or Open folder.
587c035cfef7393d.text: 下载完成：打开文件，或打开文件夹。

588db309f4fc3eb6.source: <g1>Medium</g1> (amber): 60 to 150 ms, usually the same continent.
588db309f4fc3eb6.text: <g1>中</g1>（琥珀色）：60 到 150 毫秒，通常是同一大陆。

589ba88a30d884f3.source: Installed; <g1>It's turned off, so downloads stay in this browser.</g1>
589ba88a30d884f3.text: 已安装；<g1>已关闭，因此下载将保留在此浏览器中。</g1>

5907394a8d0d09ef.source: <g1>Breeze</g1>: KDE Plasma's look: rounded corners, buttons and boxes that take the accent's edge under the pointer or when focused, KDE's check boxes and focus frame, KDE's title bar with the title centred and round buttons (on Windows, where DDM draws it), and KDE's Breeze icons.
5907394a8d0d09ef.text: <g1>Breeze</g1>：KDE Plasma 的外观：圆角、在指针下方或聚焦时带有强调色边缘的按钮和框、KDE 的复选框和焦点框、KDE 的标题栏（标题居中，圆形按钮，在 Windows 上，由 DDM 绘制），以及 KDE 的 Breeze 图标。

590af1fd6b620c24.source: DDM's channel file is from an earlier start; restart DDM.
590af1fd6b620c24.text: DDM 的通道文件来自更早的启动；请重启 DDM。

592f898c79b39c3a.source: A download falls into a category by its file type: <g1>General</g1>, <g2>Compressed</g2>, <g3>Documents</g3>, <g4>Music</g4>, <g5>Programs</g5> or <g6>Video</g6>, and torrents into <g7>Torrents</g7>. Each category has its own folder inside your Downloads folder, so a ZIP file lands in <x8/> and a film in <x9/> without you choosing.
592f898c79b39c3a.text: 下载文件会根据其文件类型归入相应类别：<g1>常规</g1>、<g2>压缩文件</g2>、<g3>文档</g3>、<g4>音乐</g4>、<g5>程序</g5> 或 <g6>视频</g6>，种子文件则归入<g7>种子</g7>。每个类别在您的“下载”文件夹中都有自己的子文件夹，因此 ZIP 文件会自动存入<x8/>，电影文件会自动存入<x9/>，无需您手动选择。

5931ce0e4ef63e2e.source: In Chrome, Edge and Brave you can limit an extension to some sites (right-click its toolbar button → <g1>This can read and change site data</g1>), and in Firefox take its access away in <g2>Add-ons and themes</g2> → the extension → <g3>Permissions</g3>. On a site it may not read, the extension can't pass your sign-in on, so it leaves the download to the browser. Choose <g4>On all sites</g4> to let DDM take downloads everywhere, or click <g5>Allow on all sites</g5> on the extension's status page (right-click its toolbar button → <g6>Help</g6>), which asks the browser for it.
5931ce0e4ef63e2e.text: 在 Chrome、Edge 和 Brave 中，您可以将扩展限制在部分站点上（右键单击其工具栏按钮 → <g1>此扩展可读取和更改网站数据</g1>）；在 Firefox 中，可在<g2>附加组件和主题</g2> → 该扩展 → <g3>权限</g3>中收回其访问权限。在扩展无权读取的站点上，它无法传递您的登录状态，因此会将下载留给浏览器。选择<g4>在所有网站上</g4>可让 DDM 在所有位置接管下载，也可以单击扩展状态页（右键单击其工具栏按钮 → <g6>帮助</g6>）上的<g5>允许访问所有站点</g5>，由它向浏览器申请该权限。

5934223575270924.text: 在<g1>下载文件信息</g1>中：<g2>开始下载</g2>

5936f5324103bf1c.source: Sizes are in bytes (<x1/> while unknown), speeds in bytes per second. A failure prints <x2/> and exits with code 1. For example:
5936f5324103bf1c.text: 大小以字节为单位（<x1/> 表示未知），速度以字节每秒为单位。失败会打印 <x2/> 并以代码 1 退出。例如：

593feee2a86436e5.source: : DDM's log (<x1/>, with older ones as <x2/> and so on, 2 MB each).

5cc84b0198dcee09.source: Rules only look at articles that are new since the feed was last fetched, and a feed's first fetch only lists what is there. So adding a feed or a rule never downloads a whole backlog. <g1>Matches ... articles now</g1> shows which of the articles the feeds hold now the rule matches, to check it; download those by hand. A torrent the list already has isn't added again, and neither is one whose files are already in the folder: DDM never writes into files it didn't make without asking. The bottom line of the tab says what the rules did last, and a torrent a rule added says so in its event log.

Once the download is done, or taken off DDM's list, it leaves your account's list of web downloads on TorBox; a paused one keeps its place there, to go on with.
5e526dd27fbac753.text: TorBox 首先将文件下载到其自己的服务器 (如果已有则立即下载)。DDM 会等待，最长一小时，列表中会显示进度，例如 <g1>TorBox 上 40%</g1>。一旦下载完成，或从 DDM 列表中移除，它就会从您 TorBox 账户的网页下载列表中消失；暂停的下载会保留其位置，以便继续。

5e5f73aecd59f452.source: <g1>User-Agent for downloads you add yourself</g1> — how DDM names itself to servers for downloads you add yourself. With <g2>Automatic</g2> ticked (the default), DDM introduces itself as your default browser: the User-Agent that browser sends, at the version you have installed (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Firefox or Safari). The box shows it, and pointing at it names the browser. When DDM doesn't recognise your default browser, it sends a current Chrome's. Untick <g3>Automatic</g3> to type your own; tick it again to go back. Downloads from the browser use that browser's own User-Agent. These files are made when they are asked for, so their size is unknown until they arrive and they can't be resumed: a cut-off download starts again.

64411e8900502fb0.text: Windows 8 的扁平外观：方形边角、扁平按钮和单色图标。

6453a141bfc3ae57.source: By default DDM starts downloading while this window is open, so no time is lost while you decide. The download joins the list only when you choose <g1>Start Download</g1> or <g2>Download Later</g2>; <g3>Cancel</g3> drops what it fetched and leaves nothing behind. You can turn this off in <g4>Options → Downloads → Start fetching while Download File Info is open</g4>.
6453a141bfc3ae57.text: 默认情况下，DDM 在此窗口打开时就开始下载，因此在您决定的同时不会浪费时间。只有当您选择<g1>开始下载</g1>或<g2>稍后下载</g2>时，下载才会加入列表；<g3>取消</g3>会丢弃已获取的内容，不留任何痕迹。您可以在<g4>选项 → 下载 → “下载文件信息”打开时开始获取</g4>中关闭此行为。

646fee8a2fcc7423.source: <g1>Server.</g1> The lab server from this repository, on 127.0.0.1, serving generated content. It throttles, delays, refuses or cuts connections per test, and logs every request with millisecond start and end times.
646fee8a2fcc7423.text: <g1>服务器。</g1>本仓库中的测试服务器，运行在 127.0.0.1 上，提供生成的内容。它按测试要求限速、延迟、拒绝或切断连接，并以毫秒精度记录每个请求的开始和结束时间。

647a6ba9cf8c0dae.source: the <x1/> file, and its folder of icons if it has one;
647a6ba9cf8c0dae.text: 该 <x1/> 文件，以及其图标文件夹（如果有）；

64b0bbf6e3e92f4b.source: On the same PC and the same test server, DDM fetched a 1 GiB file in 1.0 s against IDM 6.42's 5.5 s, and a 256 KiB file in 0.03 s against 3.1 s: the medians of alternating runs. The <g1>benchmark page</g1> has every run, the method and the raw data.
64b0bbf6e3e92f4b.text: 在同一台电脑和同一测试服务器上，DDM 下载 1 GiB 文件耗时 1.0 秒，而 IDM 6.42 耗时 5.5 秒；下载 256 KiB 文件耗时 0.03 秒，而 IDM 耗时 3.1 秒：这些都是交替运行的中位数。<g1>基准测试页面</g1>包含每次运行、测试方法和原始数据。

64c38b8a1d0fe249.source: Yes. Copy a link to a file and DDM offers to download it at once (<g1>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g1>, on by default). You can also paste links into <g2>Add URL</g2>, drag them onto the drop target, add a whole batch, or use the command line. See <g3>Adding downloads</g3>.
64c38b8a1d0fe249.text: 是的。复制文件链接后，DDM 会立即提供下载（<g1>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g1>，默认开启）。您也可以将链接粘贴到<g2>添加 URL</g2>中，将其拖放到目标区域，添加一整批，或使用命令行。请参阅<g3>添加下载</g3>。

6506f17b28e02b13.source: Choose <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1>. It opens the bug report form on GitHub with your DDM version, your system and its version, how DDM was installed and its interface language already filled in. Describe what happened, what you expected and the steps that make it happen. For a download, include the address if you can share it, and the reason shown under <g2>Status</g2>.
6506f17b28e02b13.text: 选择<g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1>。系统会在 GitHub 上打开错误报告表单，并预先填入您的 DDM 版本、系统及其版本、DDM 的安装方式和界面语言。请描述发生了什么、预期结果以及重现问题的步骤。如果问题与下载有关，请尽可能提供下载地址，以及<g2>状态</g2>下显示的原因。

6524151cc89c5108.text: <g1>速度限制器</g1>可打开或关闭限速，或按它的某一档速度开启（每个文件 128 KB/sec 至 10 MB/sec）；<g2>设置...</g2>会打开它的窗口。

6564aaf64b6741a4.text: DDM 运行在 64 位 Windows 10 和 Windows 11，以及 64 位 Linux 上：请参阅“在 Linux 上”。macOS 版本是新推出的，仍处于实验阶段：请参阅“在 Mac 上”。

65b71efc22b4ce41.text: Linux，其他包管理器（pacman 等）的包

65da44cc551abd0f.source: <g1>Download complete</g1> shows the file's size, its address and where it was saved. Choose <g2>Open</g2>, <g3>Open with...</g3>, <g4>Open folder</g4> or <g5>Close</g5>. The window shows above your other programs until you click it, without taking the keyboard from the one you're typing in.

65fa7d8610e857e4.source: Show the finished file, or resume the unfinished one
65fa7d8610e857e4.text: 显示已完成的文件，或恢复未完成的下载

661637e7fcacdc09.text: <g1>遵循站点的 robots.txt</g1>（默认开启）：站点要求机器人不要访问的页面不会被探索，它要求的 <x2/> 会被遵守（最多 10 秒）。窗口会统计因此被排除的地址数。

Each package is a row you can open and close (click its arrow, double-click it, or press <g2>Right</g2> and <g3>Left</g3>). Ticking a package ticks all its links shown; its box is half-filled when only some are ticked.
663b4d13e8084575.text: 勾选<g1>分组为包</g1>（默认）时，链接会放在包中。每个包是一行，可以展开和折叠（点击它的箭头、双击它，或按<g2>向右键</g2>和<g3>向左键</g3>）。勾选一个包会勾选它显示的所有链接；只有部分被勾选时，它的框为半选状态。

66a39a85a0d50d8a.text: <g1>仅限 Windows 的调用放在<x2/></g1>中，Linux 和 macOS 对应的调用放在<x3/>中；工作区的其余部分使用安全、可移植的 Rust（<x4/>）。在 Windows 上，<x5/>会检查是否仍能为 Linux 和 macOS 构建。

66c91a7104a192e0.source: Each grab is kept as a project, listed under <g1>Grabber projects</g1> in the Categories pane and, the latest first, under <g2>Tasks → Grabber projects</g2>. Click a project to see the downloads it added; while it has none, the list offers <g3>Open the project</g3>. Right-click it for:
66c91a7104a192e0.text: 每次抓取都保存为一个项目，列在“类别”窗格的<g1>抓取项目</g1>下，以及<g2>任务 → 抓取项目</g2>下（最新的在前）。单击项目可查看它添加的下载；当它还没有任何下载时，列表会提供<g3>打开项目</g3>。右键单击它可使用：

66d5121e5c0e0523.source: DDM downloads BitTorrent files from magnet links and <x1/> files. Torrents appear in the same list as other downloads, marked <g2>Torrent</g2> in the <g3>Source</g3> column, and can be queued and scheduled like them.
66d5121e5c0e0523.text: DDM 可以从磁力链接和 <x1/> 文件下载 BitTorrent 文件。种子会出现在与其他下载相同的列表中，在<g3>源</g3>列中标记为<g2>种子</g2>，并且可以像其他下载一样进行排队和计划。

66e61fa9b0888d8e.source: <g1>Must not contain</g1>: words that make the rule skip an article.
66e61fa9b0888d8e.text: <g1>不得包含</g1>：使规则跳过文章的词语。

66f0a3d1e574e041.source: DDM extracts safely. A name that would lead outside the folder is left out, and so is a link to somewhere else on the disk. An archive that would write far more than its size, or more than the disk has room for, stops before it fills it. When something goes wrong, nothing but the archive is left behind.
66f0a3d1e574e041.text: DDM 会安全地提取文件。可能导致文件被写入文件夹之外的路径会被忽略，指向磁盘其他位置的链接也会被忽略。如果存档会写入远超自身大小的数据，或超出磁盘可用空间，提取会在磁盘写满前停止。如果提取出错，除了存档外不会留下任何文件。

66f0d356afa03754.text: 两个辅助程序，使用前需检查

66f7530c7179f562.source: <g1>The Download video button over the video</g1> passes that page's cookies, from the window and profile you're in (a private window, a Firefox container), for the look-up and the download. Nothing to set up. Each cookie goes with the domain the browser keeps it for, so a sign-in on YouTube Music (music.youtube.com) or YouTube's mobile site reaches www.youtube.com too.
66f7530c7179f562.text: <g1>视频上方的下载视频按钮</g1>会传递您当前窗口和配置文件（私人窗口、Firefox 容器）中的页面 Cookie，用于查找和下载。无需设置。每个 Cookie 都与其浏览器保存的域一起使用，因此在 YouTube Music (music.youtube.com) 或 YouTube 移动网站上的登录也会到达 www.youtube.com。

66fbae3c59146500.source: Median CPU time each program used during a run, and its peak memory. DDM draws its window with the GPU, which takes more memory than IDM's classic Windows controls.
66fbae3c59146500.text: 每个程序在一次运行中使用的 CPU 时间中位数和内存峰值。DDM 用 GPU 绘制窗口，占用的内存比 IDM 经典的 Windows 控件多。

67300cd45bbe6ef2.source: Borders and the hover and pressed shades are mixed from these, as for a theme file's <x1/>. Text stays readable: text and secondary text at 4.5:1 or more against every background they sit on (WCAG AA), the accent at 3:1. A scheme short of that has those colours moved a little darker (lighter on a dark scheme) until they pass; DDM's log says which.
67300cd45bbe6ef2.text: 边框以及悬停和按下时的阴影是根据主题文件的 <x1/> 从这些颜色混合而成的。文本保持可读性：文本和次要文本与其所在的所有背景的对比度至少为 4.5:1 (WCAG AA)，强调色为 3:1。如果方案不符合此要求，这些颜色会稍微变暗（深色方案则变亮），直到通过为止；DDM 的日志会说明具体情况。

673b96e2bd96f00d.source: Can it download a video's subtitles? — Dannex Download Manager
673b96e2bd96f00d.text: 可以下载视频字幕吗？— Dannex Download Manager

67519ab0fd3f2e01.source: <g1>The gallery-dl of your Linux distribution:</g1> the one your distribution ships works too, from 1.20 (Ubuntu 22.04) on. Found on its own, it gets only the options every one of those versions knows; chosen in <g2>Helpers...</g2>, the ones its version knows. From {v1} on, it lists the files for DDM's downloader; an older one downloads them all itself, as before, and the progress window says so. One found on its own is asked to list them all the same, and downloads them itself if it can't. One older than 1.20 (Debian 11's 1.17) is refused when you choose it, saying which version DDM needs; found on its own, its galleries fail, and <g3>Use DDM's own copy</g3> is the way out.
67519ab0fd3f2e01.text: <g1>Linux 发行版自带的 gallery-dl：</g1>发行版提供的那个也可使用，需 1.20 及以上版本（Ubuntu 22.04）。自动找到时，只会给它这些版本都认识的选项；在<g2>帮助程序...</g2>中选择时，则给它该版本认识的选项。从 {v1} 起，它会为 DDM 的下载器列出文件；更旧的版本仍像以前一样自己下载全部文件，进度窗口会说明这一点。自动找到的版本同样会被要求列出全部文件，若做不到就自行下载。低于 1.20 的版本（Debian 11 的 1.17）在您选择时会被拒绝，并说明 DDM 需要哪个版本；自动找到时，其图库会失败，此时<g3>使用 DDM 自带的副本</g3>是解决办法。

676c0b5817404515.source: To route <g1>everything</g1> through another network, use a VPN for the whole computer.
676c0b5817404515.text: 要将<g1>所有</g1>流量通过另一个网络路由，请为整台计算机使用VPN。

6772627df15dffba.source: <g1>Any (the system chooses)</g1> is the default. Choose an adapter instead, and DDM sends its connections through that one only. When it disconnects, or the VPN is switched off, nothing goes out another way. Running downloads stop with "… is not connected" and start again by themselves when the adapter is back. The line under the list shows the adapter's address, or that it isn't connected.
6772627df15dffba.text: <g1>任何（系统选择）</g1>是默认设置。选择一个网卡后，DDM 只会通过该网卡发送连接。当网卡断开连接或 VPN 关闭时，不会有任何数据通过其他方式传输。正在进行的下载会显示“……未连接”并停止，当网卡恢复后会自动重新开始。列表下方的行显示网卡的地址，或显示其未连接。

67840f0afc4723a5.source: <g1><g2>Browser integration</g2></g1> — the extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Helium (from the Chrome Web Store) and Firefox (it comes with DDM), which downloads it takes, and what happens when DDM isn't running.
67840f0afc4723a5.text: <g1><g2>浏览器集成</g2></g1> — 适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 和 Helium（来自 Chrome 网上应用店）以及 Firefox（随 DDM 提供）的扩展，它接管哪些下载，以及 DDM 没有运行时会发生什么。

67e3386aef4aa20f.source: <g1>The network is yours to choose</g1>: incoming connections, UPnP, a fixed port, the DHT, local peers, a SOCKS5 proxy, an IP blocklist, and one network adapter (a VPN's) with a kill switch.
67e3386aef4aa20f.text: <g1>网络由您选择</g1>：传入连接、UPnP、固定端口、DHT、本地对等点、SOCKS5 代理、IP 黑名单，以及带终止开关的一个网络适配器（VPN 的）。

680e0718914ac5b0.source: <g1>Test</g1> asks it for github.com and shows how long it took.
680e0718914ac5b0.text: <g1>测试</g1>会查询 github.com 并显示耗时。

681d0b7c714c93a1.source: Passwords (Sites Logins, the proxy, debrid accounts) are in the system's keychain, not in <x1/>; see <g2>Options → Sites Logins</g2>.
681d0b7c714c93a1.text: 密码（站点登录、代理、网盘账户）存储在系统的钥匙串中，而不是在<x1/>中；请参阅<g2>选项 → 站点登录</g2>。

6821496b26156b7b.source: IDM facts from internetdownloadmanager.com, checked October 2026; timings from <g1>our published benchmark</g1> with raw data. Spot a mistake? <g2>Tell us</g2>.
6821496b26156b7b.text: IDM 数据来自 internetdownloadmanager.com，于 2026 年十月核实；时间数据来自<g1>我们发布的基准测试</g1>及原始数据。发现错误？<g2>告诉我们</g2>。

68fd0f35e54ebeb3.source: Video and music from almost any site
68fd0f35e54ebeb3.text: 几乎任何网站的视频和音乐

692f7f557ab00a1c.text: 一个 256 KiB 的文件，从命令行下载

69441d1855ab0794.source: Download videos from YouTube and other sites — Dannex Download Manager
69441d1855ab0794.text: 从 YouTube 和其他网站下载视频 — Dannex Download Manager

6976d3a5455f9216.source: Typing the start of a name while the list has the focus jumps to the first download whose name starts with it.
6976d3a5455f9216.text: 列表获得焦点时，输入名称的开头即可跳转到名称以这些字符开头的第一个下载。

6992ffb862d0a667.source: Downloads added from the phone are like the ones you add on the computer: they go into the category's folder, follow the queues, the Scheduler and the speed limits, and go through the network adapter you chose in <g1>Options → Proxy / Socks</g1> (and stop when it disconnects). The page shows the language your phone uses when DDM has it, and follows its light or dark mode.
6992ffb862d0a667.text: 从手机添加的下载与您在电脑上添加的下载一样：它们会进入类别的文件夹，遵循队列、计划程序和速度限制，并通过您在<g1>选项 → 代理/Socks</g1>中选择的网络适配器（并在断开连接时停止）。当 DDM 支持时，页面会显示您的手机使用的语言，并遵循其浅色或深色模式。

69a483f6ff4e61cd.source: <g1>Without the setup</g1> (a zip copy): on the first start, DDM shows every language with its flag and its own name. Pick yours.
69a483f6ff4e61cd.text: <g1>不使用安装程序</g1>（zip 压缩包）：首次启动时，DDM 会显示所有语言的国旗和语言名称。选择所需语言。

69cc300453b87a26.source: Yes, with no trial, no paid edition, no ads and no sign-up. It is free software under the GNU GPL, version 3.
69cc300453b87a26.text: 是的，没有试用期，没有付费版本，没有广告，也无需注册。它是 GNU GPL 第 3 版下的免费软件。

69fd3a1b0b88ad80.source: With <g1>Options → Proxy / Socks → <g2>Network adapter</g2></g1> set, video downloads go through that adapter too, with the same kill switch as other downloads. DDM's own downloader opens its connections through the adapter as for any file; for yt-dlp's look-ups (and what it downloads itself, with the ffmpeg it starts) DDM hands it a proxy of its own on this computer, and opens every connection through the adapter, looking the names up with the DNS you chose in <g3>Options → Connection</g3> (without an adapter, yt-dlp uses the system's DNS). When the adapter disconnects, the video download stops, and it starts again when the adapter is back. Formats sent over RTMP, RTSP, MMS or FTP can't go through it and are refused.
69fd3a1b0b88ad80.text: 设置<g1>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → <g2>网络适配器</g2></g1>后，视频下载也会通过该适配器进行，并具有与其他下载相同的终止开关。DDM 自己的下载器会像任何文件一样通过适配器打开其连接；对于 yt-dlp 的查找（以及它自己下载的内容，以及它启动的 ffmpeg），DDM 会在此计算机上为其提供自己的代理，并通过适配器打开每个连接，使用您在<g3>选项 → 连接</g3>中选择的 DNS 查找名称（如果没有适配器，yt-dlp 会使用系统的 DNS）。当适配器断开连接时，视频下载会停止，并在适配器恢复时重新开始。通过 RTMP、RTSP、MMS 或 FTP 发送的格式无法通过它，将被拒绝。

6a03943201e9c5c8.source: Downloading may be against some sites' terms; that is up to you to check.
6a03943201e9c5c8.text: 下载可能违反某些网站的条款；这需要您自行检查。

6a0ee35e1c3730f6.source: <g1>Keep sharing torrents after they finish</g1> — off by default: a finished torrent stops, like any download. Turn it on to keep uploading to other peers after your download is complete.
6a0ee35e1c3730f6.text: <g1>下载完成后继续共享种子</g1> — 默认关闭：种子完成后会停止共享，与其他下载相同。启用此选项后，下载完成仍会继续向其他节点上传。

6a163792b80ffc32.source: For numbers, set <g1>Digits</g1> to the number of digits. With 3, the files are <x2/>, <x3/> and so on.
6a163792b80ffc32.text: 对于数字，将<g1>位数</g1>设置为数字的位数。设为 3 时，文件为 <x2/>、<x3/>，依此类推。

6a28da34c3c8f7fb.source: A torrent's name, files (numbered) and size; <x1/> is a magnet link or a <x2/> file.
6a28da34c3c8f7fb.text: 种子的名称、文件（编号）和大小；<x1/> 是磁力链接或 <x2/> 文件。

6a3fd2d60d46c46d.source: <g1>The DNS you choose.</g1> With a DNS other than the system's in <g2>Options → Connection → DNS</g2> (Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, AdGuard, NextDNS or your own), DDM asks it, over HTTPS, TLS or TCP, for the addresses of the servers it downloads from. That service sees those names and your IP address, under its own privacy terms.
6a3fd2d60d46c46d.text: <g1>您选择的DNS。</g1>如果在<g2>选项 → 连接 → DNS</g2>中选择系统默认DNS以外的DNS（Cloudflare、Google、Quad9、AdGuard、NextDNS或您自己的DNS），DDM会通过HTTPS、TLS或TCP向其请求下载服务器的地址。该服务会根据其自身的隐私条款查看这些名称和您的IP地址。

6a4c34b7e0c237a2.source: Does DDM collect my data? — Dannex Download Manager
6a4c34b7e0c237a2.text: DDM 会收集我的数据吗？— Dannex Download Manager

6a62948fd35c80e7.source: DDM first shows a 30-second countdown. <g1>Cancel</g1> stops it; <g2>Turn off now</g2> goes ahead at once.
6a62948fd35c80e7.text: DDM 首先会显示 30 秒倒计时。<g1>取消</g1>会停止倒计时；<g2>立即关闭</g2>会立即执行。

6a8d4472340834a3.source: <g1>AppImage <x2/></g1><g3>Any distribution: make it executable and run it.</g3>
6a8d4472340834a3.text: <g1>AppImage <x2/></g1><g3>适用于任何发行版：设为可执行后运行。</g3>

6a9ae6387d051ae5.source: An unchecked box's or radio's inside
6a9ae6387d051ae5.text: 未选中复选框或单选框的内部

6ac6201c0a62d927.source: If the DNS can't be reached, the download stops with a message naming it, unless you allow falling back to the system's DNS. Your hosts file and local names stay with the system's DNS, and video pages and torrent trackers still use it. The command line's <x1/> takes <x2/>.
6ac6201c0a62d927.text: 如果无法访问 DNS，下载将停止并显示相关消息，除非您允许回退到系统 DNS。您的 hosts 文件和本地名称仍使用系统 DNS，视频页面和种子追踪器也仍使用系统 DNS。命令行中的 <x1/> 接受 <x2/>。

6ae4b601e86ca9e4.source: Or tick <g1>Close Dannex Download Manager when done</g1>.
6ae4b601e86ca9e4.text: 或者勾选<g1>完成后关闭 Dannex Download Manager</g1>。

6ae8010c32285827.source: <g1><g2>Connections and speed</g2></g1> — the progress window, how DDM splits a file over several connections, resuming, and the Speed Limiter.
6ae8010c32285827.text: <g1><g2>连接和速度</g2></g1> — 介绍进度窗口、DDM 如何通过多个连接分段下载文件、如何恢复下载，以及“速度限制器”。

6b05e78186187bf5.source: Ctrl+F, type part of the name, then Find.
6b05e78186187bf5.text: 按 Ctrl+F 键，输入名称的一部分，然后点击“查找”。

6b0ef8e85512f319.source: Runs the new setup without its windows. An installation for all users asks for the administrator's permission.
6b0ef8e85512f319.text: 在后台运行新的安装程序。为所有用户安装时，需要管理员授权。

6b3c7f839539fc50.source: <g1>Safer files</g1>: DDM asks before writing into files already in the folder, refuses names the system can't write safely, and marks the files as downloaded from the internet.
6b3c7f839539fc50.text: <g1>更安全的文件</g1>：DDM 在写入文件夹中已有的文件前会进行询问，拒绝系统无法安全写入的名称，并标记文件为从互联网下载。

6b4467986c7630ea.text: Windows 10 和 11 · <g1>Linux</g1> · <g2>Mac</g2> 可试用 · 版本 {v1}

6b7d22e1592a5870.source: Add the addresses in the copied text
6b7d22e1592a5870.text: 添加复制的文本中的地址

6b8ecaf15a5af8ad.source: The <g1>Categories</g1> pane will read as a tree, each category with its count, open or shut, and the menu bar and every right-click menu as menus whose items can be run. Screen readers will reach every row of a list, not only those in view, with its place ("12 of 40"), and lists such as Download video's qualities and Add torrent's files will read with their names and ticks. A window will show its contents the first time a screen reader reads it, and a drop-down's choice can be set by its text. In dark mode, grey notes and error texts will have the 4.5:1 contrast WCAG asks for. <g2>View → Theme</g2> adds <g3>High contrast</g3>: black and white, a bright accent, every edge drawn, text at 7:1 or more (see <g4>themes</g4>). <g5>View → Interface size</g5> will make every window larger, from 100 % to 200 % on top of the system's display scale, with <g6>Ctrl +</g6>, <g7>Ctrl −</g7> and <g8>Ctrl 0</g8> in any DDM window, as in a browser; a window larger than the screen scrolls the rest.
6b8ecaf15a5af8ad.text: “<g1>类别</g1>”窗格将以树状结构读取，每个类别及其计数（打开或关闭）都会被读出；菜单栏和所有右键菜单都将作为可执行项目的菜单被读取。屏幕阅读器将读取列表的每一行，而不仅仅是可见的行，并显示其位置（“40 个中的第 12 个”）；“下载视频”的画质列表和“添加种子”的文件列表将连同其名称和勾选状态一起被读取。屏幕阅读器首次读取窗口时，将显示其内容；下拉菜单的选择可以通过其文本进行设置。在深色模式下，灰色注释和错误文本将满足 WCAG 要求的 4.5:1 对比度。<g2>视图 → 主题</g2>增加了<g3>高对比度</g3>：黑白配色、明亮的强调色、所有边缘都已绘制、文本对比度达到 7:1 或更高（参见<g4>主题</g4>）。<g5>视图 → 界面大小</g5>将使每个窗口更大，在系统显示缩放的基础上从 100% 放大到 200%，在任何 DDM 窗口中，都可以像在浏览器中一样使用<g6>Ctrl +</g6>、<g7>Ctrl −</g7>和<g8>Ctrl 0</g8>；窗口大于屏幕时，其余部分将滚动显示。

6b957cd1180602a0.source: How many connections does it use?

6bb51ebf202023d2.source: Yes. DDM comes with an MCP server, <x1/>: add it to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or another assistant that supports MCP, and you can ask it in your own words to list, add, pause, resume or remove downloads. It works with the DDM on your computer only, and needs the automation API on. See <g2>AI assistants</g2>.
6bb51ebf202023d2.text: 可以。DDM 自带 MCP 服务器，<x1/>：将其添加到 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code 或其他支持 MCP 的助手中，即可用自己的话要求它列出、添加、暂停、恢复或删除下载。它只能连接您电脑上的 DDM，并且需要启用自动化 API。请参阅<g2>AI 助手</g2>。

6bdc08de60ab7afe.source: A link that is already in your download list goes under <g1>Already in the list</g1>, unticked.
6bdc08de60ab7afe.text: 已在下载列表中的链接会显示在<g1>已在列表中</g1>下方，且未被勾选。

6becfe19e1421f6a.source: It uses <g1>8 connections</g1> by default. You can set 1 to 32 in <g2>Options → Connection → Each download uses up to</g2>, or up to 128 after ticking <g3>Allow more than 32 connections</g3> there. More connections help only when the server sends each one at a limited speed and allows that many from one address; most servers allow far fewer.
6becfe19e1421f6a.text: 默认使用 <g1>8 个连接</g1>。您可以在<g2>选项 → 连接 → 每个下载最多使用</g2>中设置 1 到 32 个；勾选其中的<g3>允许超过 32 个连接</g3>后，最多可设置 128 个。仅当服务器以有限的速度发送每个连接，并且允许同一地址建立这么多连接时，更多连接才有帮助；大多数服务器允许的连接数要少得多。

6c06374f20810dff.source: Each file is saved where its address says, under the folder: <x1/>. A page always ends in <x2/> so a browser opens it (<x3/> becomes <x4/>, a folder's page <x5/>, <x6/> becomes <x7/>).
6c06374f20810dff.text: 每个文件都保存在其地址所指示的位置，位于文件夹下：<x1/>。页面总是以 <x2/> 结尾，以便浏览器打开它（<x3/> 变为 <x4/>，文件夹的页面为 <x5/>，<x6/> 变为 <x7/>）。

6c48c7a6103d6ccb.source: <g1>Sort:</g1> click a column title. Click again to reverse the order, and a third time to go back to the order of addition. <g2>View → Arrange files</g2> does the same from the menu, and also sorts by what has no column: <g3>By Save Path</g3> (the folder, then the name), <g4>By Referer</g4> (the address the download was asked from) and <g5>By Parent Web Page</g5> (the page it came from, as File Properties shows it). The order is kept for the next start.
6c48c7a6103d6ccb.text: <g1>排序：</g1>单击列标题。再次单击可反转顺序，第三次单击则恢复为添加顺序。<g2>视图 → 整理文件</g2>可通过菜单实现同样的操作，还能按没有对应列的内容排序：<g3>按保存路径</g3>（先按文件夹，再按名称）、<g4>按引用页</g4>（下载请求所来自的地址）和<g5>按父网页</g5>（下载来源页面，如“文件属性”所示）。顺序会保留到下次启动。

6c5ca65c1f816eb3.source: A sign-in code to type at a service's page
6c5ca65c1f816eb3.text: 在服务页面输入的登录代码

6c66862077669c1b.source: <g1>When an address is already in the list</g1> — ask, add it with a numbered name, overwrite the old one, or open the finished one / resume the unfinished one.
6c66862077669c1b.text: <g1>当地址已在列表中时</g1> — 询问、以带编号的名称添加、覆盖旧的，或打开已完成的 / 恢复未完成的。

6c75d83757eceb3d.source: Type a feed's address into <g1>Feed address</g1> and click <g2>Add feed</g2>. DDM fetches it at once, then every 30 minutes; change that under <g3>Check feeds every ... minutes</g3>, 5 at the least.
6c75d83757eceb3d.text: 在<g1>源地址</g1>中输入源地址，然后点击<g2>添加源</g2>。DDM 会立即获取源，之后每 30 分钟获取一次；可在<g3>每隔...分钟检查源</g3>中更改间隔，最短为 5 分钟。

6c8dfc86e7f6e22a.source: Check <g1>First file</g1>, <g2>Second file</g2> and <g3>Last file</g3>, then click <g4>OK</g4>.
6c8dfc86e7f6e22a.text: 检查<g1>第一个文件</g1>、<g2>第二个文件</g2>和<g3>最后一个文件</g3>，然后点击<g4>确定</g4>。

6c96dfa865023801.source: The files go to a queue, not all at once. DDM asks which one, and that question can be turned off in <g1>Options → Downloads</g1>. From there the queue runs as many files at a time as you set, and the Scheduler can start it at night. See <g2>Queues and the Scheduler</g2>.
6c96dfa865023801.text: 文件会进入队列，而不是一次性全部下载。DDM 会询问要加入哪个队列，此问题可以在<g1>选项 → 下载</g1>中关闭。从那里，队列会按照您设置的同时下载文件数量运行，并且计划程序可以在夜间启动它。请参阅<g2>队列和计划程序</g2>。

6cbd30742f3005de.source: Download a playlist's or channel's videos one after another, into a folder named after the list inside <x1/>. <x2/> is one quality for all, as for <x3/> (by default each video's best; <x4/> = up to 720p; <x5/> = the original sound; <x6/>, <x7/>, <x8/> as for <x9/>). <x10/> as for <x11/>.
6cbd30742f3005de.text: 将播放列表或频道中的视频逐个下载到 <x1/> 内以列表命名的文件夹中。<x2/> 指定所有视频的统一画质，与 <x3/> 的用法相同（默认为每个视频的最佳画质；<x4/> = 最高 720p；<x5/> = 原始音轨；<x6/>、<x7/>、<x8/> 的用法与 <x9/> 相同）。<x10/> 的用法与 <x11/> 相同。

6cd76785e09ce46c.source: DDM takes IDM's command-line switches, so scripts written for IDM can hand it their downloads. A separate tool downloads in a terminal, and a local API lets other programs see and control the running app.

70a55d3ef8ee77ec.source: A browser fetches a file over one connection. DDM asks the server for several parts of the file at once, up to 32 connections (128 if you allow it), and keeps re-splitting: when a connection finishes its part, it takes over half of the biggest part still left, so no slow connection holds up the end. It also remembers servers that refuse extra connections and stops asking them. See <g1>Connections and speed</g1>.
70a55d3ef8ee77ec.text: 浏览器通过一个连接获取文件。DDM 会同时向服务器请求文件的多个部分，最多 32 个连接（如果允许，可达 128 个），并持续重新分配：当一个连接完成其部分时，它会接管剩余最大部分的一半，这样就不会有慢速连接拖延整个下载。它还会记住拒绝额外连接的服务器，并停止向它们请求。请参阅<g1>连接和速度</g1>。

70fe96442381041e.source: Before it continues, DDM checks that the file on the server is still the same one, so a changed file never gets stitched onto an old half. When a server can't send a file in parts, the progress window says <g1>Can resume: No</g1> before you rely on it.

70ff8475a02e3a91.source: DDM has <g1>no analytics, no automatic crash reporting, no telemetry and no advertising</g1> (a crash report goes only where you send it yourself). It never sends us your download list, the addresses you download, or anything else.

The browser extension talks only to DDM on your own computer. The details are in the privacy policy.

743d17e066ad82a8.text: <g1>DDM 比扩展新</g1>（应用商店的审核滞后，或来自 DDM 文件夹的副本尚未重新加载）：下载照常进行，因为 DDM 会像以前一样响应每个较旧的扩展，状态页会说明如何获取较新的扩展。

775acb9f997b4090.source: A browser fetches a file over one connection. DDM asks the server for several parts of the file at once, up to 32 connections (128 if you allow it), and keeps re-splitting: when a connection finishes its part, it takes over half of the biggest part still left, so no slow connection holds up the end. It also remembers servers that refuse extra connections and stops asking them. See Connections and speed.
775acb9f997b4090.text: 浏览器通过一个连接获取文件。DDM 会同时向服务器请求文件的多个部分，最多 32 个连接（如果允许，可达 128 个），并持续重新拆分：当一个连接完成其部分后，它会接管剩余最大部分的一半，这样就不会有慢速连接拖延整个下载。它还会记住拒绝额外连接的服务器，并停止向它们请求。请参阅连接和速度。

77e17e7d5be4d97a.source: <g1>Offline when you install?</g1> The setup finishes anyway, saying <g2>Some parts will finish setting up the next time you're online</g2>. DDM then gets the tools itself once it is online: right away when the network comes back, and again a little later if a download fails, without asking. The status strip under the list says <g3>Getting ready...</g3> while they come. A video you ask for meanwhile waits (its status says <g4>Waiting</g4>) and starts by itself as soon as yt-dlp is there. <g5>Download video from a page</g5> says <g6>Getting ready...</g6> too, and looks the page up once it can; <g7>Try again</g7> beside <g8>Almost ready: this finishes by itself once you're online</g8> tries at once. <g9>Helpers...</g9> shows which copy of each tool DDM uses.
77e17e7d5be4d97a.text: <g1>安装时处于离线状态？</g1>安装程序依然会完成，并提示<g2>部分组件将在您下次联网时完成设置</g2>。DDM 随后会在联网后自行获取这些工具：网络恢复时立即获取，下载失败时稍后再试，无需询问。它们到来期间，列表下方的状态栏显示<g3>正在准备...</g3>。您在此期间请求的视频会等待（它的状态显示<g4>等待</g4>），yt-dlp 一就位就自动开始。<g5>从页面下载视频</g5>也显示<g6>正在准备...</g6>，并在可以时查找该页面；<g7>重试</g7>位于<g8>即将就绪：联网后会自动完成</g8>旁边，点击会立即尝试。<g9>帮助程序...</g9>显示 DDM 使用的每个工具是哪一份副本。

77efacf2c131fb24.source: Closed to the notification area, DDM gives its memory back to Windows: <g1>Memory</g1> drops to under 10 MB within seconds and stays low while it waits. Downloads, queues and the scheduler go on as before. The list of every language (<g2>View → Language</g2>) loads fonts for every script while it's open; DDM lets them go when it closes.

78e579434cd145d4.source: <g1>Keep running when closing the window</g1> — closing the main window hides it in the notification area instead of quitting, and downloads, queues and schedules go on. On by default; unticked, closing quits DDM (so a <g2>portable copy</g2>'s folder can then be deleted). Greyed where no tray shows DDM's icon (some Linux desktops): closing quits there.
78e579434cd145d4.text: <g1>关闭窗口时保持运行</g1> — 关闭主窗口时，它会隐藏到通知区域而不是退出，下载、队列和计划会继续进行。默认开启；如果取消勾选，关闭窗口会退出 DDM（这样<g2>便携版</g2>的文件夹就可以被删除）。如果完全没有 DDM 的图标 — 甚至在 ^ 隐藏图标后面也没有 — 窗口会最小化到任务栏，这样下载会继续，窗口也保持可访问；可以点击 ^ 后面的图标将其恢复，或再次启动 DDM。在没有托盘显示 DDM 图标的地方（某些 Linux 桌面）会变灰：关闭时会退出。

78edb621758e8dc9.source: Each connection has its own HTTP client (<x1/>, <x2/>): hyper's pool sends every request to a host over one HTTP/2 connection, so a shared client would turn an HTTP/2 server's 8 connections into 8 streams of one TCP connection, at one connection's speed. On its own connection, HTTP/2 keeps its gain for a download: a part cut short by a split ends its stream, and the warm connection serves the next request. The lanes time their own silence, the waits for the disk left out (reqwest's read timeout runs while a write is held up). A connection that goes silent while the others receive reconnects after a few seconds (<x3/>) instead of waiting out the read timeout. A file up to 16 MiB starts on its first connection, and the others open once its pace says they would finish it sooner (<x4/>: a new connection costs its time to first byte); a Metalink download's mirrors are asked from the start.
78edb621758e8dc9.text: 每个连接都有自己的 HTTP 客户端（<x1/>、<x2/>）：hyper 的连接池会把发往同一主机的所有请求放在一个 HTTP/2 连接上，所以共用一个客户端会把 HTTP/2 服务器的 8 个连接变成同一个 TCP 连接上的 8 个流，速度只相当于一个连接。只有在各自独立的连接上，HTTP/2 才能保住它对下载的好处：被拆分截短的分段会结束它的流，已建立的连接则处理下一个请求。各通道自行计算静默时间，不计磁盘等待（写入被卡住时，reqwest 的读取超时仍在计时）。其他连接都在接收数据而某个连接静默时，它会在几秒后重新连接（<x3/>），而不是等到读取超时。不超过 16 MiB 的文件先在第一个连接上开始，其余连接要等到其速度表明它们能更快完成时才打开（<x4/>：新连接要花费首字节时间）；Metalink 下载的镜像则从一开始就会被请求。

790e0458e3fc7df1.source: <g1>docker/unraid.xml</g1> is a template: copy it to <x2/> on the flash drive, then <g3>Docker → Add Container</g3> and pick <g4>dannexdownloadmanager</g4>. It maps <x5/> to <x6/>, <x7/> to a share, the port 8463, and runs as <x8/> (99:100), as Unraid's shares expect. The image must be built first (above), on the server or pushed to a registry you use. If the container's log says a folder belongs to another user, give it to <x9/> once: <x10/>.
790e0458e3fc7df1.text: <g1>docker/unraid.xml</g1> 是一个模板：将其复制到闪存驱动器上的 <x2/>，然后选择 <g3>Docker → 添加容器</g3> 并选择 <g4>dannexdownloadmanager</g4>。它将 <x5/> 映射到 <x6/>，将 <x7/> 映射到一个共享，端口为 8463，并以 <x8/> (99:100) 身份运行，正如 Unraid 的共享所期望的那样。镜像必须先在服务器上构建（如上所述），或者推送到您使用的注册表。如果容器日志显示某个文件夹属于其他用户，请将其一次性授予 <x9/>：<x10/>。

79639c98d5418ae1.source: Sign-in secrets (debrid accounts, Sites Logins' and the proxy's passwords) live in the system's keychain (<x1/>, #44): Windows Credential Manager (<x2/>), the Secret Service on Linux or the macOS keychain (<x3/>). The settings keep a <x4/> reference in their place, written only once the keychain has confirmed the secret; without a keychain (or with a locked one, never unlocked for DDM) the secret stays in the settings as before.
79639c98d5418ae1.text: 登录凭据（debrid 账户、“站点登录”和代理的密码）存储在系统的密钥链中 (<x1/>, #44)：Windows 凭据管理器 (<x2/>)，Linux 上的 Secret Service 或 macOS 密钥链 (<x3/>)。设置中保留一个 <x4/> 引用，仅在密钥链确认凭据后写入；如果没有密钥链（或密钥链已锁定，且从未为 DDM 解锁），凭据仍像以前一样保存在设置中。

79a0cbc1cf868d3a.source: A theme in a folder of its own (<x1/>) can bring its icons in <x2/> and <x3/> (and, for PNG pictures, <x4/> and <x5/>, used on a screen scaled to 150 % and more), each named for what it shows (<x6/>, <x7/>…). The full list of names is in <g10>themeicons.rs</g10> (<x11/>).

7a7f1a80d67e4b64.source: In a Wayland session (GNOME, KDE Plasma and others), DDM's windows run through XWayland when it is there: Wayland doesn't let a program place its own windows, so DDM's menus and drop-down lists would open in the middle of the screen. To run on Wayland itself anyway, start it with <x1/>. If the system lacks a library X11 windows need (such as libxkbcommon-x11, which the .deb and .rpm bring but the AppImage and the tar.gz can't), DDM opens on Wayland instead; with no window system it can use, it names what's missing and the command that installs it.
7a7f1a80d67e4b64.text: 在 Wayland 会话（GNOME、KDE Plasma 及其他）中，如果存在 XWayland，DDM 的窗口会通过 XWayland 运行：Wayland 不允许程序自行放置窗口，因此 DDM 的菜单和下拉列表会打开在屏幕中央。若要在 Wayland 本身运行，请使用<x1/>启动。如果系统缺少 X11 窗口所需的库（例如 libxkbcommon-x11，.deb 和 .rpm 包会提供，但 AppImage 和 tar.gz 包无法提供），DDM 会转而在 Wayland 上打开；如果没有可用的窗口系统，它会列出缺失的组件和安装命令。

Start DDM once after moving or renaming the AppImage, or after an AppImage manager (Gear Lever, AppImageLauncher and the like) moved it, so the helper knows where to start it from.

They connect to a port on this computer only, with a secret token that changes at every start and that only your own programs can read. The API is off until you turn it on with <x1/>, and <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/> and <x6/> use it from the command line.
7bda8095d8381906.text: 其他程序可以向正在运行的应用程序请求其下载任务（以 JSON 格式），并暂停、开始、移除或删除它们。它们仅连接到此计算机上的一个端口，使用每次启动时都会更改的秘密令牌，并且只有您自己的程序才能读取。API 默认关闭，直到您使用 <x1/> 开启它，并且 <x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/> 和 <x6/> 从命令行使用它。

7bdb6a7c0d131e39.source: <g1>Faster where it counts.</g1> 1 GiB in 1.0 s against IDM's 5.5 s, and a small file in 0.03 s against 3.1 s, <g2>in our tests</g2>.
7bdb6a7c0d131e39.text: <g1>该快的地方更快。</g1><g2>在我们的测试中</g2>，1 GiB 的文件只要 1.0 s，IDM 要 5.5 s；小文件只要 0.03 s，IDM 要 3.1 s。

7beb76c0e99ab62c.source: <g1>Videos that need you signed in</g1>: <g2>Options → Sites Logins → Cookies for video sites</g2> lets yt-dlp read a browser's cookies, for pasted links. Chrome, Edge and Brave lock theirs on Windows, and the window says so; Firefox works, and so does the button over the video.
7beb76c0e99ab62c.text: <g1>需要登录才能观看的视频</g1>：<g2>选项 → 站点登录 → 视频网站的 Cookie</g2>允许 yt-dlp 读取浏览器的 Cookie，用于粘贴的链接。Chrome、Edge 和 Brave 在 Windows 上会锁定其 Cookie，窗口会提示；Firefox 可以正常工作，视频上方的按钮也可以。

7bf07491298eaae4.source: <g1>Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi</g1> can't ask for that permission at the switch, so the extension has it from the install (Chrome counts it under the access to every site the extension already asks for, so it adds no line to the install prompt and the update asks for nothing new). The switch asks nothing. DDM gets the browser's effective proxy, whoever set it (a VPN or proxy extension, a policy, the command line): a fixed server for the download's scheme (<x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>), unless the address is on its bypass list, or its proxy auto-config script (by its address or inline). With no proxy, or the system's, nothing is sent and DDM goes by its own Options. A QUIC proxy can't be shared.
7bf07491298eaae4.text: <g1>Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi</g1>无法在切换时请求该权限，因此扩展在安装时就已获得（Chrome 将其计入扩展已请求的对每个站点的访问权限中，因此不会在安装提示中添加新行，更新时也不会请求新内容）。此切换不请求任何权限。DDM 会获取浏览器有效的代理，无论是由谁设置的（VPN 或代理扩展、策略、命令行）：对于下载方案（<x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>），它是一个固定的服务器，除非地址在其绕过列表中，或者其代理自动配置脚本（通过其地址或内联）。如果没有代理，或者使用系统代理，则不会发送任何内容，DDM 将遵循其自己的选项。QUIC 代理无法共享。

7c13b99aeb6bd7c5.source: A playlist is listed whole, as its videos come in: the line above the list says how far it is ("Listing the videos: 1,200 of 6,000"). <g1>Stop listing</g1> keeps the ones listed so far, and <g2>List the rest</g2> carries on from there. If the site stops answering part-way (YouTube may, when it's asked too often), the window says after how many videos and why, and <g3>List the rest</g3> tries again from there.
7c13b99aeb6bd7c5.text: 播放列表会逐步列出其中的视频：列表上方会显示进度（“正在列出视频：6,000 个中的 1,200 个”）。<g1>停止列出</g1>会保留已列出的视频，<g2>列出其余部分</g2>会从那里继续。如果网站中途停止响应（YouTube 在请求过于频繁时可能会这样），窗口会显示已列出多少个视频以及原因，然后<g3>列出其余部分</g3>会从那里继续尝试。

7c395edd6333d2b1.source: Everything DDM doesn't take stays with the browser.
7c395edd6333d2b1.text: DDM 不捕获的内容仍由浏览器处理。

7c5ee42e360cb052.source: A torrent names the trackers DDM asks for peers. DDM doesn't contact a tracker on your own computer or your local network (<x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/> and the like), so a torrent can't make DDM send requests into the network it sits in. <g4>Add trackers...</g4> follows the same rule: it refuses such an address and tells you why, rather than keeping one that would never be asked.
7c5ee42e360cb052.text: 种子会列出 DDM 用来请求对等方的跟踪器。DDM 不会联系您自己的计算机或本地网络上的跟踪器（<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/> 等），因此种子无法让 DDM 向其所在的网络发送请求。<g4>添加跟踪器...</g4>也遵循同样的规则：遇到这类地址时会拒绝添加并说明原因，而不是保留一个永远不会被联系的地址。

7c61c4f7eb5732af.source: A filtered column's title is tinted and keeps its funnel, in blue, and the strip under the list says <g1>(filtered)</g1>. To remove every filter, click <g2>Clear filters</g2> there, or right-click a column title and choose <g3>Clear all filters</g3>. Filters last until you close DDM.
7c61c4f7eb5732af.text: 被筛选的列标题会着色并保留蓝色的漏斗，列表下方的状态栏会显示<g1>（已筛选）</g1>。要移除所有筛选器，请单击那里的<g2>清除筛选器</g2>，或右键单击列标题并选择<g3>清除所有筛选器</g3>。筛选器会保留到您关闭 DDM 为止。

7c937c28782fee15.source: The list keeps the host's link. The direct link is never shown or copied: the services forbid sharing it. It lives only in the download's resume data, and when it expires DDM asks the service for a new one.
7c937c28782fee15.text: 列表中保留文件托管网站的链接。直接链接不会显示或复制，因为服务禁止分享该链接。直接链接只保存在下载的续传数据中；链接过期后，DDM 会向服务请求新的链接。

7c9ac4a167131000.source: Browser integration is set up by DDM itself at each start (the browsers installed then are found); add the extension as in <g1>Browser integration</g1>.
7c9ac4a167131000.text: 浏览器集成由 DDM 每次启动时自行设置（会找到当时安装的浏览器）；按照<g1>浏览器集成</g1>中的说明添加扩展。

7ca06640051a11fc.source: The tray menu also has <g1>Add new download</g1>, <g2>Add batch download</g2>, the <g3>Speed Limiter</g3>, the <g4>Scheduler</g4>, the main download queue and <g5>Options</g5>.
7ca06640051a11fc.text: 托盘菜单还包括<g1>添加新下载</g1>、<g2>添加批量下载</g2>、<g3>速度限制器</g3>、<g4>计划程序</g4>、主下载队列和<g5>选项</g5>。

7ca97bd5e93217a8.source: Its progress window: each file and how much of it is here.
7ca97bd5e93217a8.text: 其进度窗口：显示每个文件及其已下载的百分比。

7cab5b043dd16bd1.source: The app and the extension <g1>send nothing about you to us</g1>. We don't run servers that could receive it.
7cab5b043dd16bd1.text: 应用和扩展程序<g1>不会向我们发送您的任何信息</g1>。我们没有运行可以接收这些信息的服务器。

7caee0cc5ae2399b.source: In Torrent settings you can turn off <g1>Accept incoming connections</g1> and <g2>Map the port on the router (UPnP)</g2>, or the DHT. Downloads still work, sometimes more slowly. With the <g3>Port</g3> box empty, DDM picks a port the first time and keeps it (another one if a program has taken it since), so firewall and router rules keep working; a port typed there is always the one used. These changes apply the next time the engine starts, so when no torrent is running.
7caee0cc5ae2399b.text: 在“种子设置”中，您可以关闭<g1>接受传入连接</g1>和<g2>在路由器上映射端口 (UPnP)</g2>，或关闭 DHT。下载仍可进行，但有时速度会变慢。如果<g3>端口</g3>框为空，DDM 首次运行时会选择一个端口并保持使用（如果此后有程序占用，则会选择另一个），这样防火墙和路由器规则就能持续生效；如果在此处输入端口，则始终使用该端口。这些更改将在引擎下次启动时生效，即在没有种子运行时生效。

7ce987620338a702.source: To take a download out of its queue, right-click it and choose <g1>Delete from queue</g1>. The download stays in the list.
7ce987620338a702.text: 要将下载任务从队列中移除，请右键点击该任务并选择<g1>从队列中删除</g1>。下载任务仍会保留在列表中。

7cefc273f40903c0.source: The highlighted (default) button; a focused button presses that button
7cefc273f40903c0.text: 触发高亮显示的（默认）按钮；如果焦点位于按钮上，则按下该按钮

7d125b4137f847e0.source: Select the download in the list.

7d17735716f7550b.source: Height of a focused text box's accent line
7d17735716f7550b.text: 获得焦点的文本框强调线的粗细

7d32e887febf85b0.source: Right-click the download and choose <g1>Refresh download address</g1>.
7d32e887febf85b0.text: 右键点击下载并选择<g1>刷新下载地址</g1>。

7d3af2ef0e680bca.source: The progress window of a download coming in over several connections
7d3af2ef0e680bca.text: 通过多个连接下载文件时的进度窗口

7d448312b2080392.source: Downloads one file over HTTP(S) or FTP(S): probe, segment planner, connection workers, resume state, per-host limits, speed limiter, checksums, proxy scripts
7d448312b2080392.text: 通过 HTTP(S) 或 FTP(S) 下载单个文件：探测、分段规划器、连接工作器、恢复状态、每主机限制、速度限制器、校验和、代理脚本

7d4f2b3dbb748727.source: <g1>Open offline copy</g1>: its saved start page, in your browser (a project whose pages work offline).
7d4f2b3dbb748727.text: <g1>打开离线副本</g1>：在您的浏览器中打开其已保存的起始页（适用于页面可离线使用的项目）。

7d7c56f97fe554b4.source: Firefox installs only add-ons signed by Mozilla, and Dannex's add-on isn't listed on addons.mozilla.org yet. Until it is:
7d7c56f97fe554b4.text: Firefox 只安装 Mozilla 签名的附加组件，而 Dannex 的附加组件尚未列在 addons.mozilla.org 上。在此之前：

7d85e3a7a0f5dbf9.source: Starts with the computer, without getting in front

7db6ec1b50e019c9.source: <g1>As the language and the system's region write them</g1> (the default) — the way DDM's language writes them (German <x2/>, <x3/>), or Windows' region settings (Settings → Time & language → Region) when your region is in that same language. In English, the system region's date order and clock, and the list keeps IDM's own date text.
7db6ec1b50e019c9.text: <g1>按语言和系统区域设置</g1>（默认）— 按 DDM 语言的写法（德语 <x2/>、<x3/>），或在您的区域使用同一种语言时，按 Windows 的区域设置（设置 → 时间和语言 → 区域）。英语则采用系统区域的日期顺序和时钟，列表保留 IDM 自己的日期文字。

7db9ed501785d447.source: <g1>Quality</g1> applies to every video: <g2>Best quality</g2>, <g3>Up to</g3> a height (each video at that height, or the nearest below it), <g4>Audio only, original</g4>, <g5>Audio only MP3</g5>, <g6>Audio only OPUS</g6> or <g7>Audio only FLAC</g7>. Without ffmpeg, only the qualities that come with their sound are offered, and no MP3, Opus or FLAC.
7db9ed501785d447.text: <g1>画质</g1>适用于所有视频：<g2>最佳质量</g2>、<g3>最高</g3>高度（每个视频下载该高度或最接近的较低高度）、<g4>仅音频，原始</g4>、<g5>仅音频 MP3</g5>、<g6>仅音频 OPUS</g6>或<g7>仅音频 FLAC</g7>。没有 ffmpeg 时，只提供带有音频的视频画质选项，不提供 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC。

7e003eeb98d38711.source: Is it really free, or a trial?
7e003eeb98d38711.text: 它是真的免费，还是试用版？

7e318a27b34c246a.source: There are several ways to give DDM something to download. Most of them end in the same window, Download File Info, where you choose where the file goes.
7e318a27b34c246a.text: 有几种方法可以给 DDM 添加下载任务。大多数方法都会打开同一个窗口，即“下载文件信息”，您可以在其中选择文件的保存位置。

7e3326f31ea1a679.source: A debrid service downloads files from file hosts on its own servers and hands back a plain link, without the host's waits, speed caps and captchas. With your account in DDM, that link is downloaded like any file.
7e3326f31ea1a679.text: 网盘服务会从文件主机下载文件到其自己的服务器，然后返回一个普通链接，没有主机等待、速度限制和验证码。在 DDM 中使用您的账户，该链接会像任何文件一样被下载。

7e65341170033bf2.source: The user guide and tutorials, this file, the benchmark data; the website makes the guide its help pages, which Help opens
7e65341170033bf2.text: 用户指南和教程，此文件，基准数据；网站将此指南作为其帮助页面，点击“帮助”即可打开

7e997f3f6fbc646c.source: The extension can't read this site
7e997f3f6fbc646c.text: 扩展程序无法读取此网站

7eb542d3a6bc3fb8.source: The file's size, when the server told it.
7eb542d3a6bc3fb8.text: 服务器提供文件大小时显示该大小。

7eb97ed779cd3652.source: Ask your assistant. DDM does the downloading.

7ebe922b703038bb.source: Select part of a page and right-click it for <g1>Download selected links with DDM</g1>, or right-click the page for <g2>Download all links with DDM</g2>: the links open in <g3><g4>Link grabber</g4></g3>, sorted into packages, where you tick the ones you want. Right-click the page for <g5>Download all images with DDM</g5> (each picture at the largest size the page offers) or <g6>Download all videos and audio with DDM</g6> (the page's players and links to such files, and the files its players played): they open in Link grabber the same way.
7ebe922b703038bb.text: 选中页面的一部分并右键点击，选择<g1>使用 DDM 下载选定链接</g1>；或右键点击页面，选择<g2>使用 DDM 下载所有链接</g2>：这些链接会在<g3><g4>链接抓取器</g4></g3>中打开，并分成若干包，您可勾选需要的链接。右键点击页面，选择<g5>使用 DDM 下载所有图像</g5>（每张图片取页面提供的最大尺寸）或<g6>使用 DDM 下载所有视频和音频</g6>（页面中的播放器和指向此类文件的链接，以及播放器播放过的文件）：它们同样在链接抓取器中打开。

7ed1a150972c9f29.source: DDM itself extracts zip archives (AES-encrypted and Deflate64 ones too), tar, tar.gz and tar.xz archives, and single <x1/> and <x2/> files.
7ed1a150972c9f29.text: DDM 可以直接提取 zip 存档（也支持 AES 加密和 Deflate64 格式）、tar、tar.gz 和 tar.xz 存档，以及单个 <x1/> 和 <x2/> 文件。

7ef4bcd5b2cb6b88.source: <g1>DDM's commands in the browsers' right-click menu → Edit...</g1> — which of DDM's five commands the browser's right-click menu shows (Download with DDM, selected links, all links, all images, all videos and audio). A browser changes its menu when you next switch to it.
7ef4bcd5b2cb6b88.text: <g1>DDM 在浏览器右键菜单中的命令 → 编辑...</g1> — 浏览器的右键菜单显示 DDM 五个命令中的哪几个（使用 DDM 下载、所选链接、所有链接、所有图片、所有视频和音频）。浏览器会在您下次切换到它时更改其菜单。

7f0cbe382b22bf78.source: Very likely: DDM speaks 86 languages, every display language Windows 11 offers, chosen on the first start or any time in View → Language. Arabic, Hebrew…
7f0cbe382b22bf78.text: 很有可能：DDM 支持 86 种语言，涵盖 Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，您可以在首次启动时选择，或随时通过“视图”→“语言”进行更改。阿拉伯语、希伯来语……

7f1e7ebaff978239.source: <g1>DDM 0.2.x with the extension from the Chrome Web Store?</g1> The store's copy needs a newer DDM: 0.2.x knows only the copy in its own folder. Update DDM with <g2>Help → Check for updates...</g2>. Until then, remove the store's copy and load the one in DDM's folder instead (<x3/>, see <g4>Browser integration</g4>).
7f1e7ebaff978239.text: <g1>DDM 0.2.x 与来自 Chrome 网上应用店的扩展程序？</g1> 网上应用店的版本需要更新的 DDM：0.2.x 仅识别其自身文件夹中的版本。请通过<g2>帮助 → 检查更新...</g2>更新 DDM。在此之前，请移除网上应用店的版本，并加载 DDM 文件夹中的版本（<x3/>，请参阅<g4>浏览器集成</g4>）。

7f2837a2015479db.source: The system's DNS looks names up its own way, and Windows may ask over every adapter. To keep the names inside the VPN as well, choose a DNS in <g1>Options → Connection → DNS</g1>: DDM then asks it through the adapter. See <g2>DNS and proxies</g2>.
7f2837a2015479db.text: 系统的 DNS 以自己的方式查找名称，Windows 可能会通过每个网卡进行查询。为了也将名称保留在 VPN 内部，请在<g1>选项 → 连接 → DNS</g1>中选择一个 DNS：DDM 然后会通过该网卡进行查询。请参阅<g2>DNS 和代理</g2>。

7f2b3156563a771b.source: Stopped, or after a restart, the download continues where it was: the service isn't sent the torrent again, and files already downloaded aren't downloaded again.
7f2b3156563a771b.text: 停止下载或重启后，下载会从中断处继续。DDM 不会再次将种子发送给服务，也不会重新下载已下载的文件。

7f333770668a1e9a.text: 工具栏按钮显示的内容

7f39a823d358a0ab.source: Install DDM; the page changes by itself. <g1>More</g1>
7f39a823d358a0ab.text: 安装 DDM；页面会自动变化。<g1>更多</g1>

7f6ce25a3c642090.source: If Dannex Download Manager closes unexpectedly or stops responding, a crash report window opens. It shows what happened, lets you read the whole report, and…
7f6ce25a3c642090.text: 如果 Dannex Download Manager 意外关闭或停止响应，会打开崩溃报告窗口。窗口会显示发生了什么，让您阅读完整报告，并且……

7f6e9b487e59c00f.source: The list shows the queue's downloads in the order they will run. The arrow buttons under it move the selected download down or up; the cross takes it out of the queue.
7f6e9b487e59c00f.text: 此列表按下载运行的顺序显示队列中的下载。列表下方的箭头按钮可将选定的下载向上或向下移动；叉号按钮可将其从队列中移除。

7f766e56cac844dc.source: The accent: focus lines, open and default controls, filters, links' focus
7f766e56cac844dc.text: 强调色：焦点线、打开和默认控件、过滤器、链接焦点

7f79702d18f48f44.source: <g1>Limits</g1>: stop sharing at a share ratio or after some minutes, and cap what torrents send, all together or one by one.
7f79702d18f48f44.text: <g1>限制</g1>：达到共享率或经过一定时间后停止共享，并限制种子发送的总量，可以全部一起限制，也可以逐个限制。

7fc6f4be3515bc1a.source: <g1>Help → Check for updates...</g1> — <g2>Check for updates at every start</g2> is in that window.
7fc6f4be3515bc1a.text: <g1>帮助 → 检查更新…</g1> — <g2>每次启动时检查更新</g2>在该窗口中。

7fce2d2d4f446d51.source: For downloads already in the list:
7fce2d2d4f446d51.text: 对于已在列表中的下载：

8000c69387905255.source: If someone already reported the same problem, the window says so and <g1>Open the reported issue</g1> takes you there, with your report on the clipboard to add as a comment.
8000c69387905255.text: 如果有人已经报告了相同的问题，窗口会显示此信息，并且<g1>打开已报告的问题</g1>会带您前往该问题，您的报告已复制到剪贴板，可作为评论添加。

8001429da879c123.source: Medians of alternating runs, measured on the server's own log. <g1>Every run and the raw data</g1>

By default DDM asks which one: pick the queue under <g2>Add to queue</g2>, and tick <g3>Start the queue now</g3> if you want it to run straight away. <g4>Cancel</g4> leaves the download in the list, in no queue.

The browser's cookies stay behind, so a download that needs you signed in to a site stays with your computer.
835dcc399b35282c.text: 在浏览器扩展中，<g1>将下载发送到 → 另一个 Dannex Download Manager（服务器）</g1>会把扩展捕获的下载，以及对链接使用的<g2>使用 Dannex Download Manager 下载</g2>，发送到服务器而不是您的计算机。浏览器的 Cookie 不会随之发送，因此需要登录网站的下载仍留在您的计算机上。

83771adf9df51604.source: Windows wakes a computer only if its power plan allows wake timers. If it doesn't, the Scheduler says so, and <g1>Change</g1> opens the setting: <g2>Power Options → Change plan settings → Change advanced power settings → Sleep → Allow wake timers</g2>. Choose <g3>Enable</g3>: <g4>Important Wake Timers Only</g4> lets only Windows' own important timers wake the computer. On laptops the setting is often off on battery, so the computer is woken only while plugged in.
83771adf9df51604.text: Windows 仅在其电源计划允许唤醒计时器时才会唤醒电脑。如果不允许，计划程序会提示，<g1>更改</g1>会打开设置：<g2>电源选项 → 更改计划设置 → 更改高级电源设置 → 睡眠 → 允许唤醒计时器</g2>。选择<g3>启用</g3>：<g4>仅重要唤醒计时器</g4>只允许 Windows 自身的重要计时器唤醒电脑。在笔记本电脑上，此设置在电池供电时通常是关闭的，因此电脑只会在插入电源时被唤醒。

85e66d381c28e0c4.source: It works as a kill switch. When the adapter disconnects, running torrents stop with "… is not connected; it goes on when it is back", and they start again through the adapter when it is. Until DDM notices (within a second), the engine's sockets are still bound to an address that is gone, so nothing can leave another way. A torrent added while the adapter isn't connected doesn't start, and says why. Tracker names are still looked up by the system's DNS.
85e66d381c28e0c4.text: 这相当于一个网络断开保护开关。适配器断开连接时，正在运行的种子会停止，并显示“……未连接；重新连接后将继续”。适配器重新连接后，种子会通过该适配器重新启动。在 DDM 检测到断开之前（最多 1 秒），种子引擎的套接字仍绑定到已失效的地址，因此无法通过其他途径发送数据。适配器未连接时添加的种子不会启动，并会说明原因。跟踪器名称仍由系统的 DNS 查询。
