8739f4cbef1f1480.source: One egui window painted to fixed pixel coordinates, plus one immediate viewport per dialog. <x1/> and its modules (<x2/>, see <g3>Source layout</g3>) hold the state (downloads, queues, settings, the list's selection) and turn menu, toolbar, key and IPC commands into actions. Each dialog is its own module and returns an <x4/> (open, closed, done with a value). A window that comes up by itself (Download complete, a message DDM tells, a question while DDM isn't the program in front) shows above the others without taking the keyboard from the program being typed in (<x5/>, <x6/>); those the person asked for take it. The windows handed over one after another (Download File Info, Add torrent, Download video) and Download complete boxes show one at a time, in one place, the next when one closes. Windows-only calls are confined to <x7/> (and its modules in <x8/>) and their Linux and macOS counterparts to <x9/> (starting with the session, the browsers' host, sounds, show in folder, the crash handler); every other file is safe, portable Rust. Fonts come from the system: Windows' Fonts folder, macOS's system fonts, fontconfig on Linux (<x10/>). On Windows, Latin, Greek and Cyrillic text is drawn by DirectWrite (<x11/>, through egui's glyph rasterizer hook): View → Text → Smooth in its natural mode, anti-aliased at the size asked for and placed at quarter pixels with the font's own advances; Classic (the default) in GDI-classic mode, so each letter's hinted shape and whole-pixel width come together. Other scripts are shaped and drawn by egui.
8739f4cbef1f1480.text: 一个 egui 窗口按固定的像素坐标绘制，每个对话框再各有一个即时视口。<x1/> 及其模块（<x2/>，见<g3>源码布局</g3>）保存状态（下载、队列、设置、列表的选择），并把菜单、工具栏、按键和 IPC 命令转换为操作。每个对话框都是各自的模块，并返回一个 <x4/>（打开、已关闭、已完成并带有一个值）。自行弹出的窗口（“下载完成”、DDM 发出的消息、DDM 不在前台时的提问）显示在其他窗口之上，但不会从正在输入的程序那里夺走键盘（<x5/>、<x6/>）；用户主动要求打开的窗口则会获得键盘。依次交出的窗口（“下载文件信息”、“添加种子”、“下载视频”）和“下载完成”框一次只显示一个，位置相同，一个关闭后再显示下一个。仅限 Windows 的调用集中在 <x7/>（及其在 <x8/> 中的模块），其在 Linux 和 macOS 上的对应实现集中在 <x9/>（从会话、浏览器的主机程序、声音、在文件夹中显示、崩溃处理程序开始）；其他所有文件都是安全、可移植的 Rust。字体来自系统：Windows 的 Fonts 文件夹、macOS 的系统字体、Linux 上的 fontconfig（<x10/>）。在 Windows 上，拉丁、希腊和西里尔文字由 DirectWrite 绘制（<x11/>，通过 egui 的字形光栅化钩子）：视图 → 文本 → 平滑采用自然模式，按所请求的大小抗锯齿，并按四分之一像素定位，使用字体自身的字宽；经典（默认）采用 GDI 经典模式，使每个字母的微调后字形和整像素字宽相配合。其他文字由 egui 排版和绘制。

874309c1d3f0920b.source: <g1>Downloads still go to the computer's Downloads folder</g1> unless you change it. To keep them with DDM, set each category's folder in <g2>Options → Save to</g2>. <g3>Carry DDM on a USB stick</g3> shows how.

87762c1628d1de13.source: On a queue's <g1>Schedule</g1> tab, tick <g2>Start at</g2> and choose a time, <g3>Once on</g3> a date or <g4>Repeat on</g4> the days you tick. <g5>Stop at</g5> halts whatever is left, for example before work in the morning. A queue can also start whenever DDM starts.

RAR's own extraction code can't be part of a free program like DDM, which is why it asks 7-Zip.

87ff7e81ac4516d8.source: What keeps the remote control safe, in short:
87ff7e81ac4516d8.text: 简而言之，远程控制的安全保障：

880dcd6570293c2e.source: Downloading may be against some sites' terms. Checking that is up to you.
880dcd6570293c2e.text: 下载可能违反某些网站的服务条款。是否违反条款由您自行确认。

88125ffc76ce682b.source: Download a video; <x1/> takes a quality's selector from <x2/> (<x3/> = the best single file; <x4/> = the sound alone as the site has it, not converted; <x5/>, <x6/>, <x7/> or <x8/> = the sound as an MP3 at that bitrate, <x9/> at its best variable one; <x10/> = as Opus; <x11/> = as FLAC, lossless but no better than the site's sound; conversions need ffmpeg). <x12/>: DDM's own downloader brings each stream yt-dlp finds over this many connections (8 by default, 1 to 128), a stream in pieces (HLS, DASH) this many pieces at once. <x13/> saves subtitles beside it: language codes from <x14/> (<x15/>), or <x16/> for every one the uploader gave; <x17/> takes the site's automatic captions instead; <x18/> puts them into the video (needs ffmpeg, MP4 or MKV). <x19/> sends the downloads' connections, and yt-dlp's (and ffmpeg's), through one network adapter, as for <x20/>; when it isn't connected, nothing starts.
88125ffc76ce682b.text: 下载视频；<x1/> 从 <x2/> 获取画质选择器（<x3/> = 最佳单一文件；<x4/> = 网站提供的纯音频，不转换；<x5/>、<x6/>、<x7/> 或 <x8/> = 该比特率的 MP3 音频，<x9/> 为最佳可变比特率；<x10/> = Opus 格式；<x11/> = FLAC 格式，无损但音质不优于网站源；转换需要 ffmpeg）。<x12/>：DDM 自己的下载器通过这么多连接（默认 8 个，1 到 128 个）下载 yt-dlp 找到的每个流，HLS、DASH 等分段流则同时下载这么多片段。<x13/> 将字幕保存到旁边：语言代码来自 <x14/>（<x15/>），或 <x16/> 表示上传者提供的所有字幕；<x17/> 改为获取网站的自动字幕；<x18/> 将字幕嵌入视频中（需要 ffmpeg，MP4 或 MKV 格式）。<x19/> 通过一个网络适配器发送下载连接以及 yt-dlp（和 ffmpeg）的连接，如 <x20/>；如果未连接，则不开始任何操作。

They are kept with the torrent, after the ones it has, and the <g5>Trackers</g5> tab shows them. A tracker on your computer or your local network is refused: DDM never contacts those (<g6>why</g6>).

8a588b9978a09377.source: <g1>Catching problems.</g1> When DDM crashes (a Windows exception, a signal on Linux, a Mach exception on macOS), panics, or freezes, it asks the monitor for a dump. A freeze is a frame of the window running more than 8 s, seen by a watchdog thread that ignores time spent asleep. It times both parts of a frame: what DDM handles (the commands that come in, the clock of downloads, queues and the Scheduler), which runs minimized too, and the drawing; never the wait between frames. The watchdog also measures how much processor time the window thread got meanwhile, and the report says what that means: it ran all along (a loop), it waited in a lock or on I/O (a deadlock), or it hardly ran in ordinary code, which is a computer too busy to run DDM or slow to load it from disk, most likely not DDM's bug (those share one signature, <x2/>). When the window thread is already back in the event loop by the time the dump is written, the freeze was over before the snapshot, so its stack can't explain it; those reports say so and share the signature <x3/>. macOS doesn't measure it yet. The monitor then writes a <g4>minidump</g4> of every thread from outside, through <x5/> and <x6/>. A crashed process never writes its own dump, which is how Firefox, Crashpad and Sentry do it too.
8a588b9978a09377.text: <g1>捕获问题。</g1> 当 DDM 崩溃（Windows 异常、Linux 信号、macOS Mach 异常）、程序异常终止或冻结时，它会向监视器请求一个转储。冻结是指窗口运行超过 8 秒的帧，由一个忽略休眠时间的看门狗线程检测。它会测量帧的两个部分：DDM 处理的部分（接收到的命令、下载时钟、队列和计划程序），这部分在最小化时也会运行，以及绘图部分；但不测量帧之间的等待时间。看门狗还会测量在此期间窗口线程获得了多少处理器时间，报告会说明这意味着什么：它一直在运行（一个循环），它在锁或 I/O 上等待（死锁），或者它几乎没有在普通代码中运行，这表示计算机太忙而无法运行 DDM 或从磁盘加载 DDM 太慢，这很可能不是 DDM 的错误（这些情况共享一个签名，<x2/>）。如果转储写入时窗口线程已经回到事件循环中，则冻结在快照之前已经结束，因此其堆栈无法解释冻结；这些报告会说明这一点并共享签名 <x3/>。macOS 尚未测量此项。然后，监视器通过 <x5/> 和 <x6/> 从外部写入每个线程的<g4>小型转储</g4>。崩溃的进程从不写入自己的转储，Firefox、Crashpad 和 Sentry 也是如此。

8e6d5328fa5fa2f0.text: 如果服务器需要用户名和密码，请勾选<g1>登录服务器</g1>并输入。

8e777a315376e404.source: The assistant can list your downloads with their status, size, progress and speed, and filter them by status or by name. It can add an http, https, ftp or ftps address and start it or only queue it, in the folder and under the name you say. A magnet link opens <g1>Add torrent</g1> in DDM, for you to choose the files. It can pause, resume and remove downloads, deleting the files only when asked, and start the main download queue.
8e777a315376e404.text: 助手可以列出您的下载任务，包括它们的状态、大小、进度和速度，并按状态或名称进行筛选。它可以添加 http、https、ftp 或 ftps 地址，并立即开始下载或仅将其排队，下载到您指定的文件夹和名称。磁力链接会在 DDM 中打开<g1>添加种子</g1>，供您选择文件。它可以暂停、恢复和删除下载，仅在请求时删除文件，并启动主下载队列。

8e82c1224fd0c1d5.source: BitTorrent and magnet links through librqbit; web seeds (BEP 19 <x1/>, which librqbit 9.1 doesn't read) served to it as a peer of DDM's own on 127.0.0.1 that fetches the pieces asked for by HTTP ranges, librqbit checking each (<x2/>)
8e82c1224fd0c1d5.text: BitTorrent 和磁力链接通过 librqbit 处理；Web 种子（BEP 19 <x1/>，librqbit 9.1 不读取）则作为 DDM 自己在 127.0.0.1 上的一个对等方提供给它，由该对等方通过 HTTP Range 请求获取所需的分块，每个分块都由 librqbit 校验（<x2/>）

8ebacedce5c28ec5.source: Add URL sends these to the gallery window: - Wikimedia Commons categories; - Flickr photographers and albums; - DeviantArt and ArtStation galleries; - Imgur albums; - Pixiv artists and works; - Pinterest boards and pins; - Danbooru and Gelbooru searches; - Tumblr blogs; - Bluesky profiles.
8ebacedce5c28ec5.text: 添加 URL 会将以下内容发送到图库窗口：- 维基共享资源分类；- Flickr 摄影师和相册；- DeviantArt 和 ArtStation 图库；- Imgur 相册；- Pixiv 艺术家和作品；- Pinterest 画板和图钉；- Danbooru 和 Gelbooru 搜索；- Tumblr 博客；- Bluesky 个人资料。

8ee5bc4bbe3c427a.source: The people behind Dannex Download Manager
8ee5bc4bbe3c427a.text: Dannex Download Manager 背后的人

8f085588eab5dbf1.source: <g1>RSS feeds</g1><g2>Follow torrent feeds, and let rules add the new episodes you want, each one only once.</g2>
8f085588eab5dbf1.text: <g1>RSS 源</g1><g2>关注种子 RSS 源，设置规则自动添加您想要的新剧集，每集只添加一次。</g2>

8f332d210170d0cf.source: <g1>Download selected</g1> adds the ticked files to the download list; <g2>Download all</g2> adds every file found. They are added as one batch: no window opens for any of them, as it is added or as it finishes. Each download carries the page it was found on as its referrer, as the browser would.
8f332d210170d0cf.text: <g1>下载所选项</g1>会将已勾选的文件添加到下载列表；<g2>全部下载</g2>会添加找到的每个文件。它们作为一批添加：无论是添加时还是完成时，都不会为其中任何一个打开窗口。每个下载都会带着找到它的页面作为其引用页，就像浏览器那样。

8f5bc00256713559.source: Nothing: the window says so, and your system's updates bring the new version.
8f5bc00256713559.text: 无：窗口会显示，并且您的系统更新会带来新版本。

8f70d98ab55b1e55.source: Hidden in the notification area, DDM hands the memory it isn't using back to the system. Task Manager's <g1>Memory</g1> for DDM drops from about 50 MB to under 10 MB there, and DDM gives memory back again every 10 minutes while it stays hidden. On Linux it does the same with its free memory.
8f70d98ab55b1e55.text: 隐藏在通知区域时，DDM 会将其未使用的内存交还给系统。任务管理器的 DDM <g1>内存</g1>会从大约 50 MB 下降到 10 MB 以下，并且 DDM 在保持隐藏状态时每 10 分钟会再次释放内存。在 Linux 上，它也会以同样的方式处理其空闲内存。

8f81187a957c46df.source: <g1><g2>Download overnight</g2></g1> — queue files and let the Scheduler start them at night.
8f81187a957c46df.text: <g1><g2>通宵下载</g2></g1> — 将文件加入队列，让计划程序在夜间启动下载。

8f815841ec6b033f.source: <g1>Test browser integration...</g1> in <g2>Options → General</g2> checks DDM's side.
8f815841ec6b033f.text: <g1>测试浏览器集成...</g1>在<g2>选项 → 常规</g2>中检查 DDM 端。

8fb3d70faa4b2bac.text: 勾选<g1>限制此下载的速度</g1>。

8fb7daff1c4ae24d.source: <g1>Add a download</g1> opens. If the clipboard holds a web address, it is already filled in. The arrow at the end of <g2>Address</g2> lists the last 20 addresses you entered; pick one to use it again. Right-click the box for <g3>Cut</g3>, <g4>Copy</g4>, <g5>Paste</g5>, <g6>Delete</g6> and <g7>Select all</g7>.
8fb7daff1c4ae24d.text: <g1>添加下载</g1>窗口随即打开。如果剪贴板中有网址，会自动填入。<g2>地址</g2>末尾的箭头会列出您最近输入的 20 个地址；选择一个即可再次使用。右键单击该框可使用<g3>剪切</g3>、<g4>复制</g4>、<g5>粘贴</g5>、<g6>删除</g6>和<g7>全选</g7>。

8fd5190974156ab1.source: <g1>Reading the dump.</g1> The monitor reads the dump with Mozilla's <x2/>. It uses the release's Breakpad symbols when they are found. A build from source can also read the native debug info beside it (its <x3/>, DWARF) when built with <x4/>; the shipped app goes without that reader, several MB. The report's <g5>Signature</g5> (for example <x6/>) stays the same across reports of one problem, and the window searches existing issues for it.
8fd5190974156ab1.text: <g1>读取转储文件。</g1> 监视器使用 Mozilla 的 <x2/> 读取转储文件。如果找到发布版本的 Breakpad 符号，就会使用这些符号。使用 <x4/> 构建的源码版本也可以读取旁边的原生调试信息（其 <x3/>，DWARF）；随附的应用不包含该读取器，因为它会占用几 MB。报告的<g5>签名</g5>（例如 <x6/>）在同一问题的多份报告中保持不变，窗口会据此搜索现有问题。

8fe7cc9878663c27.source: To watch a video while it downloads, tick <g1>Download in order</g1> (see <g2>Download in order</g2>).
8fe7cc9878663c27.text: 要边下载边观看视频，请勾选<g1>按顺序下载</g1>（参见<g2>按顺序下载</g2>）。

8ff85631a55ead59.source: With the server set up, you can ask your assistant things like "What is DDM downloading right now, and how long is left?", "Download this ISO to my ISOs folder tonight, don't start it yet", or "Remove the finished downloads from the list but keep the files". The assistant turns that into requests to DDM and tells you what happened.
8ff85631a55ead59.text: 设置好服务器后，您可以向助手提问，例如“DDM 现在正在下载什么，还剩多长时间？”，“今晚将此 ISO 下载到我的 ISO 文件夹，但暂时不要开始”，或者“从列表中删除已完成的下载，但保留文件”。助手会将这些问题转换为对 DDM 的请求，并告诉您结果。

9001d9a9ddba3f85.source: <g1>Metro</g1>: Windows 8's flat look: square corners, flat buttons and boxes, a coloured title bar with the title centred (on Windows, where DDM draws it), and one-colour icons (Microsoft's Fluent UI System Icons).
9001d9a9ddba3f85.text: <g1>现代</g1>：Windows 8 的扁平外观：方形边角，扁平按钮和方框，带有居中标题的彩色标题栏（在 Windows 上，由 DDM 绘制），以及单色图标（Microsoft 的 Fluent UI System Icons）。

9019ff06c86e5c17.source: A download manager can fill your whole connection. These steps cap DDM so that browsing, video calls and games stay smooth.
9019ff06c86e5c17.text: 下载管理器可能会占满整个网络带宽。按以下步骤限制 DDM 的速度，让网页浏览、视频通话和游戏保持流畅。

902881a3e9d2e863.source: How do I uninstall it? — Dannex Download Manager
902881a3e9d2e863.text: 如何卸载？— Dannex Download Manager

9043acfd376ea96d.source: Corner radius of egui's own widgets
9043acfd376ea96d.text: egui 自身小部件的圆角半径

906061a133fd191c.source: DDM saves how far each part has got as it goes. A download picks up where it stopped after you pause it, after the connection drops, or after Windows or DDM itself crashes. A connection that fails is retried on its own, and the table shows <g1>Retrying</g1> with the reason.
906061a133fd191c.text: DDM 会在下载过程中保存每个部分的进度。在您暂停下载、连接中断或 Windows 或 DDM 本身崩溃后，下载会从中断处继续。失败的连接会自行重试，表格会显示<g1>正在重试</g1>及原因。

908e0cc6bcc8957d.text: Dannex Download Manager 的 GitHub 页面

90a08a02d6179492.source: No. DDM doesn't break copy protection (DRM), by design. Videos that are protected stay protected. See also <g1>what DDM is made for</g1>.
90a08a02d6179492.text: 不能。DDM 的设计宗旨是不破解版权保护 (DRM)。受保护的视频将保持受保护状态。另请参阅<g1>DDM 的用途</g1>。

90c53d032e28403b.source: The checked accent under the pointer

90e8aa747b236f64.source: Can I download without the browser extension? — Dannex Download Manager
90e8aa747b236f64.text: 没有浏览器扩展，我能下载吗？— Dannex Download Manager

90f5fe16b9f31f12.source: Batch download numbered files and lists of links
90f5fe16b9f31f12.text: 批量下载编号文件和链接列表

90f994f09c15f5fa.source: With <x1/>, every command prints JSON, one object per line: a progress line every half second while a file downloads, then the path, size and time when it's done. Sizes are in bytes, speeds in bytes per second, and a failure prints an error object, so a script or an AI agent reads the result without parsing text. The <g2>formats</g2> are listed command by command.
90f994f09c15f5fa.text: 使用 <x1/>，每个命令都会打印 JSON，每行一个对象：文件下载时每半秒打印一行进度，然后是完成时的路径、大小和时间。大小以字节为单位，速度以字节每秒为单位，失败时打印错误对象，因此脚本或 AI 代理无需解析文本即可读取结果。<g2>格式</g2>按命令列出。

911baa1a13bfe282.source: The queues are on the left, with <g1>Download limits</g1> below them. The right side shows the selected queue on two tabs, <g2>Schedule</g2> and <g3>Files in the queue</g3>.
911baa1a13bfe282.text: 队列位于左侧，<g1>下载限制</g1>位于其下方。右侧通过两个选项卡显示所选队列的内容：<g2>计划</g2>和<g3>队列中的文件</g3>。

9121e1b489370681.source: <g1>Speed Limiter</g1> — a limit for this download only. See below.
9121e1b489370681.text: <g1>速度限制器</g1> — 仅用于此下载的限制。请参见下文。

91349c94fea24e71.source: It notes where page loads' redirects started and ended (in memory, for two minutes), so DDM gets the address you clicked, not only where it led.
91349c94fea24e71.text: 它会记录页面加载重定向的起点和终点（在内存中保存两分钟），这样 DDM 获取的就是您点击的地址，而不只是重定向后的地址。

91413c8d067f6992.source: <g1>All Downloads</g1> — everything, with a node per category below it.
91413c8d067f6992.text: <g1>所有下载</g1> — 显示所有下载，下方按类别列出各个节点。

9146f6e2b5b7667d.source: Some sites, YouTube among them, send each viewer to a nearby video server, sometimes one inside the internet provider's own network. If that server can't be reached from your connection, a browser quietly switches to another one, but yt-dlp on its own would give up. Before each video download DDM checks the servers in the video's links and, if one doesn't answer, switches to the next one the site lists. The download's log says when this happens.
9146f6e2b5b7667d.text: 一些网站（包括 YouTube）会将每位观看者连接到附近的视频服务器，有时是互联网服务提供商自己网络中的服务器。如果您的网络无法连接到该服务器，浏览器会自动切换到另一个服务器，但单独使用 yt-dlp 则会放弃。每次下载视频前，DDM 都会检查视频链接中的服务器；如果某个服务器没有响应，就会切换到网站列出的下一个服务器。下载日志会记录这种情况。

9189b83bf9497166.source: On <g1>Status</g1>, tick only <g2>Error</g2> to see the downloads that failed.
9189b83bf9497166.text: 在 <g1>状态</g1> 列中，只勾选 <g2>错误</g2>，即可查看下载失败的任务。

91cefe80b7f00fac.source: <g1><g2>Download a file</g2></g1> — copy a link, add it, open the file.
91cefe80b7f00fac.text: <g1><g2>下载文件</g2></g1> — 复制链接、添加链接，然后打开文件。

91d9821e91c26313.text: Dannex Download Manager 是谁开发的？

91f7b61e72ddf0bc.source: <g1>Acceleration and resume</g1><g2>A file split over up to 32 connections, re-split until the last byte, and resumed after any crash.</g2>
91f7b61e72ddf0bc.text: <g1>加速与续传</g1><g2>文件可拆分为最多 32 个连接，重新拆分直到最后一个字节，并在任何崩溃后恢复下载。</g2>

9234aa60d4155968.text: <g1>不收集遥测数据</g1>：请参阅<g2>隐私政策</g2>。

9235535325c5d83c.source: In <g1>Find file</g1>, tick what to search:
9235535325c5d83c.text: 在 <g1>查找文件</g1> 中，勾选要搜索的内容：

924459f1594756a8.source: Pick another folder in <g1>Download File Info</g1> and, by default, it becomes the category's folder from then on. <g2>Options → Save to</g2> shows each category's file types and folder in one place.
924459f1594756a8.text: 在<g1>下载文件信息</g1>中选择其他文件夹后，该文件夹将默认成为该类别此后的保存位置。<g2>选项 → 保存到</g2>可在一个地方查看每个类别的文件类型和文件夹。

92a4e4872087c6ab.source: The Chrome Web Store's: as above. The one from DDM's folder: grey, amber <g1>!</g1>
92a4e4872087c6ab.text: Chrome 应用商店的副本：如上所述。来自 DDM 文件夹的副本：灰色，琥珀色<g1>!</g1>

92abe6de5cd6999e.source: <g1>Hide tab</g1> takes a tab off this download's window and goes back to <g2>Download status</g2>. To bring the tabs back, right-click the tab row and choose <g3>Show hidden tabs</g3>; closing the window and opening it again brings them back too.
92abe6de5cd6999e.text: <g1>隐藏选项卡</g1>会将当前选项卡从下载窗口中移除，并返回到<g2>下载状态</g2>。要恢复选项卡，请右键点击选项卡行并选择<g3>显示隐藏的选项卡</g3>；关闭窗口再重新打开也能恢复。

92c40823018cb745.source: Yes. DDM comes with an MCP server, dannexdownloadmanager-mcp: add it to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or another assistant that supports MCP, and you can ask it in your own words to list, add, pause, resume or remove downloads. It works with the DDM on your computer only, and needs the automation API on. See AI assistants.
92c40823018cb745.text: 可以。DDM 自带 MCP 服务器，dannexdownloadmanager-mcp：将其添加到 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code 或其他支持 MCP 的助手中，即可用自己的话要求它列出、添加、暂停、恢复或删除下载。它只能连接您电脑上的 DDM，并且需要启用自动化 API。请参阅 AI 助手。

92f23ad4b35d3d62.source: The setup or DDM won't start
92f23ad4b35d3d62.text: 安装程序或 DDM 无法启动

92fe9e671a3616e6.source: DDM opens <g1>Download a gallery</g1> instead of downloading the page as a file. The first time, click <g2>Install the gallery helper</g2>.
92fe9e671a3616e6.text: DDM 会打开<g1>下载图库</g1>，而不是把页面当作文件下载。第一次使用时，请点击<g2>安装图库帮助程序</g2>。

9315d662b51c5629.source: <g1><g2>Catch downloads from your browser</g2></g1> — set up the extension so clicked downloads go to DDM.
9315d662b51c5629.text: <g1><g2>从浏览器捕获下载</g2></g1> — 设置扩展程序，让点击下载的文件通过 DDM 下载。

931872eeef27a13d.source: <g1><g2>Your first download</g2></g1> — a two-minute walk-through from copied link to opened file.
931872eeef27a13d.text: <g1><g2>首次下载</g2></g1> — 从复制链接到打开文件，只需两分钟。

932220e95efec82c.source: <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> appears in the list. Leave it turned on. Pin its button to the toolbar to see at a glance whether the browser reaches DDM.
932220e95efec82c.text: <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> 会出现在列表中。保持其开启状态。将其按钮固定到工具栏，即可一目了然地查看浏览器是否已连接到 DDM。

932bdecbc746c3d4.source: <g1>Port</g1>: <x2/> unless another program uses it; then pick another (1024 to 65535).
932bdecbc746c3d4.text: <g1>端口</g1>：<x2/>，除非其他程序正在使用它；然后选择另一个（1024 到 65535）。

93306d927621de67.source: Yes. They don't share settings or files. Turn off one browser extension so each download goes to one program.
93306d927621de67.text: 可以。它们不共享设置或文件。关闭其中一个浏览器扩展程序，以确保每个下载都由一个程序处理。

9335063c349851e4.source: <g1>Fix causes, not cases</g1>, and keep producers and consumers of shared data (the download list, the browser extension's messages, the catalogs) in step.
9335063c349851e4.text: <g1>解决根本原因，而非个别问题</g1>，并确保共享数据（下载列表、浏览器扩展的消息、目录）的生成方和使用方保持同步。

9389247375fa372f.source: How do I report a bug or ask for a feature? — Dannex Download Manager
9389247375fa372f.text: 如何报告错误或提出功能请求？— Dannex Download Manager

93e5e70937b50101.source: The app's answer, which is JSON already (see below).
93e5e70937b50101.text: 应用的回答，已经是 JSON 格式（见下文）。

93f24e6ba5efc95d.source: Pick a <g1>Template</g1>: <g2>All images</g2>, <g3>All audio</g3>, <g4>All video</g4>, <g5>All documents</g5>, <g6>Whole site for offline reading</g6>, or <g7>Custom</g7>. A template sets which files are collected and how deep the grabber goes; you can change both later.
93f24e6ba5efc95d.text: 选择一个<g1>模板</g1>：<g2>所有图像</g2>、<g3>所有音频</g3>、<g4>所有视频</g4>、<g5>所有文档</g5>、<g6>整个站点（供离线阅读）</g6>或<g7>自定义</g7>。模板决定收集哪些文件以及抓取器深入多少层；您之后可以更改这两项。

93f335b0185aba7d.source: Keep some speed for everything else →
93f335b0185aba7d.text: 为其他一切保留一些速度 →

93fe047e6ce08047.source: Without the API, the assistant can still add downloads, as DDM's <g1>command line</g1> can.
93fe047e6ce08047.text: 即使没有 API，助手仍然可以添加下载，就像 DDM 的<g1>命令行</g1>一样。

940b9b61593ef30c.source: <g1><x2/></g1> — the shape of text boxes, check boxes, buttons, progress bars, scroll bars, the focus mark and the title bar.
940b9b61593ef30c.text: <g1><x2/></g1> — 文本框、复选框、按钮、进度条、滚动条、焦点标记和标题栏的形状。

94280a68d863d482.source: Windows, dialogs, the toolbar, the menu bar and column headers
94280a68d863d482.text: Windows、对话框、工具栏、菜单栏和列标题

9439b503963faae1.source: <g1>Regular expressions</g1>: the two boxes hold regular expressions instead.
9439b503963faae1.text: <g1>正则表达式</g1>：这两个输入框改为填写正则表达式。

945dd1a4f985ec9a.source: <g1>Description</g1> — a note of your own. It shows in the list's <g2>Description</g2> column and Find can search it.
945dd1a4f985ec9a.text: <g1>描述</g1> — 您自己的备注。它会显示在列表的<g2>描述</g2>列中，并且“查找”可以搜索它。

9464b1100a111c0c.source: DDM on Ubuntu's GNOME desktop, with the desktop's own file icons.
9464b1100a111c0c.text: DDM 在 Ubuntu 的 GNOME 桌面上运行，使用桌面自带的文件图标。

94779d223bac3da1.source: The Scheduler didn't start the queue

949b30501b1deb8b.source: Control your downloads from your phone — Dannex Download Manager
949b30501b1deb8b.text: 用手机控制下载 — Dannex Download Manager

949e7c1956120262.source: Options → Connection: the DNS list at the bottom.
949e7c1956120262.text: 选项 → 连接：底部的 DNS 列表。

94a7f71ab168f4df.source: Debrid accounts (#44): the services' official APIs (Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox) turn a file host's link into a direct one the engine downloads
94a7f71ab168f4df.text: 网盘账户 (#44)：这些服务的官方 API（Real-Debrid、AllDebrid、Premiumize、TorBox）将文件托管链接转换为下载引擎可直接下载的链接。

94fc845655fe4463.source: <g1>No proxy</g1> — connect directly. This is the default.
94fc845655fe4463.text: <g1>无代理</g1> — 直接连接。这是默认设置。

950c43d71bd73d95.source: You can change it at any time in <g1>View → Language</g1>. More in <g2>Languages</g2>.
950c43d71bd73d95.text: 您可以随时在<g1>视图 → 语言</g1>中更改语言。更多信息请参阅<g2>语言</g2>。

9525905f481b0709.source: A white canvas, one near-black ink, emerald fills with near-black text, 6-point corners.
9525905f481b0709.text: 白色画布，近乎黑色的墨水，翡翠色填充搭配近乎黑色的文本，6 点圆角。

952f398f939aa5aa.source: Every release lists the SHA-256 checksum of each file in <g1>SHA256SUMS.txt</g1>. On Windows, compare it with <x2/>; on macOS and Linux with <x3/>. The build logs are on <g4>GitHub</g4>.
952f398f939aa5aa.text: 每个版本都在 <g1>SHA256SUMS.txt</g1> 中列出每个文件的 SHA-256 校验和。在 Windows 上用 <x2/> 比对；在 macOS 和 Linux 上用 <x3/>。构建日志在 <g4>GitHub</g4> 上。

953a64f3542b5742.source: Correct the translation in the third column and delete the row's <x1/> line.
953a64f3542b5742.text: 更正第三列中的翻译，并删除该行的 <x1/>。

954e6d3b4b30d19d.source: A theme changes how DDM looks and keeps everything where it was: the same windows, menus and buttons in the same places, drawn in other colours, shapes and icons. Each theme has a light and a dark side.
954e6d3b4b30d19d.text: 主题会改变 DDM 的外观，但所有元素的位置保持不变：相同的窗口、菜单和按钮，以不同的颜色、形状和图标呈现。每个主题都有浅色和深色两种模式。

958547a6449be61a.source: Tick <g1>Keep this limit when the download is stopped and resumed</g1> to keep this limit for the file: it applies again when you resume it later, even after restarting DDM.
958547a6449be61a.text: 勾选<g1>下载停止并恢复后仍保留此限制</g1>可为该文件保留此限制：以后恢复该文件时，即使重启 DDM，限制也会再次生效。

958664bb01cc22af.source: A torrent comes from other people's computers, not from one website. That changes what you can trust and what others can see. This page says plainly what…
958664bb01cc22af.text: 种子来自其他人的计算机，而不是来自一个网站。这改变了您可以信任的内容以及其他人可以看到的内容。本页面明确说明了...

958cbd51e99d7652.source: Download Dannex Download Manager {v1} free: one click for Windows, plus Linux packages, a Mac version to try and the browser extension. No ads, nothing bundled.
958cbd51e99d7652.text: 免费下载 Dannex Download Manager {v1}：Windows 一键安装，另有 Linux 安装包、可试用的 Mac 版本和浏览器扩展。没有广告，不捆绑软件。

95a7bc21a4aef232.source: Every release, with its notes and files, is on <g1>GitHub Releases</g1>. The source code is at <g2>github.com/Riskraptor/dannexdownloadmanager</g2> under the GNU GPL, version 3; <g3>building it yourself</g3> takes one <x4/>.
95a7bc21a4aef232.text: 每个版本及其说明和文件都在 <g1>GitHub Releases</g1> 上。源代码位于 <g2>github.com/Riskraptor/dannexdownloadmanager</g2>，遵循 GNU GPL 第 3 版；<g3>自行构建</g3>只需一条 <x4/>。

95c10421608930fc.source: The proxy's password moves to the system's keychain: Windows Credential Manager, the keyring on Linux, the macOS keychain.
95c10421608930fc.text: 代理密码会移动到系统的密钥链中：Windows 凭据管理器、Linux 上的密钥环或 macOS 密钥链。

95cd68fe730a5e09.source: And on the other desktops it was checked on:
95cd68fe730a5e09.text: 在其他已测试的桌面上：

95d9ea7a266a569b.source: The download page: pick your system's file
95d9ea7a266a569b.text: 下载页面：选择适合您系统的文件

95dadfcaa8f08124.source: The browser and DDM aren't connected — Dannex Download Manager help
95dadfcaa8f08124.text: 浏览器与 DDM 未连接 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

95e0579f795bdd56.source: <g1>Description or part of the description</g1> — your notes.
95e0579f795bdd56.text: <g1>描述或描述的一部分</g1> — 您的备注。

961eaa849deedf28.source: Download File Info for a ZIP file: its address, the Compressed category, the folder it goes to, its size, and the Download Later, Start Download and Cancel buttons
961eaa849deedf28.text: ZIP文件的下载文件信息：其地址、压缩文件类别、保存文件夹、大小，以及稍后下载、开始下载和取消按钮

962661aca0a7d432.source: Each running download has its own progress window. It opens when you start or resume the download. To open it again, right-click the download and choose…
962661aca0a7d432.text: 每个正在运行的下载都有自己的进度窗口。它在您开始或恢复下载时打开。要再次打开它，请右键单击下载并选择…

96305159e842a657.source: Every colour and size a control is drawn with comes from the active theme (#45). A theme is a light and a dark palette, metrics, control styles and an icon style (<x1/>):
96305159e842a657.text: 控件绘制的每种颜色和大小都来自活动主题 (#45)。一个主题包含一个亮色和暗色调色板、度量、控件样式和图标样式 (<x1/>)：

9641498adf0c3309.source: <g1>A Base16 scheme</g1>, the <x2/> file the <g3>Base16 and Base24 schemes</g3> come in: both the classic layout (<x4/> and <x5/> to <x6/> at the top) and the newer one (<x7/> and a <x8/> block). A Base24 scheme reads as its first 16 colours.
9641498adf0c3309.text: <g1>Base16 方案</g1>，即 <x2/> 文件，<g3>Base16 和 Base24 方案</g3> 均采用此格式：包括经典布局（顶部 <x4/> 和 <x5/> 到 <x6/>）和新布局（<x7/> 和 <x8/> 块）。Base24 方案读取其前 16 种颜色。

965276c683656c91.source: Video pages through yt-dlp and ffmpeg, image galleries through gallery-dl (run as separate programs), installed from their releases and checked against their publishers' signed checksums (<x1/>: the ones DDM can't do without); while a network adapter is chosen, their connections go through a proxy of DDM's on 127.0.0.1 that binds them to it (<x2/>)
965276c683656c91.text: 视频页面通过 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg 处理，图片图库通过 gallery-dl 处理（作为独立程序运行），它们从各自的发布渠道安装，并对照发布者签名的校验和进行校验（<x1/>：DDM 离不开的那些）；选择了网络适配器时，它们的连接会经过 DDM 在 127.0.0.1 上的代理，该代理把连接绑定到所选适配器（<x2/>）

96640d6850d00a78.source: Browsers built on them work too: Chromium and Helium take the extension as Chrome does, Brave Origin as Brave does, Zen and LibreWolf as Firefox does. On Windows, Zen has a bug of its own (see <g1>The browser and DDM aren't connected</g1>).
96640d6850d00a78.text: 基于这些浏览器构建的其他浏览器也同样适用：Chromium 和 Helium 像 Chrome 一样安装扩展，Brave Origin 像 Brave 一样，Zen 和 LibreWolf 像 Firefox 一样。在 Windows 上，Zen 自身存在一个错误（请参阅<g1>浏览器与 DDM 未连接</g1>）。

966968c5d27758d7.source: Select one or more downloads and press <g1>Delete</g1>, click <g2>Delete</g2> on the toolbar, or choose <g3>File → Remove</g3>. DDM asks first:
966968c5d27758d7.text: 选择一个或多个下载，然后按 <g1>Delete</g1>、单击工具栏上的<g2>删除</g2>，或选择<g3>文件 → 删除</g3>。DDM 会先询问：

9675f888cdb836b1.text: 选择第一个/最后一个下载

96762962430d58e1.source: The tabs stay once the torrent has finished, for as long as it is shared.
96762962430d58e1.text: 只要 torrent 仍在共享，其选项卡就会在下载完成后保留。

96a4ef9606d92b45.source: In Safari the toolbar button's click works the same way, but Safari gives an extension's button no right-click menu: open <g1>Safari → Settings → Extensions → Dannex Download Manager → Settings</g1> for the options page.
96a4ef9606d92b45.text: 在 Safari 中，工具栏按钮的点击效果相同，但 Safari 不为扩展的按钮提供右键菜单：请打开 <g1>Safari → 设置 → 扩展 → Dannex Download Manager → 设置</g1>进入选项页面。

96cec022ce66b5c4.source: Unzip the file to a folder you can write to (not straight into <x1/>).
96cec022ce66b5c4.text: 将文件解压到您有写入权限的文件夹中（不要直接解压到 <x1/>）。

96d73217192641fd.source: DDM reads MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and CRC32 checksums. Paste the code as the site shows it: there is no list to pick the kind from, as DDM tells them apart by their length.
96d73217192641fd.text: DDM 可读取 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 和 CRC32 校验和。请按网站显示的方式粘贴代码：无需从列表中选择类型，DDM 会根据其长度进行区分。

96e3a6d626144c98.source: <g1>Options → Proxy / Socks → Network adapter</g1> holds DDM's connections to one adapter, usually a VPN's (<g2>Options</g2>). The torrent engine binds every socket to it: peers (TCP, and through a SOCKS proxy), HTTP and UDP trackers, the DHT and the listening port. On Linux and macOS it binds the adapter itself. On Windows it binds the adapter's address (its IPv4 one when it has one), and Windows sends a packet only through the adapter that has its source address. UPnP and local peer discovery are turned off then, because they talk to the local network rather than through the adapter.
96e3a6d626144c98.text: <g1>选项 → 代理/Socks → 网络适配器</g1>可将 DDM 的连接绑定到一个适配器，通常是 VPN 适配器（<g2>选项</g2>）。种子引擎会将每个套接字绑定到该适配器：包括对等方连接（TCP，以及通过 SOCKS 代理的连接）、HTTP 和 UDP 跟踪器、DHT，以及监听端口。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，它会绑定适配器本身。在 Windows 上，它会绑定适配器的地址（如果有 IPv4 地址，则绑定该地址）；Windows 只会通过拥有该源地址的适配器发送数据包。此时会关闭 UPnP 和本地对等方发现，因为它们通过本地网络通信，而不是通过该适配器通信。

970641facab3170c.source: <g1>Move/Rename</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+M</g2>) moves or renames the file of a finished download, or of one that hasn't started yet. With several downloads selected it asks for a folder and moves them all there, each under its own name.
970641facab3170c.text: <g1>移动/重命名</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+M</g2>) 用于移动或重命名已完成下载的文件，或尚未开始下载的文件。如果选中了多个下载任务，它会要求选择一个文件夹，然后将所有文件移动到该文件夹，每个文件保留其原有名称。

97383cda956e06f9.source: <g1>The installer</g1> (<x2/>), the one to pick unless you have a reason not to. It installs for you alone without administrator rights, or for everyone, and can set up browser integration and open <x3/> files and magnet links with DDM.
97383cda956e06f9.text: <g1>安装程序</g1> (<x2/>)，除非您有特殊原因，否则请选择此项。它无需管理员权限即可为您个人或所有用户安装，并可设置浏览器集成，以及使用 DDM 打开 <x3/> 文件和磁力链接。

97408a3a460ac468.source: Untick what you don't want, then Download Now.
97408a3a460ac468.text: 取消勾选不想要的文件，然后点击“立即下载”。

97500b52b4a33a3e.source: Many sites publish their new torrents as an RSS or Atom feed. DDM watches the feeds you follow, lists what they hold, and its rules add the new torrents you want by themselves.
97500b52b4a33a3e.text: 许多网站以 RSS 或 Atom 源的形式发布新种子。DDM 会监控您关注的订阅源，列出其中的内容，并根据其规则自动添加您想要的新种子。

9757a8b628979f6a.source: The list shows each quality with its size, best first, and the sound alone at the end. Check <g1>Save to</g1> and <g2>File name</g2>, then click <g3>Download Now</g3>, or <g4>Later</g4> to put it in the list for later. The video gets its own row and progress window, like any other download.
9757a8b628979f6a.text: 列表会显示各种画质及其大小，最佳画质排在最前面，纯音频排在最后。检查<g1>保存到</g1>和<g2>文件名</g2>，然后点击<g3>立即下载</g3>，或点击<g4>稍后</g4>将其添加到稍后下载列表。视频会像其他下载一样，拥有独立的行和进度窗口。

976e1bc04dee0c02.source: Both the address you clicked and the one its redirects led to are checked, so a site you excluded stays excluded even when it sends you to another server. Everything else stays with the browser. Changes in Options reach the browser within a minute; you don't need to restart it.
976e1bc04dee0c02.text: 系统会检查您点击的地址以及重定向后的地址，因此即使被排除的网站将您重定向到另一台服务器，该网站仍会被排除。其他所有下载仍由浏览器处理。选项中的更改会在一分钟内同步到浏览器，无需重启浏览器。

9772287c22790a58.source: Unzip it onto the stick, for example to <x1/>.
9772287c22790a58.text: 将其解压到 U 盘上，例如解压到<x1/>。

97b923935fd6ed95.text: DDM 会收集我的数据吗？

97c670ad821220a9.source: Unzip it where you want DDM to live, for example <x1/> on a USB stick.
97c670ad821220a9.text: 将其解压到您希望 DDM 存放的位置，例如 U 盘上的 <x1/>。

97de26efb1e196ce.source: The <g1>Q</g1> column now shows a queue icon for each of them.
97de26efb1e196ce.text: <g1>Q</g1>列现在会为每个下载显示一个队列图标。

97df160b348bfb2f.source: Select the downloads in the box

980436929d94cbf9.source: A download that stopped halfway doesn't have to start over. DDM keeps what it has and continues from there.
980436929d94cbf9.text: 中途停止的下载不必重新开始。DDM 会保留已下载的部分，并从那里继续。

981faeae41148137.source: Check the folder, then Start Download.
981faeae41148137.text: 检查文件夹，然后点击“开始下载”。

982812ef66b913d5.source: <g1>Status</g1> — what it is doing, the address to open on the phone, and the certificate's fingerprint.
982812ef66b913d5.text: <g1>状态</g1> — 当前正在做什么、手机上要打开的地址以及证书的指纹。

983aeac80361dee3.source: <g1>Toolbar icons</g1>: <g2>Line</g2> (thin coloured lines), <g3>3D</g3> (glossy pictures) or <g4>The theme's own</g4> (Metro's, Adwaita's, Breeze's, Luna's, Aero's and Aqua's). Also in <g5>View → Toolbar</g5>.
983aeac80361dee3.text: <g1>工具栏图标</g1>：<g2>线条</g2>（细的彩色线条）、<g3>3D</g3>（带光泽的图片）或<g4>主题自带的</g4>（现代、Adwaita、Breeze、Luna、Aero 和 Aqua 的）。也可在<g5>视图 → 工具栏</g5>中设置。

98471ddc759bbcb3.source: On the web page, start the download again, or copy the new download link (right-click → <g1>Copy link</g1>). If the browser hands the new download to DDM, cancel it there: you only need the address.
98471ddc759bbcb3.text: 在网页上，再次开始下载，或复制新的下载链接（右键点击 → <g1>复制链接</g1>）。如果浏览器将新下载交给 DDM，请在那里取消它：您只需要地址。

989684c83eea8b0b.source: <g1>Aero</g1>: Windows 7's look: glossy buttons that turn light blue under the pointer, quiet check boxes, a glossy green progress bar, a glassy title bar with the title on a soft glow (on Windows), and glossy icons drawn for DDM in that manner.
989684c83eea8b0b.text: <g1>Aero</g1>：Windows 7 的外观：光泽按钮，指针悬停时变为浅蓝色，低调的复选框，光泽绿色进度条，玻璃质感标题栏，标题带有柔和光晕（在 Windows 上），以及为 DDM 绘制的光泽图标。

989d0a3e3e184d6f.source: On the phone, on the same Wi-Fi: scan the QR code with the camera (or type the address).
989d0a3e3e184d6f.text: 在手机上，连接同一 Wi-Fi：用相机扫描二维码（或输入地址）。

989f471f8d0c0cca.source: The website's <g1>Themes page</g1> has a prompt you can give an AI assistant, with the format, every key and the rules, to write a theme for you from a description.
989f471f8d0c0cca.text: 网站的<g1>主题页面</g1>提供了一个您可以提供给 AI 助手的提示，其中包含格式、所有键和规则，以便根据描述为您编写主题。

98b77f378859b820.source: It notes the addresses of video streams (HLS and DASH playlists) and of video and sound files a page's players load, in memory for that tab, so the <g1>Download video</g1> button and the right-click menu can pass them on. Its button reads the page only to find video and sound players and place itself, and, for its menu, the qualities the player or its stream lists (on YouTube, what the player says it plays and its formats). Clicking it passes the page's address, the video's address, the page's title, the site's cookies, the page that embeds the player and your browser's User-Agent to DDM. So that the qualities are ready when you click, it passes the same when the pointer reaches the button, or rests over the video on that video's own page; never from a private window.
98b77f378859b820.text: 它会在内存中为该标签页记录页面播放器加载的视频流（HLS 和 DASH 播放列表）以及视频和音频文件的地址，以便<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮和右键菜单可以将其传递出去。其按钮读取页面只是为了找到视频和音频播放器并放置自己，以及（对于其菜单）读取播放器或其流所列出的画质（在 YouTube 上，是播放器所说的可播放内容及其格式）。单击它会将页面的地址、视频的地址、页面的标题、站点的 Cookie、嵌入播放器的页面以及您浏览器的 User-Agent 传递给 DDM。为了让画质在您单击时已准备好，当指针移到按钮上，或在该视频自己的页面上的视频上停留时，它也会传递同样的内容；绝不会来自隐私窗口。

98ba5822f64ea0d2.source: Mac OS X's feel: gel buttons round at the ends, a blue focus ring and a blue gel progress bar.
98ba5822f64ea0d2.text: Mac OS X 的感觉：两端圆润的凝胶按钮、蓝色焦点环和蓝色凝胶进度条。

98cabd18b288ca1d.source: Yes, built in: open a .torrent file or paste a magnet link, tick the files you want in the folder tree, and the torrent downloads in the same list as everything else, with its peers, trackers and pieces one tab away. See Torrents.
98cabd18b288ca1d.text: 是，内置支持：打开 .torrent 文件或粘贴磁力链接，在文件夹树中勾选所需文件，种子下载会与其他下载显示在同一列表中，其对等节点、跟踪器和分块信息只需切换一个选项卡即可查看。请参阅“种子”页面。

98d5e27c784a055e.source: When the queue is done: open a file, quit DDM, or turn the computer off.
98d5e27c784a055e.text: 队列完成后：打开文件、退出 DDM 或关闭计算机。

98ee44f0be07d8d6.text: 选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 网卡

98f8f3a8ba59b632.source: comes with every download of DDM and works without the app running. <x1/> downloads a file over several connections with a progress line, <g2>Ctrl+C</g2> pauses it and <x3/> carries on later. <x4/> downloads a video, and <x5/> a torrent or only some of its files. <x6/> and <x7/> say what there is to choose before you download. <x8/> lists every option, and a command that fails exits with code 1.
98f8f3a8ba59b632.text: 随 DDM 的每次下载附带，无需应用程序运行即可工作。<x1/> 通过多个连接下载文件，并显示进度条，<g2>Ctrl+C</g2> 暂停，<x3/> 稍后继续。<x4/> 下载视频，<x5/> 下载种子或仅下载其部分文件。<x6/> 和 <x7/> 说明下载前有哪些选项可供选择。<x8/> 列出所有选项，失败的命令将以代码 1 退出。

990ac76c42b765ec.source: Give the video's page address to <g1>Add URL</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>). DDM recognises video pages and opens the video window, already looking the page up.
990ac76c42b765ec.text: 将视频页面地址输入<g1>添加 URL</g1>（<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>）。DDM 会识别视频页面并打开视频窗口，同时开始查找该页面。

990eebff0153d94b.source: How dates and times are written in the list of downloads, the Scheduler and Statistics.
990eebff0153d94b.text: 下载列表、计划程序和统计信息中日期和时间的写法。

995f8de8c1aac52c.source: <g1>Delete</g1> — remove a category, your own or a built-in one (not General or Torrents). DDM asks what happens to its downloads: <g2>Move its downloads to General</g2>, or <g3>Remove its downloads from the list</g3> (a download that is running moves to General instead). Their files stay where they are either way. From then on, files of its types go to another category that has them, or to General.
995f8de8c1aac52c.text: <g1>删除</g1> — 删除自定义类别或内置类别（常规和种子类别除外）。DDM 会询问如何处理该类别中的下载：<g2>将其下载移动到“常规”</g2>，或<g3>从列表中删除其下载</g3>（正在进行的下载会改为移至“常规”）。无论选择哪种方式，文件都会保留在原处。之后，该类别所含文件类型的文件会归入其他包含这些类型的类别，或归入“常规”。

99605902518653e2.source: The same programs without an installer. It keeps its data in <x1/>, like an installed copy.
99605902518653e2.text: 不带安装程序的程序。它将数据保存在 <x1/> 中，就像已安装的版本一样。

9980d7b09f417fc4.source: DDM's icon in the top bar of Ubuntu's GNOME, its menu open: Open DDM, Add new download, Add batch download, Downloads in progress, Speed Limiter, Scheduler, the main queue, Options and Exit
9980d7b09f417fc4.text: Ubuntu GNOME 顶部栏中的 DDM 图标，其菜单已打开：打开 DDM、添加新下载、添加批量下载、正在进行的下载、速度限制器、计划程序、主队列、选项和退出

999042cdd3edbcf1.source: Who the app talks to, and why
999042cdd3edbcf1.text: 应用与谁通信，以及原因

9996301ba94de649.text: 下载面板设置：按钮的开启或关闭，以及它从不显示的网站

9996e70b2743bdbf.text: 免费的 DDM 扩展会将您点击的每个下载任务交给 DDM，同时附带来源页面和您在该网站的登录信息。视频上方的按钮也会将视频发送到 DDM。

99c3f60a725ee399.source: <g1><g2>Video downloads</g2></g1> — download a video from its page (YouTube, Vimeo and many more) with yt-dlp.
99c3f60a725ee399.text: <g1><g2>视频下载</g2></g1> — 使用 yt-dlp 从视频页面（YouTube、Vimeo 等）下载视频。

99e97ad515986dce.source: Options on its Sites Logins page: a list of sites with their user names
99e97ad515986dce.text: “选项”的“站点登录”页面：带有用户名的网站列表。

9a26fd6f740cf884.source: <g1>Show details >></g1> (open by default) adds the connection view:
9a26fd6f740cf884.text: <g1>显示详情 >></g1>（默认打开）会添加连接视图：

9a37e805240604f2.source: Set <g1>Limit each download to</g1> in KBytes/sec. It starts at 10, so set it before you turn the limiter on.
9a37e805240604f2.text: 以 KB/s 为单位设置<g1>将每个下载限制为</g1>。它起初为 10，因此请在开启限制器之前设置它。

9a67d2830eed6ffa.source: Show links of every kind (<g1>Alt+1</g1>), or of one kind: video, audio, archives, documents, programs, images, other
9a67d2830eed6ffa.text: 显示所有类型的链接（<g1>Alt+1</g1>），或某一类型的链接：视频、音频、压缩包、文档、程序、图像、其他

9a7aa1f60dbf9dbd.source: Keep <x1/> and the one <x2/> (the keyboard shortcut letter) as they are.
9a7aa1f60dbf9dbd.text: 保留<x1/>和唯一的<x2/>（键盘快捷键字母），不要更改。

9a946958fe91d2d6.source: Right-click and choose <g1>Add to queue → Main download queue</g1>.
9a946958fe91d2d6.text: 右键点击并选择<g1>添加到队列 → 主下载队列</g1>。

9aaff800d23a7c48.source: A link the service can't give says why in the list: sign in again, premium needed, the host is down (DDM tries again later), the file is gone, and so on.
9aaff800d23a7c48.text: 如果服务无法提供链接，列表会说明原因，例如需要重新登录、需要高级帐户、文件托管网站不可用（DDM 会稍后重试）或文件已不存在。

9ab2283e83608818.source: Before you click <g1>OK</g1>, the window shows the <g2>First file</g2>, <g3>Second file</g3> and <g4>Last file</g4>, so a typo shows up before anything downloads. If the server needs a login, tick <g5>Log in to the server</g5>. Copied the address already? <g6>Tasks → Add batch download from clipboard</g6> fills it in.
9ab2283e83608818.text: 在单击<g1>确定</g1>之前，窗口会显示<g2>第一个文件</g2>、<g3>第二个文件</g3>和<g4>最后一个文件</g4>，因此在下载任何内容之前就能发现输入错误。如果服务器需要登录，请勾选<g5>登录服务器</g5>。已经复制了地址？<g6>任务 → 从剪贴板添加批处理下载</g6>会自动填入。

9ac831e3083f5953.text: 其“代理/SOCKS”页面上的选项：无代理、使用系统设置、使用配置脚本和使用此代理服务器

9ad6d79bda135a68.text: 下载加速与防崩溃续传

9b13534b69e87859.source: <g1>Torrents</g1> are peer to peer: other people in a torrent's swarm see your IP address, as with every torrent client.
9b13534b69e87859.text: <g1>种子</g1>是点对点的：洪流群中的其他人会看到您的 IP 地址，所有洪流客户端都是如此。

9b3077cadf5c65e0.source: Start DDM yourself and try the download again.
9b3077cadf5c65e0.text: 启动 DDM，然后重试下载。

9b364ec1f04b6971.source: For those, a new speed limit starts the download again with it, from where it was (<g1>Speed limits</g1>).
9b364ec1f04b6971.text: 对于这些视频，新的速度限制会从停止的地方重新开始下载（<g1>速度限制</g1>）。

9b3dde1851a80204.source: <g1>Match case</g1> tells capitals apart. <g2>Match whole string only</g2> finds only an exact, complete match.
9b3dde1851a80204.text: <g1>区分大小写</g1> 会区分大小写字母。<g2>只匹配整个字符串</g2> 只查找精确、完整的匹配项。

9b47af5a9641c752.source: To check DDM's side, open <g1>Options → General</g1> in DDM and click <g2>Test browser integration...</g2>. It checks that browser integration is on, that this is the installed copy, that the browsers can find DDM, and which browsers' extension has connected (and which copy: the Chrome Web Store's, or the one loaded from DDM's folder); <g3>How to fix it</g3> opens the section for the first that fails.
9b47af5a9641c752.text: 要检查 DDM 一侧，请在 DDM 中打开<g1>选项 → 常规</g1>并单击<g2>测试浏览器集成...</g2>。它会检查浏览器集成是否开启、这是否为已安装的副本、浏览器能否找到 DDM，以及哪些浏览器的扩展已连接（以及是哪个副本：Chrome 应用商店的，还是从 DDM 文件夹加载的）；<g3>如何修复</g3>会打开第一个失败项对应的部分。

9b65b545fb1be7e5.text: 勾选 / 取消勾选显示的所有链接

9b6e0916bcbf22ba.source: A connection that fails is retried on its own. The progress window's table shows <g1>Retrying</g1> and the reason.
9b6e0916bcbf22ba.text: 连接失败时会自动重试。进度窗口的表格会显示<g1>正在重试</g1>和重试原因。

9b8f479386883793.source: Most translations were made by machine and are waiting for a native speaker. If DDM speaks your language a little oddly, you can fix it in a few minutes, no programming needed:
9b8f479386883793.text: 大多数翻译由机器完成，正等待母语人士校对。如果 DDM 的中文听起来有点奇怪，您可以在几分钟内修正它，无需编程：

9bb035da4696ddfc.source: A <x1/> file is sent as its magnet link (its hash, its name and its trackers). Every file of the torrent is downloaded; the service fetches the whole torrent.
9bb035da4696ddfc.text: <x1/>文件会以磁力链接的形式发送，其中包含哈希值、名称和跟踪器。种子中的所有文件都会下载；服务会获取整个种子。

9bb3d17ebf50acad.source: Install or update the helpers videos need: yt-dlp (checked against its signing key) and ffmpeg (Windows; on macOS and Linux DDM uses the system's).
9bb3d17ebf50acad.text: 安装或更新下载视频所需的辅助工具：yt-dlp（使用其签名密钥验证）和 ffmpeg（适用于 Windows；在 macOS 和 Linux 上，DDM 使用系统自带的 ffmpeg）。

9bb97350926cc022.source: Open <g1>Tasks → RSS feeds...</g1>, type a feed's address into <g2>Feed address</g2> and click <g3>Add feed</g3>. DDM fetches it at once, then every 30 minutes, or as often as you set, down to every 5. Pick a feed to see its articles: one with a torrent shows a torrent icon, and its size when the feed gives it. Double-click an article to open <g4>Add torrent</g4> with it, as for any <g5>torrent</g5>.
9bb97350926cc022.text: 打开<g1>任务 → RSS 源...</g1>，在<g2>订阅源地址</g2>中输入订阅源地址，然后点击<g3>添加订阅源</g3>。DDM 会立即获取它，然后每 30 分钟获取一次，或者按照您设置的频率（最短 5 分钟）获取。选择一个订阅源以查看其文章：带有种子图标的文章会显示种子图标，并在订阅源提供时显示其大小。双击文章以使用它打开<g4>添加种子</g4>，就像任何<g5>种子</g5>一样。

9bc63b6329de1038.source: Two copies of the extension in one browser
9bc63b6329de1038.text: 同一个浏览器中有两个扩展副本

9be7deca7d13f40b.source: Keys to force or prevent capture
9be7deca7d13f40b.text: 强制或阻止捕获的按键

9c136b22fe1f1d61.source: DDM is made by its contributors on <g1>GitHub</g1>. It is free software under the GNU GPL, version 3, and open to contributions from anyone. Bug reports, translations and code are all welcome.
9c136b22fe1f1d61.text: DDM 由贡献者在 <g1>GitHub</g1> 上共同开发。它是遵循 GNU GPL 第 3 版的自由软件，欢迎任何人参与贡献。无论是错误报告、翻译还是代码，我们都欢迎。

9c1cda1d769c9ac5.source: The keys are the ones Windows users already know. <g1>Ctrl+N</g1> adds a download, <g2>Ctrl+F</g2> finds one, <g3>Enter</g3> opens it and <g4>Alt+Enter</g4> shows its <g5>Properties</g5>. <g6>F10</g6> or <g7>Alt</g7> opens the menus, and the underlined letters run their items. <g8>Shift+F10</g8> or the <g9>Menu</g9> key opens the selected download's menu. <g10>Tab</g10> moves between the <g11>Categories</g11> tree and the list, and the tree answers the arrow keys.
9c1cda1d769c9ac5.text: 按键是 Windows 用户已经熟悉的。<g1>Ctrl+N</g1> 添加下载，<g2>Ctrl+F</g2> 查找下载，<g3>Enter</g3> 打开下载，<g4>Alt+Enter</g4> 显示其<g5>属性</g5>。<g6>F10</g6> 或 <g7>Alt</g7> 打开菜单，带下划线的字母执行其项目。<g8>Shift+F10</g8> 或 <g9>菜单</g9> 键打开所选下载的菜单。<g10>Tab</g10> 在<g11>类别</g11>树和列表之间移动，树形视图响应方向键。

9c2a25b113f100c0.source: Dannex Download Manager's crash and freeze reports: readable, free of your addresses and file names, and sent only by you, through your browser and GitHub.
9c2a25b113f100c0.text: Dannex Download Manager 的崩溃和冻结报告：可读，不含您的地址和文件名，并且仅由您通过浏览器和 GitHub 发送。

9c4861e08c9b1cf2.source: Download manager command line and automation API
9c4861e08c9b1cf2.text: 下载管理器命令行和自动化 API

9c5c6fbd0cb66ec8.source: <g1>Turn the limiter on whenever Dannex Download Manager starts</g1> turns it on each time DDM starts.
9c5c6fbd0cb66ec8.text: <g1>每次 Dannex Download Manager 启动时开启限制器</g1>会在每次 DDM 启动时将其开启。

9c9751edd8659026.source: Close the dialog (an open drop-down list first)
9c9751edd8659026.text: 关闭对话框（如果下拉列表已打开，则先关闭下拉列表）

9cc13727be8e757c.source: <g1>Fairness.</g1> The programs alternate, IDM first on even runs and DDM first on odd ones, so drift on the machine hits both. One warm-up run each is discarded. Failed runs are counted, not dropped. Before every run the harness waits until the loopback is quiet: against a server that refuses extra connections IDM retries about 250 times a second, leaving thousands of closed sockets for half a minute; without the wait, whichever program ran next was timed on that backlog.
9cc13727be8e757c.text: <g1>公平性。</g1>两个程序交替运行，偶数次 IDM 先跑，奇数次 DDM 先跑，这样机器上的波动对两者的影响相同。每个程序各有一次预热运行，结果弃用。失败的运行会计入，不会丢弃。每次运行前，测试程序都会等本地回环安静下来：面对拒绝多余连接的服务器时，IDM 每秒重试约 250 次，会留下数千个已关闭的套接字，持续半分钟；若不等待，接着运行的程序就会在这些积压下计时。

9cd6c290fcd2830b.source: <g1>When an address stops working</g1>: a video's addresses are signed and expire after a few hours (YouTube's after six). DDM asks yt-dlp for a fresh one for the same quality and carries on from where it stopped.
9cd6c290fcd2830b.text: <g1>当地址失效时</g1>：视频地址经过签名，并在几小时后过期（YouTube 的地址在六小时后过期）。DDM 会向 yt-dlp 请求相同质量的新地址，并从停止的地方继续。

9cde19e93226436f.source: The same list is in DDM under <g1>Help → Keyboard shortcuts</g1>, and the menus show each command's keys beside it. On a Mac, <g2>⌘</g2> (Command) takes the place of <g3>Ctrl</g3>: <g4>⌘N</g4> adds a download.
9cde19e93226436f.text: DDM 中也有同样的列表，位于<g1>帮助 → 键盘快捷方式</g1>下；菜单中会在每个命令旁显示对应的快捷键。在 Mac 上，<g2>⌘</g2> (Command) 代替 <g3>Ctrl</g3>：<g4>⌘N</g4> 可添加下载。

9ce84c07ab18260e.source: The new address has to point at the same file. If it doesn't, DDM stops with <g1>the file changed on the server</g1>.
9ce84c07ab18260e.text: 新地址必须指向同一个文件。如果不是，DDM 会停止并显示<g1>服务器上的文件已更改</g1>。

9d1326816ebdec07.source: Firefox forgets the extension after a restart
9d1326816ebdec07.text: Firefox 重启后会忘记扩展程序

9d148e6408c5dc4e.source: : each report (<x1/>) and its crash data (<x2/>);
9d148e6408c5dc4e.text: ：每个报告 (<x1/>) 及其崩溃数据 (<x2/>)；

9d218a03ea7f9cde.source: <g1>Resize a column:</g1> drag the line between two titles; double-click it to fit the column to its contents. A column can't be made narrower than its title's start and "...": it stops there.
9d218a03ea7f9cde.text: <g1>调整列宽：</g1>拖动两个标题之间的线；双击它可使列宽适应其内容。列不能比其标题的开头和“...”更窄：到那里就停止了。

9d84f106d2cfbe3e.source: Is the extension loaded and turned on? Look for <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> on the browser's extensions page. In Firefox, a temporary add-on is gone after a restart: <g2>Browser integration</g2> says how to keep it. See <g3>Browser integration</g3>.
9d84f106d2cfbe3e.text: 扩展是否已加载并开启？请在浏览器的扩展页面上查找 <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1>。在 Firefox 中，临时附加组件在重启后就会消失：<g2>浏览器集成</g2>说明了如何保留它。请参阅<g3>浏览器集成</g3>。

9d9b0077f981e653.source: <g1>For Firefox <x2/></g1><g3>Until it's on addons.mozilla.org: Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR take it, or any Firefox until it closes (<g4>the steps</g4>).</g3>
9d9b0077f981e653.text: <g1>适用于 Firefox <x2/></g1><g3>在登上 addons.mozilla.org 之前：Developer Edition、Nightly 或 ESR 可直接安装，其他 Firefox 也可临时安装，直到关闭为止（<g4>操作步骤</g4>）。</g3>

9d9b6d291dfca165.source: <g1>Each download uses up to</g1> — how many connections each download may use, from 1 to 32 (8 by default). Type the number or use the arrows.
9d9b6d291dfca165.text: <g1>每个下载最多使用</g1> — 每个下载可使用多少个连接，范围为 1 到 32（默认 8）。输入数字或使用箭头。

9d9eb270f47daa62.source: Check <g1>Download limits</g1> in the Scheduler. When the limit is reached, downloads wait with <g2>Waiting: the download limit is reached (Scheduler)</g2>.
9d9eb270f47daa62.text: 检查计划程序中的<g1>下载限制</g1>。达到限制后，下载任务会显示<g2>等待: 已达到下载限制（计划程序）</g2>。

9da027e1258a39d3.source: Other programs can ask the running app what it is downloading, and pause, start, remove or delete downloads. The API is <g1>off by default</g1>; turn it on with <x2/> (and off with <x3/>).
9da027e1258a39d3.text: 其他程序可以询问正在运行的应用正在下载什么，并暂停、开始、移除或删除下载。API <g1>默认关闭</g1>；使用 <x2/> 开启（使用 <x3/> 关闭）。

9dc027cf03b45afb.source: Downloads added from the phone behave like any other: they go to the category's folder and follow the queues, the Scheduler and the speed limits. The page speaks your phone's language when DDM has it, and follows its light or dark mode.
9dc027cf03b45afb.text: 从手机添加的下载与任何其他下载一样：它们会进入所属类别的文件夹，并遵循队列、计划程序和速度限制。当 DDM 支持时，该页面会使用您手机的语言，并遵循其浅色或深色模式。

9dcb3eb62d6f2e46.source: A theme is one small text file, in <g1>TOML</g1> (or JSON). It names only what it changes; everything else comes from the theme it builds on. You don't need to build DDM or know how to program.
9dcb3eb62d6f2e46.text: 主题是一个小的 <g1>TOML</g1>（或 JSON）文本文件。它只命名它所更改的内容；其他所有内容都来自它所基于的主题。您无需构建 DDM 或了解如何编程。

9dd2cffc726c6f48.source: Headless downloads with progress (<x1/>, <x2/>), videos, torrents and the automation API's commands: a library the app's program runs (<x3/>), and <x4/>, a small launcher that starts it with the same arguments, terminal and exit code

9f3336a9d7c74216.source: The grabber finds links where a browser does: links, frames, pictures (<x1/>, <x2/> and pictures loaded late from <x3/> too), videos and their posters, sounds, style sheets and the pictures and fonts in them, scripts, icons. Relative addresses, addresses from the site's root, <x4/> addresses, a <x5/>, addresses with letters beyond ASCII and redirects are followed as a browser follows them. It doesn't run the pages' scripts, so files that only a script adds to a page aren't found. A link whose address doesn't show what it is (<x6/>) is asked once: a page is explored, a file is collected under the name the server gives it. A page that doesn't answer is counted under <g7>Could not be read</g7>; <g8>Continue</g8> asks it again. Cookies the site sets while it is explored (a session, a consent) are sent back to it for the rest of the grab, and with the downloads of its files.
9f3336a9d7c74216.text: 抓取器会在浏览器查找链接的位置查找链接：链接、框架、图片（<x1/>、<x2/>，以及稍后从 <x3/> 加载的图片）、视频及其封面、声音、样式表及其中的图片和字体、脚本、图标。相对地址、从站点根目录开始的地址、<x4/> 地址、<x5/>、含有 ASCII 以外字母的地址以及重定向，都会像浏览器一样被跟随。它不会运行页面的脚本，因此仅由脚本添加到页面的文件不会被找到。对于地址无法显示其类型的链接（<x6/>），会询问一次：是页面则探索，是文件则以服务器给出的名称收集。没有响应的页面会计入<g7>无法读取</g7>；<g8>继续</g8>会再次请求它。站点在探索期间设置的 Cookie（会话、同意）会在抓取的其余过程中，以及在其文件的下载中被发回给它。

a06aa93a7ce4eff2.source: Each connection has its own HTTP client (<x1/> in <x2/>): hyper's pool sends every request to a host over one HTTP/2 connection, so a shared client would turn an HTTP/2 server's 8 connections into 8 streams of one TCP connection, at one connection's speed. On its own connection, HTTP/2 keeps its gain for a download: a part cut short by a split ends its stream, and the warm connection serves the next request. The lanes time their own silence, the waits for the disk left out (reqwest's read timeout runs while a write is held up). A connection that goes silent while the others receive reconnects after a few seconds (<x3/>) instead of waiting out the read timeout. A file up to 16 MiB starts on its first connection, and the others open once its pace says they would finish it sooner (<x4/>: a new connection costs its time to first byte); a Metalink download's mirrors are asked from the start.
a06aa93a7ce4eff2.text: 每个连接都有自己的 HTTP 客户端（<x1/>，位于 <x2/>）：hyper 的连接池会把发往同一主机的所有请求都放在一个 HTTP/2 连接上，所以共用客户端会把 HTTP/2 服务器上的 8 个连接变成同一条 TCP 连接上的 8 个数据流，速度只有一个连接的速度。在各自独立的连接上，HTTP/2 仍能为下载保留它的优势：被拆分截短的分块会结束它的数据流，而已建立的连接会处理下一个请求。各条通道自行计算自己的静默时间，不计入等待磁盘的时间（reqwest 的读取超时在写入被阻塞时仍在计时）。当其他连接都在接收数据而某个连接一直没有响应时，它会在几秒后重连（<x3/>），而不是等到读取超时。不超过 16 MiB 的文件从第一个连接开始下载，其余连接在预计能更早完成该文件时才打开（<x4/>：新连接要花费首字节时间）；Metalink 下载的镜像则从一开始就会被询问。

a1af219c4f645498.source: <g1>yt-dlp</g1> (about 24 MB) looks the page up and finds where the video and its sound come from; DDM downloads them (<g2>How a video comes down</g2>). DDM checks the download against the signature yt-dlp's developers publish before it uses it. On Windows and macOS DDM takes yt-dlp's folder build and unpacks it once, so yt-dlp starts in about half the time at each look-up and download (the single-program build unpacks itself every time it starts). A copy installed by an earlier DDM keeps working, and the next update of yt-dlp replaces it with the folder build.
a1af219c4f645498.text: <g1>yt-dlp</g1>（约 24 MB）查找页面，找出视频及其声音的来源；由 DDM 下载它们（<g2>视频是怎样下载的</g2>）。DDM 在使用 yt-dlp 之前，会对照 yt-dlp 开发者发布的签名校验下载内容。在 Windows 和 macOS 上，DDM 采用 yt-dlp 的文件夹版本并只解压一次，所以每次查找和下载时 yt-dlp 的启动时间约减半（单文件版本每次启动都要自行解压）。早先的 DDM 安装的副本仍可使用，yt-dlp 的下一次更新会把它换成文件夹版本。

a21920e1fa173649.source: DDM opens 8 connections by default, and you can set anything from 1 to 32 in <g1>Options → Connection</g1>. When a connection finishes its part, it takes over half of the largest part still left, so the work is shared out again and again until the file is done. A connection that falls far behind the others is dropped and opened again.
a21920e1fa173649.text: DDM 默认开启 8 个连接，您可以在<g1>选项 → 连接</g1>中设置 1 到 32 个。当一个连接完成其部分后，它会接管剩余最大部分的一半，因此工作会不断重新分配，直到文件下载完成。如果一个连接远远落后于其他连接，它将被断开并重新连接。

a346550717095cb0.source: Nothing to relearn, plenty to gain
a346550717095cb0.text: 无需重新学习，收获更多

a34bf9097c2b086e.source: Metalinks (<x1/>: Metalink 3 and RFC 5854's Metalink 4) are read into files, each with its sources (priority, country), size, strongest whole-file hash and piece hashes, and a name that may not leave its folder. The app makes each file a download: <x2/> are its other sources, used only when <x3/> or <x4/> can verify them. The connections take turns among the sources (<x5/>); a mirror is asked without the main address's validators, and one that fails (no answer, a refusal, no ranges, another file) is left out for the rest of the download (<x6/>, never a failure of the download). At the end the file is checked against its hash; with piece hashes, the pieces that fail (<x7/>) are downloaded again in another round of connections over them alone, the sources that sent them left out (<x8/>), up to three rounds (<x9/>).
a34bf9097c2b086e.text: Metalink（<x1/>：Metalink 3 和 RFC 5854 的 Metalink 4）会被读成文件，每个文件带有它的来源（优先级、国家或地区）、大小、最强的整文件哈希和分块哈希，以及一个不得超出其文件夹范围的名称。应用把每个文件变成一个下载任务：<x2/> 是它的其他来源，只在 <x3/> 或 <x4/> 能校验它们时才会使用。各连接轮流使用这些来源（<x5/>）；询问镜像时不带主地址的验证信息，出错的镜像（无响应、被拒绝、不支持 Range、换了文件）在该下载的剩余时间里被排除（<x6/>，绝不会导致下载失败）。结束时，文件会对照其哈希进行校验；有分块哈希时，未通过校验的分块（<x7/>）会在另一轮连接中重新下载，这一轮只针对这些分块，并排除发送过它们的来源（<x8/>），最多三轮（<x9/>）。

a3d9722ac9cf4e47.source: A freeze whose report shows the window thread inside the graphics driver as it shows a frame (<x1/> or <x2/> for Intel, <x3/> for NVIDIA, <x4/> for AMD, under <x5/>) is the driver's OpenGL stuck, not DDM: on Windows, choose <g6>View → Draw with → Direct3D</g6> (the default) and restart DDM, and update the graphics driver. If <g7>Draw with</g7> says Direct3D didn't start there, the line under it says why.
a3d9722ac9cf4e47.text: 如果冻结报告显示窗口线程在图形驱动程序内部，正在显示帧（Intel 为<x1/>或<x2/>，NVIDIA 为<x3/>，AMD 为<x4/>，在<x5/>下），则表明是驱动程序的 OpenGL 卡住，而非 DDM：在 Windows 上，选择<g6>视图 → 绘制方式 → Direct3D</g6>（默认）并重启 DDM，然后更新图形驱动程序。如果<g7>绘制方式</g7>显示 Direct3D 未在此处启动，其下方会显示原因。

a491a1a410a8c4bc.source: <g1>Aqua</g1>: Mac OS X's look: gel buttons round at the ends (the default one blue), glossy check boxes, a blue focus ring, a blue gel progress bar, a grey title bar with small round buttons (on Windows), and icons drawn for DDM in that manner.

a4ec7f409ec80484.source: The download list and settings are saved atomically to the data folder (<x1/>): <x2/> on Windows, <x3/> on Linux, <x4/> on macOS, a <x5/> folder beside a portable copy, or <x6/> (<x7/>). The browser host reads the same file for the capture rules, so a change in Options applies to the next captured download.

The list starts with the usual ones: ZIP, RAR, 7Z, EXE, MSI, ISO, DMG, DEB, RPM, APPIMAGE, MP3, MP4, MKV, WEBM, PDF, AI models such as GGUF and SAFETENSORS, 3D files such as GLB and STL, and many more. Anything else can be added to the list.

a51b37558abe6a60.source: The app talks to <g1>the servers you download from</g1>, to <g2>GitHub</g2> to check for updates when it starts (you can turn that off), and to GitHub again for <g3>yt-dlp and ffmpeg</g3> if you download videos.
a51b37558abe6a60.text: 此应用会与<g1>您下载文件的服务器</g1>通信；启动时会与<g2>GitHub</g2>通信以检查更新（您可以关闭此功能）；如果您下载视频，还会再次与GitHub通信以获取<g3>yt-dlp和ffmpeg</g3>。

a53baf5e058e53a2.source: Add downloads with <g1>Add URL</g1>, the clipboard (<g2>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g2>) or the drop target (<g3>Tasks → Show drop target</g3>).
a53baf5e058e53a2.text: 使用<g1>添加 URL</g1>、剪贴板（<g2>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g2>）或拖放目标（<g3>任务 → 显示拖放目标</g3>）添加下载。

a56b721ce2db8d7a.source: Some torrents also name web servers that have their files (a <x1/>, "web seeds"): the Internet Archive's torrents, many Linux distributions' and game patches'. DDM downloads from them too, alongside the peers, and a torrent with no peer at all still comes whole from its web seeds. Each web seed shows in the <g2>Peers</g2> tab as a peer on your own computer (<x3/>), and its pieces are checked like any peer's: a server with a damaged copy can't spoil the file, and one that keeps failing is left alone for a while. Web seeds need <g4>Accept incoming connections</g4> in <g5>Torrent settings</g5> (on unless you turned it off) and aren't used through a SOCKS5 proxy. A web seed on your computer or your local network is never contacted, as for trackers. Not supported: a magnet link's web seeds (<x6/>) and the older Hoffman-style <x7/>.

a7431b39fec4f131.source: How it holds: Windows binds the adapter's own address. Windows then sends those packets only through that adapter (its strong host model). Linux binds the device itself (Linux 5.7 or newer), and macOS binds the interface. An address of a kind the adapter doesn't have (IPv6 on an IPv4-only VPN) is refused, not sent around it.

aa9d240c92bc8646.source: The video tools (yt-dlp, and ffmpeg on Windows) live in the data folder's <x1/> and are never asked for (<x2/>). The Windows setup runs the installed program with <x3/>, which gets what is missing with <x4/> and prints its progress line by line for the wizard's bar (<x5/> reads it, under Inno's own "Finishing installation...": the windows never name or explain the helpers, only Helpers... and the logs do). Whatever is still missing when the app runs (the setup was offline, a zip copy, Linux and macOS) a background task gets: at once while the network is up (the adapter watch's route), again after a failure with a doubling wait up to 10 minutes, and at once when the route changes. A video started meanwhile waits in the list ("Waiting") and starts once yt-dlp is there; the browser's quality menu sends the click to the Download video window, which says "Getting ready..." and looks the page up once it can.

aebece9c4f2b1a7f.source: DDM itself still sends nothing anywhere: the server talks only to the DDM on this computer, over the token-protected local channel. But what the assistant reads, it passes to its own AI service: when it lists your downloads, their file names, addresses and folders go to that service, under that service's privacy terms. Turn the automation API off, or remove the server from the assistant, when you don't want that.
aebece9c4f2b1a7f.text: DDM 本身仍不会向任何地方发送数据：服务器仅通过受令牌保护的本地通道与此计算机上的 DDM 通信。但助手读取的数据会传递给其自身的 AI 服务：列出下载内容时，下载的文件名、地址和文件夹会发送给该服务，并受该服务隐私条款的约束。如果不希望这样，请关闭自动化 API，或从助手中移除服务器。

aee59a6a5bc87cf9.source: <g1>A stream sent in many small pieces</g1> (HLS, DASH, as most sites other than YouTube send theirs) comes down that many pieces at once, each kept on disk as it arrives, then joined in order into one file, as yt-dlp joins them. Pieces encrypted with AES-128 are decrypted with the key the stream's playlist names. When their addresses expire, DDM asks yt-dlp for the stream's new list and carries on with the pieces still missing.
aee59a6a5bc87cf9.text: <g1>以许多小分块发送的流</g1>（HLS、DASH，大多数网站（YouTube 除外）都采用这种方式）会同时下载许多分块，每个分块在到达时都保存在磁盘上，然后按顺序合并成一个文件，就像 yt-dlp 合并它们一样。用 AES-128 加密的分块会用流播放列表指定的密钥解密。当它们的地址过期时，DDM 会向 yt-dlp 请求流的新列表，并继续下载仍缺失的分块。

aeebdabfd4045b05.source: <g1>Emerald</g1>: a white canvas with one near-black ink and a ladder of neutral greys for structure, emerald fills that always carry near-black text rather than white, 6-point corners on every control, and Metro's one-colour icons.
aeebdabfd4045b05.text: <g1>翡翠</g1>：白色画布，搭配近乎黑色的墨水和一系列中性灰色调以构建结构，翡翠色填充总是承载近乎黑色的文本而非白色，所有控件均采用 6 点圆角，以及现代风格的单色图标。

af13220c8027da8d.source: <g1>Paired devices</g1> — <g2>Pair a device...</g2> shows a QR code and a code; <g3>Remove</g3> unpairs the device selected, at once.
af13220c8027da8d.text: <g1>已配对设备</g1> — <g2>配对设备...</g2>显示一个二维码和一个代码；<g3>删除</g3>立即取消配对所选设备。

af26554bf768b4fc.source: On <g1>A few choices</g1>, tick what you want: - <g2>Set up browser integration (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g2> - <g3>Open .torrent files and magnet links with Dannex Download Manager</g3> - <g4>Start Dannex Download Manager when Windows starts</g4> - <g5>Create a desktop shortcut</g5> (off unless you tick it)
af26554bf768b4fc.text: 在<g1>几个选项</g1>页面，勾选您需要的项目：- <g2>设置浏览器集成（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Firefox）</g2> - <g3>用 Dannex Download Manager 打开 .torrent 文件和磁力链接</g3> - <g4>Windows 启动时启动 Dannex Download Manager</g4> - <g5>创建桌面快捷方式</g5>（除非勾选，否则不创建）

af31ce31cba24f64.source: In the browser extension's menu, <g1>Send downloads to → Another Dannex Download Manager (a server)</g1>: type the server's address, open it once in that browser to accept its certificate, then enter a pairing code (<x2/> above). Downloads the extension catches, and <g3>Download with DDM</g3> on a link, then go to the server instead of this computer. The browser's cookies are not sent to the server: a download that needs you to be signed in to a site stays with this computer.
af31ce31cba24f64.text: 在浏览器扩展程序的菜单中，选择<g1>将下载发送到 → 另一个 Dannex Download Manager（服务器）</g1>：输入服务器地址，在该浏览器中打开一次以接受其证书，然后输入配对码（如<x2/>所示）。扩展程序捕获的下载，以及链接上的<g3>使用 DDM 下载</g3>，将发送到服务器而不是此电脑。浏览器的 Cookie 不会发送到服务器：需要您登录网站的下载仍将在此电脑上进行。

af7c7d57134afbc1.source: DDM ships no list of hosts or links; the service says which hosts it supports.
af7c7d57134afbc1.text: DDM 不附带主机或链接列表；服务会说明它支持哪些主机。

af83c70c1ca46aae.source: Options on its Connection page, on Linux
af83c70c1ca46aae.text: Linux 上“选项”的“连接”页面

af8c653066cc3fda.source: Queue it today. Download it tonight.
af8c653066cc3fda.text: 今天加入队列，今晚下载。

afaa46159bead1bd.source: Some servers drop the connection when the speed is very low. Don't set a tight limit for a server that can't resume (<g1>Can resume: No</g1> in the progress window).
afaa46159bead1bd.text: 当速度很低时，有些服务器会断开连接。对于不支持断点续传的服务器（进度窗口中为<g1>支持断点续传：否</g1>），请不要设置过严的限制。

afb3f6f9eb68020d.source: <g1>Import a theme…</g1> adds a theme file or a colour scheme (as <g2>Add a theme file…</g2> below), <g3>Export this theme…</g3> saves the theme in use, its accent included, as a theme file (also <g4>View → Theme → Export this theme…</g4>), and <g5>Open themes folder</g5> opens the folder they go in.
afb3f6f9eb68020d.text: <g1>导入主题…</g1>会添加一个主题文件或配色方案（如下面的<g2>添加主题文件…</g2>），<g3>导出此主题…</g3>会把正在使用的主题连同它的强调色保存为主题文件（也可用<g4>视图 → 主题 → 导出此主题…</g4>），<g5>打开主题文件夹</g5>会打开存放它们的文件夹。

afd30b395bede669.source: Dannex Download Manager downloads torrents and magnet links: choose the files, see peers, trackers and pieces, and queue them with your other downloads.
afd30b395bede669.text: Dannex Download Manager 下载种子和磁力链接：选择文件，查看对等点、跟踪器和分块，并将其与其他下载任务一起排队。

afe2e357b236410d.source: Link grabber (<x1/>, its window <x2/>) is built for pages of thousands of links: the rows, counts by kind of file and duplicates are made again only when something changed (a generation number), and only the rows in view are drawn; look-ups run sixteen at a time (six per host) and answer on a channel; whether a file is already on the disk is asked on a thread of its own (#743). The extension sends each link's text with it (<x3/> and <x4/> in step, the native host keeping them so as it drops links it doesn't download: <x5/>).
afe2e357b236410d.text: 链接抓取器（<x1/>，其窗口为 <x2/>）是为包含数千个链接的页面而构建的：行、按文件类型统计的数量和重复项只在有变化时才重新生成（用一个代数编号判断），并且只绘制可见的行；查询每次并行十六个（每个主机六个），并通过通道返回结果；文件是否已在磁盘上，则交给专门的线程去查（#743）。扩展会随每个链接发送它的文字（<x3/> 和 <x4/> 同步，本机主机程序会保留它们，以便丢弃它不下载的链接：<x5/>）。

b0312b0d92b43a05.source: <g1>Leave these addresses to the browser → Edit list...</g1> — addresses whose downloads stay in the browser, one per line; <x2/> stands for any text (<x3/>).
b0312b0d92b43a05.text: <g1>将这些地址留给浏览器 → 编辑列表...</g1> — 其下载留在浏览器中的地址，每行一个；<x2/> 代表任意文本（<x3/>）。

b0442a90b7202b80.source: Yes. Copy a link to a file and DDM offers to download it at once (Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard, on by default). You can also paste links into Add URL, drag them onto the drop target, add a whole batch, or use the command line. See Adding downloads.
b0442a90b7202b80.text: 可以。复制文件链接后，DDM 会立即询问是否下载（选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接，默认开启）。您也可以将链接粘贴到“添加 URL”中，拖到投放区域，批量添加，或使用命令行。请参阅“添加下载”。

b04ebaded7d53aa1.source: <g1>Your proxy</g1>, if you set one in <g2>Options → Proxy / Socks</g2>, and your network's proxy auto-config script, if you point DDM at one.
b04ebaded7d53aa1.text: <g1>您的代理</g1>，如果您在<g2>选项 → 代理/Socks</g2>中设置了代理，以及您网络的代理自动配置脚本，如果您将 DDM 指向其中一个。

b05472801cf663cd.source: <g1>Run [N] downloads at once</g1> — how many of the queue's downloads run together. The rest wait their turn.
b05472801cf663cd.text: <g1>同时运行 [N] 个下载</g1> — 队列中同时运行多少个下载。其余的按顺序等待。

b0661d044f93a1d2.source: <g1>Ask for the queue after a batch download</g1> — the same for batch downloads.
b0661d044f93a1d2.text: <g1>批量下载后询问加入哪个队列</g1> — 对批量下载同样如此。

b0c0ef4ee0008226.source: — FTP secured with TLS from the start of the session (explicit FTPS, <x1/>, usually port 21). Use it when the server says it supports TLS.
b0c0ef4ee0008226.text: — 在会话开始时使用 TLS 加密的 FTP（显式 FTPS，<x1/>，通常使用端口 21）。服务器表示支持 TLS 时，请使用此方式。

b0c4e0a63ab33158.source: A Download button sits on videos and music players. Pick a quality, or just the sound, and it's on its way.
b0c4e0a63ab33158.text: 视频和音乐播放器上都有一个下载按钮。选择画质，或只要声音，下载随即开始。

b0c69399ed328758.source: <g1>Claude Desktop</g1>: <g2>Settings → Developer → Edit Config</g2> opens <x3/>. Add the server, then restart Claude Desktop:
b0c69399ed328758.text: <g1>Claude Desktop</g1>：<g2>设置 → 开发者 → 编辑配置</g2>会打开<x3/>。添加服务器，然后重启 Claude Desktop：

b0d3cd22152eff0f.source: Installed or the plain zip: <x1/>. The list and settings are in <x2/>.
b0d3cd22152eff0f.text: 已安装版或普通 zip 版：<x1/>。列表和设置位于<x2/>中。

b0ee9b152e4c0ce7.source: marks the keyboard letter of a menu item or button. Keep one <x1/> before a letter of your translation.
b0ee9b152e4c0ce7.text: 表示菜单项或按钮的键盘快捷键字母。在译文的一个字母前保留一个<x1/>。

b119279300fe5cc6.source: <g1>DNS</g1> — which DNS turns the servers' names into addresses for DDM's downloads, its own downloads (helpers, updates) and FTP. <g2>The system's DNS</g2> is the default (on Windows 11 it can already be encrypted, in Windows' own network settings). Or pick <g3>Cloudflare</g3>, <g4>Google</g4>, <g5>Quad9</g5>, <g6>AdGuard</g6> or <g7>NextDNS</g7>, or <g8>Another DNS...</g8> to type your own; <g9>Settings...</g9> chooses how it's asked:
b119279300fe5cc6.text: <g1>DNS</g1> — 选择用于将服务器名称转换为地址的 DNS，适用于 DDM 的下载、DDM 自身的下载（辅助程序、更新）和 FTP。默认使用<g2>系统的 DNS</g2>（在 Windows 11 中，系统 DNS 可能已在 Windows 自带的网络设置中加密）。也可以选择 <g3>Cloudflare</g3>、<g4>Google</g4>、<g5>Quad9</g5>、<g6>AdGuard</g6> 或 <g7>NextDNS</g7>，也可以选择<g8>其他 DNS...</g8>并输入自己的 DNS；<g9>设置...</g9>可选择查询方式：

b1618ed2436f6ef8.source: Don't make DDM reachable from the internet (a router's port forwarding): the remote control is made for your home network. To reach it while away, use a VPN to your home network instead (WireGuard, Tailscale): with Tailscale, choose its address in <g1>Listen on</g1>.
b1618ed2436f6ef8.text: 不要让 DDM 可以从互联网访问（路由器的端口转发）：远程控制是为您的家庭网络设计的。要在外出时访问它，请使用 VPN 连接到您的家庭网络（WireGuard、Tailscale）：使用 Tailscale 时，请在<g1>监听</g1>中选择其地址。

b18e946821cdb2ff.source: Put the file in DDM's themes folder. <g1>View → Theme → Open themes folder</g1> opens it, and makes it the first time. It is in DDM's data folder:
b18e946821cdb2ff.text: 将文件放入 DDM 的主题文件夹。<g1>视图 → 主题 → 打开主题文件夹</g1> 可打开该文件夹，并首次创建它。它位于 DDM 的数据文件夹中：

b198592bcc534043.text: 当地址已在列表中时，DDM 会询问如何处理，或按您在<g1>选项 → 下载 → 当地址已在列表中时</g1>中选择的方式处理。

b1b2249661e1c4a9.source: Keep changes focused and match the code around them. A few rules hold everywhere:
b1b2249661e1c4a9.text: 更改应聚焦于具体问题，并与周围的代码风格保持一致。以下规则适用于所有地方：

b1cfb9dac9c38d80.source: Then yt-dlp does what it does after a download: it joins the video and its sound with ffmpeg into one MP4, saves or embeds the subtitles, and converts the sound for an MP3, Opus or FLAC choice.
b1cfb9dac9c38d80.text: 然后 yt-dlp 会在下载完成后执行其操作：它会使用 ffmpeg 将视频和音频合并为一个 MP4 文件，保存或嵌入字幕，并为 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC 选项转换音频。

b208caa24e13c211.source: <g1>Shift+Up / Shift+Down</g1> makes the selection longer or shorter.
b208caa24e13c211.text: 按 <g1>Shift+Up / Shift+Down</g1> 可扩大或缩小选择范围。

b21d10b675161104.source: DDM makes the folder when the first file goes there; it never asks about it.
b21d10b675161104.text: DDM 会在第一个文件保存到那里时创建文件夹；从不就此询问。

b243a163e5083e77.source: Click <g1>Finish</g1>. <g2>Start Dannex Download Manager</g2> starts it, and <g3>Add Dannex Download Manager to my browser</g3> (with browser integration) opens the window that adds the extension.
b243a163e5083e77.text: 点击<g1>完成</g1>。<g2>启动 Dannex Download Manager</g2>会启动它，<g3>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到我的浏览器</g3>（启用浏览器集成时）会打开添加扩展的窗口。

b252636433b25eae.source: <g1>Numbers</g1> (counts, sizes, speeds, percentages and the list's columns) are written the way the interface language writes them, whatever the Windows region: German <x2/> and <x3/>, French <x4/>, Hindi <x5/>. When your system's region is in that same language, its own way wins (Swiss German <x6/>, or a separator you set in Windows). In English, DDM writes plain digits, as IDM does (<x7/>, <x8/>).
b252636433b25eae.text: <g1>数字</g1>（计数、大小、速度、百分比和列表列）的显示方式与界面语言的写法一致，无论 Windows 区域设置如何：德语 <x2/> 和 <x3/>，法语 <x4/>，印地语 <x5/>。当您的系统区域设置与该语言相同时，系统自己的方式优先（瑞士德语 <x6/>，或您在 Windows 中设置的分隔符）。在英语中，DDM 使用纯数字，与 IDM 相同（<x7/>，<x8/>）。

b258d94cbafaa2d0.source: <g1>Use a configuration script</g1> — the proxy auto-config (PAC) script your network gives: type its address (<x2/>, or a file). DDM fetches it and asks it which proxy each download goes through (<x3/>, <x4/> or <x5/>), as browsers do. Until it has been fetched, or if it can't be, DDM uses the system's settings.
b258d94cbafaa2d0.text: <g1>使用配置脚本</g1> — 您的网络提供的代理自动配置 (PAC) 脚本：输入其地址（<x2/>，或文件）。DDM 会获取它，并像浏览器一样询问每个下载该走哪个代理（<x3/>、<x4/> 或 <x5/>）。在获取完成之前，或获取失败时，DDM 会使用系统设置。

b27190934c8836f3.source: <g1><g2>Torrents</g2></g1> — magnet links and .torrent files, choosing files, and sharing.
b27190934c8836f3.text: <g1><g2>种子</g2></g1> — 磁力链接和 .torrent 文件，选择文件和共享。

b27695aee6ec8848.source: Find file: a name to look for
b27695aee6ec8848.text: 查找文件：要查找的名称

b27995b1d5cff0b2.source: A calendar's day or arrow pressed
b27995b1d5cff0b2.text: 日历日期或箭头被按下时

b2aa96c8ae8909e2.source: <g1>Any Firefox, until it closes:</g1> open <x2/>, click <g3>Load Temporary Add-on…</g3> and choose the same <x4/>.
b2aa96c8ae8909e2.text: <g1>任意 Firefox，到关闭为止：</g1>打开 <x2/>，点击<g3>临时载入附加组件…</g3>，然后选择同一个 <x4/>。

b2c85512ef4502f0.source: Switches can start with <x1/> or <x2/>, in any case. If DDM is running, the command goes to it; if not, DDM starts and carries it out. For example:
b2c85512ef4502f0.text: 开关可以以 <x1/> 或 <x2/> 开头，且不区分大小写。如果 DDM 正在运行，命令会发送给它；否则，DDM 会启动并执行命令。例如：

b2c9798ff463049d.source: An unselected tab, and the page's shadow
b2c9798ff463049d.text: 未选中标签页及页面阴影

b2d54f270ff8df2e.source: To hold every connection to your VPN, with a kill switch when it drops, see <g1>Network adapter</g1>.
b2d54f270ff8df2e.text: 要通过一个适配器保持与 VPN 的所有连接，并在连接断开时启用终止开关，请参阅<g1>网络适配器</g1>。

b2e253fd75c1763a.source: <g1>Move a column:</g1> drag its title sideways.
b2e253fd75c1763a.text: <g1>移动列：</g1>拖动其标题横向移动。

b2fb9e668791ef61.source: Asked again by DDM's own name when a server hangs up
b2fb9e668791ef61.text: 服务器挂断时，DDM 会以自己的名称再请求一次

b2fc02b26cb8300d.source: Install or update gallery-dl, for image galleries: its checksum list is checked against its author's signing key, the program against that list (Windows and Linux x86-64; elsewhere install it yourself).
b2fc02b26cb8300d.text: 安装或更新用于下载图片图库的 gallery-dl：使用作者的签名密钥验证其校验和列表，再根据该列表验证程序（适用于 Windows 和 Linux x86-64；其他系统需自行安装）。

b3192a3bf72c5c3b.source: The app and the extension collect no personal data from anyone, children included. The website's visit counter doesn't know who you are or how old you are.
b3192a3bf72c5c3b.text: 应用程序和扩展程序不会收集任何人的个人数据，包括儿童。网站的访问计数器不知道您是谁或您的年龄。

b3197c909639505a.source: Can other programs or scripts control DDM? — Dannex Download Manager
b3197c909639505a.text: 其他程序或脚本可以控制 DDM 吗？— Dannex Download Manager

b3225e952c7c31f3.source: Tick <g1>Wake the computer to run this queue</g1>, under the start time, and a computer that is asleep at the start time is woken for it. It needs <g2>Start at</g2>.
b3225e952c7c31f3.text: 勾选开始时间下方的<g1>唤醒电脑以运行此队列</g1>，处于睡眠状态的计算机会在开始时间被唤醒以运行它。这需要<g2>开始于</g2>。

b325354028698595.source: Before you unplug the stick, quit DDM with <g1>Tasks → Exit</g1> so it saves everything. Closing the window only hides it in the tray.
b325354028698595.text: 在拔下 U 盘之前，请使用<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>关闭 DDM，以便它保存所有内容。关闭窗口只会将其隐藏在托盘中。

b340bb4047d61e6f.source: <g1>Playlists and channels</g1>: paste a playlist's or a channel's address and the window lists its videos, all ticked. One quality applies to all of them, and they go into a folder named after the list. A channel is listed 50 videos at a time, with <g2>Load more</g2>.
b340bb4047d61e6f.text: <g1>播放列表和频道</g1>：粘贴播放列表或频道的地址，窗口会列出所有视频并全部勾选。所有视频都应用相同的画质，并保存到以列表命名的文件夹中。频道每次列出 50 个视频，可通过<g2>加载更多</g2>。

b363c78a6ffb255b.source: A PDF, a song or a video that the browser would show or play itself goes to DDM too, when its type is in <g1>Options → File types</g1> (not on the excluded sites). To turn this off, untick <g2>Also take files the browser would open</g2> in <g3>Options → General → Keys...</g3>. b3b2d01c08877810.source: Both are set in <g1>Options → General → Keys...</g1>: each can be <g2>None</g2>, Alt, Ctrl, Shift, or two or three of them together, and the two must differ. They count exactly as held: with Alt chosen, an Alt+Shift click is an ordinary one. Ctrl+Alt is the default for forcing because nobody makes that click for anything else: a browser opens a tab for Ctrl, a window for Shift and downloads for Alt, and on Windows Alt+Shift switches the keyboard layout. A key chosen to leave links to the browser keeps the browser's own meaning (Shift still opens a new window, which downloads the link); a key chosen to force a link replaces it. On a Mac, Ctrl in Options is the Command key (⌘), since a Control-click opens the right-click menu there: Command+Option forces a link. A change applies once the browser has asked DDM again, which it does when you switch back to it. The <g3>Keys...</g3> window also holds <g4>Also take files the browser would open</g4>.
b3b2d01c08877810.text: 两者都在<g1>选项 → 常规 → 按键...</g1>中设置：每个都可以是<g2>无</g2>、Alt、Ctrl、Shift，或其中两个或三个组合，且两者必须不同。它们按实际按住的键精确计算：选择 Alt 时，Alt+Shift 单击就是普通单击。默认用 Ctrl+Alt 来强制，因为没有人会为别的用途做这个单击：浏览器用 Ctrl 打开标签页，用 Shift 打开窗口，用 Alt 下载，而在 Windows 上 Alt+Shift 会切换键盘布局。选择用来将链接留给浏览器的按键保留浏览器自己的含义（Shift 仍会打开新窗口，从而下载该链接）；选择用来强制处理链接的按键则会替换其含义。在 Mac 上，选项中的 Ctrl 是 Command 键 (⌘)，因为 Control 单击会打开右键菜单：Command+Option 可强制处理链接。更改在浏览器再次询问 DDM 后生效，切换回浏览器时就会这样做。<g3>按键...</g3>窗口中还有<g4>同时接管浏览器本会打开的文件</g4>。

b4ac60c82f87352c.source: DDM reads the torrent and shows its files as a folder tree. A <x1/> file is read at once. A magnet link first has to get the file list from other peers, usually within seconds. While it waits, <g2>Add torrent</g2> shows how many peers it found, from the trackers, the DHT or your local network, and how many answered. After 30 seconds without the file list, it says what may be in the way: a link with no trackers while the DHT is off, a firewall, a VPN or a network that blocks BitTorrent, or peers that answer but don't have the file list themselves. After 3 minutes it stops and keeps showing what it found, with what to try; <g3>Look up</g3> asks again.
b4ac60c82f87352c.text: DDM 会读取种子并以文件夹树的形式显示其文件。<x1/> 文件会立即读取。磁力链接则首先要从其他节点获取文件列表，通常在几秒内完成。等待期间，<g2>添加种子</g2>会显示它从跟踪器、DHT 或您的本地网络找到了多少个节点，以及有多少个已响应。在 30 秒内仍未获得文件列表时，它会说明可能的阻碍：在 DHT 关闭时链接没有跟踪器、防火墙、阻止 BitTorrent 的 VPN 或网络，或者节点虽然响应但自己没有文件列表。3 分钟后它会停止，并继续显示已找到的内容以及可以尝试的办法；<g3>查找</g3>会再次询问。

b4c711557b443b7e.source: <g1>Torrent peers and trackers.</g1> When you download a torrent, DDM connects to the trackers listed in the torrent, to the BitTorrent DHT network and to other peers, who see your IP address and which pieces you have. To accept connections it may ask your router to open a port (UPnP). This is how BitTorrent works; it ends when the torrent stops.
b4c711557b443b7e.text: <g1>种子对等点和追踪器。</g1>当您下载种子时，DDM 会连接到种子中列出的追踪器、BitTorrent DHT 网络和其他对等点，这些对等点会看到您的 IP 地址和您拥有的片段。为了接受连接，它可能会要求您的路由器打开一个端口（UPnP）。这就是 BitTorrent 的工作方式；当种子停止时，它就结束了。
