b88a67e39c494a61.source: The server runs on the app's Tokio runtime, one listener per local network address. Each request is checked (<x1/>, <x2/>, token), turned into an <x3/> marked <x4/> (a field no request line can set) and handed to the app through the same channel as the command line's; the app answers it on its next frame, as it answers the automation API. Its page is built in (<x5/>) and its texts come from the app's catalogs (<x6/>).
b88a67e39c494a61.text: 服务器在应用的 Tokio 运行时上运行，每个本地网络地址一个监听器。每个请求都经过检查（<x1/>、<x2/>、令牌），转换为标记为 <x3/> 的 <x4/>（请求行无法设置的字段），并通过与命令行相同的通道传递给应用；应用在下一帧响应它，就像响应自动化 API 一样。其页面内置于 <x5/> 中，其文本来自应用的目录 (<x6/>)。

bd81ca5995fbd3ea.source: DDM doesn't do this alone, and doesn't pretend to. <g1>yt-dlp</g1> reads the page and downloads the video. <g2>ffmpeg</g2> joins the picture and the sound when a site keeps them apart, which most sites do for their higher qualities. Both come with DDM: the Windows setup gets them while it installs, and DDM gets any that is missing by itself once it is online, from their official releases, checked against what their publishers sign before it uses them. On Linux and macOS DDM uses the system's ffmpeg.
bd81ca5995fbd3ea.text: DDM 并非单打独斗，也不假装如此。<g1>yt-dlp</g1> 读取页面并下载视频。当网站把画面和声音分开存放（多数网站的高画质都是如此）时，由 <g2>ffmpeg</g2> 把它们合在一起。两者都随 DDM 提供：Windows 安装程序在安装时获取它们，缺少的部分则由 DDM 在联网后自行从官方发布渠道获取，并在使用前对照发布者的签名进行校验。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 使用系统自带的 ffmpeg。

For Firefox (until addons.mozilla.org lists it) and for a browser that can't use its store, it also comes with DDM, in the <x1/> folder where DDM is installed, and as its own download with every release. Until a browser's extension has reached DDM, DDM's <g2>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g2> window opens at each start (and from the setup's last page, <g3>Add Dannex Download Manager to my browser</g3>): it lists the browsers it found, and <g4>Add the extension</g4> opens its page in the store (Firefox: <g5>Show me how</g5> opens these steps). <g6>Don't ask again</g6> stops the window.
bdbc8e0251ce76a9.text: 请为您使用的每个浏览器添加扩展，步骤见下。Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 从 Chrome 网上应用店获取。Firefox（在 addons.mozilla.org 上架之前）以及无法使用其商店的浏览器，可使用随 DDM 提供的扩展：它位于 DDM 安装位置的 <x1/> 文件夹中，每个版本也单独提供下载。在某个浏览器的扩展连上 DDM 之前，DDM 的<g2>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>窗口会在每次启动时打开（也会出现在安装程序的最后一页，<g3>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到我的浏览器</g3>）：它列出找到的浏览器，<g4>添加扩展</g4>会在该浏览器中打开扩展在商店里的页面（Firefox：<g5>向我展示如何操作</g5>会打开这些步骤）。<g6>不再询问</g6>可停止弹出该窗口。

bdc9de810562c363.source: The MCP server (<x1/>): AI assistants list, add and control the running app's downloads through the automation API
bdc9de810562c363.text: MCP 服务器（<x1/>）：AI 助手通过自动化 API 列出、添加和控制正在运行的应用的下载

bdf67df1d931eced.source: A site that lets only browsers through
bdf67df1d931eced.text: 只允许浏览器访问的站点

be0ffe38b6cd621b.source: <g1>Options → Proxy / Socks → Network adapter</g1> holds every connection DDM opens to one network adapter, usually your VPN's: downloads, FTP, torrents, video pages and galleries, DDM's own downloads and the update check. It works as a kill switch: when the adapter disconnects, or the VPN is switched off, nothing goes out through your normal connection. Running downloads stop with <g2>… is not connected</g2>, and start again by themselves when the adapter is back. The line under the list shows the adapter's address, or that it isn't connected. Details in <g3>Options → Proxy / Socks</g3> and, for torrents, in <g4>Torrents and your security</g4>.
be0ffe38b6cd621b.text: <g1>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 网络适配器</g1>将 DDM 打开的所有连接（下载、FTP、种子、视频页面和图库、DDM 自身的下载以及更新检查）都绑定到一个网络适配器，通常是您的 VPN 适配器。它充当终止开关：当适配器断开连接或 VPN 关闭时，任何数据都不会通过您的常规连接传出。正在进行的下载会因<g2>…未连接</g2>而停止，并在适配器恢复后自行重新开始。列表下方的行显示适配器的地址，或显示其未连接。详情请参阅<g3>选项 → 代理/SOCKS</g3>，以及种子相关的<g4>种子与您的安全</g4>。

be2d15619e0e5dee.source: If your network gives a proxy auto-config (PAC) script, type its address, or pick the file, under <g1>Use a configuration script</g1>. DDM fetches it and asks it which way each download goes (<x2/>, <x3/> or <x4/>), as browsers do. Until it has been fetched, or if it can't be, DDM uses the system's settings.
be2d15619e0e5dee.text: 如果您的网络提供代理自动配置 (PAC) 脚本，请在<g1>使用配置脚本</g1>下输入其地址，或选取该文件。DDM 会获取它，并像浏览器一样询问每个下载该走哪条路径（<x2/>、<x3/> 或 <x4/>）。在获取完成之前，或获取失败时，DDM 会使用系统设置。

be3dff402d9bec75.source: Check that there is a <x1/> folder next to <x2/>. That folder is what makes DDM portable. Don't delete it.
be3dff402d9bec75.text: 检查<x2/>旁边是否有<x1/>文件夹。这个文件夹使 DDM 成为便携版。请勿删除它。

be551b1a5450099a.source: Double-click a torrent for its progress window. Its tabs show each file, the peers you get it from, the trackers, a map of the pieces, and the share ratio.
be551b1a5450099a.text: 双击一个种子可打开其进度窗口。其选项卡会显示每个文件、提供文件的对等点、跟踪器、分块图以及共享率。

be5f68c00b2c6c59.source: Big batches of links, extracting archives by itself, and plugins to extend it
be5f68c00b2c6c59.text: 可批量处理大量链接、自动解压归档文件，还能通过插件扩展功能

be67148bff767184.source: Hold <g1>Alt</g1> while clicking a link to let the browser download it instead of DDM. In Firefox, Alt+click saves a link only when its <x2/> setting is on (in <x3/>); otherwise right-click the link and choose <g4>Save Link As...</g4>, which the browser keeps.
be67148bff767184.text: 点击链接时按住 <g1>Alt</g1>，可让浏览器而不是 DDM 下载它。在 Firefox 中，只有其 <x2/> 设置（位于 <x3/>）开启时，Alt+点击才会保存链接；否则请右键点击链接并选择<g4>将链接另存为...</g4>，这样由浏览器保存。

be8936bd5aa080c5.source: <g1>Linux</g1>: in the system keyring through the Secret Service (GNOME Keyring, KeePassXC, KDE's wallet with its Secret Service on), its default collection, as items labelled <x2/>. DDM never unlocks a locked keyring and never asks for its password: when the keyring is locked (some desktops that log in on their own leave it locked) or there is none (many tiling window managers), the sign-ins stay in DDM's settings, in a data folder only you may read (0700), as before.
be8936bd5aa080c5.text: <g1>Linux</g1>：通过 Secret Service（GNOME Keyring、KeePassXC、KDE 钱包及其 Secret Service 已开启）保存在系统密钥环中，作为其默认集合中标记为<x2/>的项。DDM 从不解锁锁定的密钥环，也从不要求其密码：当密钥环被锁定（一些自动登录的桌面会将其锁定）或没有密钥环（许多平铺式窗口管理器）时，登录信息会像以前一样保存在 DDM 的设置中，位于只有您可以读取（0700）的数据文件夹中。

be93583a49a09b2f.source: A <x1/> file fetched from a web address goes through the same checks as one opened from disk, and DDM reads at most 10 MB of it.
be93583a49a09b2f.text: 从网址获取的 <x1/> 文件会经过与从磁盘打开的文件相同的检查，DDM 最多读取 10 MB 的内容。

bebf1a7c82ae2be4.source: A torrent in order isn't faster to finish, and it helps the swarm less: use it for what you want to watch now.
bebf1a7c82ae2be4.text: 按顺序下载不会让种子更快完成，对群的贡献也较小：仅在需要立即观看内容时使用此功能。

bec34547be3faebd.source: When the network stays away longer (the Wi-Fi gone, the server restarting), the download shows <g1>Error</g1> and its log says <g2>The network failed; trying again in 5 s</g2>. DDM starts it again by itself, waiting a little longer each time (5, 10, 20, 40 seconds, then every minute, for about an hour), and it goes on from where it stopped. The same happens after the computer wakes from sleep.
bec34547be3faebd.text: 当网络中断更久时（Wi-Fi 断了、服务器在重启），下载会显示<g1>错误</g1>，它的日志写着<g2>网络出错；5 秒后重试</g2>。DDM 会自行重新开始，每次等待稍长一些（5、10、20、40 秒，之后每分钟一次，持续约一小时），并从中断处继续。电脑从睡眠中唤醒后也是如此。

bf124e15a5fd6568.source: Open the first menu (<g1>Tasks</g1>); on a Mac <g2>Ctrl+F2</g2>
bf124e15a5fd6568.text: 打开第一个菜单（<g1>任务</g1>）；在Mac上是<g2>Ctrl+F2</g2>

bf1775587c0862fc.source: On 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, DDM is the stable, recommended build. The <g1>download page</g1> offers three files:
bf1775587c0862fc.text: 在 64 位 Windows 10 和 11 上，DDM 是稳定且推荐的构建版本。<g1>下载页面</g1>提供三种文件：

bf5d19b581af2158.source: Some servers allow only a few connections, and answer the others with <g1>429 Too Many Requests</g1> or <g2>503 Service Unavailable</g2>. DDM notices this and stops asking that server for more. What it has learned shows in <g3>Options → Connection</g3> under <g4>Exceptions</g4>, marked <g5>(auto)</g5>.
bf5d19b581af2158.text: 有些服务器只允许少数几个连接，对其余的连接回应<g1>429 Too Many Requests</g1>或<g2>503 Service Unavailable</g2>。DDM 会注意到这一点，不再向该服务器请求更多连接。它学到的结果显示在<g3>选项 → 连接</g3>的<g4>例外</g4>下，并标有<g5>（自动）</g5>。

bf6005b554acc40d.source: Click <g1>Add URL</g1> and paste a gallery's address. Instead of saving the page as a file, DDM opens <g2>Download a gallery</g2>. When its line reads <g3>gallery-dl can download this gallery's files</g3>, check <g4>Save to</g4> and click <g5>Download Now</g5>, or <g6>Later</g6> to add it without starting.
bf6005b554acc40d.text: 点击<g1>添加 URL</g1>并粘贴图库地址。DDM 不会将页面保存为文件，而是打开<g2>下载图库</g2>。当其显示“<g3>gallery-dl 可以下载此图库的文件</g3>”时，勾选<g4>保存到</g4>并点击<g5>立即下载</g5>，或点击<g6>稍后</g6>将其添加到列表而不立即开始下载。

bf627fe501394733.source: <g1>View → Theme → Add a theme file…</g1> does it for you: pick the file anywhere, and DDM copies it into the themes folder and uses it at once.
bf627fe501394733.text: 通过<g1>视图 → 主题 → 添加主题文件…</g1>即可完成：在任意位置选择文件，DDM 会将其复制到主题文件夹并立即应用。

bf727e1120314cd9.source: The main window's toolbar and categories in the Classic theme
bf727e1120314cd9.text: 主窗口的工具栏和类别采用经典主题

bf7eea4d4f75bc3c.source: You read it first, and you send it

bf806212c88c6ae3.source: An HTTP Range server with a request log and fault injection, Metalink documents of its files (<x1/>), and an FTP/FTPS server with its own faults, for tests and benchmarks
bf806212c88c6ae3.text: 一个带请求日志和故障注入的 HTTP Range 服务器、其文件的 Metalink 文档（<x1/>），以及一个带有自己的故障模拟的 FTP/FTPS 服务器，用于测试和基准测试

bf904532bdc645af.source: A torrent counts as one file here: each torrent gets the limit of its own. So do a video and an image gallery (<g1>Videos</g1>). A download with a limit of its own (see <g2>For one download</g2>) keeps that one.
bf904532bdc645af.text: 一个种子文件在此算作一个文件：每个种子文件都有自己的限制。视频和图片库（<g1>视频</g1>）也是如此。有自己限制的下载（请参阅<g2>针对单个下载</g2>）将保持该限制。

bf94455af6da7fc7.source: A plain list of links works too

bfdcb4c0c0e4bf80.source: <g1>Site name/Download link/Parent web page/Referer</g1> — the address, the site's name and the page the download came from. Tick this to find everything from one site.
bfdcb4c0c0e4bf80.text: <g1>站点名称/下载链接/父网页/引用页</g1> — 地址、站点名称和下载来源页面。勾选此项可查找来自同一站点的所有内容。

bff6b5c6e5ab99f7.source: Firefox, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, through the DDM browser extension (from the Chrome Web Store; for Firefox it comes with DDM, until addons.mozilla.org lists it), and browsers built on them: Zen and LibreWolf, Helium. The extension hands downloads to DDM with their cookies and referrer, so files behind a sign-in still work, and it adds <g1>Download with DDM</g1> to the right-click menu and a <g2>Download video</g2> button over videos. See <g3>Browser integration</g3>.
bff6b5c6e5ab99f7.text: Firefox、Google Chrome、Microsoft Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi，通过 DDM 浏览器扩展使用（Chrome 版来自 Chrome 网上应用店；Firefox 版随 DDM 一起提供，直到 addons.mozilla.org 上架），以及基于它们的浏览器：Zen、LibreWolf 和 Helium。扩展会把下载连同 Cookie 和来源页一起交给 DDM，所以需要登录才能下载的文件也能正常下载；它还会在右键菜单中加入<g1>使用 DDM 下载</g1>，并在视频上方加入<g2>下载视频</g2>按钮。参见<g3>浏览器集成</g3>。

bffdc103f06c4113.source: In the download's progress window, open the <g1>Speed Limiter</g1> tab:
bffdc103f06c4113.text: 在下载的进度窗口中，打开<g1>速度限制器</g1>选项卡：

c02886aed84abf9a.text: 隐私政策 — Dannex Download Manager

c0588cff3fa8dcb7.source: Batch download: an address with an asterisk, what replaces it, and the first, second and last file
c0588cff3fa8dcb7.text: 批量下载：带星号的地址、替换内容，以及第一个、第二个和最后一个文件

c06ba617cdfd5394.source: A feed that can't be read is shown in red, with the reason on the line at the bottom.
c06ba617cdfd5394.text: 无法读取的订阅源会以红色显示，并在底部行显示原因。

c0b1dbae9f215d5b.source: A queue is a list of downloads that run in order, a few at a time. The Scheduler starts and stops queues by the clock, and decides what happens when a queue…
c0b1dbae9f215d5b.text: 队列是按顺序运行的下载列表，每次运行少量下载。计划程序按时启动和停止队列，并决定当队列…

c0e87656ac2a45a9.source: DDM's helper serves only its own extension. The browser says this copy isn't one it knows.
c0e87656ac2a45a9.text: DDM 的辅助程序只支持 DDM 自己的扩展程序。浏览器表示它不认识此副本。

c0ecd168d3eafca3.source: Choose the <x1/> folder inside DDM's folder. If you installed DDM for yourself, that is <x2/>; you can paste that path into the folder box.
c0ecd168d3eafca3.text: 选择 DDM 文件夹中的<x1/>文件夹。如果 DDM 是为当前用户安装的，该文件夹路径为<x2/>；您可以将此路径粘贴到文件夹框中。

c116d4790c19c234.source: <g1>Add the extension</g1><g2><g3>Add to Chrome</g3> (Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi too), then <g4>download your first file</g4>.</g2>
c116d4790c19c234.text: <g1>添加扩展</g1><g2><g3>添加至 Chrome</g3>（Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 也一样），然后<g4>下载第一个文件</g4>。</g2>

c11d7008d453dcff.source: Who makes Dannex Download Manager? — Dannex Download Manager
c11d7008d453dcff.text: Dannex Download Manager 的开发者是谁？ — Dannex Download Manager

c149996bb80b8d95.source: Pieces: the torrent's map, filling in.
c149996bb80b8d95.text: 分块：种子的地图，正在填充中。

c189ef9e90d38d62.source: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi can have the extension twice: the one from the Chrome Web Store and the one loaded from DDM's folder (<g1>Load unpacked</g1>). Both would take each download, so they ask each other: the Chrome Web Store's acts (it updates itself), and the other stands aside. It takes nothing, shows no right-click items and no <g2>Download video</g2> button, and its toolbar button is grey with an amber <g3>!</g3>: click it and <g4>Remove this copy</g4> removes it (the browser asks first). Or remove it on the browser's extensions page.
c189ef9e90d38d62.text: Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 中可能会同时有两个该扩展：一个来自 Chrome 应用商店，一个从 DDM 文件夹加载（<g1>加载已解压的扩展程序</g1>）。两者都会接管每个下载，因此它们会互相询问：由 Chrome 应用商店的那个执行（它会自行更新），另一个让路。让路的副本不接管任何内容，不显示右键菜单项，也没有<g2>下载视频</g2>按钮，其工具栏按钮是带琥珀色<g3>!</g3>的灰色：单击它，<g4>移除此副本</g4>会将其移除（浏览器会先询问）。也可以在浏览器的扩展页面中将其移除。

c198ddbdf007800c.source: A torrent's progress window on its Pieces tab: a square for each piece, filled once it's here
c198ddbdf007800c.text: 种子进度窗口的“分块”选项卡：每个分块一个方块，接收后即填满

c19e7b5dcccb7c52.source: Save to: each category's file types and folder.
c19e7b5dcccb7c52.text: 保存到：每个类别的文件类型和文件夹。

c1a12a7fb17ad7d1.source: <g1>Fix a translation</g1><g2>Five minutes on GitHub, no programming.</g2>
c1a12a7fb17ad7d1.text: <g1>修正翻译</g1><g2>只需在 GitHub 上花 5 分钟，无需编程。</g2>

c1b4301f449bb83a.text: <g1>Intel <x2/></g1><g3>搭载 Intel 处理器的 Mac。</g3>

c1c5e9a142f4dca5.source: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi from the Chrome Web Store; Firefox
c1c5e9a142f4dca5.text: Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 通过 Chrome 网上应用店；Firefox

c1daf2ce510da7ad.source: <g1>Coming from IDM?</g1> The windows and menus are where you expect them, and your IDM list comes over in one step. <g2>Switching from IDM</g2>
c1daf2ce510da7ad.text: <g1>从 IDM 转过来？</g1>窗口和菜单都在您期望的位置，您的 IDM 列表一步即可导入。<g2>从 IDM 迁移</g2>

c1e8d0f24b8d82b5.source: Through your VPN only: the network adapter and its kill switch
c1e8d0f24b8d82b5.text: 仅通过您的 VPN：网络适配器及其终止开关

c1e9d465c7f0810e.source: Batch downloads in Dannex Download Manager: a numbered series of files from one address with an asterisk, or every link in a text file at once.
c1e9d465c7f0810e.text: Dannex Download Manager 中的批量下载：从一个带有星号的地址下载一系列编号文件，或一次性下载文本文件中的所有链接。

c1f0aca8da2c29b8.source: The command line talks to it as to a desktop DDM, with the same data folder: <x1/> (once <x2/>), <x3/>, and adding an address: <x4/>.
c1f0aca8da2c29b8.text: 命令行与它通信，就像与桌面版 DDM 通信一样，使用相同的数据文件夹：<x1/>（曾经是<x2/>）、<x3/>，并添加一个地址：<x4/>。

c1f0fe23766943eb.source: The help pages' pictures (<x1/>) come from one list, <x2/>: <x3/> opens each window through DDM's own <x4/> command line in a test instance off the screen, crops and annotates it from the window's accessibility tree, and writes lossless WebP; <x5/> (CI) keeps the list, the pages and the files in step. The published ones are taken on GitHub's Windows runner (<x6/>).
c1f0fe23766943eb.text: 帮助页面的图片 (<x1/>) 来自一个列表，<x2/>：<x3/> 通过 DDM 自己的 <x4/> 命令行在屏幕外的测试实例中打开每个窗口，从窗口的可访问性树中裁剪和注释，并写入无损 WebP；<x5/> (CI) 保持列表、页面和文件同步。已发布的图片是在 GitHub 的 Windows 运行器上拍摄的 (<x6/>)。

c1f102b24f2583ca.source: <g1>Space</g1> ticks or unticks the selected row, <g2>Delete</g2> takes it out of the window, <g3>Ctrl+C</g3> copies its address, and typing a name's first letters goes to it.
c1f102b24f2583ca.text: <g1>空格键</g1>勾选或取消勾选所选的行，<g2>Delete</g2> 把它从窗口中移除，<g3>Ctrl+C</g3> 复制它的地址，输入名称的前几个字母则跳到它。

c21ae87a328182aa.source: <g1>Link grabber</g1><g2>A page's links gathered, sorted into packages and checked online, then the archives unpacked when they arrive.</g2>
c21ae87a328182aa.text: <g1>链接抓取器</g1><g2>抓取页面链接，将其分类打包并在线检查，下载完成后自动解压压缩包。</g2>

c229131cc9d6c4b8.source: Can I use it without installing it? — Dannex Download Manager
c229131cc9d6c4b8.text: 我可以不安装就使用它吗？— Dannex Download Manager

c26769b88da29046.source: Colour schemes made for other programs are themes too, with nothing to convert:
c26769b88da29046.text: 为其他程序制作的配色方案也可以作为主题，无需转换：

c2916feca482f00b.source: A caption button pressed (a tint over the bar)
c2916feca482f00b.text: 已按下的标题按钮（标题栏上的着色）

c293217ee47c70b1.source: A square standing for pieces partly here
c293217ee47c70b1.text: 表示部分已有的分块的方块

c2aad92c21bfdc4e.source: The speed limiter in Dannex Download Manager: one cap for all downloads, a limit per file or per download, and full speed when you're away.
c2aad92c21bfdc4e.text: Dannex Download Manager 中的速度限制器：所有下载任务的整体限速、按文件或按下载任务的限制，以及您不在电脑旁时的全速下载。

c2c8754abcc79249.source: This is the only part of DDM that waits for connections from outside. Downloads, DDM's DNS choice (Options → Connection → DNS), its updates and its helpers only connect out, so they never need a firewall exception; the browser extension and the automation API reach DDM on this computer only (127.0.0.1).
c2c8754abcc79249.text: 这是 DDM 唯一会等待外部连接的部分。下载、DDM 的 DNS 选择（选项 → 连接 → DNS）、更新和辅助程序都只发起外连，因此不需要防火墙例外；浏览器扩展和自动化 API 只会在这台计算机上连接 DDM（127.0.0.1）。

c337f01f6c9f7565.source: Lists your downloads, newest first: file, address, folder, status, size, how much is done, speed. It can list only one status (Queued, Downloading, Stopped, Complete, Error) or only names and addresses that contain some text.

c3d39f291e3ad7b6.text: 视图 → 绘制方式：OpenGL 和 Direct3D

c3d993e38044f5f8.source: DDM lists at most 20,000 videos of one list.
c3d993e38044f5f8.text: DDM 每个列表最多列出 20,000 个视频。

c3f061f877fd42a2.source: A server that sent parts of the file before but no longer does (it was set up again, or a different server now answers for it) can't continue what DDM has. DDM then downloads the same file again from the beginning, on one connection, and says so in the download's log: <g1>The server no longer sends parts of the file: downloading it again from the start</g1>. If the file itself changed meanwhile, it stops with <g2>the file changed on the server</g2> instead, and never mixes the two.
c3f061f877fd42a2.text: 以前发送过文件分块、现在不再发送的服务器（它被重新配置了，或现在由另一台服务器应答），无法接续 DDM 已有的内容。此时 DDM 会在一个连接上把同一个文件从头再下载一遍，并在下载的日志中说明：<g1>服务器不再发送文件的分块：从头重新下载</g1>。如果文件本身在此期间发生了变化，则改为以<g2>文件在服务器上已更改</g2>停止，绝不会把两者混在一起。

c3f1eac7793f1bf4.source: <g1>Export from IDM</g1><g2>In IDM, choose <g3>Tasks → Export → To IDM export file</g3> and save your list.</g2>
c3f1eac7793f1bf4.text: <g1>从 IDM 导出</g1><g2>在 IDM 中选择<g3>任务 → 导出 → 到 IDM 导出文件</g3>，保存您的列表。</g2>

c3f4e9d71b61ca1d.source: <g1>Help</g1> — help pages and tutorials (on the website, in your language when it has it), <g2>Keyboard shortcuts</g2>, <g3>Report a problem</g3>, <g4>Check for updates</g4>, <g5>About</g5>, <g6>Tell a friend</g6> and <g7>Support DDM</g7> (Dannex's page on GitHub Sponsors).
c3f4e9d71b61ca1d.text: <g1>帮助</g1> — 帮助页面和教程（在网站上，有您的语言时即为您的语言）、<g2>键盘快捷方式</g2>、<g3>报告问题</g3>、<g4>检查更新</g4>、<g5>关于</g5>、<g6>告诉朋友</g6>和<g7>支持 DDM</g7>（Dannex 在 GitHub Sponsors 上的页面）。

c4102de250d826ec.source: 50 MiB, every 2nd connection cut after 2 MiB, 4 MB/s
c4102de250d826ec.text: 50 MiB，每隔一个连接在 2 MiB 后中断，4 MB/秒

c4192131d214f412.source: <g1>The stack:</g1> the place in DDM's code where it crashed or froze, and what every other part of it was doing.
c4192131d214f412.text: <g1>调用堆栈：</g1>DDM 代码中发生崩溃或冻结的位置，以及其他各部分当时正在执行的操作。

c41cf3697bdcc8d7.source: The extension asks the host which file types to take, checks each download against them, and cancels the browser's download only after the app has accepted it; otherwise the browser keeps it, and the extension says why.
c41cf3697bdcc8d7.text: 扩展程序会询问主机要获取哪些文件类型，对照这些类型检查每个下载，并且仅在应用程序接受后才取消浏览器的下载；否则浏览器会保留它，扩展程序会说明原因。

c43443099dc14dc5.source: runs unit tests and end-to-end downloads against <x1/> with injected faults (slow, dropped and refused connections, servers without ranges, changing files). <x2/> pulls the network out mid-download (a proxy between the engine and the lab server, its connections broken and refused, then put back) and checks that a resume continues where it was, never from zero while it can, that an outage teaches no connection limit, and that a server that stopped sending parts of the file gets it again from the start; <x3/> runs those cases, a sleeping PC and a killed DDM in the real app. <x4/> runs the published speed comparison; its raw data is in <x5/>.
c43443099dc14dc5.text: 针对 <x1/> 运行单元测试和端到端下载，并注入故障（慢速、断开和被拒绝的连接、不支持 Range 的服务器、变化的文件）。<x2/> 在下载中途切断网络（在引擎与测试服务器之间放一个代理，使其连接中断并被拒绝，然后恢复），并检查：恢复总是从中断处继续，只要有可能就绝不从零开始；断网不会让它记住任何连接数限制；以及曾停止发送文件分块的服务器会被从头重新请求；<x3/> 在真实的应用中运行这些用例，还包括电脑睡眠和 DDM 被强制结束的情形。<x4/> 运行已发布的速度对比；其原始数据在 <x5/> 中。

c43a066c9b68a599.source: If Dannex Download Manager closes unexpectedly or stops responding, a <g1>crash report</g1> window opens. It shows what happened, lets you read the whole report, and can send it to the developers on GitHub. Each report helps fix the problem for everyone.
c43a066c9b68a599.text: 如果 Dannex Download Manager 意外关闭或停止响应，会打开一个<g1>崩溃报告</g1>窗口。窗口会显示发生了什么，您可以阅读完整报告，也可以将报告发送给 GitHub 上的开发者。每份报告都有助于解决问题，让所有人受益。

c467885946dc6e66.source: Your download list, settings, logins you save in <g1>Sites Logins</g1>, the history of each download and the files you download are stored only on your computer: in <x2/> on Windows (or the <x3/> folder of the portable copy), and in the usual application-data folder on macOS and Linux. Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Uninstalling offers to delete them. The passwords of Sites Logins, the proxy and debrid accounts go into the system's keychain instead (Windows Credential Manager, the keyring on Linux, the macOS keychain), still on your computer, when one is there and unlocked.
c467885946dc6e66.text: 您的下载列表、设置、您在<g1>站点登录</g1>中保存的登录信息、每个下载的历史记录以及您下载的文件，仅存储在您的计算机上：在 Windows 上位于 <x2/>（或便携版的 <x3/> 文件夹），在 macOS 和 Linux 上位于常见的应用程序数据文件夹。不会上传到任何地方。卸载时可选择将其删除。站点登录、代理和 debrid 帐户的密码则会改存入系统的钥匙串（Windows 凭据管理器、Linux 上的密钥环、macOS 钥匙串），仍在您的计算机上，前提是存在钥匙串且已解锁。

c48962c07ea187bc.source: The video helpers window: yt-dlp and ffmpeg, each with its version and Use another program...
c48962c07ea187bc.text: 视频辅助程序窗口：yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg，各自显示版本，并提供“使用其他程序…”

c49b0509a84e8637.source: Which systems does it run on? — Dannex Download Manager
c49b0509a84e8637.text: Dannex Download Manager 适用于哪些系统？

c49b538c60630963.source: Already have yt-dlp or ffmpeg for another program? Use those instead of a second copy: in <g1>Download video from a page</g1>, click <g2>Helpers...</g2>, then <g3>Use another program...</g3> beside yt-dlp or ffmpeg, and choose the program. DDM runs it once to check that it is that program, and uses it from then on, the command line too. DDM doesn't update a program you chose: keep it up to date yourself (yt-dlp: <x4/>, or your package manager). <g5>Use DDM's own copy</g5> goes back to the one DDM downloads and checks.
c49b538c60630963.text: 已经为其他程序准备了 yt-dlp 或 ffmpeg？可以使用现有版本，无需再下载一份：在<g1>从页面下载视频</g1>窗口中，点击<g2>帮助程序...</g2>，然后点击 yt-dlp 或 ffmpeg 旁边的<g3>使用其他程序...</g3>，并选择程序。DDM 会运行一次以确认它是相应程序，之后就会一直使用它，包括通过命令行使用。DDM 不会更新您选择的程序，请自行保持其为最新版本（yt-dlp：<x4/>，或使用您的包管理器）。点击<g5>使用 DDM 自己的副本</g5>，即可切换回 DDM 下载并验证的版本。

c5178e948d40336d.source: <g1>The address isn't filled in:</g1> the clipboard didn't hold a web address. Paste it into <g2>Address</g2> yourself.
c5178e948d40336d.text: <g1>地址未填写：</g1>剪贴板中没有网页地址。请自行粘贴到<g2>地址</g2>中。

c5273f279d6aea54.text: RSS 源：DDM 订阅的源及其条目

c556890742fab7cf.source: If it says <g1>this site lets only browsers through</g1>, the site's bot check (Cloudflare's, for one) turned DDM away. DDM has already asked once more connecting the way your browser does, with your browser's cookies for that site, and the site still wants its check answered in a browser. Click <g2>Download with the browser</g2> in the download's progress window, or right-click the download and choose <g3>Download with the browser</g3>: its address opens in the browser it came from (or your default browser), where you can answer the check, and the browser keeps that download. The row stays in DDM's list; <g4>Resume</g4> tries again there. See <g5>Browser integration</g5>. Where DDM offers no such button (a link it looked at before adding it), hold <g6>Alt</g6> as you click the link to leave that download to the browser.
c556890742fab7cf.text: 如果提示<g1>此站点只允许浏览器访问</g1>，说明站点的机器人检查（例如 Cloudflare 的）挡住了 DDM。DDM 已按浏览器的连接方式，带着您的浏览器在该站点的 Cookie 再请求过一次，站点仍要求在浏览器中完成其检查。请在该下载的进度窗口中点击<g2>使用浏览器下载</g2>，或右键点击该下载并选择<g3>使用浏览器下载</g3>：其地址会在它来源的浏览器（或您的默认浏览器）中打开，您可在那里完成检查，并由浏览器保存该下载。该行仍留在 DDM 的列表中；<g4>恢复</g4>会在 DDM 中再试一次。参见<g5>浏览器集成</g5>。在 DDM 没有此按钮的地方（添加前已查看过的链接），点击链接时按住 <g6>Alt</g6>，可把该下载留给浏览器。

c559f2c786117bc1.source: IDM is the more mature product, refined over many years. DDM finished faster in <g1>our benchmark</g1>: a 1 GiB file in 1.0 s against IDM 6.42's 5.5 s, on the same PC and the same test server. The <g2>FAQ</g2> sums up the other differences.
c559f2c786117bc1.text: IDM 是一个更成熟的产品，经过多年完善。DDM 在<g1>我们的基准测试</g1>中完成速度更快：在同一台电脑和同一测试服务器上，下载 1 GiB 文件，DDM 用时 1.0 秒，而 IDM 6.42 用时 5.5 秒。<g2>常见问题</g2>总结了其他差异。

c564fdc189f16e5a.source: A finished file is checked at once. Ask while it is still downloading, and DDM checks it when the download ends. You can paste the code as soon as the download starts, and come back to the answer.
c564fdc189f16e5a.text: 已完成的文件会立即进行检查。如果文件仍在下载中，您也可以提前粘贴校验和，DDM 会在下载结束时进行检查。下载一开始您就可以粘贴代码，稍后再回来查看结果。

c5951459908e695f.text: 一个表格，每行显示一个连接：连接编号、已下载量以及当前正在执行的操作。

c59c7bae05030444.source: In Firefox, DDM sees the proxy the browser's own request for the file took, including the ones a VPN extension picks for each request. In Chrome and the other Chromium browsers, it sees the browser's proxy settings: the server for the download's scheme (honouring their bypass list) or their proxy auto-config script.
c59c7bae05030444.text: 在 Firefox 中，DDM 会看到浏览器自身请求文件所使用的代理，包括 VPN 扩展为每个请求选择的代理。在 Chrome 和其他 Chromium 浏览器中，DDM 会看到浏览器的代理设置：下载方案的服务器（遵循其绕过列表）或其代理自动配置脚本。

c5cc7f4bb704a45c.source: <g1>View → Follow the system's dark mode</g1>, <g2>Always dark</g2>, <g3>Theme</g3>, <g4>Draw with</g4>, <g5>Interface size</g5> and <g6>Language</g6>. See <g7>Getting started</g7> and <g8>Troubleshooting</g8>.

c5cd6785a2506461.source: <g1>New queue</g1> asks for the new queue's name and adds it. <g2>Delete</g2> removes one of your own queues; the two built-in queues can't be deleted. A deleted queue's downloads stay in the list.

c5e16d0a0b60859c.source: <g1>Web pages can't use it</g1>: requests must name DDM's own address, come from its own page, and carry the token; DDM's page can't be shown inside another site.
c5e16d0a0b60859c.text: <g1>网页无法使用</g1>：请求必须指定 DDM 自己的地址，来自其自己的页面，并携带令牌；DDM 的页面不能在其他网站中显示。

c6284e056b1e8432.source: (or <x1/>) removes the programs, and the small files that tell your browsers where DDM's helper is: the .deb and .rpm install those for everyone (in <x2/> and <x3/>), for Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Helium and Firefox (the Snap too), so DDM doesn't write them in your home folder. On Linux an administrator allows it once. On macOS only an administrator can schedule a wake, so the option is greyed there. DDM never asks for an administrator's password.

c9b8907290abec7f.source: <g1>Block the addresses in this list</g1> takes the address of a public IP blocklist, in the P2P (PeerGuardian) or eMule <x2/> format, plain or gzipped. DDM downloads it with its own downloader (your Proxy / Socks settings apply), checks it, and fetches it again every 7 days. Peers in it are refused. A list DDM can't read is left out, and the last good one stays. The engine reads the list when it starts.
c9b8907290abec7f.text: <g1>阻止此列表中的地址</g1>使用公共 IP 地址屏蔽列表的网址，支持 P2P (PeerGuardian) 或 eMule <x2/> 格式，也支持纯文本或 gzip 压缩格式。DDM 会使用自己的下载器获取列表（适用您的代理/Socks 设置），检查列表，并每 7 天重新获取一次。列表中的对等方会被拒绝连接。DDM 无法读取的列表会被忽略，并继续使用上次成功读取的列表。种子引擎会在启动时读取列表。

cb08223c7c338389.source: Start the video first: the extension notes what the page loads as it plays: whatever the browser fetches as a video or a sound (by its type, or by its address's extension), and whatever a player element plays even when its server names no type at all; a radio station's endless stream is noted too, named after the station. A file a player fetches piece by piece counts as one file. On a page that moves to another address without loading anew (YouTube, X, TikTok, SoundCloud), what its player loaded stays: a post opened from a feed keeps the stream the feed's player loaded, tied to that player by its picture's id or its length, never offered as the new page's own. A stream whose address doesn't end in <x1/> or <x2/>, served as plain text, is found too: when you press the button over its player (or right-click it), the extension reads the first few kilobytes of what that player fetched to recognise it. A file a player fetched piece by piece is offered only once its first 64 KB, read again from the page as the player read them, show that it is that player's whole video (an MP4 of the same length and picture size; never a piece of a stream, which could be the picture without its sound); <g3>Download all videos and audio</g3> leaves such files out. Nothing is read until the video has played a second in view, or you point at the button or press it, and each file once. Pieces of a stream (its segments) are never sent.
cb08223c7c338389.text: 先开始播放视频：扩展会在页面播放时记下它加载的内容：浏览器当作视频或声音获取的一切（按其类型，或按其地址的扩展名），以及播放器元素播放的一切，即使它的服务器没有给出任何类型；电台的无尽流也会被记下，并以电台命名。分块获取的文件算作一个文件。在不重新加载就跳转到另一个地址的页面上（YouTube、X、TikTok、SoundCloud），播放器之前加载的内容会保留：从信息流中打开的帖子保留信息流的播放器加载的流，通过其封面图的 ID 或时长与该播放器关联，绝不会作为新页面自己的内容提供。地址不以 <x1/> 或 <x2/> 结尾、以纯文本形式提供的流也能找到：当您按下其播放器上方的按钮（或右键点击它）时，扩展会读取该播放器所获取内容的前几 KB 来识别它。播放器分块获取的文件，只有当它最初的 64 KB（从页面中按播放器读取时的方式再读一遍）表明这就是该播放器的完整视频（长度和画面尺寸相同的 MP4；绝不是流的一个片段，那可能只有画面没有声音）时才会提供；<g3>下载所有视频和音频</g3>会略过这类文件。在视频在视野内播放满一秒、或您指向或按下按钮之前，不会读取任何内容，并且每个文件只读一次。流的片段（分段）绝不会发送。

It needs no desktop libraries: DDM loads those only to open a window, which a server never does.

cb697c3473b99043.source: When a connection finishes its part, it takes over half of the largest part still left, so no connection sits idle while another one is still working. Near the end, a part so small that it would arrive sooner on the connection that has it than on a new request is left to that connection.
cb697c3473b99043.text: 一个连接完成自己的部分后，会接手剩余最大部分的一半，这样在其他连接还在工作时，不会有连接闲着。接近结束时，如果某部分小到由持有它的连接来接收比发新请求更快，就留给那个连接。

ce4fd432ce06bf19.source: The app icon, Comet, is drawn from geometry as SVG (<x1/>, rendered by resvg; <x2/> writes every size, placed for whole pixels from 16 to 32 px). Every place that shows it takes the drawing for its size on screen (<x3/>): on Windows each window's title bar and taskbar icons at its display's scale (<x4/>, which also keeps them through a move to another display), the tray's at the taskbar's. View → DDM tray icon shows it in full colour (3D style) or the mark alone in the taskbar's ink (Flat style: white on a dark taskbar, dark on a light one; a template image on macOS), with a slim bar along its foot while downloads run. Its tip lists each running download (<x5/>, within Windows' 127 characters); its menu pauses and resumes everything and sets the Speed Limiter's speed. Notify when downloads complete (<x6/>) gathers downloads that end close together into one quiet notification: on Windows the shell's (<x7/>'s NIF_INFO, no sound, respecting quiet time, from the tray's watcher thread since it waits for Explorer), on Linux the desktop's (org.freedesktop.Notifications over D-Bus), on macOS AppleScript's <x8/>.
ce4fd432ce06bf19.text: 应用图标 Comet 由几何图形绘制成 SVG（<x1/>，由 resvg 渲染；<x2/> 写出所有尺寸，在 16 到 32 px 之间按整像素对齐）。显示它的每个地方都按屏幕上的尺寸取用对应的图稿（<x3/>）：在 Windows 上，每个窗口的标题栏和任务栏图标按其显示器的缩放比例取用（<x4/>，移到另一台显示器时也保持如此），托盘图标则按任务栏的缩放比例。视图 → DDM 托盘图标可选择全彩显示（3D 样式），或仅显示标志并采用任务栏的墨色（扁平样式：深色任务栏上为白色，浅色任务栏上为深色；macOS 上为模板图像），下载进行时图标底部有一条细进度条。它的提示列出每个正在进行的下载（<x5/>，不超过 Windows 的 127 个字符）；它的菜单可暂停和恢复所有下载，并设置速度限制器的速度。下载完成时通知（<x6/>）会把相近时间结束的下载合并成一条安静的通知：在 Windows 上使用系统外壳的通知（<x7/> 的 NIF_INFO，无声音，遵守安静时段，由托盘的监视线程发出，因为它要等待资源管理器），在 Linux 上使用桌面的通知（通过 D-Bus 的 org.freedesktop.Notifications），在 macOS 上使用 AppleScript 的 <x8/>。

d36d6f6b1b19acb1.source: With the DDM extension, clicking a download link in your browser hands the download to DDM. DDM gets the address together with the page it came from (the referrer), your cookies for the site and the browser's User-Agent, so downloads that need you to be signed in still work. It also gets the address the browser's own download had reached: when a site refuses DDM the link itself (a one-time link the browser has already used, or a site that lets only browsers ask for its links), DDM goes on from there once, without your cookies if it is another site. When a site's bot check (Cloudflare's, for one) or its refusal of programs (FileHippo's <g1>412 Precondition Failed</g1>) turns DDM's own connection away, DDM asks once more connecting the way your browser does (the same handshake, settings and order of headers), with your browser's User-Agent and its cookies for that site only, and downloads on that one connection; your proxy, network adapter and speed limits apply as usual. It solves no challenge: a site that still wants one answered refuses again, and DDM says <g2>this site lets only browsers through</g2>, with a way to hand the download back to the browser (see <g3>A site that lets only browsers through</g3>).
d36d6f6b1b19acb1.text: 安装 DDM 扩展后，在浏览器中点击下载链接，就会把下载交给 DDM。DDM 会同时获得地址、它所在的页面（来源页面，即 referrer）、您在该站点的 Cookie 以及浏览器的 User-Agent，因此需要登录的下载仍可正常进行。DDM 还会得到浏览器自身下载所到达的地址：当站点拒绝 DDM 访问链接本身时（浏览器已用过的一次性链接，或只允许浏览器请求其链接的站点），DDM 会从那里继续一次；如果是另一个站点，则不带您的 Cookie。当站点的机器人检查（例如 Cloudflare 的）或它对程序的拒绝（例如 FileHippo 的 <g1>412 Precondition Failed</g1>）挡住 DDM 自己的连接时，DDM 会再请求一次，并采用与浏览器相同的连接方式（相同的握手、设置和请求头顺序），使用浏览器的 User-Agent 和您仅在该站点的 Cookie，并在这一条连接上完成下载；您的代理、网络适配器和速度限制照常适用。DDM 不会解答任何验证：站点若仍要求回答，就会再次拒绝，DDM 会提示<g2>此站点只允许浏览器访问</g2>，并提供把下载交还给浏览器的办法（参见<g3>只允许浏览器访问的站点</g3>）。

d8ff54ee1079a9a1.source: One egui window painted to fixed pixel coordinates, plus one immediate viewport per dialog. <x1/> and its modules (<x2/>, see <g3>Source layout</g3>) hold the state (downloads, queues, settings, the list's selection) and turn menu, toolbar, key and IPC commands into actions. Each dialog is its own module and returns an <x4/> (open, closed, done with a value). A window that comes up by itself (Download complete, a message DDM tells, a question while DDM isn't the program in front) shows above the others without taking the keyboard from the program being typed in (<x5/>, <x6/>); those the person asked for take it. Windows handed over one after another (Download File Info, Add torrent, Download video) and Download complete boxes show one at a time, in one place, the next when one closes. Windows-only calls are confined to <x7/> (and its modules in <x8/>) and their Linux and macOS counterparts to <x9/> (starting with the session, the browsers' host, sounds, show in folder, the crash handler); every other file is safe, portable Rust. Fonts come from the system: Windows' Fonts folder, macOS's system fonts, fontconfig on Linux (<x10/>). On Windows, Latin, Greek and Cyrillic text is drawn by DirectWrite (<x11/>, through egui's glyph rasterizer hook): View → Text → Smooth in its natural mode, anti-aliased at the size asked for and placed at quarter pixels with the font's own advances; Classic (the default) in GDI-classic mode, so each letter's hinted shape and whole-pixel width come together. Other scripts are shaped and drawn by egui.
d8ff54ee1079a9a1.text: 一个 egui 窗口按固定的像素坐标绘制，每个对话框再各有一个即时视口。<x1/> 及其模块（<x2/>，见<g3>源码布局</g3>）保存状态（下载、队列、设置、列表的选择），并把菜单、工具栏、按键和 IPC 命令转换为操作。每个对话框都是各自的模块，并返回一个 <x4/>（打开、已关闭、已完成并带有一个值）。自行弹出的窗口（“下载完成”、DDM 发出的消息、DDM 不在前台时的提问）显示在其他窗口之上，但不会从正在输入的程序那里夺走键盘（<x5/>、<x6/>）；用户主动要求打开的窗口则会获得键盘。依次交出的窗口（“下载文件信息”、“添加种子”、“下载视频”）和“下载完成”框一次只显示一个，位置相同，一个关闭后再显示下一个。仅限 Windows 的调用集中在 <x7/>（及其在 <x8/> 中的模块），其在 Linux 和 macOS 上的对应实现集中在 <x9/>（从会话、浏览器的主机程序、声音、在文件夹中显示、崩溃处理程序开始）；其他所有文件都是安全、可移植的 Rust。字体来自系统：Windows 的 Fonts 文件夹（Windows\Fonts）、macOS 的系统字体、Linux 上的 fontconfig（<x10/>）。在 Windows 上，拉丁、希腊和西里尔文字由 DirectWrite 绘制（<x11/>，通过 egui 的字形光栅化钩子）：视图 → 文本 → 平滑采用自然模式，按所请求的大小抗锯齿，并按四分之一像素定位，使用字体自身的字宽；经典（默认）采用 GDI 经典模式，使每个字母的微调后字形和整像素字宽相配合。其他文字由 egui 排版和绘制。

d9012cd2cc61f595.source: Choose <g1>Tasks → Add batch download</g1>. (<g2>Tasks → Add batch download from clipboard</g2> fills in a copied address.)
d9012cd2cc61f595.text: 选择<g1>任务 → 添加批量下载</g1>。（<g2>任务 → 从剪贴板添加批处理下载</g2>会填入复制的地址。）

d92e798028b1fd1b.source: <g1>Pick your language</g1><g2>Keep <g3>Set up browser integration</g3> ticked, and DDM is ready.</g2>
d92e798028b1fd1b.text: <g1>选择语言</g1><g2>保持勾选<g3>设置浏览器集成</g3>，DDM 就准备好了。</g2>

d92f326852722dd3.source: Does it work on Mac and Linux?
d92f326852722dd3.text: 它能在 Mac 和 Linux 上运行吗？

d94a2a0bd3b3eb43.source: <g1>View → Theme → Add a theme file…</g1> does it for you: pick a file anywhere, and DDM copies it into the themes folder and uses it at once. A file that isn't a theme stays out, and DDM says why.
d94a2a0bd3b3eb43.text: <g1>视图 → 主题 → 添加主题文件…</g1> 即可完成操作：选择任意文件，DDM 会将其复制到主题文件夹并立即应用。如果文件不是主题文件，DDM 会将其排除并说明原因。

d94f1c99aee6b6e7.source: <g1>Credentials stay with their site.</g1> Logins and cookies are sent only to the host they belong to, even across redirects.
d94f1c99aee6b6e7.text: <g1>凭据仅用于对应的网站。</g1>登录信息和 Cookie 只会发送到所属主机，即使经过重定向也是如此。

d9862086c382da0c.source: Wake the computer to run a queue

d98730d2220f7083.source: If DDM says it's up to date, there's nothing for you to do. The extension updates by itself through its store and can get ahead of the app for a while. Everything keeps working, and the message goes away with the next version of DDM.
d98730d2220f7083.text: 如果 DDM 提示已是最新版本，则无需进行任何操作。扩展程序会通过其商店自行更新，有时会比应用程序版本更新得快。所有功能仍可正常使用，此消息将在 DDM 的下一个版本中消失。

d9b76e3e6afd2fa9.source: <g1><g2>Download a video from a page</g2></g1> — pick a quality and save a video.
d9b76e3e6afd2fa9.text: <g1><g2>从页面下载视频</g2></g1> — 选择质量并保存视频。

d9c09dd097c849db.source: On Linux and macOS, DDM sets browser integration up itself each time it starts: start DDM once. <g1>Test browser integration</g1> says what went wrong if it couldn't, such as <g2>The helper program the browsers start is missing</g2>: <g3>Set it up</g3> puts it back.
d9c09dd097c849db.text: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 每次启动时都会自行设置浏览器集成：只需启动 DDM 一次。<g1>测试浏览器集成</g1> 会说明如果设置失败，例如出现 <g2>浏览器启动的帮助程序缺失</g2>，是哪里出了问题：点击 <g3>设置</g3> 即可修复。

d9dde89e1b709127.source: Add URL: the copied address is already there. Click OK.
d9dde89e1b709127.text: 添加 URL：复制的地址已在其中。点击“确定”。

d9f725fa45412644.source: <g1><g2>Site grabber</g2></g1> — explore a web site a few links deep and download its pictures, documents or media, or the whole site to read offline.
d9f725fa45412644.text: <g1><g2>站点抓取器</g2></g1> — 从网站向下探索几层链接，下载其图片、文档或媒体，或下载整个网站以便离线阅读。

da1944611f1b4a60.source: <g1>Off by default</g1>, and nothing listens while it is off.
da1944611f1b4a60.text: <g1>默认关闭</g1>，关闭时没有任何监听。

da19625cfdf84664.source: IDM itself is closed source. Dannex Download Manager is open source (GPL-3.0) and laid out the way IDM users expect, but it's a separate program written from scratch. Anyone can read its code on <g1>GitHub</g1>.
da19625cfdf84664.text: IDM 本身是闭源的。Dannex Download Manager 是开源的 (GPL-3.0)，布局符合 IDM 用户的期望，但它是一个从头开始编写的独立程序。任何人都可以到 <g1>GitHub</g1> 阅读其代码。

da1c1be39d578250.source: <g1>When done, turn off the computer</g1> — choose <g2>Shut down</g2>, <g3>Sleep</g3> or <g4>Hibernate</g4>.
da1c1be39d578250.text: <g1>完成后关闭计算机</g1> — 选择<g2>关机</g2>、<g3>睡眠</g3>或<g4>休眠</g4>。

da2e1f2b68c87f18.source: Let the home server do the downloading.

da35426aeb049210.source: <g1>Stop All</g1> on the toolbar (or <g2>Downloads → Stop All</g2>, <g3>Pause All</g3>) stops every running queue along with the downloads, so no queue starts its next file. Started again, a queue goes on where it stopped.
da35426aeb049210.text: 工具栏上的<g1>停止所有</g1>（或<g2>下载 → 停止所有</g2>、<g3>暂停所有</g3>）会连同下载一起停止所有正在运行的队列，因此没有队列会开始下一个文件。再次启动后，队列会从停止处继续。

da373eda9cbcb8a7.source: It asks sites for one picture a second at most, and names itself as DDM, because some servers, Wikimedia's among them, refuse tools that ask faster or without a name. It uses no configuration file of yours.
da373eda9cbcb8a7.text: 它最多每秒向网站请求一张图片，并自称为 DDM，因为某些服务器（包括维基媒体的服务器）会拒绝请求过快或未命名的工具。它不使用您的任何配置文件。

da42e0ecc146e6f3.source: DDM can unpack an archive as soon as its download completes, or when you ask. A split archive waits for its last part, and nothing already on your disk is overwritten.
da42e0ecc146e6f3.text: DDM 可以在压缩包下载完成后立即解压，或在您需要时解压。分卷压缩包会等待所有部分下载完毕，并且不会覆盖您磁盘上已有的文件。

da51f77fc03674c8.source: <g1>From the Chrome Web Store:</g1> the browser updates it by itself within a few hours. <g2>Check for updates</g2> on the status page asks now.
da51f77fc03674c8.text: <g1>来自 Chrome 应用商店：</g1>浏览器会在几小时内自动更新它。状态页上的<g2>检查更新</g2>会立即询问。

da6586417d8dd463.source: Done: Open the file, or Open folder.
da6586417d8dd463.text: 完成：打开文件，或打开文件夹。

da6edd8a7cee18e1.source: where it listens: every local network address unless given
da6edd8a7cee18e1.text: 监听地址：除非指定，否则为所有本地网络地址

da732a1798c9def9.source: Pick the service, then either: - <g1>Sign in in the browser</g1> (Real-Debrid, AllDebrid and TorBox): DDM shows a code and opens the service's page (TorBox's is also at <x2/>). Type the code there (AllDebrid's page already has it) and allow DDM. The dialog notices on its own. - or paste your <g3>API token</g3> (<g4>Find my token</g4> opens the service's page that shows it), then <g5>Use the token</g5>. Premiumize signs in this way only: paste the API key from its Account page.
da732a1798c9def9.text: 选择服务，然后： - <g1>在浏览器中登录</g1> (Real-Debrid、AllDebrid 和 TorBox)：DDM 会显示一个代码并打开服务页面 (TorBox 的页面也在 <x2/>)。在那里输入代码 (AllDebrid 的页面已包含该代码) 并授权 DDM。对话框会自动检测到。 - 或粘贴您的 <g3>API 令牌</g3> (<g4>查找我的令牌</g4> 会打开显示该令牌的服务页面)，然后<g5>使用令牌</g5>。Premiumize 仅通过此方式登录：从其“账户”页面粘贴 API 密钥。

da77eb1016522f8a.source: <g1>Your own copy:</g1> <g2>Helpers...</g2> (in the gallery window or the video window) lists yt-dlp, ffmpeg and gallery-dl, and <g3>Use another program...</g3> takes your own copy of each instead of DDM's.
da77eb1016522f8a.text: <g1>您自己的副本：</g1><g2>帮助程序...</g2>（在图库窗口或视频窗口中）会列出 yt-dlp、ffmpeg 和 gallery-dl；点击<g3>使用其他程序...</g3>即可使用您自己的相应程序，而不是 DDM 提供的程序。

daa2aa4f40324179.source: From the Download video button in your browser
daa2aa4f40324179.text: 通过浏览器中的“下载视频”按钮

dabaf2be6d185ffc.source: Questions about these terms: open an <g1>issue on GitHub</g1>.
dabaf2be6d185ffc.text: 有关这些条款的问题：请在<g1>GitHub 上提交问题</g1>。

daf0900c44e24071.source: Removes downloads from the list and keeps their files, or deletes the files too when asked. A running download must be paused first.
daf0900c44e24071.text: 从列表中删除下载并保留其文件，或者在要求时也删除文件。正在运行的下载必须先暂停。

db1d3aacdb01ca65.source: Files are only the start. Here is what else DDM brings in, shown in the real windows.
db1d3aacdb01ca65.text: 文件只是开始。下面是 DDM 还能下载的内容，展示的都是真实窗口。

db3865d429f20bf4.source: DDM keeps the choice with the download, after a restart too.
db3865d429f20bf4.text: DDM 会将此选择与下载一起保存，即使重启后也是如此。

db3d951916b6ce25.source: <g1>Firefox as a Snap</g1> (Ubuntu's own Firefox) reaches DDM through the desktop, which reads the browser files in your home folder and those the .deb or .rpm installs for everyone. The first time the extension calls DDM, the desktop asks <g2>Allow Firefox to start WebExtension backend?</g2> for Dannex Download Manager: choose <g3>Allow</g3>. After <g4>Don't allow</g4>, the extension says the connection failed and the desktop doesn't ask again; to be asked again, run this in a terminal, then use the extension again:
db3d951916b6ce25.text: <g1>Snap 版 Firefox</g1>（Ubuntu 自带的 Firefox）通过桌面环境连接 DDM，桌面环境会读取您主文件夹中的浏览器文件以及 .deb 或 .rpm 为所有用户安装的文件。扩展程序首次调用 DDM 时，桌面环境会询问“<g2>允许 Firefox 启动 WebExtension 后端吗？</g2>”以连接 Dannex Download Manager：请选择<g3>允许</g3>。选择<g4>不允许</g4>后，扩展程序会提示连接失败，并且桌面环境不会再次询问；要再次被询问，请在终端中运行以下命令，然后再次使用扩展程序：

db3fcf8fdc9287f7.source: For Ubuntu, Debian, Mint and Pop!_OS: <x1/>. It brings the libraries DDM needs.
db3fcf8fdc9287f7.text: 适用于 Ubuntu、Debian、Mint 和 Pop!_OS：<x1/>。它包含了 DDM 所需的库。

db45ba1da15b395c.source: <g1>Temporary folder</g1> — empty (the default), each download writes straight into a part file next to its file, so nothing is copied at the end. Type a folder or click <g2>Browse</g2> to keep the part files there until their downloads complete; on another drive than a download's folder, its file is then copied over. A download paused before you changed it moves its part file there when it goes on. Video pages, galleries and torrents keep their own files where they always do.
db45ba1da15b395c.text: <g1>临时文件夹</g1> — 留空（默认）时，每个下载直接写入其文件旁边的分块文件，因此最后无需复制。输入文件夹或单击<g2>浏览</g2>，可将分块文件保留在那里，直到下载完成；如果与下载文件夹不在同一驱动器上，完成后文件会被复制过去。在您更改之前已暂停的下载，在继续时会将其分块文件移到那里。视频页面、图库和种子仍将自己的文件保存在原来的位置。

db5e343720753d5c.source: A split button's divider at rest: its shadow
db5e343720753d5c.text: 分割按钮静止时的分隔线：其阴影

db74b9137912e0a2.source: A proxy that asks for a login the VPN extension gives itself can't be shared: no other program has that login. The download then stops and says so, rather than going without the proxy. Use the VPN's own app, or choose its adapter under <g1>Network adapter</g1>.
db74b9137912e0a2.text: 如果代理需要 VPN 扩展自行提供的登录信息，就无法共享：其他程序无法获取这些登录信息。此时下载会停止并说明原因，而不会绕过代理继续下载。请使用 VPN 自带的应用，或在<g1>网络适配器</g1>中选择 VPN 的适配器。

db8cdac77d138076.source: Seven downloads, each run at least seven times by both programs. The bar is the middle half of the runs, the line the median.
db8cdac77d138076.text: 共七项下载，两个程序各至少运行七次。柱条表示中间一半的运行，线表示中位数。

db94ba5f97a1f9e2.source: The extension shows almost nothing of its own, as users of other download managers expect: a click on its toolbar button turns taking downloads off and on, its right-click menu has "Don't take downloads from this site" and Help (<x1/>, the status page: installed, or what is wrong and the one thing to do), and its options page (<x2/>) has only that switch, the browser's proxy (#42) and another DDM (#157). It never asks the app for its downloads (extensions up to {v1} did, for a window of their own: the host refuses that question now, and the app answers the automation API's <x3/> and actions only while the API is on).
db94ba5f97a1f9e2.text: 此扩展自身几乎不显示任何内容，正如其他下载管理器的用户所期望的：单击其工具栏按钮即可关闭和开启下载接管，其右键菜单有“不接管此站点的下载”和“帮助”（<x1/>，状态页：已安装，或出了什么问题以及该做的一件事），其选项页（<x2/>）只有该开关、浏览器的代理 (#42) 和另一个 DDM (#157)。它从不向应用索取其下载（{v1} 及更早版本的扩展会这样做，以便显示自己的窗口：宿主现在会拒绝该请求，而应用仅在自动化 API 开启时才回应该 API 的 <x3/> 和操作）。

db9fa76ff6d7cfdc.source: <g1>Open source.</g1> Anyone can read the code and check what it does. No adware, no telemetry.
db9fa76ff6d7cfdc.text: <g1>开源。</g1>任何人都可以阅读代码，查验它做了什么。没有广告软件，没有遥测。

dba089f6ed3c76a8.source: Black and white, a bright accent, every edge drawn, text at 7:1 or more.
dba089f6ed3c76a8.text: 黑白分明，明亮的强调色，每条边缘都清晰可见，文本对比度达到 7:1 或更高。

dba8d8facfbe6234.source: <g1>The browser.</g1> Right-click a page for <g2>Download all links with DDM</g2>, or select part of it for <g3>Download selected links with DDM</g3>. The page's referrer and cookies go with each link, and so does the text the page shows for it (its words, or a picture's description), in the <g4>Link text</g4> column.
dba8d8facfbe6234.text: <g1>浏览器。</g1>右键点击页面，选择<g2>使用 DDM 下载所有链接</g2>，或者选中页面的一部分，选择<g3>使用 DDM 下载选定链接</g3>。页面的来源页和 Cookie 会随每个链接一起发送，页面为该链接显示的文字（它的文字，或图片的描述）也会一起发送，显示在<g4>链接文字</g4>列中。

dbab4b9a74908e08.source: Your system's accent colour and contrast setting, followed as you change them, on Windows, Linux and macOS.
dbab4b9a74908e08.text: 在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 会跟随您更改系统强调色和对比度设置。

dbd76771e65e9757.source: <g1>Where it comes from:</g1> DDM downloads gallery-dl from its releases on Codeberg. It accepts it only when the release's checksum list is signed by gallery-dl's author's key, pinned in DDM, and the program matches that list. It keeps the previous version and never goes back to an older one. On Windows and on Linux (x86-64) DDM installs it; on macOS, install it with Homebrew (<x2/>) or pip.
dbd76771e65e9757.text: <g1>来源：</g1> DDM 从 Codeberg 上的发布下载 gallery-dl。只有当发布版本的校验和列表由 DDM 中固定的 gallery-dl 作者密钥签名，并且程序与该列表匹配时，DDM 才接受它。它会保留上一个版本，并且绝不会回滚到旧版本。在 Windows 和 Linux (x86-64) 上，DDM 会安装它；在 macOS 上，请使用 Homebrew (<x2/>) 或 pip 安装。

dbd790f226f0403e.source: Capped by data, not by speed
dbd790f226f0403e.text: 按数据量而非速度限制

dbf30e7142611530.source: "What is DDM downloading right now, and how long is left?"
dbf30e7142611530.text: “DDM 现在正在下载什么，还剩多长时间？”

dc16ecd169b3a1c1.source: <g1>Link text</g1>: what the page shows for the link;
dc16ecd169b3a1c1.text: <g1>链接文字</g1>：页面为该链接显示的内容；

dc1a2189e80bed74.source: <g1>Downloads in progress</g1> lists the running downloads. Choose one to see its progress window.
dc1a2189e80bed74.text: <g1>正在进行的下载</g1>列出正在运行的下载。选择一个可查看其进度窗口。

dc31fc5af0863e55.source: Many years of polish and compatibility fixes. DDM is new; if something you rely on is missing, <g1>ask for it</g1>.
dc31fc5af0863e55.text: 多年的打磨和兼容性修复。DDM 还很新；如果缺少了您依赖的功能，<g1>请告诉我们</g1>。

dc75431952fc8673.source: Today's files marked <x1/> are for macOS 11 and later, on Apple Silicon or Intel, and for Linux on x86-64: an AppImage for most distributions, a <x2/> for Ubuntu, Debian, Mint and Pop!_OS, an <x3/> for Fedora, openSUSE and RHEL, and a <x4/> of the plain programs. Please <g5>tell us how it went</g5>, good or bad.
dc75431952fc8673.text: 目前标有 <x1/> 的文件适用于 macOS 11 及更高版本（Apple Silicon 或 Intel 芯片），以及 x86-64 架构的 Linux：包括适用于大多数发行版的 AppImage、适用于 Ubuntu、Debian、Mint 和 Pop!_OS 的 <x2/>、适用于 Fedora、openSUSE 和 RHEL 的 <x3/>，以及普通程序的 <x4/>。请<g5>告诉我们您的使用体验</g5>，无论好坏。

dc7a30cec4d10ce2.source: In DDM's <g1>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g1> window, click <g2>Add the extension</g2> beside your browser. It opens the extension's page in the Chrome Web Store in that browser; you can also open <g3>the page</g3> yourself.
dc7a30cec4d10ce2.text: 在 DDM 的<g1>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g1>窗口中，点击浏览器旁边的<g2>添加扩展</g2>。它会在该浏览器中打开扩展在 Chrome 网上应用店的页面；您也可以自行打开<g3>该页面</g3>。

dc868ceecfac36d1.source: Open <g1>Downloads → Options</g1> and the <g2>Save to</g2> tab.
dc868ceecfac36d1.text: 打开<g1>下载 → 选项</g1>，然后选择<g2>保存到</g2>选项卡。

dc8bb7ad3da606ac.source: A page named after the project, at the top of the folder (<x1/>), opens the copy's start page. You can also right-click the project and choose <g2>Open offline copy</g2> once its start page is downloaded.
dc8bb7ad3da606ac.text: 项目文件夹顶部有一个以项目命名的页面（<x1/>），用于打开副本的起始页。起始页下载完成后，您也可以右键单击项目并选择<g2>打开离线副本</g2>。

dce3ae8513f15cf7.source: An import opens <g1>Link grabber</g1>, which sorts the links into packages: the volumes of one archive together, the links of one page together, the rest in <g2>Various files</g2>. Each link is looked up for its real name, its size and whether the server still has it, and the ones that are gone come unticked. A link already in your list goes under <g3>Already in the list</g3>, unticked.
dce3ae8513f15cf7.text: 导入会打开<g1>链接抓取器</g1>，它将链接分类打包：一个压缩包的多个分卷放在一起，一个页面的链接放在一起，其余的放在<g2>各种文件</g2>中。每个链接都会被查找其真实名称、大小以及服务器是否仍有该文件，已失效的链接会被取消勾选。列表中已有的链接会显示在<g3>已在列表中</g3>下，并被取消勾选。

dcf7c57bec3d49ba.source: A debrid service, such as Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize or TorBox, is a paid account that downloads files from file hosts on its own servers. It hands back a plain direct link, without the host's waits, speed caps and captchas. With your account in DDM, a link from a host your service supports is unlocked through the service, then downloaded by DDM like any file: all its connections, pause and resume.
dcf7c57bec3d49ba.text: Real-Debrid、AllDebrid、Premiumize 或 TorBox 等网盘离线下载服务是一种付费账户，它将文件从文件托管服务下载到自己的服务器上。它会返回一个直接链接，没有文件托管服务的等待、速度限制和验证码。在 DDM 中设置您的账户后，您的服务支持的文件托管服务链接将通过该服务解锁，然后由 DDM 像下载任何文件一样下载：包括所有连接、暂停和恢复功能。

dcf9fbdd7aa08cb0.source: <g1>Add browser...</g1> — a browser the list doesn't name (Vivaldi, Thorium, Yandex, Arc…): choose its program (its <x2/> on Windows, its app on macOS), give it a name, and it joins the list with its own box. DDM knows it by the program that starts DDM's helper, whatever browser its User-Agent claims to be. Select one you added and the button becomes <g3>Remove browser</g3> (or press <g4>Delete</g4>).
dcf9fbdd7aa08cb0.text: <g1>添加浏览器...</g1> — 列表中没有的浏览器（Vivaldi、Thorium、Yandex、Arc…）：选择其程序（Windows 上是其 <x2/>，macOS 上是其应用），为其命名，它就会带着自己的复选框加入列表。DDM 通过启动 DDM 辅助程序的那个程序来识别它，无论其 User-Agent 自称是哪个浏览器。选中您添加的一个后，按钮会变为<g3>移除浏览器</g3>（或按 <g4>Delete</g4>）。

dd033f338a148106.source: <g1>On</g1>: the button is in colour, with no badge, as any button. Its tooltip says <g2>Dannex Download Manager is on. Click to turn it off.</g2>
dd033f338a148106.text: <g1>开启</g1>：按钮为彩色，没有徽标，与任何按钮一样。其提示显示<g2>Dannex Download Manager 已开启。点击以关闭。</g2>

dd08837a9e712b0e.source: Set up the extension once, and every download link you click in Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi or Helium goes to DDM.
dd08837a9e712b0e.text: 只需设置一次扩展，您在 Firefox、Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 或 Helium 中点击的每个下载链接都将发送到 DDM。

dd2ca97400217502.source: If DDM never opens, see <g1>The setup or DDM won't start</g1>.
dd2ca97400217502.text: 如果 DDM 始终无法打开，请参阅<g1>安装程序或 DDM 无法启动</g1>。

dd3c1fc9912f4c10.source: Files, videos, music and torrents, faster and free. A browser extension in the Chrome Web Store, ten themes, 86 languages.
dd3c1fc9912f4c10.text: 文件、视频、音乐和种子，更快且免费。Chrome 网上应用店中的浏览器扩展，十种主题，86 种语言。

dd51eccae63b71c0.source: <g1>Categories</g1><g2>Downloads sorted by type into folders of their own, with Finished and Unfinished one click away.</g2>
dd51eccae63b71c0.text: <g1>类别</g1><g2>下载文件按类型分类到各自的文件夹中，一键查看“已完成”和“未完成”任务。</g2>

dd626c4273adae29.source: Runs nearly everywhere, with HTTP, BitTorrent, magnet and ed2k, and a REST API
dd626c4273adae29.text: 几乎可在所有地方运行，支持 HTTP、BitTorrent、磁力链接和 ed2k，并提供 REST API

dd9e9f3ba79eac09.source: In DDM, click <g1>Add URL</g1> (or press <g2>Ctrl+N</g2>) and click <g3>OK</g3>. DDM sees that the address is a video's page and opens <g4>Download video from a page</g4>. (You can also open it with <g5>Tasks → Download video from a page...</g5>, paste the address and click <g6>Look up</g6>.)
dd9e9f3ba79eac09.text: 在 DDM 中，点击<g1>添加 URL</g1>（或按<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>），然后点击<g3>确定</g3>。DDM 会识别出这是视频页面，并打开<g4>从页面下载视频</g4>。（也可以通过<g5>任务 → 从页面下载视频…</g5>打开该窗口，粘贴地址并点击<g6>查找</g6>。）

ddb9f1b963c5c27d.source: In a Wayland session the windows go through XWayland (below). Not there yet on Linux: screen readers (Orca) don't read DDM's windows; browsers installed as a Flatpak can't reach DDM (Firefox from Flathub may, through the desktop as the Snap does, but that isn't checked yet); and <g1>View → Draw with → Vulkan</g1> is a choice, OpenGL stays the default.
ddb9f1b963c5c27d.text: 在 Wayland 会话中，窗口通过 XWayland 运行（如下）。Linux 上尚未实现的功能：屏幕阅读器（Orca）无法读取 DDM 的窗口；作为 Flatpak 安装的浏览器无法连接 DDM（来自 Flathub 的 Firefox 可能会通过桌面连接，就像 Snap 那样，但这尚未验证）；<g1>视图 → 绘制方式 → Vulkan</g1>是一个选项，OpenGL 仍是默认设置。

ddbfd426bc410b06.source: DDM can be driven without its window in three ways:
ddbfd426bc410b06.text: DDM 可通过以下 3 种方式在不显示窗口的情况下运行：

de7042ead2b68920.source: <g1>Delete archives after extracting</g1>: once extracted, the archives go to the Recycle Bin (the Trash on macOS and Linux).
de7042ead2b68920.text: <g1>提取后删除存档</g1>：提取完成后，存档会移入回收站（macOS 和 Linux 上的废纸篓）。

de8b7a679086918a.source: <g1>Virus checking → Edit...</g1> — tick <g2>Check downloaded files for viruses</g2>, choose the antivirus program and its arguments (<x3/> stands for the downloaded file), and the <g4>File types</g4> to check (programs, installers, archives, disk images and documents that can carry macros by default). Each finished file of those types goes to the program; its answer is its exit code: 0 found nothing, anything else is a problem it reports. The result goes in the download's log, and a problem in its <g5>Download complete</g5> window (or in a message when that window is off). <g6>Use Microsoft Defender</g6> (Windows) fills in Defender's own scanner (<x7/>: it reports and leaves the file where it is); <g8>Use ClamAV</g8> does the same with <x9/> on Linux and macOS. Each shows only when it is installed.
de8b7a679086918a.text: <g1>病毒检查 → 编辑...</g1> — 勾选<g2>检查已下载的文件是否有病毒</g2>，选择杀毒程序及其参数（<x3/> 代表已下载的文件），以及要检查的<g4>文件类型</g4>（默认是程序、安装包、压缩包、磁盘映像和可能带有宏的文档）。这些类型的每个已完成文件都会交给该程序；其回答是它的退出代码：0 表示未发现任何问题，其他任何值都表示它报告了问题。结果会记入下载的日志，问题则显示在其<g5>下载完成</g5>窗口中（该窗口关闭时则以消息显示）。<g6>使用 Microsoft Defender</g6>（Windows）会填入 Defender 自己的扫描程序（<x7/>：它只报告，并将文件留在原处）；<g8>使用 ClamAV</g8>在 Linux 和 macOS 上用 <x9/> 实现同样的功能。每项仅在已安装时才显示。

dea26376a5dda6e5.source: Play a sound for <g1>Download complete</g1>, <g2>Download failed</g2>, <g3>A queue starts</g3> and <g4>A queue stops or is done</g4>. Tick an event, select it, click <g5>Browse...</g5> to choose a <x6/> file, and <g7>Play</g7> to hear it. The <g8>Delete</g8> key clears the selected event's sound.
dea26376a5dda6e5.text: 为<g1>下载完成</g1>、<g2>下载失败</g2>、<g3>队列启动时</g3>和<g4>队列停止或完成时</g4>播放声音。勾选一个事件，选中它，单击<g5>浏览...</g5>选择 <x6/> 文件，单击<g7>播放</g7>试听。<g8>Delete</g8> 键会清除所选事件的声音。

dec24cb67001cd4a.source: DDM downloads the pictures of a gallery (a Wikimedia Commons category, a Flickr album, a DeviantArt gallery, an Imgur album and many more) with the help of <g1>gallery-dl</g1>, a free program that reads several hundred sites: it finds the gallery's pictures, and DDM downloads them. Like yt-dlp for videos, it's an optional helper: DDM installs it the first time you need it, or uses your own copy.
dec24cb67001cd4a.text: DDM 借助 <g1>gallery-dl</g1> 下载图库（Wikimedia Commons 分类、Flickr 相册、DeviantArt 图库、Imgur 相册等）中的图片。gallery-dl 是一个免费程序，可读取数百个站点：它找出图库中的图片，由 DDM 下载。和用于视频的 yt-dlp 一样，它是可选的帮助程序：DDM 会在您第一次需要时安装它，也可使用您自己的副本。

decdfffe86a6a5b9.source: The layout is familiar on purpose: the toolbar, the categories, the download list, the progress window with every connection, queues and the scheduler. The differences: DDM is free and open source, downloads BitTorrent and magnet links in the same list, finished faster in our benchmark, speaks 86 languages and has builds for Linux and macOS. IDM is the more mature product, refined over many years. See the full comparison.
decdfffe86a6a5b9.text: 布局刻意保持熟悉：工具栏、类别、下载列表、显示每个连接的进度窗口、队列和计划任务。不同之处在于：DDM 是免费开源的，可以在同一列表中下载 BitTorrent 和磁力链接，在我们的基准测试中完成速度更快，支持 86 种语言，并提供 Linux 和 macOS 版本。IDM 是更成熟的产品，经过多年完善。查看完整比较。

ded2d9ada89753dc.source: About Dannex Download Manager: its version, licence and links
ded2d9ada89753dc.text: 关于 Dannex Download Manager：版本、许可证和链接

ded6b8d1bb0da886.source: A site may also refuse subtitles when it's asked too often. The video is saved all the same. DDM asks for the subtitles once more after 20 seconds, and if they still don't come, the <g1>Download complete</g1> window and the download's log say which ones are missing and why. Try them again later. When subtitles meant to go inside the video only come on that second try, they're saved beside it instead.
ded6b8d1bb0da886.text: 站点也可能在被请求过于频繁时拒绝提供字幕。视频仍会照常保存。DDM 会在 20 秒后再次请求字幕，如果仍然没有，<g1>下载完成</g1>窗口和下载的日志会说明缺少哪些以及原因。请稍后再试。当本应放入视频内部的字幕只在第二次尝试时才获取到时，它们会改为保存在视频旁边。

dee4ab42b514acda.source: The language list on first start: every language with its flag, its own name and its English name
dee4ab42b514acda.text: 首次启动时的语言列表：每种语言都带有其旗帜、其本国名称和英文名称

def0430c0d444bdb.source: Yes. In IDM, export your list as an .ef2 file (its Tasks → Export menu). In DDM, choose Tasks → Import → From an IDM list (.ef2) and pick that file: every…
def0430c0d444bdb.text: 可以。在 IDM 中，将列表导出为 .ef2 文件（其任务 → 导出菜单）。在 DDM 中，选择任务 → 导入 → 从 IDM 列表 (.ef2)并选取该文件：每个…

df08fbc15558c215.source: <g1>Show progress</g1> in the right-click menu always opens a download's progress window, or brings it back from the notification area.
df08fbc15558c215.text: 右键菜单中的<g1>显示进度</g1>始终会打开下载的进度窗口，或将其从通知区域调回。

df1f4287bd6b01b1.source: The download's row stays in DDM's list as it was, and <g1>Resume</g1> tries again from DDM. Where DDM shows no such button (a link the Link grabber or <g2>Download File Info</g2> looked at before adding it), hold <g3>Alt</g3> as you click the link to leave that download to the browser (<g4>Keys to force or prevent capture</g4>).
df1f4287bd6b01b1.text: 该下载的行仍保留在 DDM 的列表中，<g1>恢复</g1>会从 DDM 重新尝试。在 DDM 没有这个按钮的地方（链接抓取器或<g2>下载文件信息</g2>在添加前查看过的链接），点击链接时按住 <g3>Alt</g3>，可把该下载留给浏览器（<g4>强制或阻止捕获的按键</g4>）。

df260daf719b26b8.text: 通过高速链接下载 1 GiB 文件

df2cf479419d70fe.source: More connections help only where a server sends each one at a limited speed. Most servers allow a few connections per address, and DDM notices when one says no: it stops asking that server for more and lists what it learned under <g1>Exceptions</g1> in <g2>Options → Connection</g2>. You can set a number for a server yourself there too.
df2cf479419d70fe.text: 当服务器限制每个连接的速度时，增加连接数才会有帮助。大多数服务器允许每个地址有几个连接，DDM 会在服务器拒绝时注意到：它会停止向该服务器请求更多连接，并在<g2>选项 → 连接</g2>下的<g1>例外</g1>中列出它学到的信息。您也可以在那里为服务器自行设置连接数。

df4be9726ccb94fb.source: <g1>Pause</g1> stops the download and keeps what it has; <g2>Resume</g2> continues it.
df4be9726ccb94fb.text: <g1>暂停</g1>会停止下载并保留已下载的部分；<g2>恢复</g2>会继续下载。

df622d2f46b86c8c.source: Add it again, with a numbered file name
df622d2f46b86c8c.text: 再次添加，并为文件名加上编号

df62d3a5f2d919d9.text: IDM 的布局，没有它的价格。

df75204089bb69a0.source: Minimize leaves the window in the taskbar, as any window's does; double-clicking the title bar maximizes or restores it. To have Minimize hide it in the notification area too, tick <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1> in <g2>Options → General</g2> (off by default); where the tray has no icon, Minimize sends the window to the taskbar instead.
df75204089bb69a0.text: 最小化会像任何窗口一样将窗口留在任务栏中；双击标题栏可最大化或还原窗口。若要让“最小化”也将其隐藏到通知区域，请勾选<g2>选项 → 常规</g2>中的<g1>最小化到通知区域</g1>（默认关闭）；在托盘没有图标的地方，“最小化”会改为将窗口发送到任务栏。

df805ef6a110c232.text: 查看错误原因（将鼠标悬停在<g1>状态</g1>上）。

df81c342c23099f4.source: How do I install the browser extension? — Dannex Download Manager
df81c342c23099f4.text: 如何安装浏览器扩展？— Dannex Download Manager

df8bb30d1cebebde.source: Click a column's title to sort by it; click it again for the other way, and a third time to go back to the order the links came in. Names sort as people read them (<x1/> before <x2/>).
df8bb30d1cebebde.text: 点击列标题可按它排序；再点一次反向排序，第三次点击则恢复链接到来时的顺序。名称按人们阅读的习惯排序（<x1/> 排在 <x2/> 之前）。

dfb90004030f3913.source: From the Chrome Web Store, for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi. Firefox: the add-on comes with the app (<g1>how</g1>).
dfb90004030f3913.text: 来自 Chrome 网上应用店，适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi。Firefox：附加组件随应用提供（<g1>方法</g1>）。

dfda3e65e02aaf76.source: DDM splits a file into parts and downloads them over several connections at once:
dfda3e65e02aaf76.text: DDM 将文件分成多个部分，并通过多个连接同时下载：

dffdbe7958a45c24.source: Eight per download by default, and up to 32 if you choose in <g1>Options → Connection</g1>, or 128 after ticking <g2>Allow more than 32 connections</g2> there. DDM uses fewer when a server allows fewer, and only one when a server can't send parts of a file at all.
dffdbe7958a45c24.text: 默认情况下，每个下载使用八个连接。如果您在<g1>选项 → 连接</g1>中选择，最多可达32个；勾选<g2>允许超过32个连接</g2>后，可达128个。当服务器允许的连接数较少时，DDM会使用较少的连接；当服务器完全无法发送文件分段时，DDM只使用一个连接。

e00a7fba0e2de1d3.source: <g1>Under gallery-dl's names</g1>: each picture goes where gallery-dl would have saved it, so a gallery downloaded before by gallery-dl alone, or by DDM, finds its pictures and skips them.
e00a7fba0e2de1d3.text: <g1>沿用 gallery-dl 的命名</g1>：每张图片都保存在 gallery-dl 本会保存的位置，因此之前仅由 gallery-dl 或由 DDM 下载过的图库，能找到自己的图片并跳过它们。

e01bb3ea246cc259.source: Your download list and settings stay <g1>on your computer</g1>.
e01bb3ea246cc259.text: 您的下载列表和设置保留在<g1>您的电脑上</g1>。

e04b6de25915105e.source: Open a pull request on <g1>GitHub</g1> with the edited catalog, or
e04b6de25915105e.text: 在<g1>GitHub</g1>上提交一个包含已编辑目录的拉取请求，或者

e04c43357e5af3cf.source: A magnet link has to get the torrent's file list from other peers first. That can take a minute or two, and longer for torrents with few peers. If nobody answers in about three minutes, DDM gives up; try again later, or use the <x1/> file if the site offers one.
e04c43357e5af3cf.text: 磁力链接必须首先从其他对等点获取种子的文件列表。这可能需要一两分钟，对于对等点较少的种子则需要更长时间。如果大约三分钟内没有响应，DDM 会放弃；请稍后再试，或者如果网站提供<x1/>文件，请使用该文件。

e04f69d547a21d71.source: <g1>Native</g1>: your system's colours. Windows' accent colour (Settings → Personalization → Colors) and, when it is on, its contrast theme; the desktop's accent colour and its higher contrast setting on Linux (GNOME 47 and later, KDE Plasma); the accent colour on macOS. It follows them when you change them.
e04f69d547a21d71.text: <g1>本机</g1>：使用系统颜色。Windows 的强调色（设置 → 个性化 → 颜色），以及开启时的高对比度主题；Linux 桌面环境的强调色和高对比度设置（GNOME 47 及更高版本、KDE Plasma）；macOS 的强调色。更改这些设置时，DDM 也会随之更新。

e0551258b74afb75.source: Click it again, or the page's switch
e0551258b74afb75.text: 再次单击它，或使用页面上的开关

e06604b0b93dfd79.source: There, DDM connects itself to your browsers at each start, has its tray icon, follows the system's light or dark look and uses the system's fonts and ffmpeg. The Mac app isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS asks before its first start: right-click it and choose <g1>Open</g1> (on macOS 15 and later, <g2>System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway</g2>). A <x3/> or <x4/> update opens in the system's installer. A few parts work only on Windows, and the help says so where it matters.
e06604b0b93dfd79.text: 在此，DDM 每次启动时都会自动连接到您的浏览器，拥有托盘图标，遵循系统的浅色或深色外观，并使用系统的字体和 ffmpeg。Mac 应用程序尚未获得 Apple 认证，因此 macOS 在首次启动前会询问：右键点击它并选择<g1>打开</g1>（在 macOS 15 及更高版本上，选择<g2>系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 仍要打开</g2>）。<x3/> 或 <x4/> 更新会在系统的安装程序中打开。少数功能仅在 Windows 上可用，帮助文档会在相关位置说明。

e0ad26c06dcee181.source: 1 the start time, 2 once or on some days, 3 a stop time if you want one.
e0ad26c06dcee181.text: 1 开始时间，2 单次或某几天，3 如需要则设置停止时间。

e0f4ab5df9c8188d.source: A running queue starts its downloads in list order, a few at a time (four by default). When one fails, it moves to the end of the queue and is tried again 30 seconds later. The queue stops when nothing is left to download.
e0f4ab5df9c8188d.text: 队列运行时，会按列表顺序启动下载任务，每次启动几个（默认 4 个）。下载失败后会移到队列末尾，并在 30 秒后重试。没有剩余下载任务时，队列会停止。

e0fd074a942a4d50.source: <g1>Delete</g1>: forget the project. Its downloads stay in the list (under All Downloads again) and its files on the disk.
e0fd074a942a4d50.text: <g1>删除</g1>：忘记该项目。其下载仍保留在列表中（再次位于“所有下载”下），其文件也保留在磁盘上。

e0fed74de34d9a29.source: <g1>Whole site for offline reading</g1> (or <g2>Make the pages work offline</g2> on any project) saves a site so that it opens and works from the disk, without a connection:
e0fed74de34d9a29.text: <g1>整个站点（供离线阅读）</g1>（或任何项目上的<g2>让页面可离线使用</g2>）会保存网站，使其可以从磁盘打开并运行，无需连接：

e109f66c42a2bcb8.source: You may use, copy, change and share Dannex Download Manager under the <g1>GNU GPL, version 3</g1>.
e109f66c42a2bcb8.text: 您可以根据<g1>GNU GPL 第 3 版</g1>使用、复制、修改和分享 Dannex Download Manager。

e12b9c165be3a951.source: DDM comes with an MCP server, so an AI assistant that supports MCP can work with the downloads in your running DDM. You ask in your own words, and it lists, adds, pauses or resumes them.
e12b9c165be3a951.text: DDM 附带一个 MCP 服务器，因此支持 MCP 的 AI 助手可以与您正在运行的 DDM 中的下载任务协同工作。您可以用自己的话提问，它会列出、添加、暂停或恢复下载。

e12c33d490b22dd0.source: The single-instance channel (a token-protected local socket), the data folder, and the capture rules shared by the app and the host
e12c33d490b22dd0.text: 应用和主机共享的单实例通道（受令牌保护的本地套接字）、数据文件夹和捕获规则

e1484c9d0efe2cad.source: Move or rename the selected download
e1484c9d0efe2cad.text: 移动或重命名所选下载

e149765f8bc9c999.source: <g1>Network adapter</g1> — <g2>Any (the system chooses)</g2> is the default. Pick an adapter, usually your VPN's, and every connection DDM opens goes out through it, or not at all. That covers downloads, FTP, torrents, video pages and image galleries, the DNS you chose, DDM's own downloads and the update check. It works as a kill switch: when the adapter disconnects, or the VPN is switched off, nothing goes out through your normal connection. Running downloads stop with "… is not connected" and start again when the adapter is back. The line under the list shows the adapter's address, or that it isn't connected.
e149765f8bc9c999.text: <g1>网络适配器</g1> — <g2>任何（系统选择）</g2>是默认设置。选择一个适配器，通常是 VPN 使用的适配器，DDM 打开的所有连接都会通过它发出，否则就不会发出。这包括下载、FTP、种子下载、视频页面和图片库、您选择的 DNS、DDM 自己的下载以及更新检查。它可用作终止开关：适配器断开连接或 VPN 关闭时，所有流量都不会通过您的常规连接发出。正在进行的下载会因“……未连接”而停止，并在适配器恢复连接后重新开始。列表下方会显示适配器的地址，或显示其未连接。

e155a9e9fed089dd.source: The automation API is off by default. When you turn it on, it listens only on <x1/> (your own computer) and answers only programs that present the secret token from DDM's data folder.
e155a9e9fed089dd.text: 自动化 API 默认关闭。当您打开它时，它只监听<x1/>（您自己的电脑），并且只响应呈现 DDM 数据文件夹中秘密令牌的程序。

e15d599e6927add3.source: Options on its Save to page: a category, its file types and its folder
e15d599e6927add3.text: “选项”的“保存到”页面：一个类别、其文件类型和其文件夹。

e160eb1af05eac08.source: <g1>Use this proxy server</g1> — type the proxy's address, <g2>Port</g2>, and a <g3>User name</g3> and <g4>Password</g4> if it needs them, and keep ticked the protocols it is for (<g5>http</g5>, <g6>https</g6>). Choosing it ticks both when neither is: a proxy for neither would carry no download, and every download would go straight to its server. <g7>Advanced / Socks...</g7> chooses the proxy's kind: an <g8>HTTP proxy</g8> (the default), an <g9>HTTPS proxy</g9> (reached over TLS), <g10>SOCKS 4</g10> or <g11>SOCKS 5</g11>, and for SOCKS whether the proxy looks the servers' names up itself (<g12>DNS through the proxy</g12>, so your computer asks no DNS for them), with the address, port and login. The address then shows its kind (<x13/>); you can also type it that way.
e160eb1af05eac08.text: <g1>使用此代理服务器</g1> — 输入代理的地址、<g2>端口</g2>，如需要则输入<g3>用户名</g3>和<g4>密码</g4>，并保持勾选它适用的协议（<g5>http</g5>、<g6>https</g6>）。选择它时，若两者都未勾选，会同时勾选两者：两者都不适用的代理不会承载任何下载，所有下载都会直接连到其服务器。<g7>高级/Socks...</g7>用于选择代理的类型：<g8>HTTP 代理</g8>（默认）、<g9>HTTPS 代理</g9>（通过 TLS 连接）、<g10>SOCKS 4</g10> 或 <g11>SOCKS 5</g11>，对于 SOCKS，还可选择代理是否自己查找服务器名称（<g12>通过代理进行 DNS 解析</g12>，这样您的计算机不会为它们发出任何 DNS 请求），以及地址、端口和登录信息。此时地址会显示其类型（<x13/>）；您也可以这样输入。

e1713d442d1eea6d.source: Yes. Put downloads in a queue and let the Scheduler start it at a set time, stop it at another, and even shut down or put the computer to sleep when the…
e1713d442d1eea6d.text: 是。将下载任务放入队列，让计划程序在设定的时间开始下载，在另一个时间停止下载，甚至在队列完成后关闭计算机或使其进入睡眠状态。

e1ab431f14758e3d.source: Accessible download manager: screen readers and full keyboard use — Dannex Download Manager
e1ab431f14758e3d.text: 无障碍下载管理器：屏幕阅读器和全键盘操作 — Dannex Download Manager

e1bd121dfc6ea3a8.source: The copy from DDM's folder stands aside only while the store's copy reaches DDM. It stays the one that acts when the store's copy is turned off on the browser's extensions page, or can't reach DDM (when DDM is too old to accept the store's copy, <g1>update DDM</g1>). Removed or turned off there, the store's copy gives the work back at the next download, and turned on again it takes it back the same way: never both at once. Switched OFF with its toolbar button, the store's copy keeps the other copy off too: OFF means OFF in that browser.
e1bd121dfc6ea3a8.text: 来自 DDM 文件夹的副本只在应用商店的副本能连接 DDM 时才让路。当应用商店的副本在浏览器的扩展页面中被关闭，或无法连接 DDM 时（当 DDM 太旧而不接受应用商店的副本时，请<g1>更新 DDM</g1>），它仍是执行工作的那个。应用商店的副本在那里被移除或关闭后，会在下次下载时把工作交还；重新开启后，同样在下次下载时接回工作：绝不会两者同时工作。若用其工具栏按钮将应用商店的副本切换为“关”，另一个副本也会保持关闭：在该浏览器中，“关”就是“关”。

e1c58f7c0679af79.text: 整个文件的条形图，显示每个连接从哪里开始以及已进行到哪里（<g1>每个连接负责的文件部分</g1>）。

e1cb5a9a23d26236.text: 视频窗口列出播放列表中的视频，每个视频都显示时长和复选框，所有视频使用相同的画质

e1dc7e2037c9dcf4.source: <g1>Its settings</g1>: <g2>Options → General → DDM's download button over videos in browsers → Edit...</g2>: turn it off; show it <g3>Over videos</g3>, <g4>Over sound players</g4>, or both; leave it off media shorter than so many seconds (the browser knows a video's length once its player has loaded it, and shows the button until then); choose <g5>Where it shows first</g5> (top right unless you choose another corner; dragged elsewhere on a site, it stays there on that site); and see or edit the sites it never shows on. <g6>Never on</g6> in the button's menu adds to that list, and a site added there while Options is open is kept when you click OK.
e1dc7e2037c9dcf4.text: <g1>其设置</g1>：<g2>选项 → 常规 → DDM 在浏览器中视频上的下载按钮 → 编辑...</g2>：可将其关闭；可选择显示在<g3>视频上</g3>、<g4>音频播放器上</g4>，或两者；可让它不在短于若干秒的媒体上显示（视频的播放器加载后，浏览器才知道其长度，在此之前会一直显示按钮）；选择<g5>首次显示位置</g5>（默认右上角，除非您选择其他角落；在某站点上拖到别处后，它会在该站点上保持在那里）；并查看或编辑它永不显示的站点。按钮菜单中的<g6>永不在此显示</g6>会添加到该列表，而在选项打开期间添加的站点，在您单击“确定”时会被保留。

e1e7fd2c10af0107.source: "Download https://example.com/big.iso to D:\ISOs tonight, don't start it yet."
e1e7fd2c10af0107.text: “今晚把 https://example.com/big.iso 下载到 D:\ISOs，暂时不要开始下载。”

e1fdac1fe283477a.source: DDM works with screen readers such as Narrator and NVDA, which hear what each control is and its state. Everything can be done from the keyboard, with the keys most Windows programs use.
e1fdac1fe283477a.text: DDM 支持 Narrator 和 NVDA 等屏幕阅读器，它们能识别每个控件及其状态。所有操作都可通过键盘完成，使用大多数 Windows 程序通用的按键。

e235ba57a40331e3.text: 一些设置不在本窗口中：

e2847603e155099c.source: In Safari open <g1>Settings → Extensions</g1> and tick <g2>Dannex Download Manager</g2>. Click <g3>Always Allow on Every Website</g3>: the extension needs to read the site to pass your sign-in on.
e2847603e155099c.text: 在 Safari 中打开<g1>设置 → 扩展</g1>，然后勾选<g2>Dannex Download Manager</g2>。点击<g3>始终允许在每个网站上</g3>：扩展程序需要读取网站才能传递您的登录信息。

e2b96614efaa036c.source: The drop target's edge at rest
e2b96614efaa036c.text: 放置目标在静止时的边缘

e2d3a15847aa0c81.text: 将鼠标指向该按钮：其提示会说明是上述哪种状态，以及单击的作用。

e2e30d683ce66b3d.source: <g1>Zen on Windows:</g1> Zen 1.21.15b and later have a bug of their own that keeps add-ons from reaching their helper program (<g2>zen-browser/desktop#15432</g2>), with any add-on that uses one. Until Zen fixes it, Zen 1.21.14b works.
e2e30d683ce66b3d.text: <g1>Windows 上的 Zen：</g1>Zen 1.21.15b 及更高版本存在一个自身的错误，会导致使用辅助程序的附加组件无法连接到辅助程序（<g2>zen-browser/desktop#15432</g2>）。在 Zen 修复此问题之前，可以使用 Zen 1.21.14b。

e310899f073370cf.source: Some pages play a video without a link to it, and some players hide it from the download button too. The extension notes what the tab's players load (HLS and DASH streams, the way most sites play long videos, and video and sound files, also those a player fetches piece by piece to play them itself, as TikTok's does), so you can still save it:
e310899f073370cf.text: 有些页面播放视频时不提供它的链接，有些播放器也不让下载按钮找到它。扩展会记下该标签页中的播放器加载了什么（HLS 和 DASH 流，大多数网站播放长视频的方式，以及视频和音频文件，也包括像 TikTok 那样由播放器分块获取、自行播放的文件），所以您仍然可以保存它：

e34d09bf6290c953.source: By default DDM asks what to do when you add an address it already has. You can choose a fixed answer in <g1>Options → Downloads → When an address is already in the list</g1>:
e34d09bf6290c953.text: 默认情况下，当您添加 DDM 已有的地址时，DDM 会询问如何处理。您可以在<g1>选项 → 下载 → 当地址已在列表中时</g1>中选择固定的处理方式：

e35a37b3a0b72a89.source: Each file downloads from all of its servers at once: the Metalink's preferred ones first, and among servers of the same preference those in your country (your system's region) first. A server that fails (refuses, doesn't answer, sends another file) is left out and the others carry on. DDM uses the other servers only when the Metalink gives the file's hash or its pieces' hashes, so a server with a damaged copy can't spoil the file: the finished file is checked (<g1>Checksum verified</g1> in its log). With pieces' hashes, a piece that fails its check is downloaded again, from another server than the one that sent it; only if no server has it right does the download fail, keeping its data. Logins and cookies for the Metalink's own address are never sent to its servers.
e35a37b3a0b72a89.text: 每个文件会同时从它的所有服务器下载：优先使用 Metalink 指定的首选服务器；优先级相同时，先用您所在国家或地区（系统的区域设置）的服务器。出错的服务器（拒绝连接、没有响应、发来另一个文件）会被排除，其余服务器继续。只有当 Metalink 给出了文件的哈希值或各分块的哈希值时，DDM 才会使用其他服务器，所以副本损坏的服务器也不会毁掉文件：下载完成的文件会经过校验（日志中显示<g1>校验和已验证</g1>）。有分块哈希时，校验未通过的分块会从另一台服务器重新下载，而不是原先发送它的那台；只有所有服务器都没有正确的数据时，下载才会失败，并保留已下载的数据。针对 Metalink 自身地址的登录信息和 Cookie 绝不会发送给它的服务器。

e38c452f0cd105a5.source: <g1>Downloads go to another Dannex Download Manager</g1>, and its address
e38c452f0cd105a5.text: <g1>下载将发送到另一个 Dannex Download Manager</g1>，以及其地址

e3bd4e21e71baec4.source: When you start a download that DDM should take, it passes <g1>the download's address (and where its redirects led), the page it came from, the site's cookies for that address, your browser's User-Agent, and the file's name, size and type</g1> to DDM on your computer, through the browser's native-messaging channel. Nothing goes over the internet.
e3bd4e21e71baec4.text: 当您开始一个应由 DDM 处理的下载时，它会通过浏览器的原生消息通道，将<g1>下载地址（以及其重定向到的地址）、来源页面、该地址的网站 cookie、您的浏览器 User-Agent，以及文件名称、大小和类型</g1>传递给您计算机上的 DDM。没有任何信息会通过互联网传输。

e3ce2a886e89c710.source: Restart the browser after setting it up.
e3ce2a886e89c710.text: 设置完成后重启浏览器。

e3f369ad490fe3c9.text: DDM 不接受此扩展程序副本

e3f982054be16bb9.source: DDM has to be running for a schedule to fire. Closing the main window is fine: DDM keeps going in the notification area.
e3f982054be16bb9.text: DDM 必须运行才能触发计划。关闭主窗口没关系：DDM 会在通知区域继续运行。

e4068d69914b5fb5.text: 粘贴页面地址，然后点击“查找”。

e421fce0972d9f45.source: DDM follows your system: when Windows (or your desktop's light/dark preference on Linux and macOS) is set to dark mode, so is DDM. To keep DDM light whatever the system does, turn off <g1>View → Follow the system's dark mode</g1>. To keep it dark whatever the system does, for example on a desktop that reports no preference, turn on <g2>View → Always dark</g2>.
e421fce0972d9f45.text: DDM 会跟随您的系统：当 Windows（或 Linux 和 macOS 上桌面的浅色/深色偏好）设置为深色模式时，DDM 也是深色。若要无论系统如何设置都让 DDM 保持浅色，请关闭<g1>视图 → 跟随系统深色模式</g1>。若要无论系统如何设置都让它保持深色，例如在不报告偏好的桌面上，请开启<g2>视图 → 始终为深色</g2>。

e43399c3cb09d9d5.source: <g1>Paused and resumed</g1> like a file, also after quitting DDM: a picture stopped half-way carries on from the bytes already saved.
e43399c3cb09d9d5.text: <g1>像文件一样暂停和恢复</g1>，退出 DDM 后也一样：下载到一半停止的图片会从已保存的字节继续。

e44930d18622541d.text: 选择下一个类别（<g1>压缩文件</g1>、<g2>文档</g2>、<g3>音乐</g3>、<g4>程序</g4>、<g5>视频</g5>、<g6>种子</g6>），并执行相同的操作，例如<x7/>。

e49c7399c2758861.text: 选择您的语言。之后可通过“视图 → 语言”更改。

e51339e06df148a6.source: DDM downloads the file itself, as it was uploaded (a video comes in its own format, not the player's copy), with its real name and size, over several connections, and it can resume. For a large file, Drive shows a page that says it <g1>can't scan this file for viruses</g1>; DDM goes past it as <g2>Download anyway</g2> does.

e51927fb33202c0c.source: Install DDM with its setup and keep <g1>Set up browser integration</g1> ticked. Then add the extension: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi take it from the Chrome Web Store, and the browser keeps it updated; DDM's <g2>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g2> window opens its page in each. Firefox 140 or later takes the copy that comes with DDM, until addons.mozilla.org lists it.
e51927fb33202c0c.text: 用安装程序安装 DDM，并保持勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成</g1>。然后添加扩展：Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 从 Chrome 网上应用店获取，由浏览器负责更新；DDM 的<g2>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>窗口会在各浏览器中打开对应页面。Firefox 140 或更高版本使用随 DDM 提供的副本，直到 addons.mozilla.org 上架。

A site that needs you signed in with its own page takes the <g2>Cookies</g2> your browser sends it, written as the browser sends them: <x3/>. The login and the cookies are sent to the start address's site only, never to another site its pages link to. A login saved in <g4>Options → Sites Logins</g4> for that site is used too.
e519f7b9ebe9437b.text: 如果站点要求用户名和密码，请在<g1>登录信息和 Cookie</g1>下输入。需要您通过其自己的页面登录的站点，会使用您的浏览器发送给它的 <g2>Cookie</g2>，其写法与浏览器发送时相同：<x3/>。登录信息和 Cookie 仅发送到起始地址所在的站点，绝不会发送到其页面链接指向的其他站点。在<g4>选项 → 站点登录</g4>中为该站点保存的登录信息也会被使用。
