e55767cab9916a15.source: On Windows, DDM draws its windows with Direct3D 12; on Linux and macOS, with OpenGL, or with Vulkan (Linux) or Metal (macOS) when you choose them. A graphics driver can still misbehave: a window that holds still for seconds, flickers, or shows wrong colours or blocks. Try the other one: choose <g1>View → Draw with → OpenGL</g1> (or <g2>Direct3D</g2>, <g3>Vulkan</g3>, <g4>Metal</g4>), then quit DDM (<g5>Tasks → Exit</g5>) and start it again. Choosing the first one goes back the same way.
e55767cab9916a15.text: 在 Windows 上，DDM 使用 Direct3D 12 绘制窗口；在 Linux 和 macOS 上使用 OpenGL，也可选择 Vulkan（Linux）或 Metal（macOS）。图形驱动程序仍可能出现问题：窗口卡住几秒、闪烁，或显示错误的颜色或方块。可以尝试另一种绘制方式：选择<g1>视图 → 绘制方式 → OpenGL</g1>（或<g2>Direct3D</g2>、<g3>Vulkan</g3>、<g4>Metal</g4>），然后退出 DDM（<g5>任务 → 退出</g5>）并重新启动。要切回原来的绘制方式，也按相同步骤操作。

e6cee4e27613942f.source: DDM contains no adware, spyware, bundled offers or tracking. Its whole source code is public, so anyone can check what it does, and every release is built from that code by GitHub's servers, where the build can be inspected. The helper programs it can fetch for videos are verified before they run: yt-dlp against its developers' signing key, ffmpeg against its published checksums. Download DDM only from this site or the project's GitHub releases.
e6cee4e27613942f.text: DDM 不含广告软件、间谍软件、捆绑软件或跟踪功能。它的全部源代码都是公开的，任何人都可以检查其功能；每个版本都由 GitHub 的服务器根据这份代码构建，构建过程也可以检查。它为下载视频而获取的辅助程序在运行前都会经过验证：yt-dlp 会与其开发者的签名密钥进行验证，ffmpeg 会与其发布的校验和进行核对。请仅从本网站或项目的 GitHub 发布页面下载 DDM。

e707093847217661.source: <g1>Theme files.</g1> <x2/> reads TOML or JSON from the data folder's <x3/> (one file, or <x4/> with icons beside it). A file names only what it changes; the rest comes from the theme it <x5/> (a built-in's id or another file, the classic look by default), down a chain in which a cycle is refused. Unknown keys are warnings, not errors. The built-in style themes are such files too, carried in the program (<x6/>).
e707093847217661.text: <g1>主题文件。</g1> <x2/> 从数据文件夹的 <x3/> 读取 TOML 或 JSON（一个文件，或 <x4/> 旁边带有图标）。一个文件只命名它所更改的内容；其余部分来自它 <x5/> 的主题（内置主题的 ID 或另一个文件，默认是经典外观），沿着一个拒绝循环的链。未知键是警告，而不是错误。内置样式主题也是此类文件，包含在程序中（<x6/>）。

e70e4147e80f61f5.source: DDM never writes the token to its event log, crash reports, the automation API or the command line's output.
e70e4147e80f61f5.text: DDM 绝不会将令牌写入其事件日志、崩溃报告、自动化 API 或命令行输出。

e87a7f902199316e.source: A Metalink (<x1/> for Metalink 3, <x2/> for Metalink 4) is a small file that lists one or more files, the servers that have each of them, and the hashes they must have. Release pages of Linux distributions and other large downloads offer them next to the file itself. DDM opens one from anywhere a download comes from: <g3>Add URL</g3>, the browser (add <x4/> and <x5/> to <g6>Options → File types</g6> for the browser to hand them over), the command line, a drop on the main window or the drop target, and <g7>Tasks → Open Metalink file...</g7>.
e87a7f902199316e.text: Metalink（<x1/> 对应 Metalink 3，<x2/> 对应 Metalink 4）是一个小文件，列出一个或多个文件、各文件所在的服务器，以及它们必须具备的哈希值。Linux 发行版的发布页面和其他大型下载常在文件旁提供它。无论下载来自哪里，DDM 都能打开它：<g3>添加 URL</g3>、浏览器（在<g6>选项 → 文件类型</g6>中添加 <x4/> 和 <x5/>，浏览器才会把它们交给 DDM）、命令行、拖放到主窗口或拖放目标上，以及<g7>任务 → 打开 Metalink 文件...</g7>。

When the extension passed the page's own cookies, those are used instead: they are that page's and that session's.

e910473cbdd4ef18.source: <g1>Site grabber</g1> explores a web site from a page you give it, follows its links a few levels deep, and lists the files it finds: every picture of a gallery, the PDFs of a documentation site, the recordings of a podcast's pages, or the whole site to read offline. You tick the ones you want and DDM downloads them like any other download, as one batch.

e929c164dcedda97.source: Firefox, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, through the DDM browser extension (from the Chrome Web Store; for Firefox it comes with DDM, until addons.mozilla.org lists it), and browsers built on them: Zen and LibreWolf, Helium. The extension hands downloads to DDM with their cookies and referrer, so files behind a sign-in still work, and it adds Download with DDM to the right-click menu and a Download video button over videos. See Browser integration.
e929c164dcedda97.text: Firefox、Google Chrome、Microsoft Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi，通过 DDM 浏览器扩展使用（Chrome 版来自 Chrome 网上应用店；Firefox 版随 DDM 一起提供，直到 addons.mozilla.org 上架），以及基于它们的浏览器：Zen、LibreWolf 和 Helium。扩展会把下载连同 Cookie 和来源页一起交给 DDM，所以需要登录才能下载的文件也能正常下载；它还会在右键菜单中加入使用 DDM 下载，并在视频上方加入下载视频按钮。参见浏览器集成。

e96030baed274205.source: <g1>A click on a link to a file type DDM takes</g1> goes to DDM. A download the page starts by itself (a script, or a link with no file name in its address that the server answers with a file) stays with Safari: use right-click → <g2>Download with DDM</g2> for those.
e96030baed274205.text: <g1>点击 DDM 支持的文件类型链接</g1>会转到 DDM。页面自行启动的下载（脚本，或地址中没有文件名的链接，服务器以文件响应）会留在 Safari 中：对于这些下载，请使用右键点击 → <g2>使用 DDM 下载</g2>。

e9701ddef41a29db.source: DDM downloads videos from their web pages with yt-dlp, the open-source tool whose community keeps it working as sites change. You pick the quality; the video joins your other downloads.
e9701ddef41a29db.text: DDM 使用开源工具 yt-dlp 从网页下载视频。yt-dlp 社区会持续更新，以适应网站变化。您可以选择画质，视频将加入您的下载列表。

e98b65ae69ff53d2.source: Look at <g1>Can resume</g1> in the progress window. <g2>No</g2> means the server can't send a file in parts. DDM then uses one connection, and a download that stops has to start over. For such servers, avoid stopping the download, and avoid a very low speed limit, which can make the server drop the connection.
e98b65ae69ff53d2.text: 查看进度窗口中的<g1>支持断点续传</g1>。<g2>否</g2>表示服务器无法分块发送文件。DDM 随后会使用一个连接，停止的下载必须从头开始。对于这类服务器，请避免停止下载，也避免设置过低的速度限制，否则可能导致服务器断开连接。

ea73253f79a248d9.source: DDM's Proxy / Socks settings are for web and FTP downloads. Torrents can use a SOCKS5 one too: set a <x1/> proxy in <g2>Options → Proxy / Socks</g2> and turn on <g3>Use the proxy</g3> in Torrent settings. The proxy covers connections to peers and web trackers only, so with it DDM turns off the DHT, local peer discovery, incoming connections and UDP trackers; it opens no UDP socket toward the network at all. If the proxy is gone from Proxy / Socks while that switch is on, torrents don't start rather than go around it.
ea73253f79a248d9.text: DDM 的代理/Socks 设置适用于网页和 FTP 下载。种子也可以使用 SOCKS5 代理：在<g2>选项 → 代理/Socks</g2>中设置<x1/>代理，并在种子设置中开启<g3>使用代理</g3>。代理只用于连接对等方和网页跟踪器，因此启用后，DDM 会关闭 DHT、本地对等方发现、传入连接和 UDP 跟踪器；DDM 完全不会向网络打开 UDP 套接字。如果开启该选项时，代理/Socks 中没有配置代理，种子就不会启动，而不会绕过代理连接。

ea8323a6a76950ae.source: Yes. In IDM, export your list as an .ef2 file (its Tasks → Export menu). In DDM, choose Tasks → Import → From an IDM list (.ef2) and pick that file: every download comes over with its address, referrer and cookies. A plain text file of links works too. See Adding downloads.
ea8323a6a76950ae.text: 可以。在 IDM 中，将列表导出为 .ef2 文件（其任务 → 导出菜单）。在 DDM 中，选择任务 → 导入 → 从 IDM 列表 (.ef2) 并选取该文件：每个下载都会连同其地址、引用页和 Cookie 一起导入。纯文本的链接文件也可以。请参阅添加下载。

eae9c2daeb3849ba.source: Turn the ticks of the links shown round
eae9c2daeb3849ba.text: 反选显示的链接的勾选状态

eaee905df121bd52.source: Nothing opens a window: a download that would ask a question (a duplicate, files already there) takes the choice set in the settings, or isn't added.
eaee905df121bd52.text: 不会打开任何窗口：需要提问的下载（重复文件、已存在的文件）将根据设置中的选择进行处理，或者不予添加。

eaef784ae83d7617.source: <g1>Clean room.</g1> DDM contains no code, binaries, artwork, icons, sounds or text from Internet Download Manager or any other download manager. Never disassemble, decompile or patch another program, and never bypass anyone's licensing. See <g2>Not a reverse-engineering project</g2>.
eaef784ae83d7617.text: <g1>洁净室。</g1> DDM 不包含来自 Internet Download Manager 或任何其他下载管理器的代码、二进制文件、艺术作品、图标、声音或文本。切勿反汇编、反编译或修改其他程序，也切勿规避任何人的许可条款。请参阅<g2>这不是逆向工程项目</g2>。

eb60a779982bcd66.source: Chrome, Edge and Brave run an extension in private (incognito) windows only when you allow it, and Firefox asks too. Until then, downloads from private windows stay with the browser. To allow it: on the browser's extensions page, open <g1>Details</g1> and turn on <g2>Allow in Incognito</g2>; in Firefox, <g3>Add-ons and themes</g3> → the extension → <g4>Allow</g4> beside <g5>Run in Private Windows</g5>. Downloads from a private window use that window's cookies, and DDM doesn't keep them in its list once they're done.
eb60a779982bcd66.text: Chrome、Edge 和 Brave 只有在您允许后才会在隐私（无痕）窗口中运行扩展，Firefox 也会询问。在此之前，隐私窗口中的下载仍由浏览器处理。允许方法：在浏览器的扩展程序页面打开<g1>详情</g1>，开启<g2>在无痕模式下启用</g2>；在 Firefox 中，依次打开<g3>附加组件和主题</g3> → 该扩展 → 在<g5>在隐私窗口中运行</g5>（Run in Private Windows）旁选择<g4>允许</g4>。隐私窗口中的下载使用该窗口的 Cookie，下载完成后 DDM 不会将其保留在列表中。

eb712f80554a3646.text: DDM 中可能有窗口正等待您操作（例如问题提示或<g1>添加种子</g1>）；请先处理，然后重试。

eb77259fac2153e9.text: <g1>Vercel</g1> 负责解析本站的名称（即 DNS）：您的电脑或其 DNS 服务会向它查询 dannex.kavangi.co.ke 的位置。网页本身不经过 Vercel。请参阅 <g2>Vercel 的隐私政策</g2>。

eba4a18243d01a89.source: A queue's downloads start with their windows hidden, so a queue never fills the screen: open one the same way. <g1>Options → Downloads → How the progress window opens → Edit...</g1> chooses how the window opens when you start a download yourself: <g2>Normally</g2>, <g3>Minimized</g3>, or <g4>Hidden in the notification area</g4>.

ed005796026ee853.source: <g1>What you download, on your local network.</g1> DDM tells other computers on your network which torrents it has, so they can share faster. On public Wi-Fi, turn off <g2>Find peers on the local network</g2>.

ed015fb2e04742ce.text: <g1>加密</g1>：使用 HTTPS，证书在您的计算机上生成并保存；其指纹在“选项”中，可与手机浏览器显示的指纹进行比较。

ed0419b45b0e746b.source: Pick a feed on the left to see its articles. An article with a torrent shows a torrent icon and its size when the feed gives it. Double-click one, or select it and click <g1>Download...</g1>, to open <g2>Add torrent</g2> with it, as for any magnet link or <x3/> address.

ed5b7e8737429bd7.source: The server's certificate is checked against Windows' (or the system's) trusted certificates, as for <x1/>. A Linux system without them (a minimal install without the <x2/> package) still downloads over plain HTTP and FTP; each secure download then fails at once, saying to install that package.
ed5b7e8737429bd7.text: 服务器证书会根据 Windows（或系统）的受信任证书进行检查，与 <x1/> 的方式相同。没有这些证书的 Linux 系统（未安装 <x2/> 软件包的最小化安装）仍会通过纯 HTTP 和 FTP 下载；每个安全下载都会立即失败，并提示安装该软件包。

ed7e98ef180222ef.source: <g1>Must contain</g1>: words the title must contain, all of them, in any order. <x2/> separates alternatives (<x3/>), and <x4/> and <x5/> are wildcards. Case doesn't matter.
ed7e98ef180222ef.text: <g1>必须包含</g1>：标题必须包含的词语，且所有词语都要出现，顺序不限。<x2/>用于分隔备选项（<x3/>），<x4/>和<x5/>是通配符。不区分大小写。

DDM accepts IDM's familiar command-line switches, comes with dannexdownloadmanager-cli for downloads from a terminal, and has a local, token-protected automation API that can list, pause, start and remove downloads. The API is off until you turn it on. See Command line and automation.
ed9f8164de938ae9.text: 是。DDM 接受 IDM 熟悉的命令行开关，附带 dannexdownloadmanager-cli 用于从终端下载，并具有一个本地的、受令牌保护的自动化 API，可以列出、暂停、开始和删除下载。此 API 默认关闭，直到您将其打开。请参阅命令行和自动化。

edabad293271330f.source: <g1>Turned off in Dannex Download Manager</g1>, and which option
edabad293271330f.text: <g1>已在 Dannex Download Manager 中关闭</g1>，以及是哪个选项

edc9abcb08e77b81.source: <g1><g2>Image galleries</g2></g1> — download a gallery's pictures (Wikimedia Commons, Flickr, DeviantArt and many more) with gallery-dl.
edc9abcb08e77b81.text: <g1><g2>图片库</g2></g1> — 使用 gallery-dl 下载图片库中的图片（Wikimedia Commons、Flickr、DeviantArt 等）。

edcf801a3b35a5ab.source: Test browser integration... says whether the browser reaches DDM.
edcf801a3b35a5ab.text: 测试浏览器集成... 会显示浏览器是否能连接到 DDM。

ee0909e6f0e39f55.source: Start from the example above: change the seeds' colours, then add roles and sizes as you go.
ee0909e6f0e39f55.text: 从上面的示例开始：更改种子的颜色，然后逐步添加角色和大小。

ee13a99787f3402f.source: <g1>Browser extension</g1><g2>Downloads you click in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi or Firefox go straight to DDM, sign-in included.</g2>
ee13a99787f3402f.text: <g1>浏览器扩展</g1><g2>在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 或 Firefox 中点击的下载会直接发送到 DDM，包括登录信息。</g2>

ee1b23b4b3e85124.source: How do I install the browser extension?
ee1b23b4b3e85124.text: 如何安装浏览器扩展程序？

ee2d1549d99def1d.source: What Dannex Download Manager is made for: a general-purpose download manager, like a web browser, for files you have the right to download.
ee2d1549d99def1d.text: Dannex Download Manager 的用途：一款通用下载管理器，像网页浏览器一样，用于下载您有权下载的文件。

ee37e54eb8ede1fa.source: The window's close box (<g1>×</g1>) does the same as <g2>Cancel</g2> while the download runs, as in IDM; for a finished or stopped download it just closes the window.
ee37e54eb8ede1fa.text: 窗口的关闭框（<g1>×</g1>）在下载运行时与<g2>取消</g2>作用相同，与 IDM 一样；对于已完成或已停止的下载，它只是关闭窗口。

ee658e61097dcf6b.source: A computer that is asleep doesn't run anything until it wakes, unless the queue has <g1>Wake the computer to run this queue</g1> ticked (on Windows it needs <g2>Allow wake timers</g2> in the power plan; the Scheduler says when it's off). See <g3>Wake the computer to run a queue</g3>.
ee658e61097dcf6b.text: 电脑在休眠状态下不会运行任何程序，除非队列勾选了<g1>唤醒电脑以运行此队列</g1>（在 Windows 上，电源计划中需要<g2>允许唤醒定时器</g2>；计划程序会显示其何时关闭）。请参阅<g3>唤醒电脑以运行队列</g3>。

ee6f7b9e469f83a7.source: <g1>Download limits</g1> keeps a capped internet plan in check: no more than a set number of megabytes every few hours. When the limit is reached, downloads wait, and they carry on by themselves when the period is over.
ee6f7b9e469f83a7.text: <g1>下载限制</g1>可以控制有流量限制的互联网套餐：每隔几小时下载的兆字节数不超过设定值。达到限制后，下载会暂停，并在期限结束后自行继续。

ee9034f4bfe810cf.source: <g1>Recheck files</g1> — reads every piece of the torrent's files and checks it, for example after you moved files in or a disk had errors. A running torrent goes on afterwards and fetches what is missing. A stopped one stays stopped. Its event log says how much was found: a finished torrent with a damaged piece becomes stopped, and resuming it fetches the piece again.
ee9034f4bfe810cf.text: <g1>重新检查文件</g1> — 读取种子文件的每个部分并进行检查，例如在您移动文件或磁盘出现错误之后。运行中的种子会继续运行并获取缺失的部分。已停止的种子保持停止状态。其事件日志会显示找到多少内容：已完成的种子如果损坏了一个部分，则会变为停止状态，恢复它会再次获取该部分。

ee9d070891f55b05.source: DDM is built for 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, as an installer, a portable copy or a plain zip. Builds for Linux and macOS come with every release.
ee9d070891f55b05.text: DDM 专为 64 位 Windows 10 和 11 构建，提供安装程序、便携版或普通 zip 压缩包。每个版本都包含 Linux 和 macOS 构建。

eea0683af36fb9e8.source: Something not working? We'd like to know.

eee3ddf8a1920fce.source: The crash report window after DDM stopped responding
eee3ddf8a1920fce.text: DDM 停止响应后的崩溃报告窗口

ef4299bbbca5d797.source: A freeze report will say whether DDM's window ran all along (a loop), waited (on a lock, the disk or the network), or hardly ran at all. That last kind usually means a computer too busy to run DDM, most likely not a bug in DDM, and those reports share one signature so they find one issue instead of many. macOS doesn't measure this yet. The window's title will be in DDM's language too, and the report will keep its own lines in every language, left to right in Arabic and Persian.
ef4299bbbca5d797.text: 冻结报告会说明 DDM 窗口是始终运行（循环）、等待（锁定、磁盘或网络）还是几乎没有运行。最后一种情况通常意味着计算机过于繁忙而无法运行 DDM，很可能不是 DDM 中的错误，这些报告共享一个签名，因此它们会找到一个问题而不是多个问题。macOS 尚未测量此项。窗口标题也将采用 DDM 的语言，报告将保留其在每种语言中的行，在阿拉伯语和波斯语中从左到右显示。

ef4a8ff4d9fbf4e8.source: The <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Firefox:
ef4a8ff4d9fbf4e8.text: 适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 和 Firefox 的 <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> 扩展：

ef66ff61d7cc24b4.source: <g1>Give files the server's date</g1> — give finished files the date the server reports, not the date you downloaded them.
ef66ff61d7cc24b4.text: <g1>为文件设置服务器上的日期</g1> — 让已完成的文件采用服务器报告的日期，而不是您下载它们的日期。

ef8cedcbdccdaf85.source: The code is filled in when you scanned the QR code; otherwise type it. Give the phone a name, and tap <g1>Pair</g1>. The window on the computer says so, and closes with <g2>Done</g2>.
ef8cedcbdccdaf85.text: 扫描二维码后，代码会自动填写；否则请手动输入。为手机命名，然后点击<g1>配对</g1>。电脑上的窗口会显示配对成功，并以<g2>完成</g2>关闭。

efaf00494efe309f.source: The other downloads keep their speed.

efd87b0f999ae1f3.source: In colour; the tooltip names it

eff6c00ab7dd9c1d.source: The thumb or an arrow under the pointer

f03c509d0238da7b.source: <g1>Save to</g1>: a folder for the rule's torrents, and <g2>Add them without starting them</g2> if you'd rather start them yourself.
f03c509d0238da7b.text: <g1>保存到</g1>：规则种子的文件夹，如果您更愿意自己启动它们，则选择<g2>添加但不启动</g2>。

f047e40e7188535a.source: Narrow it down with categories and sorting
f047e40e7188535a.text: 使用类别和排序缩小范围

f07a76627a9be696.source: When you click a download, the extension checks DDM's Options:
f07a76627a9be696.text: 点击下载时，扩展会检查 DDM 的选项：

f0e933d37db8b9a1.source: <g1>Cursor</g1>: the same <x2/> entry as Claude Desktop's, in <x3/> (or add it in Cursor's MCP settings).
f0e933d37db8b9a1.text: <g1>Cursor</g1>：与 Claude Desktop 相同的<x2/>条目，在<x3/>中（或在 Cursor 的 MCP 设置中添加）。

f10113695e758efd.source: A playlist's or channel's videos, one line each as they're listed: its place, length, title and address.
f10113695e758efd.text: 列出播放列表或频道中的视频，每行一个，按列表顺序显示其位置、时长、标题和网址。

f10af3be82d5c760.source: <g1>Through a proxy</g1>, DDM only sees the proxy, so it says <g2>through a proxy</g2> (with the proxy's country when it knows it) instead of guessing the server's. A VPN that works at the system level can't be seen: the country is then the server's, but the time includes the VPN's detour.
f10af3be82d5c760.text: <g1>通过代理</g1>，DDM 只能看到代理，因此会显示<g2>通过代理</g2>（如果知道代理的国家，则会显示代理的国家），而不是猜测服务器的位置。系统级别的 VPN 无法被看到：此时国家是服务器的国家，但时间包括了 VPN 的绕行。

f10c89a15a8e65ac.source: When the Chrome Web Store's copy and the copy from DDM's folder are both in one Chromium browser, they ask each other (by their IDs, inside the browser) whether the other is there, so only one takes downloads. Nothing leaves the browser for that.
f10c89a15a8e65ac.text: 当 Chrome 应用商店的副本和来自 DDM 文件夹的副本同时存在于一个 Chromium 浏览器中时，它们会（通过其 ID，在浏览器内部）互相询问对方是否存在，以便只有一个接管下载。为此，没有任何内容离开浏览器。

f135b1b9671dc439.source: Make everything larger / smaller, in every window (<g1>View → Interface size</g1>, 100 % to 200 %)
f135b1b9671dc439.text: 放大 / 缩小所有窗口中的界面元素（<g1>视图 → 界面大小</g1>，100% 到 200%）

f15210a203cd6290.source: <g1>DDM can't be reached</g1>: the button is grey with a red <g2>!</g2>. A click opens the extension's status page instead of switching anything: in a sentence or two it says what is wrong and the one thing to do, offers DDM's download for your system when DDM isn't installed, and turns into <g3>Dannex Download Manager is installed</g3> by itself once DDM answers. See <g4>The browser and DDM aren't connected</g4> for every case.
f15210a203cd6290.text: <g1>无法连接 DDM</g1>：按钮为灰色，带红色<g2>!</g2>。单击会打开扩展的状态页，而不是切换任何内容：页面用一两句话说明出了什么问题以及该做的一件事，在 DDM 未安装时提供适合您系统的 DDM 下载，并在 DDM 响应后自动变为<g3>Dannex Download Manager 已安装</g3>。所有情况请参阅<g4>浏览器与 DDM 未连接</g4>。

f168ba524a2dbb62.source: DDM installs an update only when the release's list of checksums is signed by DDM's release key and the file matches it; anything else is refused, and <g1>Download</g1> opens the <g2>Releases</g2> page instead.
f168ba524a2dbb62.text: 仅当版本发布的校验和列表经 DDM 的发布密钥签名且文件与之匹配时，DDM 才会安装更新；其他情况一律拒绝，此时<g1>下载</g1>会改为打开<g2>发布</g2>页面。

f16b959263e848e7.source: You need your own paid account with one of these services: DDM doesn't sell or include one. Sharing an account or its links breaks the services' terms and can get the account suspended.
f16b959263e848e7.text: 您需要拥有这些服务之一的付费账户：DDM 不出售或包含任何账户。共享账户或其链接会违反服务条款，并可能导致账户被暂停。

f18d478bc7bd8af9.source: If some of the torrent's files are already in the folder, DDM asks before using them. <g1>Yes</g1> keeps them for the torrent: DDM checks them, keeps what matches the torrent and downloads the rest, which is how you continue a download started elsewhere or share files you already have. <g2>No</g2> (the default) goes back, so you can choose another folder and nothing of yours is overwritten.
f18d478bc7bd8af9.text: 如果 torrent 的某些文件已在文件夹中，DDM 会在使用前询问。选择<g1>是</g1>会将它们用于 torrent：DDM 会检查它们，保留与 torrent 匹配的部分并下载其余部分，这样您就可以继续在其他地方开始的下载或共享您已有的文件。选择<g2>否</g2>（默认）会返回，以便您可以选择另一个文件夹，并且您的任何内容都不会被覆盖。

f1ab20f2531281c0.source: Install DDM with the setup and keep Set up browser integration ticked. In Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, add the extension from the Chrome Web Store: DDM's Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser window opens its page, where Add to Chrome installs it, and the browser keeps it up to date. Firefox installs only add-ons Mozilla has signed, so until Dannex's is on addons.mozilla.org it takes the file extension\ddm-firefox.xpi in Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR, or until Firefox closes in any Firefox. The tutorial walks through each.
f1ab20f2531281c0.text: 用安装程序安装 DDM，并保持勾选设置浏览器集成。在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 中，从 Chrome 网上应用店添加扩展：DDM 的将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器窗口会打开扩展页面，点击添加至 Chrome即可安装，之后由浏览器负责更新。Firefox 只安装经 Mozilla 签名的附加组件，所以在 Dannex 的扩展登上 addons.mozilla.org 之前，需要在 Firefox Developer Edition、Nightly 或 ESR 中安装文件 extension\ddm-firefox.xpi，或者在任何 Firefox 中安装，直到 Firefox 关闭为止。教程会逐一带您操作。

f1b78c765ed86557.source: FTP downloads work like web downloads: several connections at once, pause and resume, and the same progress window.
f1b78c765ed86557.text: FTP 下载与网页下载类似：可以同时建立多个连接、暂停和恢复下载，并使用相同的进度窗口。

f1ffe13bf5cbb2c3.source: View → Interface size (<x1/>, #262) is egui's zoom factor over the display's own scale: every window is laid out in points, so it opens that much larger; one larger than the screen scrolls.
f1ffe13bf5cbb2c3.text: “视图”→“界面大小”(<x1/>, #262) 是 egui 在显示器自身缩放比例之上的缩放因子：每个窗口都以点为单位布局，因此它会按比例放大；如果大于屏幕，则会滚动。

f2039bc45d79ae2e.source: Every list's and table's column headers
f2039bc45d79ae2e.text: 所有列表和表格的列标题

f2100af9e04accde.source: Yes, completely. Dannex Download Manager (DDM) is free and open-source software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. There is no trial period, no paid edition, no registration key, no nag screen and no ads, and there never will be. You may use it at home or at work, copy it and give it to others.
f2100af9e04accde.text: 是的，完全免费。Dannex Download Manager (DDM) 是基于 GNU 通用公共许可证第 3 版的免费开源软件。没有试用期、没有付费版本、没有注册密钥、没有烦人的提示屏幕，也没有广告，而且永远不会有。您可以在家里或工作中免费使用它，也可以复制并分享给他人。

f232ea1acad0ee9e.source: If the video won't download, see <g1>Video downloads</g1>.
f232ea1acad0ee9e.text: 如果视频无法下载，请参阅<g1>视频下载</g1>。

f258c0caca2dcac9.source: Paste a video's page. Pick the quality.
f258c0caca2dcac9.text: 粘贴视频页面链接，选择画质。

f26764c71f561cf8.source: In <g1>Address</g1>, write the address with one asterisk where the number or letter changes: <x2/>.
f26764c71f561cf8.text: 在<g1>地址</g1>中，在数字或字母变化的位置写入一个星号：<x2/>。

f28372a54bdb034d.source: Options → Remote: the address, the certificate's fingerprint and the paired devices.
f28372a54bdb034d.text: 选项 → 远程：地址、证书指纹和已配对设备。

f298b52b62482795.source: Options on its Downloads page: Download File Info, Download complete and addresses already in the list
f298b52b62482795.text: 选项的“下载”页面：下载文件信息、下载完成，以及列表中已有的地址

f2ae255e0c41c631.source: When the connection drops, DDM retries on its own. In the progress window, the connection table shows <g1>Retrying</g1> and the reason. Usually the download goes on by itself once the connection is back.
f2ae255e0c41c631.text: 当连接中断时，DDM 会自行重试。在进度窗口中，连接表会显示<g1>正在重试</g1>和原因。通常，一旦连接恢复，下载就会自行继续。

f2b45bae019642ac.source: Use the path from step 2 (in JSON, every <x1/> is written <x2/>). Other assistants take the same thing: a command to start, no arguments.
f2b45bae019642ac.text: 使用第 2 步中的路径（在 JSON 中，每个<x1/>都写成<x2/>）。其他助手也使用相同的方式：一个启动命令，没有参数。

f2d4f3ae1b5602bb.source: From GitHub's public record, <x1/>: people with pull requests first, then those who opened issues, then those who commented, each once. The maintainer and automated accounts aren't counted.
f2d4f3ae1b5602bb.text: 根据 GitHub 的公开记录，<x1/>：首先是提交拉取请求的人，其次是提出问题的人，然后是发表评论的人，每人只计算一次。维护者和自动化账户不计入在内。

f2fd829426a9d905.source: Click <g1>Add URL</g1> on the toolbar, choose <g2>Tasks → Add new download</g2>, or press <g3>Ctrl+N</g3>.
f2fd829426a9d905.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>添加 URL</g1>，选择<g2>任务 → 添加新下载</g2>，或按<g3>Ctrl+N</g3>。

f313ce0fb2d7fe17.source: <g1>Peers</g1> — the computers you are downloading from, with how much you received from and sent to each.
f313ce0fb2d7fe17.text: <g1>对等方</g1> — 您正在从中下载的计算机，以及您从每个计算机接收和发送的数据量。

f35efcc64dbdeb9b.source: <g1>Confirm before deleting downloads</g1> — ask before taking downloads off the list. On by default; <g2>Don't show this again</g2> in that question turns it off, and ticking it here turns it back on.
f35efcc64dbdeb9b.text: <g1>删除下载前确认</g1> — 在从列表中移除下载之前询问。默认开启；该提问中的<g2>不再显示此消息</g2>会将其关闭，在此处勾选则会重新开启。

f3661c226f1714f0.source: <g1>Text size</g1>: the download list's text, as <g2>View → Font</g2> sets it.
f3661c226f1714f0.text: <g1>文字大小</g1>：下载列表的文字，与<g2>视图 → 字体</g2>的设置一致。

f37bb491e7425f66.source: <g1>A queue starts</g1> — a queue started by hand, at its time in the Scheduler, or as DDM starts (its <g2>Start when Dannex Download Manager starts</g2>).
f37bb491e7425f66.text: <g1>队列启动时</g1> — 手动启动的队列、在计划程序中到时间启动的队列，或在 DDM 启动时启动的队列（其<g2>Dannex Download Manager 启动时开始</g2>）。

f37caeaafc491b26.source: How Dannex Download Manager speeds up downloads: up to 32 connections per file, dynamic re-splitting, per-server limits it learns, and crash-safe resume.
f37caeaafc491b26.text: Dannex Download Manager 如何加速下载：每个文件最多 32 个连接，动态重新分段，学习并限制每个服务器的连接数，以及防崩溃续传。

f3a16665a583e72f.source: The list shows the order they will run in. Use the arrow buttons under it to move a download up or down.
f3a16665a583e72f.text: 列表显示了它们将运行的顺序。使用下面的箭头按钮可以向上或向下移动下载。

f3d90a3cd84b7d3f.source: Crash and freeze reports: the monitor process, out-of-process minidumps, symbolicated stacks, the report's text and the release logs (<g1>crash-reports.md</g1>)
f3d90a3cd84b7d3f.text: 崩溃和冻结报告：监视进程、进程外 minidumps、符号化堆栈、报告文本和发布日志（<g1>crash-reports.md</g1>）

f3db0a80eb6e5aa4.source: <g1>Apply</g1> saves your changes. <g2>Close</g2> closes the window.
f3db0a80eb6e5aa4.text: <g1>应用</g1>保存您的更改。<g2>关闭</g2>关闭窗口。

f3e21327d9c7e8e0.source: <g1>Show Download File Info first</g1> — show <g2>Download File Info</g2> for each new download. With it off, downloads start at once, or only join the queue if you tick <g3>Otherwise, add them to the queue without starting</g3>.
f3e21327d9c7e8e0.text: <g1>先显示“下载文件信息”</g1> — 为每个新下载显示<g2>下载文件信息</g2>。关闭后，下载会立即开始，或者在勾选<g3>否则，将其加入队列但不启动</g3>时仅加入队列。

f3e5893fa6669509.source: From command to finished file. The whisker is the 95% interval of the ratio; the scale is logarithmic.
f3e5893fa6669509.text: 从命令发出到文件完成。误差线表示比值的 95% 区间；坐标轴为对数刻度。

f56d3b2a3638ac92.source: A large module is a folder of files by responsibility, its top-level file the module's root: <x1/> with <x2/>, <x3/> with <x4/>. The root keeps the module's imports, what its parts share and what the rest of the program uses (re-exported, so a path such as <x5/> or <x6/> is the same as before); each part takes the root's names with <x7/>, and what one part gives the others is <x8/>. The catalog's extractor reads a folder with its root as one module (<x9/>), so a text's note says where it shows wherever its code sits.
f56d3b2a3638ac92.text: 较大的模块是按职责划分的文件夹，其顶层文件是模块的根：<x1/> 配 <x2/>，<x3/> 配 <x4/>。根文件保留模块的导入、各部分共用的内容，以及程序其余部分所使用的内容（已重新导出，因此 <x5/> 或 <x6/> 这样的路径与以前相同）；每个部分用 <x7/> 引入根文件的名称，而一个部分提供给其他部分的内容则用 <x8/>。目录提取器把带根文件的文件夹视为一个模块（<x9/>），所以无论代码位于何处，文本的注释都会说明它显示在哪里。

f5de564aaf2112b5.source: <g1>Use the browser's proxy for the downloads it hands over…</g1> — on by default. A download DDM takes from the browser goes through the proxy the browser used for it. That's the one a VPN or proxy extension set, the browser's own manual proxy, or its proxy auto-config script. Without it, the download would leave from your own address, and content limited to the VPN's country, or to its address, would fail. The browser extension reads that proxy and hands it to DDM with each download, once you switch on <g2>Download through this browser's VPN or proxy</g2> in the extension's options page, under <g3>More</g3> (right-click its toolbar button → <g4>Options</g4>; Firefox asks you once; Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi ask nothing more: see <g5>A VPN or proxy extension</g5>).
f5de564aaf2112b5.text: <g1>对浏览器交给 DDM 的下载使用浏览器的代理…</g1> — 默认开启。DDM 从浏览器接管的下载会经过浏览器当时使用的代理。即 VPN 或代理扩展设置的代理、浏览器自己的手动代理，或其代理自动配置脚本。如果不勾选，下载会从您自己的地址发出，限于 VPN 所在国家或其地址的内容将会失败。当您在扩展的选项页的<g3>更多</g3>下开启<g2>通过此浏览器的 VPN 或代理下载</g2>后（右键单击其工具栏按钮 → <g4>选项</g4>；Firefox 会询问您一次；Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 无需再询问：见<g5>VPN 或代理扩展</g5>），浏览器扩展会读取该代理，并随每个下载一起交给 DDM。

f77cbac3441da259.source: A name that would lead outside the folder is left out, and so is a link to somewhere else on the disk. An archive that would write far more than its size, or more than the disk has room for, stops before it fills it. Extracted files are marked as coming from the internet, as the archive is, so Windows still warns before running a program from them. The archive itself goes to the Recycle Bin (the Trash on macOS and Linux) only if you ask.
f77cbac3441da259.text: 如果文件名会导致文件解压到指定文件夹之外，或者链接到磁盘上的其他位置，则会跳过该文件。如果压缩包解压后文件大小远超其自身大小，或超出磁盘可用空间，解压会在填满磁盘前停止。解压后的文件会被标记为来自互联网，就像压缩包本身一样，因此 Windows 在运行其中的程序前仍会发出警告。压缩包本身只有在您要求时才会移至回收站（macOS 和 Linux 上是废纸篓）。

f780a1e13d261137.source: Everything can be done from the keyboard, and DDM works with screen readers (such as Narrator and NVDA on Windows): its windows, dialogs and menus tell them what each control is and its state, and the download list reads each download's name, status and size. The <g1>Categories</g1> pane reads as a tree (each category with its count, open or shut, selected or not), and the menu bar and every right-click menu as menus whose items can be run from there. On Linux, screen readers (Orca) don't read DDM's windows yet; the keyboard works there as everywhere.
f780a1e13d261137.text: DDM 支持屏幕阅读器（如 Windows 上的“讲述人”和 NVDA），所有操作均可通过键盘完成：其窗口、对话框和菜单会告知屏幕阅读器每个控件的名称和状态，下载列表会朗读每个下载任务的名称、状态和大小。<g1>类别</g1>窗格会以树状结构朗读（每个类别及其数量、展开或折叠、选中或未选中），菜单栏和所有右键菜单也会作为菜单朗读，其项目可直接运行。在 Linux 上，屏幕阅读器（Orca）尚无法朗读 DDM 的窗口；但键盘操作与其他地方一样有效。

f8a19e0cec17fc09.source: The time from a browser's download to Download File Info and to the file's first bytes is logged step by step (<x1/> lines: the host's hand-over, the window's pass that takes it, the dialog shown, the address answered, the early start, the first bytes; <x2/>), and <x3/> reads them over a run of its own (a browser's download, an address, or the video button's menu). eframe holds a hidden or minimized window's passes 100 ms apart; while the main window is in the notification area, a command that arrives, a window that opens and an answer a dialog waits for run its next pass at once instead (<x4/>).
f8a19e0cec17fc09.text: 从浏览器的下载到“下载文件信息”再到文件第一批字节的耗时，会逐步记入日志（<x1/> 行：主机程序的交接、窗口接手的那一轮、显示对话框、地址得到回应、提前开始、第一批字节；<x2/>），<x3/> 会在它自己的一次运行中读取这些记录（浏览器的一次下载、一个地址，或视频按钮的菜单）。eframe 会让隐藏或最小化的窗口每 100 ms 才处理一轮；当主窗口在通知区域时，到达的命令、打开的窗口以及对话框所等待的回答则立即进入下一轮处理（<x4/>）。

f96596c1b8032d50.source: If your browser can't use the Chrome Web Store (one your workplace manages, or one with its store turned off), add the copy that comes with DDM:
f96596c1b8032d50.text: 如果您的浏览器无法使用 Chrome 网上应用店（单位管理的浏览器，或关闭了商店的浏览器），请添加随 DDM 提供的副本：

f96a0c3b3f8d35d4.source: In <g1>Helium</g1>, add it from the <g2>Chrome Web Store</g2> too: click <g3>Add to Chrome</g3>. Helium fetches extensions through its own services, so this works only while they're allowed. If Helium says <g4>Extension downloads are disabled</g4>, open <x5/> (<g6>Settings → Privacy and security → Helium services</g6>), turn on <g7>Allow connecting to Helium services</g7> and <g8>Proxy extension downloads and updates</g8>, and click <g9>Add to Chrome</g9> again. With those off, load the extension by hand, as above (<x10/> works in Helium too).
f96a0c3b3f8d35d4.text: 在 <g1>Helium</g1> 中，同样从 <g2>Chrome 网上应用店</g2>添加：点击<g3>添加至 Chrome</g3>。Helium 通过它自己的服务获取扩展，所以只有这些服务被允许时才行得通。如果 Helium 提示<g4>已停用扩展下载</g4>，请打开 <x5/>（<g6>设置 → 隐私和安全 → Helium 服务</g6>），打开<g7>允许连接到 Helium 服务</g7>和<g8>代理扩展下载和更新</g8>，然后再次点击<g9>添加至 Chrome</g9>。这些选项关闭时，请如上手动加载扩展（<x10/> 在 Helium 中同样可用）。

f980845faac8dac0.source: Go to a web page and click a download link, for example a ZIP or an EXE: DDM opens <g1>Download File Info</g1>. Click <g2>Start Download</g2>.
f980845faac8dac0.text: 访问网页并点击下载链接，例如 ZIP 或 EXE 文件：DDM 会打开<g1>下载文件信息</g1>。点击<g2>开始下载</g2>。

f98daba34f677b79.source: Click the tray icon to bring the window back.
f98daba34f677b79.text: 点击托盘图标可恢复窗口。

f99fbf7e49802e4e.source: <g1>No content of its own.</g1> DDM doesn't host, index, search for or recommend anything to download. What it downloads comes from the addresses you give it.
f99fbf7e49802e4e.text: <g1>不提供任何内容。</g1> DDM 不托管、索引、搜索或推荐任何可下载的内容。它下载的内容来自您提供的地址。

f9a2daf6315effed.source: Hold the pointer over it: its tip lists each running download with how far it is and how fast it goes (as many as the tip holds, the rest counted).
f9a2daf6315effed.text: 把指针停在它上面：提示会列出每个正在进行的下载，包括进度和速度（提示能容纳多少就列多少，其余只计数）。

f9b1393934105e30.source: Yes. The portable download is a zip: unzip it anywhere, a USB stick included, and run it. Your downloads list and settings stay in its own <x1/> folder, so nothing is written to the computer. See <g2>Portable mode</g2>.
f9b1393934105e30.text: 是的。便携式下载是一个 zip 文件：将其解压到任何地方，包括 U 盘，然后运行即可。您的下载列表和设置会保留在其自己的<x1/>文件夹中，因此不会写入计算机。请参阅<g2>便携模式</g2>。

f9c9c95db8ce8c92.source: What Dannex Download Manager, its browser extension and this website do with your data: the app and extension collect nothing, and the website counts no one.
f9c9c95db8ce8c92.text: Dannex Download Manager、其浏览器扩展和本网站如何处理您的数据：应用和扩展不收集任何数据，网站也不统计任何人。

f9fb84277f217370.source: Linux won't be experimental any more: every change is now checked on a Linux desktop as well as on Windows. GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon were checked window by window: the tray icon and its menu, <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1>, dark mode following the desktop, and the browsers handing downloads over (Ubuntu's Snap Firefox, Google Chrome and Brave). A Wayland session runs DDM through XWayland, so menus open under their titles, on tiling compositors such as sway too. The <x2/> and <x3/> were installed in clean Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and Fedora 45 systems and bring everything DDM needs; from the AppImage or the <x4/>, a missing library is named at start with the command that installs it. <g5>Update now</g5> asks the package manager which package DDM is.
f9fb84277f217370.text: Linux 版不再是实验性的：现在每项更改都会在 Linux 桌面和 Windows 上同时检查。GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon 都逐个窗口检查过：托盘图标及其菜单、<g1>最小化到通知区域</g1>、跟随桌面的深色模式，以及浏览器交接下载（Ubuntu 的 Snap 版 Firefox、Google Chrome 和 Brave）。Wayland 会话通过 XWayland 运行 DDM，因此菜单会在其标题下方打开，包括 sway 等平铺式合成器。<x2/> 和 <x3/> 已在全新的 Ubuntu 24.04、Debian 12 和 Fedora 45 系统中安装，并带有 DDM 所需的一切；从 AppImage 或 <x4/> 运行时，若缺少库，启动时会指出缺少的库以及用于安装它的命令。<g5>立即更新</g5>会询问包管理器 DDM 属于哪个软件包。

f9fc95028964f92c.text: 选项 → 帐户 → 添加...

fa18671091683eeb.source: Browsers installed as a Flatpak or a Snap run in a sandbox, which decides whether they can reach DDM.
fa18671091683eeb.text: 以 Flatpak 或 Snap 形式安装的浏览器在沙盒中运行，能否访问 DDM 取决于沙盒设置。

fa1d6ae1846ad1b8.source: A download's server location (#140) is the country of the address it connected to, looked up in <x1/>'s table on this computer (<x2/> names it in the interface language); the release job builds the table again from the month's data (<x3/>).
fa1d6ae1846ad1b8.text: 下载的服务器位置 (#140) 是其连接到的地址所在国家/地区，在此计算机上通过 <x1/> 的表格查找（<x2/> 以界面语言命名）；发布任务会根据当月数据重新构建表格 (<x3/>)。

fa3e7e0e783830a9.source: A torrent's progress window on its Files tab
fa3e7e0e783830a9.text: 种子进度窗口中的“文件”选项卡

fa41979a21fbdd42.source: not to use it to break copy protection (DRM): DDM doesn't do this and isn't meant to;
fa41979a21fbdd42.text: 不使用它来破解复制保护（DRM）：DDM 不具备此功能，也无意为之；

fa55ccb9217efbb9.source: Replaces the programs in their folder (a portable copy's <x1/> folder is kept).
fa55ccb9217efbb9.text: 替换其文件夹中的程序（便携版副本的<x1/>文件夹会保留）。

fa5f14a1aee829e9.source: first when the download goes through a debrid account, then a <x1/> line every half second, then <x2/>, or <x3/> after <x4/> (<x5/> is the file <x6/> takes).
fa5f14a1aee829e9.text: 首先当下载通过网盘服务帐户时，然后每半秒一行<x1/>，然后<x2/>，或者在<x4/>之后<x3/>（<x5/>是<x6/>获取的文件）。

fa67cf7e559510a2.source: The line at the bottom says what would be added: how many links are ticked, of how many, and their size together (and how many have no size known yet).
fa67cf7e559510a2.text: 底部的一行说明将要添加的内容：勾选了多少个链接，共多少个，它们合计的大小（以及有多少个还不知道大小）。

fa69a7e72d92848f.source: <g1>Edit...</g1>: open its settings in Site grabber.
fa69a7e72d92848f.text: <g1>编辑...</g1>：在站点抓取器中打开其设置。

fa6a5141054cb2c6.source: The layout is familiar on purpose: the toolbar, the categories, the download list, the progress window with every connection, queues and the scheduler. The…
fa6a5141054cb2c6.text: 布局特意设计得很熟悉：工具栏、类别、下载列表、显示每个连接的进度窗口、队列和调度程序。...

fa6e95ec9b6285a4.source: Check <g1>Save to</g1> and <g2>File name</g2>. The name comes from the video's title; change it if you like.
fa6e95ec9b6285a4.text: 检查<g1>保存到</g1>和<g2>文件名</g2>。文件名来自视频标题；如果您喜欢，可以更改它。

fa8a033a2e9083c4.text: 成功、仪表和种子的片段

fb140a625b84ac20.source: An unknown question or action is answered <x1/>, as is a question while the API is off (then with <x2/>, for programs to check: the error text may change). A wrong token is answered <x3/>.

fb265667f2856e05.source: If the server needs a login, tick <g1>Log in to the server</g1>.
fb265667f2856e05.text: 如果服务器需要登录，请勾选<g1>登录服务器</g1>。

fb744339b1b7f421.source: Theme files you make or download go in DDM's themes folder. <g1>View → Theme → Open themes folder</g1> opens it (and makes it the first time). It is in DDM's data folder:
fb744339b1b7f421.text: 您创建或下载的主题文件存放在 DDM 的主题文件夹中。<g1>视图 → 主题 → 打开主题文件夹</g1>会打开它（首次打开时会创建）。它位于 DDM 的数据文件夹中：

fb8c39302dc9ca78.source: Video pages and image galleries need helpers that the image doesn't include. Nothing opens a window, so a download that would ask a question, such as a duplicate, takes the choice set in the settings, or isn't added. Don't publish the port on the internet: reach your home network through a VPN instead.
fb8c39302dc9ca78.text: 视频页面和图片库需要镜像中不包含的辅助程序。没有任何窗口会打开，因此需要提问的下载（例如重复文件）会根据设置中选择的选项进行处理，或者不被添加。请勿将端口发布到互联网：请通过 VPN 访问您的家庭网络。

fb93d324a1845a73.source: Copy this prompt into your AI assistant and describe the look you want at its end. It gives the assistant the format, the keys and the rules: readable text and a visible focus in both sides, and nothing copied from anyone else's artwork. Look at both sides yourself before you share the result.
fb93d324a1845a73.text: 将此提示复制到您的 AI 助手，并在末尾描述您想要的外观。它会为助手提供格式、键和规则：两面都应有可读的文本和可见的焦点，并且不复制任何其他人的作品。在分享结果之前，请您自己查看两面。

fbb161a5ca59215d.source: Click <g1>Load unpacked</g1> and choose the <x2/> folder.
fbb161a5ca59215d.text: 点击<g1>加载已解压的扩展</g1>，然后选择<x2/>文件夹。

fbba8f18d2fae06e.source: A text box's bottom line while it can be typed in
fbba8f18d2fae06e.text: 可输入时文本框的底线

fbbaac3b1dd46b41.source: Link grabber collects many links at once, from the browser, a text file or the clipboard. It sorts them into packages, shows which ones are really there, and DDM can unpack the archives once they are downloaded.
fbbaac3b1dd46b41.text: 链接抓取器可以从浏览器、文本文件或剪贴板一次性收集大量链接。它将链接分类打包，显示哪些链接真实存在，并且 DDM 可以在下载完成后解压压缩包。

fbc5c79e5fad811f.source: <g1>VS Code</g1>: in <x2/>, or <g3>MCP: Add Server</g3> in the command palette:
fbc5c79e5fad811f.text: <g1>VS Code</g1>：在<x2/>中，或在命令面板中选择<g3>MCP: 添加服务器</g3>：

fc08963d3bab24c0.source: On Ubuntu's GNOME desktop, with the desktop's own file icons.
fc08963d3bab24c0.text: 在 Ubuntu 的 GNOME 桌面上，使用桌面自带的文件图标。

fc146c0af2c90237.source: <g1>Windows' language</g1>, at the top, follows Windows' display language. When Windows uses a language DDM doesn't have, DDM shows English.
fc146c0af2c90237.text: 顶部的<g1>Windows 语言</g1>会跟随 Windows 的显示语言。如果 Windows 使用的语言不在 DDM 中，DDM 会显示英文。

fc1b82f7343be62d.source: <g1>Limits.</g1> A loopback link has no real distance or packet loss; the faults stand in for them. Results are from one machine. Run it yourself: <x2/>, then <x3/>.
fc1b82f7343be62d.text: <g1>限制。</g1> 回环链路没有实际距离或数据包丢失；故障代表它们。结果来自一台机器。您可以自己运行：<x2/>，然后 <x3/>。

fc2924c84dfb0d12.source: The extension and DDM tell each other their versions at each connection, and every pair keeps working:
fc2924c84dfb0d12.text: 扩展与 DDM 在每次连接时会互相告知各自的版本，而且每种组合都能正常工作：

fc2d76f391d405c4.source: IDM takes about three seconds to accept a download from its command line before it sends anything; downloads caught by its browser extension skip that step. The transfer-only view below leaves it out.
fc2d76f391d405c4.text: IDM 从命令行接收一个下载任务要花约三秒，然后才开始传输；由浏览器扩展接管的下载不需要这一步。下面“仅传输”的视图不计入这段时间。

fc4a679f70deadb3.source: GNOME's look: round corners, flat grey buttons, a rounded focus ring and a header bar.
fc4a679f70deadb3.text: GNOME 的外观：圆角、扁平灰色按钮、圆形焦点环和标题栏。

fc4ea1eb1195b72e.source: <g1>Logging in.</g1> Write the login in the address (<x2/>), tick <g3>Log in to the server</g3>, or save it in <g4>Options → Sites Logins</g4>. Without one, DDM logs in as <x5/>. The path is relative to the folder the login starts in; to start from the server's root, write <x6/> after the server (<x7/>).
fc4ea1eb1195b72e.text: <g1>登录。</g1>在地址中写入登录信息（<x2/>）、勾选<g3>登录服务器</g3>，或将其保存在<g4>选项 → 站点登录</g4>中。如果没有登录信息，DDM 会以 <x5/> 身份登录。路径是相对于登录后起始文件夹的；若要从服务器根目录开始，请在服务器后写入 <x6/>（<x7/>）。

fc6180180d6d8bff.source: <g1>Help → Check for updates...</g1> tells you whether a newer version is out, and what is new in it: that version's release notes, with their headings, lists and bold words, in a box you can scroll and copy from (right-click). <g2>Check for updates at every start</g2> in that window lets DDM look by itself: a few seconds after it starts, and once a day while it stays open. When there's a new version, its window opens in front.
fc6180180d6d8bff.text: <g1>帮助 → 检查更新...</g1>会告诉您是否有更新的版本，以及其中有什么新内容：该版本的更新说明，包括标题、列表和粗体文字，显示在可滚动、可复制（右键点击）的框中。该窗口中的<g2>每次启动时检查更新</g2>让 DDM 自行检查：启动几秒后检查一次，并在保持打开期间每天一次。有新版本时，它的窗口会在最前面打开。

fc67345a4f529039.source: Choose whether to install for you only or for everyone on the computer. For you only needs no administrator rights and goes to <x1/>. For everyone goes to <x2/>.
fc67345a4f529039.text: 选择是仅为您安装还是为计算机上的所有人安装。仅为您安装不需要管理员权限，并会安装到 <x1/>。为所有人安装会安装到 <x2/>。

fc7fe0579b9363e9.source: One egui window painted to fixed pixel coordinates, plus one immediate viewport per dialog. <x1/> holds the state (downloads, queues, settings, the list's selection) and turns menu, toolbar, key and IPC commands into actions. Each dialog is its own module and returns an <x2/> (open, closed, done with a value). A window that comes up by itself (Download complete, a message DDM tells, a question while DDM isn't the program in front) shows above the others without taking the keyboard from the program being typed in (<x3/>, <x4/>); those the person asked for take it. Windows handed over one after another (Download File Info, Add torrent, Download video) and Download complete boxes show one at a time, in one place, the next when one closes. Windows-only calls are confined to <x5/> and their Linux and macOS counterparts to <x6/> (starting with the session, the browsers' host, sounds, show in folder, the crash handler); every other file is safe, portable Rust. Fonts come from the system: Windows' Fonts folder, macOS's system fonts, fontconfig on Linux (<x7/>). On Windows, Latin, Greek and Cyrillic text is drawn by DirectWrite (<x8/>, through egui's glyph rasterizer hook): View → Text → Smooth in its natural mode, anti-aliased at the size asked for and placed at quarter pixels with the font's own advances; Classic (the default) in GDI-classic mode, so each letter's hinted shape and whole-pixel width come together. Other scripts are shaped and drawn by egui.
fc7fe0579b9363e9.text: 一个按固定像素坐标绘制的 egui 窗口，外加每个对话框各一个即时视口（immediate viewport）。<x1/> 保存状态（下载、队列、设置、列表中的选择），并把菜单、工具栏、按键和 IPC 命令转换为操作。每个对话框都是独立的模块，返回一个 <x2/>（打开、关闭、带值完成）。自行弹出的窗口（下载完成、DDM 发出的消息、DDM 不在前台时的提问）会显示在其他窗口之上，但不会夺走正在输入的程序的键盘焦点（<x3/>、<x4/>）；用户主动打开的窗口则会获得键盘焦点。接连交来的窗口（下载文件信息、添加种子、下载视频）和下载完成窗口每次只显示一个，位置相同，关闭一个后再显示下一个。仅限 Windows 的调用都集中在 <x5/> 中，它们在 Linux 和 macOS 上的对应实现集中在 <x6/> 中（随会话启动、浏览器的宿主程序、声音、在文件夹中显示、崩溃处理程序）；其余所有文件都是安全、可移植的 Rust。字体来自系统：Windows 的 Fonts 文件夹、macOS 的系统字体、Linux 上的 fontconfig（<x7/>）。在 Windows 上，拉丁文、希腊文和西里尔文由 DirectWrite 绘制（<x8/>，通过 egui 的字形光栅化钩子）：视图 → 文本 → 平滑使用其自然模式，按请求的字号抗锯齿，并按字体自身的步进宽度以四分之一像素定位；经典（默认）使用 Windows 的 GDI-classic 模式，使每个字母经过微调的字形与整像素宽度保持一致。其他文字由 egui 进行字形排布和绘制。

fcd7edd5083864fc.source: The main window in the Luna theme

fd0d0a4f3f8ac0fc.source: Close / open a package, or a file's other links
fd0d0a4f3f8ac0fc.text: 折叠 / 展开一个包，或一个文件的其他链接

fd40efe02c1179f3.source: The examples use Windows' paths; on macOS and Linux the programs have the same names without <x1/>.
fd40efe02c1179f3.text: 示例使用 Windows 路径；在 macOS 和 Linux 上，程序名称相同，不带 <x1/>。

fd48ccb610778e29.source: <g1>Fit columns to content</g1> in the same menu makes every column as wide as its title and cells need; <g2>Reset columns</g2> puts them back as they first were.
fd48ccb610778e29.text: 同一菜单中的<g1>使列适应内容</g1>会让每一列的宽度刚好满足其标题和单元格所需；<g2>重置列</g2>会将它们恢复为最初的样子。

fd557623911e01e1.source: Adds an http, https, ftp or ftps address and starts it, or only queues it. It can say which folder and file name to use. A magnet link opens <g1>Add torrent</g1> in DDM, for you to choose the files.
fd557623911e01e1.text: 添加 http、https、ftp 或 ftps 地址并开始下载，或者只将其排队。它可以指定要使用的文件夹和文件名。磁力链接会在 DDM 中打开<g1>添加种子</g1>，供您选择文件。

fd63eb3e402437d2.source: <g1>First and last pieces first</g1> — with <g2>Download in order</g2>, each file's first and last pieces come before the rest. It's on by default.
fd63eb3e402437d2.text: <g1>先下载首尾分块</g1> — 启用<g2>按顺序下载</g2>时，每个文件的首尾分块会优先于其他分块下载。此功能默认开启。

fd6b36f88f676305.source: Take the selected link (or package) out of the window
fd6b36f88f676305.text: 把所选链接（或包）从窗口中移除

fd7286bca754d992.source: Not every test got faster: on a 1 GiB file the disk, not the network, set the pace, and some tests stayed within their spread. <g1>The full report</g1> has every test, curl's and aria2c's times, and the raw runs.
fd7286bca754d992.text: 并非每项测试都变快了：下载 1 GiB 的文件时，快慢取决于磁盘而不是网络，还有一些测试的差异在误差范围之内。<g1>完整报告</g1>列出了每项测试、curl 和 aria2c 的用时以及原始数据。

fd7b1524562f0431.source: Free for Windows and Linux, with a Mac version to try. One installer, then the browser extension.
fd7b1524562f0431.text: Windows 和 Linux 免费，另有可试用的 Mac 版本。一个安装程序，再加浏览器扩展。

fd876f9ac58a00f5.source: You can also paste a magnet link into <g1>Add URL</g1>, or drop a magnet link or a <x2/> file on the drop target (<g3>Tasks → Show drop target</g3>). With <g4>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g4> on, copying a magnet link opens <g5>Add torrent</g5> with it, as copying a <x6/> file's address does, while <x7/> is in <g8>Options → File types</g8>. In the browser, right-click a magnet link and choose <g9>Download with DDM</g9>: <g10>Add torrent</g10> opens with it (the extension hands over only the magnet links you choose this way). If a torrent is already in the list, DDM says so instead of adding it twice.
fd876f9ac58a00f5.text: 您也可以将磁力链接粘贴到<g1>添加 URL</g1>中，或将磁力链接或 <x2/> 文件拖放到拖放目标上（<g3>任务 → 显示拖放目标</g3>）。在<g4>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g4>开启时，复制磁力链接会用它打开<g5>添加种子</g5>，就像复制 <x6/> 文件的地址一样，前提是 <x7/> 在<g8>选项 → 文件类型</g8>中。在浏览器中，右键单击磁力链接并选择<g9>使用 DDM 下载</g9>：<g10>添加种子</g10>会随之打开（扩展只会交出您以这种方式选择的磁力链接）。如果种子已在列表中，DDM 会提示，而不会重复添加。

fd9436eee4e48316.source: To set a time, click a part of it (hours, minutes, seconds) and use the arrows, the mouse wheel, <g1>Up</g1> / <g2>Down</g2> or the number keys. <g3>Left</g3> and <g4>Right</g4> move between the parts.
fd9436eee4e48316.text: 要设置时间，请点击时间的一部分（小时、分钟、秒），然后使用箭头、鼠标滚轮、<g1>向上</g1>/<g2>向下</g2>键或数字键。<g3>向左</g3>和<g4>向右</g4>键可在各部分之间移动。

fda2cfaa8ff38501.source: Changed your mind? <g1>Options → Save to → Restore the built-in categories</g1> brings them back as they came, and leaves your own categories alone. <g2>General</g2> and <g3>Torrents</g3> still change only their folder.
fda2cfaa8ff38501.text: 改变主意了？<g1>选项 → 保存到 → 恢复内置类别</g1>可将它们恢复到初始状态，同时保留您自己的类别。<g2>常规</g2>和<g3>种子</g3>仍然只能更改其文件夹。

fda48c1e8bc723f7.source: <g1><g2>Keep some speed for everything else</g2></g1> — cap DDM so browsing and calls stay smooth.
fda48c1e8bc723f7.text: <g1><g2>为其他任务留出带宽</g2></g1> — 限制 DDM 的下载速度，让网页浏览和通话保持流畅。

fdb90e7b13e19b7f.text: DDM 的窗口显示<g1>已连接</g1>。

fdcffa742865c035.text: <g1>其他所有链接</g1>都会归入<g2>各种文件</g2>。

fdd3b365476f4122.source: You can always save a video without the button: in DDM, open <g1>Tasks → Download video from a page</g1> and paste the video's address.
fdd3b365476f4122.text: 您始终可以在没有按钮的情况下保存视频：在 DDM 中，打开<g1>任务 → 从页面下载视频</g1>并粘贴视频地址即可。

fde94fba7214be17.source: Add a download with the copied address filled in
fde94fba7214be17.text: 添加下载，已填入复制的地址

fe04554eccb8bb00.source: In the <g1>Categories</g1> tree, <g2>Up</g2> / <g3>Down</g3> choose a node, <g4>Left</g4> / <g5>Right</g5> close and open a branch, and <g6>Home</g6> / <g7>End</g7> go to the first / last node. <g8>Left</g8> on a category inside a branch goes to the branch, <g9>Right</g9> on an open branch to its first category. The selection of whichever of the two has the keys is in the selection colour, the other one's in grey.
fe04554eccb8bb00.text: 在<g1>类别</g1>树中，<g2>上</g2> / <g3>下</g3>选择节点，<g4>左</g4> / <g5>右</g5>收起和展开分支，<g6>Home</g6> / <g7>End</g7>跳到第一个 / 最后一个节点。分支内某个类别上按<g8>左</g8>回到该分支，展开的分支上按<g9>右</g9>进入其第一个类别。两者中拥有按键控制权的那一个，其选中项用选择色显示，另一个用灰色。

fe1e9bfa950043a0.source: File Properties: change the address or the folder of a download.
fe1e9bfa950043a0.text: 文件属性：更改下载的地址或文件夹。

fe61a646d618ccfe.source: <g1>Take downloads from these browsers</g1> — untick a browser to leave its downloads alone.
fe61a646d618ccfe.text: <g1>接管这些浏览器的下载</g1> — 取消勾选某个浏览器即可忽略它的下载。

fe63bdf14208dc05.source: Queues and the Scheduler — Dannex Download Manager help
fe63bdf14208dc05.text: 队列和计划程序 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

fe7544246e6d98cc.source: <g1><g2>The download list</g2></g1> — columns, filters, the categories tree, selecting many downloads, finding one, and deleting downloads with or without their files.
fe7544246e6d98cc.text: <g1><g2>下载列表</g2></g1> — 列、筛选器、类别树、选择多个下载、查找下载，以及删除下载时是否同时删除文件。

fe7ec4edd3453985.source: On the computer: <g1>Options → Remote → Pair a device...</g1> It shows a QR code, the address and an 8-digit code.
fe7ec4edd3453985.text: 在电脑上：<g1>选项 → 远程 → 配对设备...</g1> 它会显示一个二维码、地址和一个 8 位代码。

fea610c52c0ff664.source: <g1>Save to</g1>: a folder of your choice. Left empty, each file goes to its category's folder (<g2>Options → Save to</g2>), as other downloads do.
fea610c52c0ff664.text: <g1>保存到</g1>：您选择的文件夹。留空时，每个文件会像其他下载一样，保存到其类别的文件夹（<g2>选项 → 保存到</g2>）。

feaa1885a7fdd962.source: Connection: how many connections, through which network adapter.
feaa1885a7fdd962.text: 连接：通过哪个网络适配器进行多少个连接。

feb880337ed0c948.source: The real app on Windows 11. Every picture on this site is the app itself, unretouched.
feb880337ed0c948.text: Windows 11 上的真实应用。本站的每张图片都是应用本身，未经修饰。

fedfa647604c147d.source: <g1>Stop at</g1> — a time to stop the queue if it is still running.
fedfa647604c147d.text: <g1>停止于</g1> — 如果队列仍在运行，则在该时间将其停止。

ff26f3ab22a86c09.source: installs or updates gallery-dl, verified in the same way.
ff26f3ab22a86c09.text: 安装或更新 gallery-dl，并以相同方式进行验证。

ff4727ccf5f9acd0.source: The Scheduler's Schedule tab: Start at, Once on or Repeat on, and Stop at
ff4727ccf5f9acd0.text: 计划程序的“计划”选项卡：开始于、单次于或每周重复于，以及停止于

ff7459be5ff75e63.source: <g1>Chrome, Edge and Brave on Windows</g1> lock their cookies to themselves (Chrome 127 and later, "app-bound encryption"), and yt-dlp can't read them while the browser is open either. The window says so; choose Firefox, or use the button over the video, which works with any browser.
ff7459be5ff75e63.text: <g1>Windows 上的 Chrome、Edge 和 Brave</g1>将其 Cookie 锁定给自己（Chrome 127 及更高版本，“应用绑定加密”），并且在浏览器打开时 yt-dlp 也无法读取它们。窗口会显示此信息；请选择 Firefox，或使用视频上方的按钮，该按钮适用于任何浏览器。

ff91da638125787d.source: The download list with its columns: Source, File Name, Q, Size, Status, Time left, Transfer rate and more
ff91da638125787d.text: 下载列表及其列：源、文件名、队列、大小、状态、剩余时间、传输速率等

ffca4ce1942dca9b.source: <g1>A sound with no video.</g1> On a music site, a podcast or a radio's page, the button stands on the page's player bar as <g2>Download audio</g2> (<g3>Music, podcasts and radio</g3>); its menu opens on the <g4>Audio</g4> tab, and so does a YouTube Music song's: the sound as the site has it, MP3 and the other conversions.
ffca4ce1942dca9b.text: <g1>只有声音，没有视频。</g1>在音乐网站、播客或电台的页面上，按钮位于页面的播放器栏上，名为<g2>下载音频</g2>（<g3>音乐、播客和电台</g3>）；它的菜单在<g4>音频</g4>选项卡中打开，YouTube Music 的歌曲也是如此：网站原有的声音、MP3 和其他转换格式。

ffcaba42e75ae497.source: Control DDM from your phone — Dannex Download Manager help
ffcaba42e75ae497.text: 从手机控制 DDM — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

ffeedec50b9a371f.source: For a download already in the list, <g1>File Properties</g1> has the same choice beside the login: <g2>Through Real-Debrid</g2>. It can be changed while the download isn't running. The next start goes the new way, and continues from what is already downloaded when the file is the same.
ffeedec50b9a371f.text: 对于列表中已有的下载，<g1>文件属性</g1> 中登录信息旁边也有相同的选项：<g2>通过 Real-Debrid</g2>。下载未运行时可以更改此选项。下次启动时将改用新方式，并在文件相同时从已下载的部分继续。

fffd298a8c5fc91a.source: your download addresses or file names;

ffffe7806eaeae3d.source: The option is off until you tick it. On Linux and macOS DDM starts with your session the same way. A <g1>portable copy</g1> can't start with Windows, since that needs the registry, so the option is greyed there.
ffffe7806eaeae3d.text: 此选项默认关闭，勾选后启用。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 也会以同样的方式随会话启动。<g1>便携版</g1>无法随 Windows 启动，因为它需要注册表，所以该选项会显示为灰色。
